papers.title: Querying Historical k-Dense Subgraphs On Temporal graphs
papers.title_zh: 时序图上的历史 k-稠密子图查询
papers.authors: Qi Zhang, Yalong Zhang, Rong-Hua Li, Xu-Cheng  Yin, Guoren Wang
papers.abstract: Historical cohesive subgraph queries in temporal graphs identify dense substructures within snapshots corresponding to given time intervals, gaining attention due to their broad applications. Existing works primarily focus on $k$-core, which fails to consider subgraph density (measured as the ratio of edges to vertices) and may fragment natural community structures. Borradaile et al. introduced density decomposition, hierarchically organizing graphs into nested $k$-dense subgraphs, with each subgraph ensuring a minimum density of $(k-1)$. Building on this, we, for the first time, formalize and comprehensively investigate the historical $k$-dense subgraph query problem. We propose Online, which identifies $k$-dense subgraphs in the detemporal graph over the query interval by employing max-flow computation. We then present Online+ and Online++, two corepruning based algorithms that significantly reduce the number of edges requiring max-flow computation. Furthermore, three index structures are developed to support efficient query processing. Specifically, VPI leverages time interval inclusion relationships to achieve significant space savings compared to the naive index storing all $k$-dense subgraphs for all time intervals, while preserving query performance. TPI refines the structure of VPI to attain optimal query time at the cost of increased space consumption. A compromise index, TUI, reduces space usage while maintaining near-optimal query efficiency by integrating temporal inclusion relationships with the hierarchical nesting of $k$-dense subgraphs. Additionally, we propose three construction algorithms for VPI: a baseline (BasicVPI) and two optimized variants (BatInsVPI, IncInsVPI). These algorithms are later extended to construct TPI and TUI. The IndexUpdate algorithm for index maintenance is also developed. Extensive experiments and case studies demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 时序图中的历史内聚子图查询旨在识别给定时间区间所对应快照中的稠密子结构，因其广泛的应用而受到关注。现有研究主要关注 $k$-核，但该结构未考虑以边数与顶点数之比衡量的子图密度，还可能割裂自然社区。Borradaile 等人提出了密度分解，将图按层次组织为嵌套的 $k$-稠密子图，并保证每个子图的密度至少为 $(k-1)$。在此基础上，本文首次形式化定义并系统研究历史 $k$-稠密子图查询问题。我们提出 Online 算法，通过最大流计算识别查询区间对应的去时序化图中的 $k$-稠密子图；进一步提出基于核剪枝的 Online+ 和 Online++，显著减少需要进行最大流计算的边数。我们还设计了三种索引结构，以支持高效查询。与为所有时间区间存储全部 $k$-稠密子图的朴素索引相比，VPI 利用时间区间的包含关系，在保持查询性能的同时大幅节省空间；TPI 改进了 VPI 的结构，以额外空间开销换取最优查询时间；折衷方案 TUI 将时间包含关系与 $k$-稠密子图的层次嵌套关系相结合，在降低空间开销的同时保持接近最优的查询效率。此外，我们提出 VPI 的基线构建算法 BasicVPI 和两个优化版本 BatInsVPI、IncInsVPI，并将其扩展用于构建 TPI 和 TUI；同时设计 IndexUpdate 算法维护索引。大量实验和案例研究验证了所提方法的有效性与效率。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: FaScalSQL: A Fast and Scalable GPU-Accelerated SQL Query Engine for Out-of-Memory Tables
papers.title_zh: FaScalSQL：面向超出显存容量数据表的快速、可扩展 GPU 加速 SQL 查询引擎
papers.authors: Chaemin Lim, Suhyun Lee, Jinwoo Choi, Kwanghyun Park, Jinho Lee, Joonsung Kim, Youngsok Kim
papers.abstract: Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) are promising for analytical SQL query processing, but their limited memory capacity hinders processing large input tables exceeding the GPU memory. The existing engines either 1) statically split input columns into chunks and iteratively perform host-to-GPU transfer and relational operations (streaming engines), or 2) maintain a static and fixed-size cache on GPU memory and distribute input columns and their query workloads to the host CPU and a GPU (CPU-GPU distributive engines). However, we find that they suffer from two primary bottlenecks which eventually lead the engines to severe GPU underutilization: excessive host-to-GPU data movement and CPU-GPU load imbalance. We find that they arise from a conflict between their static input data placement and the dynamic progressive filtering of analytical queries. This conflict leads the engines either to transfer column values that are eventually discarded or to assign a large amount of the workload to the host CPU as the input table size scales. In this paper, we present FaScalSQL, a fast and scalable GPU-accelerated SQL query engine that overcomes the severe GPU underutilization of query processing on out-of-memory tables. FaScalSQL introduces a new type of on-demand CPU-GPU coprocessing engine which exploits both GPU-initiated data transfer and CPU-GPU co-processing capability. It replaces the static large unfiltered chunks with a dynamic GPU-initiated on-demand fetching of necessary input data, guided by the host CPU's prefiltering. We evaluate FaScalSQL with Star Schema Benchmark (SSB) and TPC-H. Using SSB with scale factors of 100 and 200, FaScalSQL achieves geometric mean speedups of 2.60× and 2.20× over the existing streaming and CPU-GPU distributive engines.
papers.abstract_zh: GPU 在分析型 SQL 查询处理中具有潜力，但显存容量有限，难以处理超出显存容量的大型输入表。现有引擎通常采用两种方式：一是将输入列静态划分为数据块，迭代执行主机到 GPU 的数据传输和关系运算，即流式引擎；二是在显存中维护固定大小的静态缓存，并将输入列及其查询工作负载分配给主机 CPU 和 GPU，即 CPU-GPU 协同分配引擎。本文发现，这些引擎存在主机到 GPU 数据传输过多以及 CPU-GPU 负载不均衡两大瓶颈，最终导致 GPU 利用率严重不足。根源在于静态输入数据布局与分析查询的动态渐进过滤之间存在冲突：引擎要么传输了最终会被过滤掉的列值，要么随着输入表规模增长，将大量工作负载分配给主机 CPU。为此，本文提出 FaScalSQL，一种面向超出显存容量数据表的快速、可扩展 GPU 加速 SQL 查询引擎。它采用新的按需 CPU-GPU 协同处理机制，同时利用 GPU 发起的数据传输和 CPU-GPU 协同处理能力。在主机 CPU 预过滤的引导下，GPU 动态按需获取必要的输入数据，替代静态的大块未过滤数据。我们使用 Star Schema Benchmark（SSB）和 TPC-H 进行评估。在 SSB 规模因子为 100 和 200 时，相比现有流式引擎和 CPU-GPU 协同分配引擎，FaScalSQL 的几何平均加速比分别达到 2.60 倍和 2.20 倍。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: GeminiSketch: An Accurate and Efficient Sketch for Summarizing Temporal Graph Streams with Rolling-out Elimination
papers.title_zh: GeminiSketch：利用滚出式淘汰实现精准高效的时序图流摘要
papers.authors: Xuyang Jing, Chenhao Zhang, Zheng Yan, Qingze Jiang, Witold Pedrycz, Mingjun Wang, Cong Wang
papers.abstract: A temporal graph stream represents a graph stream with dynamic behaviors, where the edges connecting vertices change over time. It can model a wide range of network behaviors, e.g., describing changes of subscribers in a social network, monitoring call duration within a mobile network. Analyzing the temporal graph streams needs to timely eliminate expired edges as time goes on. However, existing graph stream summarization methods inadequately handle this temporal characteristic, causing problems in query accuracy and efficiency. In this paper, we propose GeminiSketch, a novel accurate and efficient sketch to summarize temporal graph streams with Rolling-out elimination. GeminiSketch adopts a dual-matrix design to separately record graph edges based on temporal information and vertex relationship, thereby reducing the summarization error and facilitating the management of graph edges. For temporal graph queries, it can quickly access the graph information from the corresponding matrix, which addresses the efficiency problem. Furthermore, GeminiSketch employs a new Rolling-out elimination strategy to efficiently and accurately eliminate expired edges from a large number of edges in a directional way instead of a full traversal, solving the accuracy problem caused by expired edges that are not removed in time. Experimental results demonstrate that GeminiSketch significantly outperforms prior work by supporting various types of temporal graph queries, achieving smaller errors and higher process speed under same experiment settings. The source code of GeminiSketch is available on GitHub.
papers.abstract_zh: 时序图流是一类具有动态行为的图流，其顶点之间的边随时间变化，可用于建模多种网络行为，例如描述社交网络中的订阅关系变化或监测移动网络中的通话时长。分析时序图流时，需要随着时间推移及时移除过期边。然而，现有图流摘要方法对这一时间特征的处理不充分，影响了查询精度和效率。本文提出 GeminiSketch，一种利用滚出式淘汰机制构建时序图流摘要的高精度、高效率 sketch。GeminiSketch 采用双矩阵设计，分别依据时间信息和顶点关系记录图中的边，以减少摘要误差并方便边的管理。执行时序图查询时，该方法可从相应矩阵快速获取图信息，提高查询效率。此外，GeminiSketch 采用新的滚出式淘汰策略，通过定向处理而非全量遍历，从大量边中高效、准确地移除过期边，解决过期边未及时清除造成的精度问题。实验结果表明，GeminiSketch 支持多种时序图查询；在相同实验设置下，相比以往方法，其误差更小、处理速度更快。GeminiSketch 的源代码已在 GitHub 上公开。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Fast Discovery of Functional Dependencies via Bayesian Network Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过贝叶斯网络学习快速发现函数依赖
papers.authors: Siyi Yang, Shenglin Chen, Xi Wang, Yuhua Tang, Ruochun Jin
papers.abstract: Functional dependencies (FDs) are fundamental to data quality and query optimization. However, discovering highconfidence FDs from large-scale, noisy real-life datasets remains challenging, especially for those with low-support which can be early pruned. In view of this challenge, we propose BSFD, a scalable and parallel framework that leverages Bayesian network (BN) structure learning to guide the discovery of meaningful FDs with low support and high confidence $\left(\text{FD}_{\sigma, \delta} \mathrm{s}\right)$. We establish a numerical equivalence between FDs and parent-child relationships in BNs, which lays the statistical foundation of our approach. We have also proposed a stratified sampling strategy with a theoretical bound on structure correctness relative to the sampling ratio, which enables efficient BN learning with structural accuracy preserved. As for large datasets, BSFD vertically partitions the input relation into multiple smaller sub-tables using BN-derived correlated attribute sets, which significantly reduces the search space. Experiments on real-life and synthetic datasets demonstrate that BSFD achieves on average $490 \times$ and up to 7008× speedup over baseline methods while maintaining high discovery accuracy, with an average $F_{1}$ score of 0.98.
papers.abstract_zh: 函数依赖（FD）是数据质量和查询优化的基础。然而，从大规模、含噪的真实数据集中发现高置信度函数依赖仍具挑战，尤其是低支持度的函数依赖容易在搜索早期被剪枝。针对这一问题，本文提出可扩展的并行框架 BSFD，利用贝叶斯网络（BN）结构学习，指导发现具有低支持度和高置信度的有意义函数依赖 $\left(\text{FD}_{\sigma, \delta} \mathrm{s}\right)$。我们建立了函数依赖与贝叶斯网络中父子关系之间的数值等价关系，为方法提供统计基础。此外，我们提出分层采样策略，给出结构正确性与采样率关系的理论界，在保证结构准确性的同时实现高效的贝叶斯网络学习。对于大型数据集，BSFD 利用贝叶斯网络导出的相关属性集合，将输入关系按列划分为多个较小的子表，从而显著缩小搜索空间。在真实和合成数据集上的实验表明，BSFD 相比基线方法平均加速 490 倍、最高加速 7008 倍，同时保持较高的发现准确率，平均 $F_1$ 分数为 0.98。

papers.title: Approximate Butterfly Counting in Sublinear Time
papers.title_zh: 次线性时间近似蝴蝶计数
papers.authors: Chi Luo, Jiaxin Song, Yuhao Zhang, Kai Wang, Zhixing He, Kuan Yang
papers.abstract: Bipartite graphs serve as a natural model for representing relationships between two different types of entities. When analyzing bipartite graphs, butterfly counting is a fundamental research problem that aims to count the number of butterflies (i.e., 2x2 bicliques) in a given bipartite graph. While this problem has been extensively studied in the literature, existing algorithms usually necessitate access to a large portion of the entire graph, presenting challenges in real scenarios where graphs are extremely large and I/O costs are expensive. In this paper, we study the butterfly counting problem under the query model, where the following query operations are permitted: degree query, neighbor query, and vertex-pair query. We propose TLS, a practical two-level sampling algorithm that can estimate the butterfly count accurately while accessing only a limited graph structure, achieving significantly lower query costs under the standard query model. TLS also incorporates several key techniques to control the variance, including "small-degree-first sampling" and "wedge sampling via small subsets". To ensure theoretical guarantees, we further introduce two novel techniques: "heavy-light partition" and "guess-and-prove", integrated into TLS. With these techniques, we prove that the algorithm can achieve a (1+eps) accuracy for any given approximation parameter 0 < eps < 1 on general bipartite graphs with a promised time and query complexity. In particular, the promised time is sublinear when the input graph is dense enough. Extensive experiments on 15 datasets demonstrate that TLS delivers robust estimates with up to three orders of magnitude lower query costs and runtime compared to existing solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 二分图是表示两类实体之间关系的自然模型。蝴蝶计数是二分图分析中的基础问题，目标是统计给定二分图中蝴蝶（即 $2\times2$ 双团）的数量。尽管该问题已得到广泛研究，现有算法通常需要访问图中的大量结构；当图规模极大、I/O 成本高昂时，这一要求会带来挑战。本文研究查询模型下的蝴蝶计数，允许的操作包括度查询、邻居查询和顶点对查询。我们提出实用的两级采样算法 TLS，仅访问有限的图结构即可准确估计蝴蝶数量，在标准查询模型下显著降低查询开销。TLS 结合“小度优先采样”和“通过小子集进行楔形采样”等关键技术来控制方差。为提供理论保证，我们进一步提出并集成“轻重划分”和“猜测并证明”两项技术。基于这些技术，我们证明：对任意近似参数 $0<\epsilon<1$，算法在一般二分图上可达到 $(1+\epsilon)$ 近似精度，并具有有保证的时间和查询复杂度；当输入图足够稠密时，运行时间为次线性。对 15 个数据集的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，TLS 能够给出稳定的估计，查询开销和运行时间最多降低三个数量级。

papers.title: Exqutor: Extended Query Optimizer for Vector-augmented Analytical Queries
papers.title_zh: Exqutor：面向向量增强分析查询的扩展查询优化器
papers.authors: Hyunjoon Kim, Chaerim Lim, Hyeonjun An, Rathijit Sen, Kwanghyun Park
papers.abstract: Vector similarity search is becoming increasingly important for data science pipelines, particularly in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where it enhances large language model inference by enabling efficient retrieval of relevant external knowledge. As RAG expands with table-augmented generation to incorporate structured data, workloads integrating table and vector search are becoming more prevalent. However, efficiently executing such queries remains challenging due to inaccurate cardinality estimation for vector search components, leading to suboptimal query plans. In this paper, we propose Exqutor, an extended query optimizer for vector-augmented analytical queries. Exqutor is a pluggable cardinality estimation framework designed to address this issue, leveraging exact cardinality query optimization techniques to enhance estimation accuracy when vector indexes (e.g., HNSW, IVF) are available. In scenarios lacking these indexes, we employ a sampling-based approach with adaptive sampling size adjustment, dynamically tuning the sample size to balance estimation accuracy and sampling overhead. This allows Exqutor to efficiently approximate vector search cardinalities while minimizing computational costs. We integrate our framework into pgvector, VBASE, and DuckDB, demonstrating performance improvements of up to four orders of magnitude on vector-augmented analytical queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 向量相似性搜索在数据科学流程中日益重要，尤其是在检索增强生成（RAG）中，它通过高效检索相关外部知识来增强大语言模型推理。随着表增强生成被引入 RAG 以利用结构化数据，结合表查询与向量搜索的工作负载也越来越普遍。然而，向量搜索部分的基数估计不准确，容易导致次优查询计划，使此类查询难以高效执行。本文提出 Exqutor，一种面向向量增强分析查询的扩展查询优化器。Exqutor 是一个可插拔的基数估计框架：当 HNSW、IVF 等向量索引可用时，利用精确基数查询优化技术提高估计精度；当缺少这些索引时，则采用采样方法并自适应调整样本量，以平衡估计精度与采样开销。由此，Exqutor 能够以较低计算成本有效近似向量搜索的结果基数。我们将该框架集成到 pgvector、VBASE 和 DuckDB 中，实验表明，向量增强分析查询的性能最高提升四个数量级。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: RoarChain: A Robust Sharding Blockchain System for Enterprise Consortium
papers.title_zh: RoarChain：面向企业联盟的高可靠分片区块链系统
papers.authors: Yuan Sui, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang, Yujie Zhang, Lina Wang
papers.abstract: Enterprise consortium blockchains are increasingly adopted in domains such as supply chains and finance, where secure, high-throughput data storage and verifiable, highly available query services are essential. While existing solutions like ScorpioBase leverage off-chain databases and fine-grained signatures to improve data throughput, they suffer from a critical limitation: the lack of data replication makes them vulnerable to Byzantine failures, leading to permanent service unavailability when individual storage nodes fail. To address this challenge, we propose RoarChain, a robust and storage-efficient sharding system designed for permissioned blockchain environments. RoarChain introduces a novel replica placement strategy based on Balanced Incomplete Block Designs (BIBDs) to generate structured, permutation-based replica sets, achieving three key objectives: (1) high query availability under anonymous node failures, (2) minimized storage overhead for each participating organization, and (3) integrity-preserving data recovery. Unlike traditional data center techniques that rely on full replication or trusted hardware, RoarChain provides strong fault tolerance without assuming trusted infrastructure or imposing excessive redundancy. We formally prove the correctness of RoarChain's replica scheme using combinatorial theory and analyze its efficiency and robustness. Our system is implemented on a large-scale cluster, and extensive experiments demonstrate that RoarChain significantly improves service availability, reduces storage load, and achieves rapid recovery from node failures, outperforming baseline approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业联盟链日益广泛地应用于供应链、金融等领域，这些场景需要安全、高吞吐的数据存储，以及可验证、高可用的查询服务。ScorpioBase 等现有方案利用链下数据库和细粒度签名提高数据吞吐量，但存在关键局限：缺少数据副本使其易受拜占庭故障影响，单个存储节点故障就可能导致服务永久不可用。针对这一问题，本文提出 RoarChain，一种面向许可链环境、兼顾鲁棒性和存储效率的分片系统。RoarChain 提出基于平衡不完全区组设计（BIBD）的副本放置策略，生成具有结构的、基于排列的副本集合，实现三个目标：在匿名节点故障下保持较高查询可用性、降低各参与组织的存储开销，以及在数据恢复过程中保持完整性。与依赖全量复制或可信硬件的传统数据中心技术不同，RoarChain 无须假设基础设施可信，也不引入过多冗余，即可提供较强的容错能力。我们使用组合理论形式化证明副本方案的正确性，并分析其效率和鲁棒性。在大规模集群上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，RoarChain 显著提高了服务可用性，降低了存储负载，并能够在节点故障后快速恢复。

papers.title: Towards the Distributed Large-scale k-NN Graph Construction by Graph Merge
papers.title_zh: 通过图合并构建大规模分布式 k-NN 图
papers.authors: Cheng Zhang, Wan-Lei Zhao, Shihai Xiao, Jiajie Yao, Xuecang Zhang
papers.abstract: In order to support the real-time interaction with LLMs and the instant search or the instant recommendation on social media, it becomes an imminent problem to build a k-NN graph or an indexing graph for the massive number of vectorized multimedia data. In such scenarios, the scale of the data or the scale of the graph may exceed the processing capacity of a single machine. This paper aims to address the graph construction problem of such scale via efficient graph merge. For the graph construction on a single node, two generic and highly parallelizable algorithms, namely Two-way Merge and Multi-way Merge are proposed to merge subgraphs into one. For the graph construction across multiple nodes, a multi-node procedure based on Two-way Merge is presented. The procedure makes it feasible to construct a large-scale k-NN graph/indexing graph on either a single node or multiple nodes when the data size exceeds the memory capacity of one node. Extensive experiments are conducted on both large-scale k-NN graph and indexing graph construction. For the k-NN graph construction, the large-scale and high-quality k-NN graphs are constructed by graph merge in parallel. Typically, a billion-scale k-NN graph can be built in approximately 17h when only three nodes are employed. For the indexing graph construction, similar NN search performance as the original indexing graph is achieved with the merged indexing graphs while requiring much less time of construction.
papers.abstract_zh: 为支持与大语言模型的实时交互，以及社交媒体上的即时搜索或推荐，亟须针对海量向量化多媒体数据构建 k 近邻（k-NN）图或索引图。在这些场景中，数据或图的规模可能超出单机处理能力。本文旨在通过高效的图合并解决大规模图构建问题。针对单节点构图，我们提出两种通用且高度可并行化的算法——双路合并和多路合并，将多个子图合并为一个图；针对多节点构图，我们提出基于双路合并的多节点流程。当数据规模超过单节点内存容量时，该流程支持在单节点或多节点上构建大规模 k-NN 图及索引图。我们对大规模 k-NN 图和索引图构建进行了广泛实验。对于 k-NN 图，通过并行图合并可以构建大规模、高质量的图；例如，仅使用三个节点，约 17 小时即可构建十亿规模的 k-NN 图。对于索引图，合并后的索引图能够达到与原始索引图相近的近邻搜索性能，同时显著缩短构建时间。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: CSD-CoKV: Host-CSD Collaborative Offloading for High-Performance LSM-tree based KV Stores
papers.title_zh: CSD-CoKV：基于 KV 存储的高性能 LSM 树的主机-CSD 协作卸载
papers.authors: Zhining Cao, Kai Zhang, Jinrun Yang, Hui Li, Nan Su, Qian Wei, Shikun Ma, Zehao Chen, Junbo Yin, Haijun Zhang, Zhaoyan Shen
papers.abstract: LSM-tree-based key-value stores are widely used due to their write efficiency and scalability. However, their background compaction process requires substantial data movement between the host and storage devices, resulting in inefficient resource usage, frequent write stalls, and degraded overall throughput. Existing optimizations fail to address the performance bottlenecks caused by excessive system interconnect traffic. Although in-storage computing offers a promising way to mitigate data transfer overhead, prior works typically offload all compaction tasks blindly to computational storage devices. We have performed plenty of preliminary experiments and observed that such naive offloading leads to performance inefficiency due to CSD resource constraints. In this work, we propose CSD-CoKV, a novel framework that harmonizes CSD arrays with the host to accelerate LSMtree compaction more intelligently. We propose a semantic-aware offloader to selectively pick appropriate compaction jobs to CSD arrays and deploys a lightweight high-speed compaction kernel inside each CSD. Additionally, we design a CSD-friendly data partitioning scheme that leverages both KV store characteristics and CSD storage locality to achieve balanced workload distribution and improved efficiency in CSD arrays. Evaluations show that, with the same number of compaction threads, CSD-CoKV improves write throughput by up to $2.39 \times$ and boosts compaction speed by up to $3.28 \times$.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于LSM树的键值存储由于其写入效率和可扩展性而被广泛使用。然而，它们的后台压缩过程需要主机和存储设备之间进行大量数据移动，从而导致资源使用效率低下、频繁写入停顿以及整体吞吐量下降。现有的优化无法解决系统互连流量过多造成的性能瓶颈。尽管存储内计算提供了一种有前途的方法来减轻数据传输开销，但先前的工作通常将所有压缩任务盲目地卸载到计算存储设备。我们进行了大量的初步实验，发现由于 CSD 资源限制，这种简单的卸载会导致性能低下。在这项工作中，我们提出了 CSD-CoKV，这是一种新颖的框架，可以将 CSD 阵列与主机协调起来，以更智能地加速 LSMtree 压缩。我们提出了一个语义感知卸载器，可以有选择地为 CSD 阵列选择适当的压缩作业，并在每个 CSD 内部署一个轻量级高速压缩内核。此外，我们设计了一种 CSD 友好的数据分区方案，利用 KV 存储特性和 CSD 存储局部性来实现平衡的工作负载分配并提高 CSD 阵列的效率。评估表明，在相同数量的压缩线程的情况下，CSD-CoKV 的写入吞吐量和压缩速度分别最高达到原来的 2.39 倍和 3.28 倍。

papers.title: On Graph Rewiring with Motifs: a Find-and-Replace Approach
papers.title_zh: 用图案重新连接图：查找和替换方法
papers.authors: Qihao Wang, Hongtai Cao, Xiaodong Li, Matin Najafi, Kevin Chen-Chuan Chang, Reynold Cheng
papers.abstract: Homophily, which expects that similar nodes should be more likely to be connected, is desired in many graph analytics applications like community detection, node ranking, and node classification. However, real-world graphs may not have high homophily, so some existing works adopt graph rewiring to improve it. Existing graph rewiring techniques are often classified into spatial and spectral methods. Spatial rewiring captures hidden and indirect relations in the graph, while spectral rewiring optimizes diverse graph-based metrics. However, spatial rewiring often introduces dense connections, resulting in high computational costs. On the other hand, spectral rewiring fails to preserve local structures of the graph, causing significant changes in the original graphs. In this paper, we propose a motif-based graph rewiring method that has the benefits of both methods while avoiding their pitfalls. In particular, we propose a find-and-replace approach: we first find instances of motifs from the graph, where motifs are small and recurring patterns with rich semantics. Then we replace each motif instance with a new pattern generated by our algorithm. We discover an Injective Principle that controls the entire graph via the change of small motifs. We then theoretically analyze the quality of our framework. Extensive experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness and efficiency of our proposed solution. The results showed that our framework outperform existing State-of-the-Art (SOTA) rewiring and graph analytics algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 同质性，即相似的节点更有可能被连接，是许多图形分析应用程序（如社区检测、节点排名和节点分类）所需要的。然而，现实世界的图可能不具有很高的同质性，因此一些现有的工作采用图重新布线来改进它。现有的图重连技术通常分为空间方法和谱方法。空间重新布线捕获图中隐藏和间接的关系，而频谱重新布线则优化各种基于图形的指标。然而，空间重新布线通常会引入密集连接，导致计算成本较高。另一方面，谱重新布线无法保留图的局部结构，导致原始图发生显著变化。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于主题的图重新布线方法，该方法具有两种方法的优点，同时避免了它们的缺陷。特别是，我们提出了一种查找和替换方法：我们首先从图中找到主题的实例，其中主题很小且具有丰富语义的重复模式。然后我们用我们的算法生成的新模式替换每个主题实例。我们发现了一个内射原理，它通过小主题的变化来控制整个图。然后我们从理论上分析我们框架的质量。进行了大量的实验来验证我们提出的解决方案的有效性和效率。结果表明，我们的框架优于现有的最先进（SOTA）重新布线和图形分析算法。

papers.title: Conflict Resolution for Improving ML Accuracy
papers.title_zh: 解决冲突以提高机器学习准确性
papers.authors: Wenfei Fan, Xiaoyu Han, Hufsa Khan, Weilong Ren, Yaoshu Wang, Min Xie, Zihuan Xu
papers.abstract: This paper investigates how to make practical use of conflict resolution (CR) to enhance the accuracy of ML classifiers $\mathcal{M}$ on relational data. We show that applying CR to influential attributes and/or tuples can substantially improve the performance of downstream model $\mathcal{M}$. Based on this, we formulate two problems for identifying influential attributes and tuples in the data to maximize model accuracy. Although we show that both problems are intractable, we develop effective algorithms to pinpoint these critical factors. To mitigate the impact of noise introduced by imprecise CR methods, we propose a creator-critic framework that iteratively applies CR and trains $\mathcal{M}$ with the corrected data. We prove that the creator-critic process guarantees convergence to a more accurate model. Using real-life datasets, we experimentally verify that our approach improves the relative accuracy of various ML classifiers by an average of 40.5%.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了如何实际利用冲突解决（CR）来提高机器学习分类器 $\mathcal{M}$ 在关系数据上的准确性。我们证明，将 CR 应用于有影响力的属性和/或元组可以显著提高下游模型 $\mathcal{M}$ 的性能。基于此，我们提出了两个问题来识别数据中有影响的属性和元组，以最大限度地提高模型的准确性。尽管我们表明这两个问题都很棘手，但我们开发了有效的算法来查明这些关键因素。为了减轻不精确 CR 方法引入的噪声的影响，我们提出了一个创建者评论家框架，该框架迭代地应用 CR 并使用校正后的数据训练 $\mathcal{M}$。我们证明了创建者-批评者过程保证了收敛到更准确的模型。使用现实生活中的数据集，我们通过实验验证了我们的方法将各种 ML 分类器的相对准确度平均提高了 40.5%。

papers.title: MVGPT: Generative Materialized View Forecasting
papers.title_zh: MVGPT：生成物化视图预测
papers.authors: Yue Han, Guoliang Li, Wenchun Xu, Xianglei Ran, ZeYa Gong, Wei Guo, Guang Qiu, Bo Zheng
papers.abstract: Existing materialized view (MV) selection methods rely on historical queries to select MVs. However, queries are dynamically and continually changing, and it is ineffective to generate MVs based only on historical queries. To address this limitation, we propose a novel MV forecasting framework, MVGPT, which utilizes large language models (LLMs) to predict effective MVs for evolving query workloads. First, we finetune an LLM for MV forecasting, retrieve relevant events to incorporate real-time event knowledge to instruct the query workload evolution inference. We then propose a predicate-level MV model based on the Bayesian network to generate valid and effective MVs. Finally, we propose a variable set representation method as the interactive interface between the LLM and the MV model to address the risk that the LLM generates incorrect results. We have implemented our system MVGPT and deployed it into Alibaba's advertising analysis platform, and experimental results on real datasets show that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的物化视图（MV）选择方法依赖于历史查询来选择MV。然而，查询是动态且持续变化的，仅根据历史查询生成MV是无效的。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一种新颖的 MV 预测框架 MVGPT，它利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 来预测不断变化的查询工作负载的有效 MV。首先，我们对 MV 预测的 LLM 进行微调，检索相关事件以合并实时事件知识来指导查询工作负载演化推理。然后，我们提出了一种基于贝叶斯网络的谓词级 MV 模型，以生成有效且有效的 MV。最后，我们提出了一种变量集表示方法作为LLM和MV模型之间的交互接口，以解决LLM产生错误结果的风险。我们已经实现了我们的系统MVGPT并将其部署到阿里巴巴的广告分析平台中，并且在真实数据集上的实验结果表明我们的方法优于现有的最先进的方法。

papers.title: Accurate Table Question Answering with Accessible LLMs
papers.title_zh: 利用易获取的大语言模型进行准确的表格问答
papers.authors: Yangfan Jiang, Fei Wei, Ergute Bao, Yaliang Li, Bolin Ding, Yin Yang, Xiaokui Xiao
papers.abstract: Given a table T in a database and a question Q in natural language, the table question answering (TQA) task aims to return an accurate answer to Q based on the content of T. Recent state-of-the-art solutions leverage large language models (LLMs) to obtain high-quality answers. However, most rely on proprietary, large-scale LLMs with costly API access, posing a significant financial barrier. This paper instead focuses on TQA with smaller, open-weight LLMs that can run on a desktop or laptop. This setting is challenging, as such LLMs typically have weaker capabilities than large proprietary models, leading to substantial performance degradation with existing methods. We observe that a key reason for this degradation is that prior approaches often require the LLM to solve a highly sophisticated task using long, complex prompts, which exceed the capabilities of small open-weight LLMs. Motivated by this observation, we present Orchestra, a multi-agent approach that unlocks the potential of accessible LLMs for high-quality, cost-effective TQA. Orchestra coordinates a group of LLM agents, each responsible for a relatively simple task, through a structured, layered workflow to solve complex TQA problems -- akin to an orchestra. By reducing the prompt complexity faced by each agent, Orchestra significantly improves output reliability. We implement Orchestra on top of AgentScope, an open-source multi-agent framework, and evaluate it on multiple TQA benchmarks using a wide range of open-weight LLMs. Experimental results show that Orchestra achieves strong performance even with small- to medium-sized models. For example, with Qwen2.5-14B, Orchestra reaches 72.1% accuracy on WikiTQ, approaching the best prior result of 75.3% achieved with GPT-4; with larger Qwen, Llama, or DeepSeek models, Orchestra outperforms all prior methods and establishes new state-of-the-art results across all benchmarks.
papers.abstract_zh: 给定数据库中的表 T 和自然语言的问题 Q，表问答 (TQA) 任务旨在根据 T 的内容返回 Q 的准确答案。最近最先进的解决方案利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 来获得高质量的答案。然而，大多数都依赖于专有的、大规模的大语言模型，其 API 访问成本高昂，构成了重大的财务障碍。相反，本文重点关注可在台式机或笔记本电脑上运行的小型、开放式 LLM 的 TQA。这种设置具有挑战性，因为此类大语言模型的功能通常比大型专有模型更弱，导致现有方法的性能大幅下降。我们观察到，这种退化的一个关键原因是，先前的方法通常要求大语言模型使用长而复杂的提示来解决高度复杂的任务，这超出了小型开放权重大语言模型的能力。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了 Orchestra，这是一种多智能体方法，可以释放可访问的大语言模型的潜力，以实现高质量、具有成本效益的 TQA。 Orchestra 协调一组 LLM 代理，每个代理负责相对简单的任务，通过结构化、分层的工作流程来解决复杂的 TQA 问题——类似于管弦乐队。通过降低每个代理所面临的提示复杂性，Orchestra 显著提高了输出可靠性。我们在 AgentScope（一个开源多智能体框架）之上实施 Orchestra，并使用各种开放权重 LLM 在多个 TQA 基准上对其进行评估。实验结果表明，即使使用中小型模型，Orchestra 也能实现强劲的性能。例如，使用 Qwen2.5-14B，Orchestra 在 WikiTQ 上达到了 72.1% 的准确率，接近 GPT-4 达到的 75.3% 的最佳先前结果；借助更大的 Qwen、Llama 或 DeepSeek 模型，Orchestra 的性能优于所有先前的方法，并在所有基准测试中建立了新的最先进的结果。

papers.title: AutoHFormer: Efficient Hierarchical Autoregressive Transformer for Time Series Prediction
papers.title_zh: AutoHFormer：用于时间序列预测的高效分层自回归Transformer
papers.authors: Qianru Zhang, HongGang Wen, Ming Li, Dong Huang, Siu-Ming Yiu, Christian S  Jensen, Pietro Liò
papers.abstract: Time series forecasting requires architectures that simultaneously achieve three competing objectives: (1) strict temporal causality for reliable predictions, (2) sub-quadratic complexity for practical scalability, and (3) multi-scale pattern recognition for accurate long-horizon forecasting. We introduce AutoHFormer, a hierarchical autoregressive transformer that addresses these challenges through three key innovations: 1) Hierarchical Temporal Modeling: Our architecture decomposes predictions into segment-level blocks processed in parallel, followed by intra-segment sequential refinement. This dual-scale approach maintains temporal coherence while enabling efficient computation. 2) Dynamic Windowed Attention: The attention mechanism employs learnable causal windows with exponential decay, reducing complexity while preserving precise temporal relationships. This design avoids both the anti-causal violations of standard transformers and the sequential bottlenecks of RNN hybrids. 3) Adaptive Temporal Encoding: a novel position encoding system is adopted to capture time patterns at multiple scales. It combines fixed oscillating patterns for short-term variations with learnable decay rates for long-term trends. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AutoHFormer 10.76X faster training and 6.06X memory reduction compared to PatchTST on PEMS08, while maintaining consistent accuracy across 96-720 step horizons in most of cases. These breakthroughs establish new benchmarks for efficient and precise time series modeling. Implementations of our method and all baselines in hierarchical autoregressive mechanism are available at https://github.com/lizzyhku/Autotime.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列预测需要架构同时实现三个相互竞争的目标：（1）严格的时间因果关系以实现可靠的预测，（2）次二次复杂性以实现实际的可扩展性，以及（3）多尺度模式识别以实现准确的长期预测。我们引入了 AutoHFormer，这是一种分层自回归转换器，它通过三个关键创新来解决这些挑战：1）分层时间建模：我们的架构将预测分解为并行处理的段级块，然后进行段内顺序细化。这种双尺度方法保持时间一致性，同时实现高效计算。 2）动态窗口注意力：注意力机制采用具有指数衰减的可学习因果窗口，降低复杂性，同时保留精确的时间关系。这种设计避免了标准 Transformer 的反因果违规和 RNN 混合的顺序瓶颈。 3）自适应时间编码：采用一种新颖的位置编码系统来捕获多个尺度的时间模式。它将短期变化的固定振荡模式与长期趋势的可学习衰减率相结合。综合实验表明，与 PEMS08 上的 PatchTST 相比，AutoHFormer 训练速度提高了 10.76 倍，内存减少了 6.06 倍，同时在大多数情况下在 96-720 个步骤范围内保持一致的准确性。这些突破为高效、精确的时间序列建模建立了新的基准。我们的方法的实现以及分层自回归机制中的所有基线都可以在 https://github.com/lizzyhku/Autotime 上找到。

papers.title: CausalPre: Scalable and Effective Data Pre-processing for Causal Fairness
papers.title_zh: CausalPre：可扩展且有效的数据预处理以实现因果公平性
papers.authors: Ying Zheng, Yangfan Jiang, Kian-Lee Tan
papers.abstract: Causal fairness in databases is crucial to preventing biased and inaccurate outcomes in downstream tasks. While most prior work assumes a known causal model, recent efforts relax this assumption by enforcing additional constraints. However, these approaches often fail to capture broader attribute relationships that are critical to maintaining utility. This raises a fundamental question: Can we harness the benefits of causal reasoning to design efficient and effective fairness solutions without relying on strong assumptions about the underlying causal model? In this paper, we seek to answer this question by introducing CausalPre, a scalable and effective causality-guided data pre-processing framework that guarantees justifiable fairness, a strong causal notion of fairness. CausalPre extracts causally fair relationships by reformulating the originally complex and computationally infeasible extraction task into a tailored distribution estimation problem. To ensure scalability, CausalPre adopts a carefully crafted variant of low-dimensional marginal factorization to approximate the joint distribution, complemented by a heuristic algorithm that efficiently tackles the associated computational challenge. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CausalPre is both effective and scalable, challenging the conventional belief that achieving causal fairness requires trading off relationship coverage for relaxed model assumptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据库中的因果公平性对于防止下游任务中出现有偏见和不准确的结果至关重要。虽然大多数先前的工作都假设已知的因果模型，但最近的工作通过强制执行额外的约束来放松这一假设。然而，这些方法通常无法捕获对于维持效用至关重要的更广泛的属性关系。这就提出了一个基本问题：我们能否利用因果推理的优势来设计高效且有效的公平解决方案，而不依赖于对底层因果模型的强烈假设？在本文中，我们试图通过引入 CausalPre 来回答这个问题，CausalPre 是一个可扩展且有效的因果引导数据预处理框架，可保证合理的公平性，即强因果公平概念。 CausalPre 通过将原本复杂且计算上不可行的提取任务重新表述为定制的分布估计问题来提取因果公平关系。为了确保可扩展性，CausalPre 采用精心设计的低维边缘分解变体来近似联合分布，并辅之以有效解决相关计算挑战的启发式算法。对基准数据集的大量实验表明，CausalPre 既有效又可扩展，挑战了传统观念，即实现因果公平性需要权衡关系覆盖范围和宽松的模型假设。

papers.title: Evolving Sketch: Time-Decaying Frequency Estimation for Evolving Streams
papers.title_zh: 演化草图：演化流的时间衰减频率估计
papers.authors: Ge Gao, Yang Du, He Huang, Yu-E Sun, Jianzhi Tang
papers.abstract: Frequency estimation approximates element occurrences using limited memory and is fundamental in data stream processing. Traditional probabilistic sketches provide spaceefficient solutions but treat all occurrences equally regardless of timing, causing suboptimal performance when recent observations matter more than history. To address this, emerging studies have refined sketches using time-decaying methods, such as continuous decay functions and sliding window techniques. However, existing approaches typically rely on fine-tuned parameters configured in advance (such as decay coefficients or window sizes), which is often unrealistic in large-scale deployment scenarios where data streams exhibit unpredictable behaviors and holistic parameters tuning becomes prohibitively expensive. Moreover, existing studies keep these parameters fixed throughout the entire system's lifetime, which can only decay element occurrences at fixed rates and may fail to capture long-term pattern evolution. This paper introduces Evolving Sketch, a novel time-decaying frequency estimation framework that dynamically adapts its decay parameters based on real-time application feedback. Evolving Sketch consists of two main components: a decay sketch that maintains frequency estimates using time-decaying mechanisms with numerical stability guarantees, and an adapter that implements a pluggable interface supporting multiple optimization strategies from gradient-based to bandit-based methods. Such a modular design allows applications to choose the adaptation strategies that best match their specific requirements and environmental characteristics, which is verified through extensive experiments in real-world application scenarios including cache eviction and e-commerce online product ranking maintenance (maintaining a $K$-sized ranked list under time-decayed frequencies). Compared to existing approaches, Evolving Sketch can at most reduce the cache miss ratios from 26.3% to 16.7% and substantially improve ranking quality, measured by DCG, by up to 21.8%.
papers.abstract_zh: 频率估计使用有限的内存来近似元素的出现，并且是数据流处理的基础。传统的概率草图提供了节省空间的解决方案，但无论时间如何，都会平等地对待所有发生的情况，当最近的观察结果比历史更重要时，会导致性能不佳。为了解决这个问题，新兴研究使用时间衰减方法（例如连续衰减函数和滑动窗口技术）来完善草图。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于预先配置的微调参数（例如衰减系数或窗口大小），这在大规模部署场景中通常是不现实的，在大规模部署场景中，数据流表现出不可预测的行为，并且整体参数调整变得非常昂贵。此外，现有的研究在整个系统的生命周期中保持这些参数固定，这只能以固定的速率衰减元素的出现，并且可能无法捕获长期的模式演化。本文介绍了 Evolving Sketch，这是一种新颖的时间衰减频率估计框架，可根据实时应用程序反馈动态调整其衰减参数。 Evolving Sketch 由两个主要组件组成：一个衰减草图，它使用具有数值稳定性保证的时间衰减机制来维护频率估计；以及一个适配器，它实现了可插拔接口，支持从基于梯度到基于老虎机的方法的多种优化策略。这种模块化设计允许应用程序选择最符合其特定需求和环境特征的适应策略，这通过缓存驱逐和电子商务在线产品排名维护（在时间衰减频率下维护 $K$ 大小的排名列表）等实际应用场景中的大量实验得到验证。与现有方法相比，Evolving Sketch 最多可以将缓存未命中率从 26.3% 降低到 16.7%，并大幅提高 DCG 测量的排名质量高达 21.8%。

papers.title: Contextual Pattern Mining and Counting
papers.title_zh: 上下文模式挖掘和计数
papers.authors: Ling Li, Daniel Gibney, Sharma Thankachan, Solon Pissis, Grigorios Loukides
papers.abstract: Given a string $P$ of length $m$, a longer string $T$ of length $n>m$, and two integers $l \geq 0$ and $r \geq 0$, the context of $P$ in $T$ is the set of all string pairs $(L, R)$, with $\vert L\vert =l$ and $\vert R\vert =r$, such that the string $L P R$ occurs in $T$. We introduce two problems related to the notion of context: (1) the Contextual Pattern Mining (CPM) problem, which given $T$, a tuple of integers $(m, l, r)$, and an integer $\tau>0$, asks for outputting the context of each substring $P$ of length $m$ of $T$, provided that the size of the context of $P$ is at least $\tau$; and (2) the Contextual Pattern Counting (CPC) problem, which asks for preprocessing $T$ so that the size of the context of a given query string $P$ can be found efficiently. Both problems have direct applications in text mining and bioinformatics and are challenging to solve for realistically long strings. For CPM, we propose an efficient algorithm that either uses only internal memory, or a bounded amount of internal memory and external memory, which allows much larger datasets to be handled. For CPC, we propose a near-linear space index that can answer queries in near-optimal time. We further improve the practical performance of the CPC index by optimizations that exploit the LZ77 factorization of $T$ and an upper bound on the query length. Using billion-letter datasets from different domains, we show that the external memory version of our CPM algorithm can handle very large datasets using a small amount of internal memory while its runtime is comparable to that of the internal memory version. Interestingly, we also show that our optimized index for CPC outperforms an approach based on the state of the art for the reporting version of CPC in terms of all measures of efficiency, query time, index size, construction time, and construction space, often by more than an order of magnitude.
papers.abstract_zh: 给定一个长度为 $m$ 的字符串 $P$，一个长度为 $n>m$ 的较长字符串 $T$，以及两个整数 $l \geq 0$ 和 $r \geq 0$，$T$ 中 $P$ 的上下文是所有字符串对的集合$(L, R)$，其中 $\vert L\vert =l$ 和 $\vert R\vert =r$，使得字符串 $L P R$ 出现在 $T$ 中。我们引入与上下文概念相关的两个问题：（1）上下文模式挖掘（CPM）问题，给定$T$、整数元组$(m, l, r)$和整数$\tau>0$，要求输出长度为$m$的每个子字符串$P$的上下文$T$，前提是$P$的上下文大小至少为$\tau$； (2) 上下文模式计数 (CPC) 问题，该问题要求预处理 $T$，以便可以有效地找到给定查询字符串 $P$ 的上下文大小。这两个问题都直接应用于文本挖掘和生物信息学，并且对于解决实际的长字符串具有挑战性。对于 CPM，我们提出了一种有效的算法，该算法要么仅使用内部存储器，要么使用有限数量的内部存储器和外部存储器，从而允许处理更大的数据集。对于 CPC，我们提出了一种近线性空间索引，可以在近乎最佳的时间内回答查询。我们通过利用 $T$ 的 LZ77 分解和查询长度上限的优化，进一步提高了 CPC 索引的实际性能。使用来自不同领域的十亿个字母的数据集，我们表明我们的 CPM 算法的外部存储器版本可以使用少量内部存储器处理非常大的数据集，而其运行时间与内部存储器版本相当。有趣的是，我们还表明，我们的 CPC 优化索引在效率、查询时间、索引大小、构建时间和构建空间的所有指标方面都优于基于 CPC 报告版本的最新技术的方法，通常高出一个数量级以上。

papers.title: Compressing High-Frequency Time Series Through Multiple Models and Stealing from Residuals
papers.title_zh: 通过多个模型压缩高频时间序列并窃取残差
papers.authors: Abduvoris Abduvakhobov, Soeren Kejser Jensen, Christian Thomsen, Torben Bach Pedersen
papers.abstract: Wind turbines are equipped with high-quality sensors that generate vast volumes of high-frequency time series. The time series are ingested on the edge and transferred to the cloud for later analytics. This process is complicated by challenges like low network bandwidth and high cloud storage costs. ModelarDB was proposed as a solution to efficiently manage time series across the entire pipeline by using so-called models for lossless or error-bounded lossy compression of time series. However, ModelarDB’s compression can be further improved through: 1) avoiding models that only represent few values by storing residuals (i.e., values that models fail to compress) explicitly with them; 2) exploiting error bounds even more through preprocessing; and 3) timestamp compression specialized for regular and irregular time series. We propose the multi-model compression method Fauna which uses 1) the novel model fitting method Platypus; 2) PMC and Swing for compressing values and; 3) the novel Macaque for compressing residuals and timestamps. Platypus is a model fitting method that uses different models for specialized compression of values and residuals. We then evaluate state-of-the-art lossless compression methods for 32-bit floats and propose preprocessing methods to add support for error-bounded compression. We present Macaque that includes MacaqueV and MacaqueTS. MacaqueV modifies Facebook Gorilla’s lossless compression method for 32-bit floats (GorillaV) and combines it with our novel preprocessing methods to now also enable error-bounded lossy compression. MacaqueTS is a lossless compression method for timestamps. Using only Platypus reduces ModelarDB’s storage use by up to 1.8x and significantly simplifies using the system. While also up to 7x better for lossless compression, ModelarDB with Fauna uses up to 2.5x less storage than ModelarDB and up to 14.5x, 7.2x, 17.5x and 14.2x less storage than ClickHouse, Apache IoTDB, Apache Parquet and TimescaleDB, respectively, with a realistic 1% error bound.
papers.abstract_zh: 风力涡轮机配备了高质量传感器，可生成大量高频时间序列。时间序列在边缘获取并传输到云端以供后续分析。由于网络带宽低和云存储成本高等挑战，这一过程变得复杂。 ModelarDB 被提出作为一种解决方案，通过使用所谓的模型对时间序列进行无损或误差有限有损压缩，来有效管理整个管道中的时间序列。然而，ModelarDB 的压缩可以通过以下方式进一步改进：1）通过显式存储残差（即模型无法压缩的值）来避免仅表示少量值的模型； 2）通过预处理更多地利用误差界限； 3）专门针对规则和不规则时间序列的时间戳压缩。我们提出了多模型压缩方法 Fauna，它使用 1）新颖的模型拟合方法 Platypus； 2) PMC 和 Swing 用于压缩值； 3）新颖的Macaque用于压缩残差和时间戳。 Platypus 是一种模型拟合方法，它使用不同的模型对值和残差进行专门的压缩。然后，我们评估 32 位浮点数最先进的无损压缩方法，并提出预处理方法来添加对误差有限压缩的支持。我们推出的 Macaque 包括 MacaqueV 和 MacaqueTS。 MacaqueV 修改了 Facebook Gorilla 的 32 位浮点数无损压缩方法 (GorillaV)，并将其与我们新颖的预处理方法相结合，现在还可以实现误差有限的有损压缩。 MacaqueTS 是一种时间戳的无损压缩方法。仅使用 Platypus 可将 ModelarDB 的存储使用量减少高达 1.8 倍，并显著简化系统的使用。虽然无损压缩性能也提高了 7 倍，但带有 Fauna 的 ModelarDB 使用的存储空间比 ModelarDB 少了 2.5 倍，比 ClickHouse、Apache IoTDB、Apache Parquet 和 TimescaleDB 分别少了 14.5 倍、7.2 倍、17.5 倍和 14.2 倍，并且误差范围实际为 1%。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Compressed and Encrypted Text Direct Processing
papers.title_zh: 压缩加密文本直接处理的统一框架
papers.authors: Yani Liu, Feng Zhang, Yu Zhang, Siqi Ma, Elisa Bertino, Xiaoyong Du
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of textual data calls for systems that can efficiently manage large-scale text, while the need to safeguard text privacy has become increasingly urgent. Homomorphic encryption enables computation directly on encrypted data but incurs significant ciphertext expansion and high storage and computation costs. Compression, by exploiting redundancy, reduces storage and transmission overhead, and homomorphic compression further allows direct processing without decompression. Combining these techniques offers a promising path to both privacy and efficiency. We propose Double Homomorphism, a novel theoretical framework that integrates compression and encryption to support direct processing of doubly-encoded textual data without the need for decoding. To demonstrate its practicality, we design DOHO, a text management system built upon the DH framework. DOHO supports direct modification, random access, and analysis over compressed and encrypted textual data. We evaluate DOHO using five real-world textual datasets. In the efficiency-prioritized setting, DOHO achieves up to 69.04× throughput improvement for text modification, 3.54× speedup for text analysis, and 3.75× enhancement in space efficiency compared to uncompressed solutions. In the privacyprioritized setting, DOHO outperforms state-of-the-art FHEbased methods, delivering $\mathbf{1 0 8. 0 5} \times$ throughput improvement for text modification, $\mathbf{9. 6 9} \times$ speedup for text analysis, and $\mathbf{1 2. 0 6} \times$ space efficiency improvement.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本数据的快速增长呼唤能够高效管理大规模文本的系统，同时保护文本隐私的需求也变得越来越迫切。同态加密可以直接对加密数据进行计算，但会带来显著的密文扩展以及较高的存储和计算成本。压缩通过利用冗余来减少存储和传输开销，并且同态压缩进一步允许直接处理而无需解压缩。结合这些技术为隐私和效率提供了一条有希望的途径。我们提出了双重同态，这是一种新颖的理论框架，它集成了压缩和加密，支持直接处理双重编码的文本数据，而无需解码。为了展示其实用性，我们设计了DOHO，一个基于DH框架构建的文本管理系统。 DOHO支持对压缩和加密文本数据的直接修改、随机访问和分析。我们使用五个真实世界的文本数据集来评估 DOHO。在效率优先的设置中，与未压缩的解决方案相比，DOHO 的文本修改吞吐量提高了 69.04 倍，文本分析速度提高了 3.54 倍，空间效率提高了 3.75 倍。在隐私优先设置中，DOHO 优于最先进的基于 FHE 的方法，为文本修改提供 $\mathbf{1 0 8. 0 5} \times$ 吞吐量改进，$\mathbf{9. 6 9} \times$ 文本分析加速，以及 $\mathbf{1 2. 0 6} \times$ 空间效率提高。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Sketch Disaggregation: Streaming Analytics with Heterogeneous Resources
papers.title_zh: 时空素描分解：异构资源的流分析
papers.authors: Jonatan Langlet, Peiqing Chen, Michael Mitzenmacher, Zaoxing Liu, Ran Ben Basat, Gianni Antichi
papers.abstract: Streaming analytics are essential in a large range of applications, including databases, networking, and machine learning. To optimize performance, practitioners are increasingly offloading such analytics to network nodes such as switches. However, resources such as fast SRAM memory available at switches are limited, not uniform, and may serve other functionalities as well (e.g., firewall). Moreover, resource availability changes over time due to the dynamic demands of in-network applications. In this paper, we propose a new approach to disaggregating data structures, leveraging any residual resources available at network nodes. We focus on sketches, which are fundamental for summarizing data for streaming analytics while providing beneficial space-accuracy tradeoffs. Our idea is to break sketches into multiple 'fragments' that are placed at different network nodes. The fragments cover different time periods and vary in size, and are combined to form a network-wide view of the underlying traffic. We apply our solution to three popular sketches (namely, Count Sketch, Count-Min Sketch, and UnivMon) and demonstrate that we can achieve approximately a 75% memory size reduction for the same error for many queries, or a near order-of-magnitude error reduction if memory is kept unchanged. Further, we demonstrate real-world feasibility through a hardware pipeline for high-speed commodity switches.
papers.abstract_zh: 流分析在数据库、网络和机器学习等大量应用中至关重要。为了优化性能，从业者越来越多地将此类分析卸载到交换机等网络节点。然而，诸如交换机上可用的快速 SRAM 存储器之类的资源是有限的、不统一的，并且还可以服务于其他功能（例如，防火墙）。此外，由于网络内应用程序的动态需求，资源可用性随着时间的推移而变化。在本文中，我们提出了一种分解数据结构的新方法，利用网络节点上可用的任何剩余资源。我们专注于草图，这是总结流分析数据的基础，同时提供有益的空间精度权衡。我们的想法是将草图分成多个“片段”，放置在不同的网络节点上。这些片段涵盖不同的时间段且大小各异，组合起来形成底层流量的全网视图。我们将我们的解决方案应用于三个流行的草图（即 Count Sketch、Count-Min Sketch 和 UnivMon），并证明对于许多查询的相同错误，我们可以实现大约 75% 的内存大小减少，或者如果内存保持不变，则可以实现接近数量级的错误减少。此外，我们通过高速商品交换机的硬件管道展示了现实世界的可行性。

papers.title: L4G: Two-hop Label Management for Group Steiner Tree Search on Graphs
papers.title_zh: L4G：图上组 Steiner 树搜索的两跳标签管理
papers.authors: Xiaoyao Feng, Yahui Sun, Zhuoran Wang, Junlin Li, Sijia Luo, Rong-Hua Li
papers.abstract: Finding group Steiner trees (GSTs) is widely utilized for keyword search in relational databases. Current methods often build GSTs by querying and merging shortest paths. Some recent work explores the possibility of employing shortest path indexes, i.e., 2-hop labels, to speed up GST search, but fails to achieve a constant and effective GST search acceleration. We present a new GST-customized label management scheme to address this issue. First, to speed up GST search more effectively, we propose a novel label generation algorithm, which avoids producing unused labels in GST scenarios when indexing the graph with mock vertices that represent candidate groups in possible GST search tasks. Second, to maintain labels at a higher speed in dynamic cases, we develop an original batch-friendly label maintenance framework, which contains a unique integrated label update process that is carefully designed to reduce redundant operations. We conduct experiments on various real datasets to demonstrate the usefulness of this work: (i) different from the current approach that usually fails to accelerate GST search, our techniques support a constant GST search speedup of more than 3 orders of magnitude; and (ii) in comparison with the state-of-the-art methods that could be inefficient to repair labels when users change data frequently, our techniques are usually an order of magnitude faster to maintain labels in GST cases, by often reducing more than 90% of redundant operations.
papers.abstract_zh: 查找群斯坦纳树 (GST) 广泛用于关系数据库中的关键字搜索。当前的方法通常通过查询和合并最短路径来构建 GST。最近的一些工作探索了采用最短路径索引（即 2 跳标签）来加速 GST 搜索的可能性，但未能实现持续有效的 GST 搜索加速。我们提出了一种新的 GST 定制标签管理方案来解决这个问题。首先，为了更有效地加速 GST 搜索，我们提出了一种新颖的标签生成算法，当使用表示可能的 GST 搜索任务中的候选组的模拟顶点对图进行索引时，可以避免在 GST 场景中生成未使用的标签。其次，为了在动态情况下以更高的速度维护标签，我们开发了独创的批量友好的标签维护框架，其中包含独特的集成标签更新流程，经过精心设计，以减少冗余操作。我们对各种真实数据集进行了实验，以证明这项工作的有用性：（i）与当前通常无法加速 GST 搜索的方法不同，我们的技术支持恒定的 GST 搜索加速超过 3 个数量级； (ii) 与当用户频繁更改数据时修复标签效率低下的最先进方法相比，我们的技术在 GST 情况下维护标签的速度通常要快一个数量级，通常可以减少 90% 以上的冗余操作。

papers.title: MICRO: A Lightweight Middleware for Optimizing  Cross-store Cross-model Graph-Relation Joins
papers.title_zh: MICRO：用于优化跨商店跨模型图关系连接的轻量级中间件
papers.authors: Xiuwen Zheng, Arun Kumar, Amarnath Gupta
papers.abstract: Modern data applications increasingly involve heterogeneous data managed in different models and stored across disparate database engines, often deployed as separate installs. Limited research has addressed cross-model query processing in federated environments. This paper takes a step toward bridging this gap by: (1) formally defining a class of cross-model join queries between a graph store and a relational store by proposing a unified algebra; (2) introducing one real-world benchmark and four semi-synthetic benchmarks to evaluate such queries; and (3) proposing a lightweight middleware, MICRO, for efficient query execution. At the core of MICRO is CMLero, a learning-torank-based query optimizer that selects efficient execution plans without requiring exact cost estimation. By avoiding the need to materialize or convert all data into a single model-which is often infeasible due to third-party data control or cost-MICRO enables native querying across heterogeneous systems. Experimental results on the benchmark workloads demonstrate that MICRO outperforms the state-of-the-art federated relational system XDB by up to 2.1× in total runtime across the full test set. On the 93 test queries of real-world benchmark, 14 queries achieve over 10× speedup, including 4 queries with more than 100× speedup; however, 4 queries experienced slowdowns of over 5 seconds, highlighting opportunities for future improvement of MICRO. Further comparisons show that CMLero consistently outperforms rule-based and regression-based optimizers, highlighting the advantage of learning-to-rank in complex crossmodel optimization.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代数据应用程序越来越多地涉及在不同模型中管理并存储在不同数据库引擎中的异构数据，通常作为单独安装进行部署。有限的研究涉及联合环境中的跨模型查询处理。本文通过以下方式迈出了弥合这一差距的一步：（1）通过提出统一代数，正式定义图存储和关系存储之间的一类跨模型连接查询； (2) 引入一个真实世界基准和四个半合成基准来评估此类查询； (3) 提出一种轻量级中间件 MICRO，以实现高效的查询执行。 MICRO 的核心是 CMLero，它是一种基于学习排序的查询优化器，可以选择高效的执行计划，而不需要精确的成本估计。通过避免将所有数据具体化或转换为单一模型的需要（由于第三方数据控制或成本而这通常是不可行的），MICRO 可以实现跨异构系统的本机查询。基准工作负载的实验结果表明，在整个测试集中，MICRO 的总运行时间比最先进的联合关系系统 XDB 提高了 2.1 倍。在真实世界基准测试的 93 个测试查询中，有 14 个查询实现了超过 10 倍的加速，其中 4 个查询实现了超过 100 倍的加速；然而，有 4 个查询的速度慢了超过 5 秒，这凸显了 MICRO 未来改进的机会。进一步的比较表明，CMLero 始终优于基于规则和基于回归的优化器，凸显了学习排序在复杂的跨模型优化中的优势。

papers.title: SwitchDelta: Asynchronous Metadata Updating for Distributed Storage with In-Network Data Visibility
papers.title_zh: SwitchDelta：具有网络内数据可见性的分布式存储的异步元数据更新
papers.authors: Junru Li, Qing Wang, Zhe Yang, Shuo Liu, Jiwu Shu, Youyou Lu
papers.abstract: Distributed storage systems typically maintain strong consistency between data nodes and metadata nodes by adopting ordered writes: 1) first installing data; 2) then updating metadata to make data visible.We propose SwitchDelta to accelerate ordered writes by moving metadata updates out of the critical path. It buffers in-flight metadata updates in programmable switches to enable data visibility in the network and retain strong consistency. SwitchDelta uses a best-effort data plane design to overcome the resource limitation of switches and designs a novel metadata update protocol to exploit the benefits of in-network data visibility. We evaluate SwitchDelta in three distributed in-memory storage systems: log-structured key-value stores, file systems, and secondary indexes. The evaluation shows that SwitchDelta reduces the latency of write operations by up to 52.4% and boosts the throughput by up to 126.9% under write-heavy workloads.
papers.abstract_zh: 分布式存储系统通常采用有序写入的方式来维持数据节点和元数据节点之间的强一致性：1）先安装数据； 2）然后更新元数据以使数据可见。我们建议SwitchDelta通过将元数据更新移出关键路径来加速有序写入。它在可编程交换机中缓冲正在进行的元数据更新，以实现网络中的数据可见性并保持强一致性。 SwitchDelta 使用尽力而为的数据平面设计来克服交换机的资源限制，并设计了一种新颖的元数据更新协议来利用网络内数据可见性的优势。我们在三种分布式内存存储系统中评估 SwitchDelta：日志结构键值存储、文件系统和二级索引。评估结果显示，在写入密集型工作负载下，SwitchDelta可将写入操作的延迟降低高达52.4%，并将吞吐量提升高达126.9%。

papers.title: DIndex: An Efficient On-Disk Learned Index for Memory-Constrained Environments
papers.title_zh: DIndex：适用于内存受限环境的高效磁盘学习索引
papers.authors: Jiahuan Shen, Chuzhe Tang, Haoning Lan, Ren Ren, Zhaoguo Wang
papers.abstract: B+trees, the de facto standard for on-disk database indexing, exhibit significant performance degradation in memoryconstrained environments due to frequent disk I/O that accesses out-of-cache index nodes during tree traversal. The recent proposal of in-memory learned indexes promises substantial reductions in index footprint by replacing traditional hierarchical structures with compact learned models. However, they require sorted data layouts for accurate lookups, which are costly to maintain on disks, especially in the presence of writes. So far, attempts to adapt learned indexes for on-disk use have yet to fully realize the performance benefits of learned models: they either incur massive disruptive data movement to maintain data layout or introduce significant metadata overhead that negates the space advantage of learned models. We present DIndex, a new on-disk learned index tailored for memory-constrained environments. DIndex efficiently supports write operations while maintaining high read performance and low index size. Key to DIndex's design is the decoupling of logical ordering from physical data layout and a set of techniques that realize this decoupling with small metadata overhead. Specifically, DIndex proposes to maintain model-compressed pivot keys to guide error correction and a mapping table that associates data blocks' physical locations using an adaptive, variable-span mapping scheme. Experiments show that DIndex outperforms B+tree and other learned indexes by up to 28× in throughput and reduces index size by up to 99%.
papers.abstract_zh: B+树是磁盘数据库索引的事实上的标准，但由于在树遍历期间访问缓存外索引节点的频繁磁盘 I/O，B+树在内存受限的环境中表现出显著的性能下降。最近提出的内存学习索引有望通过用紧凑的学习模型取代传统的分层结构来大幅减少索引占用空间。然而，它们需要排序的数据布局才能进行准确的查找，这在磁盘上维护成本很高，尤其是在存在写入的情况下。到目前为止，调整学习索引以适应磁盘使用的尝试尚未完全实现学习模型的性能优势：它们要么会产生大量破坏性数据移动以维护数据布局，要么会引入大量元数据开销，从而抵消学习模型的空间优势。我们推出了 DIndex，这是一种专为内存受限环境量身定制的新磁盘学习索引。 DIndex 有效支持写入操作，同时保持高读取性能和低索引大小。 DIndex 设计的关键是将逻辑顺序与物理数据布局解耦，以及一组以较小的元数据开销实现这种解耦的技术。具体来说，DIndex 建议维护模型压缩的主键来指导纠错，以及使用自适应、可变跨度映射方案关联数据块的物理位置的映射表。实验表明，DIndex 的吞吐量比 B+tree 和其他学习索引高出 28 倍，并减少索引大小高达 99%。

papers.title: Federated Retrieval over Embedding-Heterogeneous Vector Databases
papers.title_zh: 嵌入异构向量数据库的联合检索
papers.authors: Yuxiang Wang, Yongxin Tong, Zimu Zhou, Ziyuan He, Ruixi Hu, Ke Xu
papers.abstract: Vector databases are increasingly used to manage unstructured data by mapping them into high-dimensional embeddings and enabling efficient similarity retrieval. Many realworld applications, such as legal document retrieval and medical question answering, require embedding-based retrieval in federated environments where data are distributed across autonomous silos. We formulate this setting as Federated Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (FANNS), where a server issues a query along with a query embedding model, aiming to retrieve the top- $k$ nearest objects from datasets across all silos. A key challenge in FANNS is embedding heterogeneity, where silos and the server employ different embedding models, a problem overlooked in prior research. To address this challenge, we exploit the nonIID nature of federated data and propose two novel adaptive algorithms for FANNS queries. The first is a competition-based method that dynamically adjusts retrieval sizes across silos, though it can be sensitive to misleading candidates. The second is a contribution-based method that samples promising silos based on their accumulated contributions, and we provide theoretical guarantees on its latency reduction. Evaluations on four datasets show that our method achieves over 90% retrieval accuracy and $\mathbf{2. 3} \times$ to $\mathbf{6. 2} \times$ speedups over existing solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 矢量数据库越来越多地用于通过将非结构化数据映射到高维嵌入并实现高效的相似性检索来管理非结构化数据。许多现实世界的应用程序，例如法律文档检索和医疗问答，需要在数据分布在自治孤岛的联合环境中进行基于嵌入的检索。我们将此设置表述为联合近似最近邻搜索 (FANNS)，其中服务器发出查询以及查询嵌入模型，旨在从所有孤岛的数据集中检索前 $k$ 个最近的对象。 FANNS 的一个关键挑战是嵌入异构性，其中孤岛和服务器采用不同的嵌入模型，这是先前研究中忽视的一个问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们利用联合数据的非独立同分布性质，提出了两种新颖的 FANNS 查询自适应算法。第一种是基于竞争的方法，可以跨孤岛动态调整检索大小，尽管它可能对误导候选者很敏感。第二种是基于贡献的方法，根据累积的贡献对有前途的孤岛进行采样，并且我们为其延迟减少提供了理论保证。对四个数据集的评估表明，我们的方法实现了 90% 以上的检索准确率，与现有方案相比速度提升了 $2.3\times$ 至 $6.2\times$。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: LogDelta: Differential Encoding for Log Data
papers.title_zh: LogDelta：日志数据的差分编码
papers.authors: Songze Li, Shaoxu Song, Zhitao Shen
papers.abstract: System logs are critical for understanding the performance of various software systems. Compression is essential to efficient storage or transmission of system log data. Generalpurpose compressors like LZMA treat logs as binary data, ignoring their structure, and thus fail to achieve the best compression. The semi-structured nature of log data leads to parser-based methods, which however require extra space for storing templates. We observe that although log data exhibit high similarity, the repetitions are extremely scattered. Rather than storing the vast positions or complicated templates for short repetitions, we propose to merge them as one large difference between log records. Inspired by the differential encoding for numerical data, we propose LogDelta, a novel differential encoding method for log data. The compression task is formulated as an optimization problem to minimize the cost of differential operations from one log record to another. By replaying such differential operations, each log record can be reconstructed in decompression. While a dynamic programming algorithm is developed, we further propose a linear time approximation, delivering comparable compression ratio as the optimal solution. Experimental results on real world system logs demonstrate that LogDelta achieves superior compression ratios while maintaining comparable compression speeds.
papers.abstract_zh: 系统日志对于了解各种软件系统的性能至关重要。压缩对于系统日志数据的有效存储或传输至关重要。像 LZMA 这样的通用压缩器将日志视为二进制数据，忽略其结构，因此无法实现最佳压缩。日志数据的半结构化性质导致了基于解析器的方法，然而，这需要额外的空间来存储模板。我们观察到，虽然日志数据表现出很高的相似性，但重复却极其分散。我们建议将它们合并为日志记录之间的一大差异，而不是存储大量位置或复杂的模板以进行短暂重复。受数值数据差分编码的启发，我们提出了 LogDelta，一种新颖的日志数据差分编码方法。压缩任务被表述为一个优化问题，以最小化从一个日志记录到另一个日志记录的差异操作的成本。通过重放这样的差分操作，可以在解压中重建每条日志记录。在开发动态编程算法的同时，我们进一步提出了线性时间近似，提供可比较的压缩比作为最佳解决方案。现实世界系统日志的实验结果表明，LogDelta 实现了卓越的压缩比，同时保持了相当的压缩速度。

papers.title: Secure Query Processing with Linear Online Cost
papers.title_zh: 具有线性在线成本的安全查询处理
papers.authors: Qiyao Luo, Yilei Wang, Wei Dong, Ke Yi
papers.abstract: Query processing under the secure multi-party computation (MPC) model has received increasing attention in recent years. However, all existing MPC query processing algorithms incur a cost of $\Omega(n \log n)$, due to the use of secure sorting. While secure sorting is believed to be inevitable, we observe that it can be moved to a one-time preprocessing stage. By doing so, we manage to reduce the online cost of each subsequent query to linear for free-connex queries, a large class of select-project-joinaggregation queries. This matches the plaintext result for query processing, as free-connex queries are the largest class of queries known to be solvable in linear time on plaintext. We have then built SLOOP, a Secure Linear Online cOst query Processing system. Experimental results show that SLOOP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while supporting a much broader class of queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 安全多方计算（MPC）模型下的查询处理近年来受到越来越多的关注。然而，由于使用安全排序，所有现有的 MPC 查询处理算法都会产生 $\Omega(n \log n)$ 的成本。虽然安全排序被认为是不可避免的，但我们观察到它可以转移到一次性预处理阶段。通过这样做，我们设法将每个后续查询的在线成本降低到线性自由连接查询（一大类选择项目加入聚合查询）。这与查询处理的明文结果匹配，因为自由连接查询是已知可在明文线性时间内解决的最大类查询。然后我们构建了 SLOOP，一个安全线性在线成本查询处理系统。实验结果表明，SLOOP 的性能显著优于最先进的方法，同时支持更广泛的查询类别。

papers.title: VisPoison: An Effective Backdoor Attack Framework for Tabular Data Visualization Models
papers.title_zh: VisPoison：表格数据可视化模型的有效后门攻击框架
papers.authors: Shuaimin Li, Chen Jason Zhang, Xuanang  Chen, Anni Peng, Zhuoyue Wan, Yuanfeng  Song, Shiwen  Ni, Min  Yang, Fei Hao, Raymond Chi-Wing  Wong
papers.abstract: Text-to-visualization (text-to-vis) models for tabular data have become essential tools in the era of big data, enabling users to generate visualizations and make data-driven decisions through natural language queries (NLQs). Despite their growing adoption, the security vulnerabilities of these models remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose VisPoison, a backdoor attack framework that realistically simulates three types of attacks on text-to-vis models via data poisoning: data exposure, misleading visualizations, and denial-of-service (DoS). Specifically, VisPoison introduces two types of stealthy triggers to enable both proactive and passive backdoor activations. Proactive triggers are deliberately inserted by attackers using rare-word patterns to extract sensitive information, whereas passive triggers are unintentionally activated by users through first-word prompts, resulting in visualization errors or DoS failures. To support these triggers, we craft specialized payloads for visualization queries that allow compromised models to function normally on benign inputs while producing malicious outputs in the presence of triggers. Extensive evaluations on both trainable and in-context learning (ICL)-based text-to-vis models show that VisPoison achieves attack success rates exceeding 90\%, exposing serious vulnerabilities. Additionally, existing defense strategies reveal limited effectiveness against VisPoison, underscoring the urgent need for more robust and security-aware text-to-vis systems to safeguard human-data interaction.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据的文本到可视化（text-to-vis）模型已成为大数据时代的重要工具，使用户能够生成可视化并通过自然语言查询（NLQ）做出数据驱动的决策。尽管它们的采用率越来越高，但这些模型的安全漏洞在很大程度上仍未得到探索。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 VisPoison，这是一种后门攻击框架，可以通过数据中毒真实地模拟对文本到可见模型的三种类型的攻击：数据暴露、误导性可视化和拒绝服务 (DoS)。具体来说，VisPoison 引入了两种类型的隐形触发器来启用主动和被动后门激活。主动触发器是攻击者使用罕见单词模式故意插入的，以提取敏感信息，而被动触发器是用户通过第一个单词提示无意中激活的，从而导致可视化错误或 DoS 失败。为了支持这些触发器，我们为可视化查询制作了专门的有效负载，允许受损模型在良性输入上正常运行，同时在存在触发器的情况下产生恶意输出。对基于可训练和上下文学习 (ICL) 的文本到可见模型的广泛评估表明，VisPoison 的攻击成功率超过 90%，暴露了严重的漏洞。此外，现有的防御策略显示针对 VisPoison 的有效性有限，这凸显了迫切需要更强大且具有安全意识的文本到可见系统来保护人类数据交互。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: PRO-HNSW: Proactive Repair and Optimization for High-Performance Dynamic HNSW Indexes
papers.title_zh: PRO-HNSW：高性能动态 HNSW 索引的主动修复和优化
papers.authors: Huijun Jin, Jieun Lee, Shengmin Piao, Sangmin  Seo, Sanghyun Park
papers.abstract: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS), particularly using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs, offers state-of-the-art query performance for large-scale, high-dimensional data. However, the efficiency and accuracy of HNSW indexes degrade seriously under dynamic conditions involving frequent data deletions and reinsertions, often necessitating costly full index rebuilds. This paper introduces PRO-HNSW (Proactive Repair and Optimized HNSW), a novel and lightweight maintenance framework designed to efficiently preserve and even enhance the quality of the HNSW graph in dynamic environments. PRO-HNSW systematically addresses key structural degradation factors by incorporating three targeted modules: (1) a RemoveObsoleteEdges module to prune edges pointing to deleted nodes while preserving minimal connectivity, (2) a RepairDisconnectedNodes module that re-establishes connectivity for isolated nodes via BFS-based neighbor discovery, and (3) a ResolveUnidirectionalEdges module to ensure more balanced and navigable graph structures. Extensive experiments on eight diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that PRO-HNSW significantly outperforms not only the standard HNSW but also the state-of-the-art MN-RU method. Notably, on the high-dimensional GIST1M dataset under high data churn, PRO-HNSW achieves a peak recall of 84.23%, a significant 2.56 percentage points higher than even the ideal HNSW-Rebuild baseline, showcasing its superior ability to produce a more optimal graph structure. Our findings also reveal that applying specific PRO-HNSW maintenance modules to a freshly built static HNSW index can improve its initial recall, highlighting its utility as a general graph optimization technique. PRO-HNSW thus provides a practical and robust solution for maintaining highperformance ANNS in evolving real-world applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的近似最近邻搜索 (ANNS)，特别是使用分层可导航小世界 (HNSW) 图，为大规模、高维数据提供最先进的查询性能。然而，在涉及频繁数据删除和重新插入的动态条件下，HNSW 索引的效率和准确性会严重下降，通常需要昂贵的全索引重建。本文介绍了 PRO-HNSW（主动修复和优化 HNSW），这是一种新颖的轻量级维护框架，旨在有效地保存甚至增强动态环境中 HNSW 图的质量。 PRO-HNSW 通过合并三个目标模块来系统地解决关键的结构退化因素：（1）RemoveObsoleteEdges 模块，用于修剪指向已删除节点的边缘，同时保留最小连接性；（2）RepairDisconnectedNodes 模块，通过基于 BFS 的邻居发现重新建立隔离节点的连接性；（3）ResolveUnidirectiveEdges 模块，以确保更加平衡和可导航的图形结构。对八个不同基准数据集的大量实验表明，PRO-HNSW 不仅明显优于标准 HNSW，而且还优于最先进的 MN-RU 方法。值得注意的是，在高数据流失率下的高维 GIST1M 数据集上，PRO-HNSW 达到了 84.23% 的峰值召回率，比理想的 HNSW-Rebuild 基线高出 2.56 个百分点，展示了其生成更优化图结构的卓越能力。我们的研究结果还表明，将特定的 PRO-HNSW 维护模块应用于新构建的静态 HNSW 索引可以提高其初始召回率，突出其作为通用图形优化技术的实用性。因此，PRO-HNSW 提供了实用且强大的解决方案，用于在不断发展的现实应用中维持高性能 ANN。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: Promoting Fairness in Information Access within Social Networks
papers.title_zh: 促进社交网络内信息访问的公平性
papers.authors: Changan Liu, Xiaotian Zhou, Ahad N. Zehmakan, Zhongzhi Zhang
papers.abstract: The advent of online social networks has facilitated fast and wide spread of information. However, some users, especially members of minority groups, may be less likely to receive information spreading on the network, due to their disadvantaged network position. We study the optimization problem of adding new connections to a network to enhance fairness in information access among different demographic groups. We provide a concrete formulation of this problem where information access is measured in terms of resistance distance, {offering a new perspective that emphasizes global network structure and multi-path connectivity.} The problem is shown to be NP-hard. We propose a simple greedy algorithm which turns out to output accurate solutions, but its run time is cubic, which makes it undesirable for large networks. As our main technical contribution, we reduce its time complexity to linear, leveraging several novel approximation techniques. In addition to our theoretical findings, we also conduct an extensive set of experiments using both real-world and synthetic datasets. We demonstrate that our linear-time algorithm can produce accurate solutions for networks with millions of nodes.
papers.abstract_zh: 在线社交网络的出现促进了信息的快速和广泛传播。然而，一些用户，尤其是少数群体的成员，由于其不利的网络地位，可能不太可能接收到网络上传播的信息。我们研究向网络添加新连接的优化问题，以增强不同人口群体之间信息访问的公平性。我们提供了这个问题的具体表述，其中信息访问是根据阻力距离来衡量的，{提供了一个强调全局网络结构和多路径连接的新视角。}该问题被证明是 NP 困难的。我们提出了一种简单的贪婪算法，该算法可以输出准确的解决方案，但其运行时间是立方的，这使得它不适合大型网络。作为我们的主要技术贡献，我们利用几种新颖的近似技术将其时间复杂度降低为线性。除了我们的理论发现之外，我们还使用现实世界和合成数据集进行了大量实验。我们证明了我们的线性时间算法可以为具有数百万节点的网络提供准确的解决方案。

papers.title: Keyword-Aware Skyline Community Search on Semantics and Structure
papers.title_zh: 关于语义和结构的关键字感知 Skyline 社区搜索
papers.authors: Chuanhou Sun, Yuhai Zhao, Ling Li, Yuan Li
papers.abstract: Community search (CS) on attributed graphs has been widely studied, catering to various applications such as friend recommendation. Recent works have focused on keywordaware community search with query keywords $Q$, aiming to return the closely connected communities relating to $\boldsymbol{Q}$. To achieve the best recommendation effectiveness, the ideal community should exhibit the strong semantic relevance between attributes of its members and $Q$, the high semantic similarity in attributes among members, and the closely connected structure. However, existing works only consider partial semantics to optimize one of the semantics and structure, which cannot flexibly handle the different optimized preferences for users on the above three conditions because they cannot be optimized simultaneously. Thus, we propose a novel community model that views keyword relevance, attribute similarity, and structure closeness as three different measures. Then, we study the keyword-aware skyline community search (KSCS) problem to provide a set of communities that other communities cannot dominate in terms of the three measures above, thereby facilitating users in easily choosing interested communities from the skyline set according to their preferences. We prove that this problem is NP-hard. Next, we propose a novel top-down KSCS solution with structure-preserving vertex shrinkage to approximate results. Furthermore, we propose an efficient bottom-up solution with two search strategies: structurerelaxed vertex/edge shrinkage and similarity-guided subgraph expansion, which can significantly improve approximation guarantees. Extensive experimental studies on synthetic and realworld datasets validated the effectiveness and efficiency of our methods, where the expansion-based bottom-up method achieves a good balance between efficiency and approximation.
papers.abstract_zh: 属性图上的社区搜索（CS）已被广泛研究，以满足好友推荐等各种应用。最近的工作重点是使用查询关键字 $Q$ 进行关键字感知社区搜索，旨在返回与 $\boldsymbol{Q}$ 相关的紧密连接的社区。为了达到最佳的推荐效果，理想的社区应该表现出其成员的属性与$Q$之间具有较强的语义相关性、成员之间的属性具有较高的语义相似度以及紧密的连接结构。然而，现有的工作仅考虑部分语义来优化语义和结构之一，无法灵活处理用户在上述三种情况下的不同优化偏好，因为它们不能同时优化。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的社区模型，将关键词相关性、属性相似性和结构紧密度视为三种不同的衡量标准。然后，我们研究了关键字感知的天际线社区搜索（KSCS）问题，以提供一组其他社区在上述三种措施方面无法主导的社区，从而方便用户根据自己的喜好轻松地从天际线集中选择感兴趣的社区。我们证明这个问题是NP-hard问题。接下来，我们提出了一种新颖的自顶向下 KSCS 解决方案，通过保留结构的顶点收缩来近似结果。此外，我们提出了一种有效的自下而上的解决方案，具有两种搜索策略：结构松弛的顶点/边收缩和相似性引导的子图扩展，这可以显著提高近似保证。对合成数据集和真实数据集的广泛实验研究验证了我们方法的有效性和效率，其中基于扩展的自下而上方法在效率和近似之间实现了良好的平衡。

papers.title: Zero-Knowledge Verifiable Graph Query Evaluation via Expansion-Centric Operator Decomposition
papers.title_zh: 通过以扩展为中心的运算符分解进行零知识可验证图查询评估
papers.authors: Hao Wu, Changzheng Wei, Yanhao Wang, Li Lin, Yilong Leng, Shiyu He, Minghao Zhao, Hanghang Wu, Ying Yan, Aoying Zhou
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the feasibility of achieving zero-knowledge verifiability for graph databases, enabling database owners to cryptographically prove the query execution correctness without disclosing the underlying data. Although similar capabilities have been explored for relational databases, their implementation for graph databases presents unique challenges. This is mainly attributed to the relatively large complexity of queries in graph databases. When translating graph queries into arithmetic circuits, the circuit scale can be too large to be practically evaluated. To address this issue, we propose to break down graph queries into more fine-grained, primitive operators, enabling a step-by-step evaluation through smaller-scale circuits. Accordingly, the verification with ZKP circuits of complex graph queries can be decomposed into a series of composable cryptographic primitives, each designed to verify a fundamental structural property such as path ordering or edge directionality. Especially, having noticed that the graph expansion (i.e., traversing from nodes to their neighbors along edges) operation serves as the backbone of graph query evaluation, we design the expansion centric operator decomposition. In addition to constructing circuits for the expansion primitives, we also design specialized ZKP circuits for the various attributes that augment this traversal. The circuits are meticulously designed to take advantage of PLONKish arithmetization. By integrating these optimized circuits, we implement ZKGraph, a system that provides verifiable query processing while preserving data privacy. Performance evaluation indicates that ZKGraph significantly outperforms naive in circuit implementations of graph operators, achieving substantial improvements in both runtime and memory consumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了图数据库实现零知识可验证性的可行性，使数据库所有者能够在不泄露底层数据的情况下以密码方式证明查询执行的正确性。尽管已经针对关系数据库探索了类似的功能，但它们在图数据库中的实现提出了独特的挑战。这主要归因于图数据库的查询复杂度相对较大。当将图查询转化为算术电路时，电路规模可能太大而无法实际评估。为了解决这个问题，我们建议将图查询分解为更细粒度、更原始的运算符，从而能够通过更小规模的电路进行逐步评估。因此，使用 ZKP 电路对复杂图查询的验证可以分解为一系列可组合的密码原语，每个密码原语都设计用于验证基本结构属性，例如路径排序或边缘方向性。特别是，注意到图扩展（即沿边从节点遍历到邻居）操作作为图查询评估的支柱，我们设计了以扩展为中心的运算符分解。除了为扩展原语构建电路之外，我们还为增强这种遍历的各种属性设计专门的 ZKP 电路。这些电路经过精心设计，以利用 PLONKish 算术化。通过集成这些优化电路，我们实现了 ZKGraph，这是一个提供可验证查询处理同时保护数据隐私的系统。性能评估表明，ZKGraph 在图算子的电路实现中显著优于 naive，在运行时间和内存消耗方面均实现了显著改进。

papers.title: cuFHEDB: GPU-Accelerated Fully Homomorphic Encryption Database
papers.title_zh: cuFHEDB：GPU 加速的全同态加密数据库
papers.authors: Shijie Gao, Feng Zhang, Qian Xu, Yang Li, XueFeng Liu, Chao Jiang, Limin Xiao, Siqi Ma, Elisa Bertino, Xiaoyong Du
papers.abstract: As data privacy becomes increasingly critical, fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) emerges as a promising solution for securely outsourcing database queries to the cloud without exposing plaintext information. However, FHE-based databases suffer from significant computational latency, obstructing efficient SQL query execution. In this paper, we present cuFHEDB, the first GPU-accelerated FHE-based database tailored for efficient homomorphic query processing. cuFHEDB addresses bottlenecks at both the FHE and database layers. At the FHE level, it incorporates a novel GPU-oriented acceleration architecture that provides high security and efficiency for core FHE operations. This includes a custom-optimized folding FFT for polynomial computations, an inter-block external product strategy to overcome GPU resource limits at high security levels, and a GPU-aware bootstrapping unroll scheme that alleviates the sequential nature of FHE. At the database level, it features a two-level parallelism framework that accelerates both underlying FHE operators and concurrent homomorphic filtering, thus minimizing query latency. Our experimental evaluation on TPC-H and real-world healthcare queries demonstrates up to $118 \times$ speedup in end-to-end SQL execution compared to state-of-theart FHE-based solutions, making FHE-based databases more feasible for real-world applications. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/SekaiGao/cuFHEDB.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着数据隐私变得越来越重要，完全同态加密 (FHE) 成为一种有前途的解决方案，可以将数据库查询安全地外包到云而不暴露明文信息。然而，基于 FHE 的数据库存在显著的计算延迟，阻碍了高效的 SQL 查询执行。在本文中，我们提出了 cuFHEDB，这是第一个基于 GPU 加速的 FHE 数据库，专为高效同态查询处理而定制。 cuFHEDB 解决了 FHE 和数据库层的瓶颈。在FHE层面，它采用了新颖的面向GPU的加速架构，为核心FHE操作提供了高安全性和高效率。这包括用于多项式计算的定制优化折叠 FFT、用于在高安全级别克服 GPU 资源限制的块间外部产品策略，以及减轻 FHE 顺序性质的 GPU 感知引导展开方案。在数据库级别，它具有两级并行框架，可加速底层 FHE 运算符和并发同态过滤，从而最大限度地减少查询延迟。我们对 TPC-H 和现实世界医疗保健查询的实验评估表明，与最先进的基于 FHE 的解决方案相比，端到端 SQL 执行速度最高提升至原来的 118 倍，从而使基于 FHE 的数据库对于现实世界应用程序更加可行。我们的代码公开于：https://github.com/SekaiGao/cuFHEDB。

papers.title: Contemp: Instance Caching Based on Container Temperature in Serverless Environment
papers.title_zh: Contemp：无服务器环境下基于容器温度的实例缓存
papers.authors: Pengwei Wang, Nuo Chen, Haoquan Qi, Yichen Zhong, Shun Song
papers.abstract: In serverless computing, cloud providers dynamically manage the underlying resource allocation, allowing developers to concentrate on business logic development. Although containers ensure runtime consistency, creation and destruction of instances significantly degrade performance by increasing cold start latency. A widely adopted solution is instance caching, which facilitates rapid container reuse upon request arrival. However, existing caching mechanisms exhibit limitations under highconcurrency burst workloads: the lack of a dynamic evaluation mechanism for real-time container activity levels may lead to premature eviction of high-activity containers or excessive resource occupation by low-activity containers, thereby reducing resource efficiency and service quality. This paper presents Contemp, a container temperature-based cache eviction strategy. Contemp constructs a Historical-Enhanced Adaptive Temperature Model (HEATM), which integrates temporal patterns, cold start latency, resource efficiency, and historical invocation frequency. In addition, it adopts a decay mechanism based on Newton's Law of Cooling to prevent excessive caching of containers. Based on the temperature awareness of container, Contemp dynamically adjusts cache priorities to guide cache eviction decisions, and achieves a better trade-off between resource costs and cold start latency. Experimental evaluations on Azure Functions trace demonstrate Contemp's superior performance: improving an average of 17.3% higher cache hit rate of each node, 30.1% reduction in cold start latency, and 25.4% cost effectiveness improvement compared to existing approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 在无服务器计算中，云提供商动态管理底层资源分配，使开发人员能够专注于业务逻辑开发。尽管容器确保运行时一致性，但实例的创建和销毁会增加冷启动延迟，从而显著降低性能。一种广泛采用的解决方案是实例缓存，它有助于在请求到达时快速重用容器。然而，现有的缓存机制在高并发突发工作负载下表现出局限性：缺乏实时容器活动水平的动态评估机制可能会导致高活动容器过早驱逐或低活动容器过度占用资源，从而降低资源效率和服务质量。本文提出了 Contemp，一种基于容器温度的缓存驱逐策略。 Contemp 构建了历史增强型自适应温度模型 (HEATM)，该模型集成了时间模式、冷启动延迟、资源效率和历史调用频率。此外，它采用基于牛顿冷却定律的衰减机制来防止容器的过度缓存。基于容器的温度感知，Contemp动态调整缓存优先级来指导缓存驱逐决策，在资源成本和冷启动延迟之间实现更好的权衡。对 Azure Functions 跟踪的实验评估证明了 Contemp 的卓越性能：与现有方法相比，每个节点的缓存命中率平均提高了 17.3%，冷启动延迟降低了 30.1%，成本效益提高了 25.4%。
