papers.title: TopFGL: A Topology-Aware and Distribution-Agnostic Federated Learning Framework Tackling Topological Heterogeneity on Graph Data
papers.title_zh: TopFGL：一种拓扑感知和分布无关的联邦学习框架，解决图数据上的拓扑异构性
papers.authors: Junyang Wang, Lan Zhang, Yihang Cheng, Mu Yuan, Tianfu Wang, Zhihui Fu, Jun Wang
papers.abstract: While the modern internet generates graph data at an unprecedented scale, stringent privacy regulations like GDPR have fragmented it into silos, creating an urgent need for distributed learning paradigms. Federated Graph Learning (FGL) meets this demand, enabling collaborative training across graph silos. A core challenge for FGL is that the graphs among participants are topologically heterogeneous due to diverse sources and methods of structure collection, which leads to significant performance degradation. However, recent works tackling heterogeneity require clients to share class-wise intermediate information derived from local embeddings, which could increase risks of label and structure leakage. Moreover, they are often computationally expensive and narrowly tailored for a single type of heterogeneity, which hinders their applicability in efficiency-demanding and distribution-variant practical scenarios. To this end, we present TopFGL, the first topologyaware and distribution-agnostic framework to tackle heterogeneity without intermediate information sharing. TopFGL trains a topology learner in each client to learn local topological patterns, and globally aggregates all learners along with the main task models. We propose a multi-level topology extraction scheme to adapt to diverse distributions, along with a streamlined training pipeline that reduces redundant computations. Building upon the learners, we propose a server-side topological similarity-based aggregation algorithm to share similar optimization directions across clients. A client-side dual-model guided topology augmentation approach is also proposed to supplement neighborhood connections for topology-insufficient nodes, improving adaptability to imbalanced distributions. Experiments on 11 datasets with 3 topological distributions across 3 \~{} 100 client counts show that TopFGL achieves up to 5.6% accuracy improvement along with 50% time cost reduction compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然现代互联网以前所未有的规模生成图数据，但 GDPR 等严格的隐私法规已将其分割成孤岛，迫切需要分布式学习范例。联合图学习（FGL）满足了这一需求，实现了跨图孤岛的协作训练。 FGL 的核心挑战是，由于结构收集的来源和方法不同，参与者之间的图在拓扑上是异构的，这导致性能显著下降。然而，最近处理异质性的工作要求客户共享从本地嵌入导出的类中间信息，这可能会增加标签和结构泄漏的风险。此外，它们通常计算成本昂贵，并且针对单一类型的异构性进行了狭隘的定制，这阻碍了它们在效率要求高和分布变化的实际场景中的适用性。为此，我们提出了 TopFGL，这是第一个拓扑感知和分布无关的框架，无需中间信息共享即可解决异构性。 TopFGL 在每个客户端中训练一个拓扑学习器来学习局部拓扑模式，并全局聚合所有学习器以及主要任务模型。我们提出了一种多级拓扑提取方案来适应不同的分布，以及减少冗余计算的简化训练管道。在学习器的基础上，我们提出了一种基于服务器端拓扑相似性的聚合算法，以在客户端之间共享相似的优化方向。还提出了客户端双模型引导拓扑增强方法来补充拓扑不足节点的邻域连接，提高对不平衡分布的适应性。对 11 个数据集、3 个拓扑分布、3 个 100 个客户端的实验表明，与最先进的基线相比，TopFGL 的准确率提高了 5.6%，时间成本降低了 50%。
papers.search_extra: federated learning graph data graph neural networks 联邦学习 图表数据 图神经网络

papers.title: OsmT: Bridging OpenStreetMap Queries and Natural Language with Open-source Tag-aware Language Models
papers.title_zh: OsmT：通过开源标签感知语言模型桥接 OpenStreetMap 查询和自然语言
papers.authors: Zhuoyue WAN, Wentao Hu, Chen Jason Zhang, Yuanfeng Song, Shuaimin Li, Ruiqiang Xiao, Xiao-Yong Wei, Raymond Chi-Wing Wong
papers.abstract: Bridging natural language and structured query languages is a long-standing challenge in the database community. While recent advances in language models have shown promise in this direction, existing solutions often rely on large-scale closed-source models that suffer from high inference costs, limited transparency, and lack of adaptability for lightweight deployment. In this paper, we present OsmT, an open-source tag-aware language model specifically designed to bridge natural language and Overpass Query Language (OverpassQL), a structured query language for accessing large-scale OpenStreetMap (OSM) data. To enhance the accuracy and structural validity of generated queries, we introduce a Tag Retrieval Augmentation (TRA) mechanism that incorporates contextually relevant tag knowledge into the generation process. This mechanism is designed to capture the hierarchical and relational dependencies present in the OSM database, addressing the topological complexity inherent in geospatial query formulation. In addition, we define a reverse task, OverpassQL-to-Text, which translates structured queries into natural language explanations to support query interpretation and improve user accessibility. We evaluate OsmT on a public benchmark against strong baselines and observe consistent improvements in both query generation and interpretation. Despite using significantly fewer parameters, our model achieves competitive accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of open-source pre-trained language models in bridging natural language and structured query languages within schema-rich geospatial environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 连接自然语言和结构化查询语言是数据库社区中长期存在的挑战。虽然语言模型的最新进展在这个方向上显示出了希望，但现有的解决方案通常依赖于大规模的闭源模型，这些模型存在推理成本高、透明度有限以及缺乏轻量级部署适应性的问题。在本文中，我们提出了 OsmT，一种开源标签感知语言模型，专门用于桥接自然语言和 Overpass 查询语言 (OverpassQL)，这是一种用于访问大规模 OpenStreetMap (OSM) 数据的结构化查询语言。为了提高生成查询的准确性和结构有效性，我们引入了标签检索增强（TRA）机制，该机制将上下文相关的标签知识合并到生成过程中。该机制旨在捕获 OSM 数据库中存在的层次结构和关系依赖关系，解决地理空间查询制定中固有的拓扑复杂性。此外，我们定义了一个反向任务 OverpassQL-to-Text，它将结构化查询转换为自然语言解释，以支持查询解释并提高用户可访问性。我们根据强大的基线在公共基准上评估 OsmT，并观察到查询生成和解释方面的持续改进。尽管使用的参数明显减少，但我们的模型实现了有竞争力的准确性，证明了开源预训练语言模型在模式丰富的地理空间环境中桥接自然语言和结构化查询语言方面的有效性。

papers.title: Knapsack Optimization-based Schema Linking for LLM-based Text-to-SQL Generation
papers.title_zh: 基于背包优化的架构链接，用于基于 LLM 的文本到 SQL 生成
papers.authors: Zheng Yuan, Hao Chen, Zijin Hong, Qinggang Zhang, Feiran Huang, Qing Li, Xiao 	Huang
papers.abstract: Generating SQLs from user queries is a long-standing challenge, where the accuracy of initial schema linking significantly impacts subsequent SQL generation performance. However, current schema linking models still struggle with missing relevant schema elements or an excess of redundant ones. A crucial reason for this is that commonly used metrics, recall and precision, fail to capture relevant element missing and thus cannot reflect actual schema linking performance. Motivated by this, we propose enhanced schema linking metrics by introducing a restricted missing indicator. Accordingly, we introduce Knapsack optimization-based Schema Linking Approach (KaSLA), a plug-in schema linking method designed to prevent the missing of relevant schema elements while minimizing the inclusion of redundant ones. KaSLA employs a hierarchical linking strategy that first identifies the optimal table linking and subsequently links columns within the selected table to reduce linking candidate space. In each linking process, it utilizes a knapsack optimization approach to link potentially relevant elements while accounting for a limited tolerance of potentially redundant ones. With this optimization, KaSLA-1.6B achieves superior schema linking results compared to large-scale LLMs, including DeepSeek-V3 with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) schema linking method. Extensive experiments on Spider and BIRD benchmarks verify that KaSLA can significantly improve the SQL generation performance of SOTA Text2SQL models by substituting their schema linking processes. The code is available at https://github.com/DEEP-PolyU/KaSLA.
papers.abstract_zh: 从用户查询生成 SQL 是一个长期存在的挑战，其中初始模式链接的准确性会显著影响后续 SQL 生成性能。然而，当前的模式链接模型仍然面临着缺少相关模式元素或过多冗余的问题。造成这种情况的一个关键原因是常用的指标（召回率和精度）无法捕获相关元素的缺失，因此无法反映实际的模式链接性能。受此启发，我们提出通过引入 限制缺失指标来增强模式链接指标。因此，我们引入了 Knapsack 基于优化的 Schema Linking Aapproach (KaSLA)，这是一种插件模式链接方法，旨在防止丢失相关模式元素，同时最大限度地减少冗余元素的包含。 KaSLA 采用分层链接策略，首先识别最佳表链接，然后链接所选表中的列以减少链接候选空间。在每个链接过程中，它利用背包优化方法来链接潜在相关元素，同时考虑到潜在冗余元素的有限容忍度。通过这种优化，与大规模 LLM 相比，KaSLA-1.6B 实现了卓越的模式链接结果，包括采用最先进 (SOTA) 模式链接方法的 DeepSeek-V3。 Spider 和 BIRD 基准测试的大量实验验证了 KaSLA 可以通过替换 SOTA Text2SQL 模型的模式链接过程来显著提高 SOTA Text2SQL 模型的 SQL 生成性能。代码可在 https://github.com/DEEP-PolyU/KaSLA 获取。

papers.title: FLASH Viterbi: Fast and Adaptive Viterbi Decoding for Modern Data Systems
papers.title_zh: FLASH Viterbi：现代数据系统的快速自适应维特比解码
papers.authors: Ziheng Deng, Xue Liu, Jiantong Jiang, Yankai Li, Qingxu Deng, Xiaochun Yang
papers.abstract: The Viterbi algorithm is a key operator for structured sequence inference in modern data systems, with applications in trajectory analysis, online recommendation, and speech recognition. As these workloads increasingly migrate to resource-constrained edge platforms, standard Viterbi decoding remains memory-intensive and computationally inflexible. Existing methods typically trade decoding time for space efficiency, but often incur significant runtime overhead and lack adaptability to various system constraints. This paper presents FLASH Viterbi, a Fast, Lightweight, Adaptive, and Hardware-Friendly Viterbi decoding operator that enhances adaptability and resource efficiency. FLASH Viterbi combines a non-recursive divide-and-conquer strategy with pruning and parallelization techniques to enhance both time and memory efficiency, making it well-suited for resource-constrained data systems. To further decouple space complexity from the hidden state space size, we present FLASH-BS Viterbi, a dynamic beam search variant built on a memory-efficient data structure. Both proposed algorithms exhibit strong adaptivity to diverse deployment scenarios by dynamically tuning internal parameters. To ensure practical deployment on edge devices, we also develop FPGA-based hardware accelerators for both algorithms, demonstrating high throughput and low resource usage. Extensive experiments show that our algorithms consistently outperform existing baselines in both decoding time and memory efficiency, while preserving adaptability and hardware-friendly characteristics essential for modern data systems. All codes are publicly available at https://github.com/Dzh-16/FLASH-Viterbi.
papers.abstract_zh: 维特比算法是现代数据系统中结构化序列推理的关键算子，在轨迹分析、在线推荐和语音识别中都有应用。随着这些工作负载越来越多地迁移到资源受限的边缘平台，标​​准维特比解码仍然需要大量内存且计算不灵活。现有方法通常以解码时间换取空间效率，但通常会产生大量的运行时开销，并且缺乏对各种系统约束的适应性。本文介绍了 FLASH Viterbi，一种快速、轻量级、自适应且硬件友好的 Viterbi 解码运算符，可增强适应性和资源效率。 FLASH Viterbi 将非递归分而治之策略与修剪和并行化技术相结合，以提高时间和内存效率，使其非常适合资源受限的数据系统。为了进一步将空间复杂性与隐藏状态空间大小解耦，我们提出了 FLASH-BS Viterbi，这是一种基于内存高效数据结构的动态波束搜索变体。两种提出的算法通过动态调整内部参数，表现出对不同部署场景的强大适应性。为了确保在边缘设备上的实际部署，我们还为这两种算法开发了基于 FPGA 的硬件加速器，展示了高吞吐量和低资源使用率。大量实验表明，我们的算法在解码时间和内存效率方面始终优于现有基线，同时保留了现代数据系统所必需的适应性和硬件友好特性。所有代码均可在 https://github.com/Dzh-16/FLASH-Viterbi 上公开获取。

papers.title: Sorting Compressed Time Series
papers.title_zh: 对压缩时间序列进行排序
papers.authors: Zhiheng Liu, Xingyu Liu, Shaoxu Song, Jianmin Wang
papers.abstract: Compression is commonly used to reduce storage costs in large-scale time series databases. While time series data should be ordered by timestamps, they often arrive out of order due to network delay and thus need to be sorted. However, most existing compression schemes do not support direct swap operations on compressed data, and thus need to decompress for sorting. The challenges of sorting directly the compressed data are the potential space amplification and high time costs when performing swap operations. In this paper, (1) we design the Order-Sensitive Encoding (OSE) method, which not only reduces space usage as the orderliness of the time series improves, but also delivers high encoding and decoding speeds. Based on the space-bound of OSE, (2) we propose the Compressed Bubble Sort (CBS) algorithm, which enables sorting compressed data without space amplification. Notably, it achieves a time complexity of $O(n)$, since the delay of time series data typically follows an exponential distribution. Furthermore, (3) we propose the Compressed Merge Sort (CMS) algorithm for merging two compressed and ordered time series in database compaction. It needs only $O(1)$ time cost by leveraging the ordered nature of data segments, given the exponential delay distribution. The proposed OSE has been implemented as encoding method in Apache TsFile, while CBS and CMS as compressed sorting operators in Apache IoTDB. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly improves both space and time efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 压缩通常用于降低大规模时间序列数据库的存储成本。虽然时间序列数据应按时间戳排序，但由于网络延迟，它们通常会乱序到达，因此需要排序。然而，大多数现有的压缩方案不支持对压缩数据进行直接交换操作，因此需要解压缩进行排序。直接对压缩数据进行排序的挑战是执行交换操作时潜在的空间放大和高时间成本。在本文中，（1）我们设计了顺序敏感编码（OSE）方法，该方法不仅随着时间序列有序性的提高而减少了空间使用，而且还提供了较高的编码和解码速度。基于OSE的空间限制，（2）我们提出了压缩冒泡排序（CBS）算法，该算法能够在不放大空间的情况下对压缩数据进行排序。值得注意的是，它的时间复杂度为 $O(n)$，因为时间序列数据的延迟通常遵循指数分布。此外，（3）我们提出了压缩合并排序（CMS）算法，用于在数据库压缩中合并两个压缩且有序的时间序列。考虑到指数延迟分布，通过利用数据段的有序性质，它只需要 $O(1)$ 时间成本。所提出的 OSE 已在 Apache TsFile 中作为编码方法实现，而 CBS 和 CMS 在 Apache IoTDB 中作为压缩排序运算符实现。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著提高了空间和时间效率。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Reverse k Nearest Neighbor Query in Large Road Networks: A Tree Decomposition based Approach
papers.title_zh: 大型道路网络中的反向 k 最近邻查询：基于树分解的方法
papers.authors: Dian Ouyang, Boyu Zhang, Jianye  Yang, Shiyu Yang, Chonghua Wang, Xuemin Lin
papers.abstract: Reverse k-nearest neighbor (R $k$ NN) query in road networks is an important and fundamental problem. Given a facility query vertex $q$, an $\mathrm{R} k \text{NN}$ query asks for finding all user vertices such that each of them regards $q$ as one of the $k$ nearest neighbors $(k \text{NN})$. Although $\mathbf{R} k \mathbf{N N}$ has a wide range of applications, such as location selection, influential domain analysis, potential customer analysis, we note that this problem has not been well addressed. Existing solutions typically need to traverse the graph and perform $k \text{NN}$ queries for every vertex in a non-decreasing order of their distances to the query vertex, which incurs high computational cost, especially for large graphs. In this paper, we develop a novel tree decomposition based approach, namely TD-Query. In general, a tree decomposition can be considered as an index to store the hierarchical decomposition of the graph. By making use of the nice properties of the tree decomposition, we develop useful search branch pruning techniques such that we can avoid traversing the entire graph. Observing that TD-Query may still visit many result irrelevant nodes during the traversal, we propose an advanced approach, termed ATD-Query. In specific, we first identify a set of critical nodes in the tree decomposition. Based on these critical nodes, we then construct an augmented tree decomposition by storing auxiliary data structures for tree nodes with little space and time overhead. On top of the augmented tree decomposition, ATD-Query can collect the query results by only visiting a subset of critical nodes, and hence substantially improve the query efficiency. We conduct extensive experiments on 8 reallife road networks, and the experimental results demonstrate that ATD-Query can achieve up to an order of magnitude performance improvement over the state-of-the-art algorithm, while consuming much less memory for index structure.
papers.abstract_zh: 道路网络中的反向k近邻（R $k$ NN）查询是一个重要且基本的问题。给定一个设施查询顶点 $q$，$\mathrm{R} k \text{NN}$ 查询要求查找所有用户顶点，使得每个顶点都将 $q$ 视为 $k$ 最近邻居 $(k \text{NN})$ 之一。尽管 $\mathbf{R} k \mathbf{N N}$ 具有广泛的应用，例如位置选择、影响力领域分析、潜在客户分析，但我们注意到这个问题尚未得到很好的解决。现有的解决方案通常需要遍历图，并按照每个顶点到查询顶点的距离的非递减顺序执行 $k \text{NN}$ 查询，这会产生很高的计算成本，尤其是对于大型图。在本文中，我们开发了一种新颖的基于树分解的方法，即 TD-Query。一般来说，树分解可以被认为是存储图的层次分解的索引。通过利用树分解的良好特性，我们开发了有用的搜索分支修剪技术，这样我们就可以避免遍历整个图。观察到 TD-Query 在遍历过程中仍然可能访问许多与结果无关的节点，我们提出了一种高级方法，称为 ATD-Query。具体来说，我们首先确定树分解中的一组关键节点。基于这些关键节点，我们通过存储树节点的辅助数据结构来构造增强树分解，而空间和时间开销很小。在增强树分解的基础上，ATD-Query只需访问关键节点的子集即可收集查询结果，从而大幅提高查询效率。我们在 8 个现实道路网络上进行了广泛的实验，实验结果表明，ATD-Query 可以比最先进的算法实现高达一个数量级的性能提升，同时消耗更少的索引结构内存。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索
papers.search_extra: road network tree decomposition spatial query processing large-scale networks 道路网络 树分解 空间查询处理 大规模网络

papers.title: Benchmarking RL-Enhanced Spatial Indices Against Traditional, Advanced, and Learned Counterparts [Experiment, Analysis, and Benchmark]
papers.title_zh: 将 RL 增强型空间指数与传统、高级和学习对应物进行基准测试 [实验、分析和基准测试]
papers.authors: Guanli Liu, Renata Borovica-Gajic, Hai Lan, Zhifeng Bao
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has recently been used to enhance index structures, giving rise to reinforcement learning-enhanced spatial indices (RLESIs) that aim to improve query efficiency during index construction. However, their practical benefits remain unclear due to the lack of unified implementations and comprehensive evaluations, especially in disk-based settings. We present the first modular and extensible benchmark for RLESIs. Built on top of an existing spatial index library, our framework decouples index training from building, supports parameter tuning, and enables consistent comparison with traditional, advanced, and learned spatial indices. We evaluate 12 representative spatial indices across six datasets and diverse workloads, including point, range, $k \text{NN}$, spatial join, and mixed read/write queries. Using latency, I/O, and index statistics as metrics, we find that while RLESIs can reduce query latency with tuning, they consistently underperform learned spatial indices and advanced variants in both query efficiency and index build cost. These findings highlight that although RLESIs offer promising architectural compatibility, their high tuning costs and limited generalization hinder practical adoption.
papers.abstract_zh: 强化学习最近被用来增强索引结构，从而产生了强化学习增强空间索引（RLESI），旨在提高索引构建过程中的查询效率。然而，由于缺乏统一的实现和全面的评估，它们的实际好处仍不清楚，特别是在基于磁盘的设置中。我们提出了第一个模块化且可扩展的 RLESI 基准测试。我们的框架建立在现有的空间索引库之上，将索引训练与构建分离，支持参数调整，并能够与传统的、高级的和学习的空间索引进行一致的比较。我们评估了 6 个数据集和不同工作负载中的 12 个代表性空间索引，包括点、范围、$k \text{NN}$、空间连接和混合读/写查询。使用延迟、I/O 和索引统计信息作为指标，我们发现虽然 RLESI 可以通过调整来减少查询延迟，但它们在查询效率和索引构建成本方面始终低于学习空间索引和高级变体。这些发现强调，尽管 RLESI 提供了有前景的架构兼容性，但其高昂的调优成本和有限的通用性阻碍了实际采用。

papers.title: PROGQL: A Provenance Graph Query System for Cyber Attack Investigation
papers.title_zh: PROGQL：用于网络攻击调查的来源图查询系统
papers.authors: Fei Shao, Jia Zou, Zhichao Cao, Xusheng Xiao
papers.abstract: Provenance analysis (PA) has recently emerged as an important solution for cyber attack investigation. PA leverages system monitoring to monitor system activities as a series of system audit events and organizes these events as a provenance graph to show the dependencies among system activities, which can reveal steps of cyber attacks. Despite their potential, existing PA techniques face two critical challenges: (1) they are inflexible and non-extensible, making it difficult to incorporate analyst expertise, and (2) they are memoryinefficient, often requiring $>100 ~\text{GB}$ of RAM to hold entire event streams, which fundamentally limits scalability and deployment in real-world environments. To address these fundamental limitations, we propose the ProGQL framework, which provides a domain-specific graph search language with a well-engineered query engine, allowing PA over system audit events and expert knowledge to be jointly expressed as a graph search query and thereby facilitating the investigation of complex cyberattacks. In particular, to support dependency searches from a starting edge required in PA, ProGQL introduces new language constructs for constrained graph traversal, edge weight computation, value propagation along weighted edges, and graph merging to integrate multiple searches. Moreover, the ProGQL query engine is optimized for efficient incremental graph search across heterogeneous database backends, eliminating the need for full in-memory materialization and reducing memory overhead. Our evaluations on real attacks demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProGQL language in expressing a diverse set of complex attacks compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) graph query language Cypher, and the comparison with the SOTA PA technique DepImpact further demonstrates the significant improvement of the scalability brought by our ProGQL framework's design $(8 \times$ saving of memory consumption without penalty on runtime performance).
papers.abstract_zh: 来源分析（PA）最近已成为网络攻击调查的重要解决方案。 PA 利用系统监控将系统活动作为一系列系统审计事件进行监控，并将这些事件组织为来源图，以显示系统活动之间的依赖关系，从而揭示网络攻击的步骤。尽管有潜力，现有的 PA 技术面临着两个关键挑战：(1) 它们不灵活且不可扩展，因此很难融入分析师的专业知识；(2) 它们的内存效率低下，通常需要 $>100 ~\text{GB}$ 的 RAM 来保存整个事件流，这从根本上限制了现实环境中的可扩展性和部署。为了解决这些基本限制，我们提出了 ProGQL 框架，它提供了一种特定于领域的图搜索语言和精心设计的查询引擎，允许将系统审计事件和专家知识的 PA 联合表达为图搜索查询，从而促进复杂网络攻击的调查。特别是，为了支持 PA 中所需的从起始边开始的依赖搜索，ProGQL 引入了新的语言结构，用于约束图遍历、边权重计算、沿加权边的值传播以及图合并以集成多个搜索。此外，ProGQL 查询引擎针对跨异构数据库后端的高效增量图搜索进行了优化，消除了完全内存中实现的需要并减少了内存开销。我们对真实攻击的评估表明，与最先进的（SOTA）图查询语言 Cypher 相比，ProGQL 语言在表达各种复杂攻击方面的有效性，并且与 SOTA PA 技术 DepImpact 的比较进一步证明了我们的 ProGQL 框架的设计带来的可扩展性的显著提高（节省了 8 倍的内存消耗，而不影响运行时性能）。

papers.title: Efficient Hypergraph Pattern Matching via Match-and-Filter and Intersection Constraint
papers.title_zh: 通过匹配过滤器和交集约束进行高效的超图模式匹配
papers.authors: Siwoo Song, Wonseok Shin, Kunsoo Park, Giuseppe Italiano, Zhengyi Yang, Wenjie Zhang
papers.abstract: A hypergraph is a generalization of a graph, in which a hyperedge can connect multiple vertices, modeling complex relationships involving multiple vertices simultaneously. Hypergraph pattern matching, which is to find all isomorphic embeddings of a query hypergraph in a data hypergraph, is one of the fundamental problems. In this paper, we present a novel algorithm for hypergraph pattern matching by introducing (1) the intersection constraint, a necessary and sufficient condition for valid embeddings, which significantly speeds up the verification process, (2) the candidate hyperedge space, a data structure that stores potential mappings between hyperedges in the query hypergraph and the data hypergraph, and (3) the Match-and-Filter framework, which interleaves matching and filtering operations to maintain only compatible candidates in the candidate hyperedge space during backtracking. Experimental results on real-world datasets demonstrate that our algorithm significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art algorithms, by up to orders of magnitude in terms of query processing time.
papers.abstract_zh: 超图是图的概括，其中超边可以连接多个顶点，同时对涉及多个顶点的复杂关系进行建模。超图模式匹配，即在数据超图中找到查询超图的所有同构嵌入，是基本问题之一。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的超图模式匹配算法，通过引入（1）交集约束，这是有效嵌入的充分必要条件，这显著加快了验证过程；（2）候选超边空间，一种存储查询超图和数据超图中超边之间潜在映射的数据结构；（3）匹配和过滤框架，它交错匹配和过滤操作，以便在回溯期间仅在候选超边空间中维护兼容的候选者。真实数据集上的实验结果表明，我们的算法在查询处理时间方面显著优于最先进的算法，高出几个数量级。
papers.search_extra: hypergraph isomorphism backtracking query processing 超图同构 回溯 查询处理

papers.title: Trading Vector Data in Vector Databases
papers.title_zh: 交易矢量数据库中的矢量数据
papers.authors: Jin Cheng, Xiangxiang Dai, Ningning Ding, John C.S. Lui, Jianwei Huang
papers.abstract: Vector data trading is essential for cross-domain learning with vector databases, yet it remains largely unexplored. We study this problem under online learning, where sellers face uncertain retrieval costs and buyers provide stochastic feedback to posted prices. Three main challenges arise: (1) heterogeneous and partial feedback in configuration learning, (2) variable and complex feedback in pricing learning, and (3) inherent coupling between configuration and pricing decisions. We propose a hierarchical bandit framework that jointly optimizes retrieval configurations and pricing. Stage I employs contextual clustering with confidence-based exploration to learn effective configurations with logarithmic regret. Stage II adopts interval-based price selection with local Taylor approximation to estimate buyer responses and achieve sublinear regret. We establish theoretical guarantees with polynomial time complexity and validate the framework on four real-world datasets, demonstrating consistent improvements in cumulative reward and regret reduction compared with existing methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 矢量数据交易对于矢量数据库的跨领域学习至关重要，但它在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们在在线学习下研究这个问题，其中卖家面临不确定的检索成本，而买家对发布的价格提供随机反馈。出现了三个主要挑战：（1）配置学习中的异构和部分反馈，（2）定价学习中的可变和复杂反馈，以及（3）配置和定价决策之间的固有耦合。我们提出了一个分层老虎机框架，联合优化检索配置和定价。第一阶段采用上下文聚类和基于置信度的探索来学习具有对数遗憾的有效配置。第二阶段采用基于区间的价格选择和局部泰勒近似来估计买家反应并实现次线性后悔。我们建立了具有多项式时间复杂度的理论保证，并在四个现实世界数据集上验证了该框架，证明了与现有方法相比，累积奖励和遗憾减少方面的持续改进。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: Updatable Balanced Index for Fast On-device Search with Auto-selection Model
papers.title_zh: 可更新的平衡索引，用于通过自动选择模型进行快速设备搜索
papers.authors: Yushuai Ji, Sheng Wang, Zhiyu Chen, Yuan Sun, Zhiyong Peng
papers.abstract: Diverse types of edge data, such as 2D geo-locations and 3D point clouds, are collected by sensors like lidar and GPS receivers on edge devices. On-device searches, such as k-nearest neighbor (kNN) search and radius search, are commonly used to enable fast analytics and learning technologies, such as k-means dataset simplification using kNN. To maintain high search efficiency, a representative approach is to utilize a balanced multi-way KD-tree (BMKD-tree). However, the index has shown limited gains, mainly due to substantial construction overhead, inflexibility to real-time insertion, and inconsistent query performance. In this paper, we propose UnIS to address the above limitations. We first accelerate the construction process of the BMKD-tree by utilizing the dataset distribution to predict the splitting hyperplanes. To make the continuously generated data searchable, we propose a selective sub-tree rebuilding scheme to accelerate rebalancing during insertion by reducing the number of data points involved. We then propose an auto-selection model to improve query performance by automatically selecting the optimal search strategy among multiple strategies for an arbitrary query task. Experimental results show that UnIS achieves average speedups of 17.96x in index construction, 1.60x in insertion, 7.15x in kNN search, and 1.09x in radius search compared to the BMKD-tree. We further verify its effectiveness in accelerating dataset simplification on edge devices, achieving a speedup of 217x over Lloyd's algorithm.
papers.abstract_zh: 边缘设备上的激光雷达和 GPS 接收器等传感器收集各种类型的边缘数据，例如 2D 地理位置和 3D 点云。设备上搜索（例如 k 最近邻 (kNN) 搜索和半径搜索）通常用于实现快速分析和学习技术，例如使用 kNN 的 k 均值数据集简化。为了保持高搜索效率，代表性的方法是利用平衡多路KD树（BMKD树）。然而，该索引的收益有限，主要是由于巨大的构建开销、实时插入不灵活以及查询性能不一致。在本文中，我们提出 UniIS 来解决上述限制。我们首先利用数据集分布来预测分裂超平面，从而加速 BMKD 树的构建过程。为了使连续生成的数据可搜索，我们提出了一种选择性子树重建方案，通过减少涉及的数据点数量来加速插入过程中的重新平衡。然后，我们提出了一种自动选择模型，通过在任意查询任务的多个策略中自动选择最佳搜索策略来提高查询性能。实验结果表明，与 BMKD 树相比，UniIS 在索引构建中平均加速 17.96 倍，在插入中平均加速 1.60 倍，在 kNN 搜索中平均加速 7.15 倍，在半径搜索中平均加速 1.09 倍。我们进一步验证了其在加速边缘设备上数据集简化方面的有效性，比 Lloyd 算法实现了 217 倍的加速。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: Banknote-Chain: Achieving User-Incentivized Parallelism in Blockchain via a Banknote-Inspired Transaction Model
papers.title_zh: 钞票链：通过钞票启发的交易模型在区块链中实现用户激励的并行性
papers.authors: Zhiyu Ma, Xiaofeng Li, He Zhao, Tong Zhou, Nianzu Sheng, Haotian Cheng
papers.abstract: Scalability remains a fundamental bottleneck in blockchain, hindering its widespread adoption in highthroughput and large-scale applications. Existing research usually attempts to enhance performance through various on-chain algorithms. However, these methods can introduce significant computing overhead for analysis and transaction scheduling, which can paradoxically overburden the blockchain nodes. This paper introduces Banknote-Chain, a novel blockchain model designed to achieve near-linear scalability and high parallel processing capabilities. Banknote-Chain employs a unique dualtype multi-ledger architecture and a user-incentivized transaction model inspired by real-world banknotes. Through a flexible fee model, Banknote-Chain shifts partial parallelization responsibilities from consensus nodes to users themselves, significantly reducing transaction conflicts. The design enhances the utilization of computing resources through concurrent processing of banknotes. Our comprehensive evaluation demonstrates Banknote-Chain's robust performance. By injecting a workload derived from the main net USDT transaction data, the system achieves a throughput of $136,680 \text{tx} / \mathrm{s}$. Under idealized conditions designed to maximize parallel processing, Banknote-Chain exhibits a maximum average throughput of $445,317 \text{tx} / \mathrm{s}$, representing a 31.8x improvement over the original account model blockchain based on go-ethereum. Furthermore, it maintains a consistent number of active banknotes through an automated banknote recycling mechanism, demonstrating stable storage consumption. The transaction fee model also effectively incentivizes users to engage in banknote transactions more frequently, offering a new tokenomics approach that contributes to overall blockchain ecosystem.
papers.abstract_zh: 可扩展性仍然是区块链的基本瓶颈，阻碍了其在高吞吐量和大规模应用中的广泛采用。现有的研究通常尝试通过各种链上算法来增强性能。然而，这些方法可能会给分析和事务调度带来大量的计算开销，这可能会导致区块链节点负担过重。本文介绍了 Banknote-Chain，这是一种新颖的区块链模型，旨在实现近线性可扩展性和高并行处理能力。 Banknote-Chain采用独特的双类型多账本架构和受现实世界纸币启发的用户激励交易模型。通过灵活的收费模型，Banknote-Chain将部分并行化责任从共识节点转移到用户本身，显著减少了交易冲突。该设计通过纸币的并发处理来提高计算资源的利用率。我们的综合评估表明了 Banknote-Chain 的强劲表现。通过注入源自主网 USDT 交易数据的工作负载，系统实现了 $136,680 \text{tx} / \mathrm{s}$ 的吞吐量。在旨在最大化并行处理的理想条件下，Banknote-Chain 的最大平均吞吐量为 $445,317 \text{tx} / \mathrm{s}$，比基于 go-ethereum 的原始账户模型区块链提高了 31.8 倍。此外，它通过自动钞票回收机制保持活跃钞票数量一致，展现出稳定的存储消耗。交易费用模型还有效地激励用户更频繁地参与纸币交易，提供了一种新的代币经济学方法，有助于整个区块链生态系统。

papers.title: Efficient Zero-shot and Label-free Log Anomaly Detection for Resource-constrained Systems
papers.title_zh: 针对资源受限系统的高效零样本和无标签日志异常检测
papers.authors: Zuohan Wu, Jiachuan Wang, Libin Zheng, Yongqi Zhang, Shuangyin Li, Lei Chen
papers.abstract: Logs, generated from modern computational systems such as cloud servers or DBMS, are the primary indicator of system states and thus have drawn significant attention from researchers. One of its key tasks is log anomaly detection, aiming to discover anomalous signals that can subsequently imply errors in systems. Conventionally, the major challenge of such a detection task is the insufficiency of well-labeled logs, which require unaffordable human resources. To tackle this issue, recent works have adopted the large language models (LLMs) as zeroshot label-free log anomaly detectors. However, these solutions necessitate direct deployment of LLM instances for downstream tasks, incurring substantial computational costs. Such costs limit their applications in resource-constrained scenarios, which motivates us to reposition the LLMs from direct detectors to training assistants and propose MaidLog. Specifically, MaidLog comprises an LLM-assisted pseudo-labels assignment workflow that automatically generates high-quality labels at training, enabling it to run entirely without manual labels. Based on them, we propose a lightweight detector designed for generalizability, where a well-trained detector is even applicable to downstream systems without any post-training. Once the training is finished, the downstream detection is efficient and only detector-based, without any involvement of LLM. Extensive experiments show that MaidLog effectively handles challenging real-world scenarios. With only a few unlabeled entries, MaidLog achieves comparable performance with a $25,000 \mathrm{x}$ speedup over SOTA LLM-centric solutions in out-of-domain systems, demonstrating its applicability on resource-constrained systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 由云服务器或 DBMS 等现代计算系统生成的日志是系统状态的主要指标，因此引起了研究人员的极大关注。其关键任务之一是日志异常检测，旨在发现随后可能暗示系统错误的异常信号。传统上，此类检测任务的主要挑战是缺乏良好标记的日志，这需要昂贵的人力资源。为了解决这个问题，最近的工作采用了大型语言模型（LLM）作为零样本无标签日志异常检测器。然而，这些解决方案需要直接部署 LLM 实例来执行下游任务，从而产生大量的计算成本。这样的成本限制了它们在资源有限的场景中的应用，这促使我们将大语言模型从直接检测器重新定位为训练助手，并提出了 MaidLog。具体来说，MaidLog 包含一个 LLM 辅助的伪标签分配工作流程，可在训练时自动生成高质量标签，使其完全无需手动标签即可运行。基于它们，我们提出了一种专为通用性而设计的轻量级检测器，其中训练有素的检测器甚至无需任何后期训练即可适用于下游系统。一旦训练完成，下游检测是高效的，并且仅基于检测器，没有任何LLM的参与。大量实验表明 MaidLog 可以有效处理具有挑战性的现实场景。只需几个未标记的条目，MaidLog 就可以在域外系统中实现与以 SOTA LLM 为中心的解决方案相比的 25,000 倍加速，这证明了其在资源受限系统上的适用性。

papers.title: Mitigating Dual Load Imbalance via Dynamic Cooperative Scheduling in Distributed Key-Value Stores
papers.title_zh: 通过分布式键值存储中的动态协作调度缓解双负载不平衡
papers.authors: Jiakun Zhang, Patrick P. C. Lee, Wenzhe Zhu, Yongkun Li, Shuyi  Zhang, Yinlong Xu
papers.abstract: Distributed key-value (KV) stores are essential components of modern computing infrastructure, enabling efficient storage and management of large-scale datasets. Existing distributed KV stores often shard data by key ranges into multiple regions and distribute the regions across multiple nodes. However, such range-based sharding leads to load imbalance in two dimensions: CPU utilization and disk I/O bandwidth. Our analysis reveals that the two dimensions exhibit misaligned and dynamic behaviors. Moreover, their tight coupling, where scheduling one dimension affects the other, makes it more challenging to simultaneously achieve balance in both. To address this challenge, which we term dual load imbalance, we propose Libra, a cooperative scheduling framework that monitors the interactions of CPU and disk I/O loads and carefully migrates regions across nodes based on the critical dimension. We implement Libra atop TiKV, a production distributed KV store, and show that Libra increases throughput by up to 72.1% and reduces tail latency by up to 56.7% compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 分布式键值 (KV) 存储是现代计算基础设施的重要组成部分，可实现大规模数据集的高效存储和管理。现有的分布式KV存储通常将数据按键范围分片到多个区域，并将这些区域分布在多个节点上。然而，这种基于范围的分片会导致两个维度的负载不平衡：CPU利用率和磁盘I/O带宽。我们的分析表明，这两个维度表现出错位和动态行为。此外，它们的紧密耦合（其中一个维度的调度会影响另一个维度）使得同时实现两个维度的平衡变得更具挑战性。为了解决这一挑战（我们称之为双重负载不平衡），我们提出了 Libra，这是一种协作调度框架，可以监控 CPU 和磁盘 I/O 负载的交互，并根据关键维度仔细地跨节点迁移区域。我们在 TiKV（一种生产分布式 KV 存储）之上实现了 Libra，结果表明，与最先进的方法相比，Libra 将吞吐量提高了 72.1%，并将尾部延迟降低了 56.7%。

papers.title: MOCHI: Motif-based Community Search over Large Heterogeneous Information Networks
papers.title_zh: MOCHI：大型异构信息网络上基于主题的社区搜索
papers.authors: Yuhan  Zhou, Qing Liu, Xin Huang, Jianliang Xu, Yunjun Gao
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the problem of motif-based community search over heterogeneous information networks (MOCHI). We introduce a novel motif density modularity (MDM) to measure the motif cohesiveness of communities. Based on MDM, we define the MOCHI problem as follows: given a heterogeneous information network (HIN) $H$, a motif $M$, and a query vertex set $Q$, the objective is to identify the subgraph of $H$ connected by motif instances, containing $Q$, and maximizing MDM. Since motifs encapsulate rich semantics, the MOCHI problem enables the retrieval of semantically meaningful communities, facilitating applications like fraud detection and academic collaboration analysis. Due to the NP-hardness of MOCHI, we propose three algorithms. The basic algorithm iteratively removes vertices to maximize MDM. However, vertex selection and maintaining $M$-connectivity incur significant overhead. Hence, we devise an MW-HIN-based algorithm that employs a vertex selection strategy and a compact data structure motif-based weighted HIN to boost efficiency. Additionally, we propose a motif-distance-based algorithm to further improve performance by integrating motif distance and a lightweight goodness function M-ratio to remove vertices. Extensive experiments on real-world HINs demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our proposed methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了异构信息网络（MOCHI）上基于主题的社区搜索问题。我们引入了一种新颖的主题密度模块化（MDM）来衡量社区的主题凝聚力。基于MDM，我们将MOCHI问题定义如下：给定异构信息网络（HIN）$H$、模体$M$和查询顶点集$Q$，目标是识别由模体实例连接的$H$的子图，包含$Q$，并最大化MDM。由于主题封装了丰富的语义，MOCHI 问题能够检索具有语义意义的社区，从而促进欺诈检测和学术协作分析等应用。由于 MOCHI 的 NP 难度，我们提出了三种算法。基本算法迭代地删除顶点以最大化 MDM。然而，顶点选择和维护 $M$ 连接会产生大量开销。因此，我们设计了一种基于 MW-HIN 的算法，该算法采用顶点选择策略和基于紧凑数据结构的加权 HIN 来提高效率。此外，我们提出了一种基于主题距离的算法，通过集成主题距离和轻量级优良函数 M-ratio 来删除顶点，进一步提高性能。对现实世界 HIN 的大量实验证明了我们提出的方法的有效性和效率。

papers.title: Reconfiguring Scalable Hashing with Persistent CPU Caches
papers.title_zh: 使用持久 CPU 缓存重新配置可扩展散列
papers.authors: Zhenyu  Yu, Bolong Zheng, Ling  Xu, Qianlu  Wu, Qiang  Chen, Ziyang  Yue
papers.abstract: As an essential functionality in main memory system, the extendible hash index exhibits both low latency and instant recovery with the persistent memory (PM). The recently released eADR feature of PM further provides an opportunity to enhance write performance of extendible hash index. Compared to the previous generation ADR, eADR avoids inefficient manual flush and mitigates write amplification by including CPU cache into the persistent domain. However, existing PM-based hash indexes are either designed without the enhancement of eADR, or fail to effectively leverage the persistent CPU cache. On the one hand, although using DRAM as a buffer helps mitigate write amplification, its shared usage of the CPU cache with PM leads to severe cache contention. On the other hand, skewed access towards metadata leads to inefficient CPU cache utilization. We propose PIONEER, an eADR-friendly persistent extendible hash index for a hybrid DRAM-PM memory architecture. First, to alleviate cache contention during data persistence, PIONEER introduces the directory snapshot that employs non-temporal write to bypass the CPU cache while preserving crash consistency guarantees. Second, PIONEER enhances the CPU cache utilization by re-designing the layout of hash index in a metadataseparated manner. In addition, PIONEER proposes a data-aware persistence strategy that dynamically adjusts the persistence approach for each segment based on data hotness. Extensive experiments conducted with YCSB workloads demonstrate that PIONEER achieves up to $36.4 \times$ higher write performance compared to other state-of-the-art persistent hash indexes.
papers.abstract_zh: 作为主存系统中的一项重要功能，可扩展哈希索引表现出低延迟和持久内存（PM）的即时恢复。 PM最近发布的eADR功能进一步提供了增强可扩展哈希索引写入性能的机会。与上一代 ADR 相比，eADR 通过将 CPU 缓存纳入持久域，避免了低效的手动刷新并减轻了写放大。然而，现有的基于PM的哈希索引要么在设计时没有增强eADR，要么无法有效利用持久CPU缓存。一方面，虽然使用 DRAM 作为缓冲区有助于减轻写放大，但其与 PM 共享 CPU 缓存会导致严重的缓存争用。另一方面，对元数据的倾斜访问会导致 CPU 缓存利用率低下。我们提出了 PIONEER，这是一种适用于混合 DRAM-PM 内存架构的 eADR 友好的持久可扩展哈希索引。首先，为了缓解数据持久化期间的缓存争用，PIONEER 引入了目录快照，该快照采用非临时写入来绕过 CPU 缓存，同时保留崩溃一致性保证。其次，PIONEER通过以元数据分离的方式重新设计哈希索引的布局，提高了CPU缓存利用率。此外，PIONEER提出了数据感知的持久化策略，根据数据热度动态调整每个细分市场的持久化方式。对 YCSB 工作负载进行的大量实验表明，与其他最先进的持久哈希索引相比，PIONEER 的写入性能最高达到其他方案的 36.4 倍。

papers.title: TemplateQO: Template-aware and Scalable Query Optimization with Data-efficient Learning
papers.title_zh: TemplateQO：具有数据高效学习的模板感知和可扩展查询优化
papers.authors: Pengfei  Zheng, Guoneng  Li, Ling  Xu, Rong  Zhu, Yan  Li, Bolong Zheng
papers.abstract: Learning-based query optimizers have demonstrated strong performance across various scenarios. However, most of these approaches rely heavily on estimated cardinalities, and inaccuracies in these estimates may significantly degrade their effectiveness in certain cases. Moreover, in our experiments we observe as the training data grows, these optimizers often encounter performance plateaus, indicating limited ability to leverage richer data distributions. To address these two challenges, we develop a novel query optimizer TemplateQO, which groups queries according to the canonical join template they instantiate, and employs a unified model to optimize over all templates. We assign a unified set of candidate query plans to each template, thus eliminating the need to encode execution plans. To facilitate information flow between templates, we propose a feature extractor and a feature-fusion Transformer. These two modules are shared for all templates, in order to capture relations across tables and columns. By focusing on precise, query-level features instead of potentially inaccurate estimated plan featuers, TemplateQO can more effectively learn the underlying mapping between queries and their execution plans. Moreover, to efficiently adapt to evolving workloads, we introduce a lightweight fine-tuning method. The fine-tuning method preserves previously learned knowledge, enabling effective continual learning. Experiments indicate that TemplateQO effectively improves query performance, exhibits strong scalability, and significantly lowers planning time.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于学习的查询优化器在各种场景中都表现出了强大的性能。然而，大多数这些方法严重依赖估计基数，并且这些估计的不准确可能会在某些情况下显著降低其有效性。此外，在我们的实验中，我们观察到随着训练数据的增长，这些优化器经常会遇到性能瓶颈，这表明利用更丰富的数据分布的能力有限。为了解决这两个挑战，我们开发了一种新颖的查询优化器 TemplateQO，它根据查询实例化的规范连接模板对查询进行分组，并采用统一的模型来优化所有模板。我们为每个模板分配一组统一的候选查询计划，从而消除了对执行计划进行编码的需要。为了促进模板之间的信息流，我们提出了特征提取器和特征融合Transformer。这两个模块为所有模板共享，以便捕获跨表和列的关系。通过关注精确的查询级特征而不是可能不准确的估计计划特征，TemplateQO 可以更有效地了解查询及其执行计划之间的底层映射。此外，为了有效地适应不断变化的工作负载，我们引入了一种轻量级的微调方法。微调方法保留了以前学到的知识，从而实现有效的持续学习。实验表明，TemplateQO有效提高了查询性能，具有很强的可扩展性，并显著降低了规划时间。

papers.title: Query-Driven Data Exploration with Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
papers.title_zh: 具有异构处理效果的查询驱动的数据探索
papers.authors: Antonis Mandamadiotis, Sihem Amer-Yahia, Georgia Koutrika
papers.abstract: Understanding how changes in actions or policies impact different population segments (users, items, etc.) is central to data-driven decision-making, but it is time-consuming and labor-intensive. We introduce a novel framework that combines user-defined search areas with causal inference to automatically identify responsive subgroups, i.e., subgroups most likely to benefit from a specific action or intervention, by estimating the impact of interventions, while also promoting subgroup diversity to ensure broad and representative insights. To support this, we develop a formal problem definition and an efficient search strategy to navigate the large combinatorial space of possible subgroups. We propose efficient algorithms that use pretrained causal effect estimators to dynamically surface the top- $K$ subgroups. Experiments across multiple datasets and estimation techniques demonstrate the scalability and effectiveness of our framework for large-scale analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 了解行动或政策的变化如何影响不同的人群（用户、物品等）是数据驱动决策的核心，但它既耗时又费力。我们引入了一种新颖的框架，该框架将用户定义的搜索区域与因果推理相结合，通过估计干预措施的影响来自动识别响应子组，即最有可能从特定行动或干预中受益的子组，同时还促进子组多样性以确保广泛且具有代表性的见解。为了支持这一点，我们开发了一个正式的问题定义和一个有效的搜索策略来导航可能的子组的大组合空间。我们提出了有效的算法，使用预先训练的因果效应估计器来动态地显示前 $K$ 子组。跨多个数据集和估计技术的实验证明了我们的大规模分析框架的可扩展性和有效性。

papers.title: Chase Anonymisation: Privacy-Preserving Knowledge Graphs with Logical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: Chase 匿名化：具有逻辑推理的隐私保护知识图
papers.authors: Luigi Bellomarini, Costanza Catalano, Andrea Coletta, Michela Iezzi, Pierangela Samarati
papers.abstract: We propose a novel framework to enable Knowledge Graphs (KGs) sharing while ensuring that information that should remain private is not directly released nor indirectly exposed via derived knowledge, maintaining at the same time the embedded knowledge of the KGs to support business downstream tasks. Our approach produces a privacy-preserving KG as an augmentation of the input one via controlled addition of nodes and edges as well as re-labeling of nodes and perturbation of weights. We introduce a novel privacy measure for KGs, which considers derived knowledge, a new utility metric that captures the business semantics we want to preserve, and propose two novel anonymisation algorithms. Our extensive experimental evaluation, with both synthetic graphs and real-world datasets, confirms the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架来实现知识图谱（KG）共享，同时确保应保持私密性的信息不会直接发布或通过派生知识间接暴露，同时维护知识图谱的嵌入式知识以支持业务下游任务。我们的方法通过控制节点和边的添加以及节点的重新标记和权重的扰动，生成一个保护隐私的知识图谱，作为输入的增强。我们引入了一种新颖的 KG 隐私措施，它考虑派生知识，这是一种新的效用指标，可以捕获我们想要保留的业务语义，并提出两种新颖的匿名算法。我们使用合成图和真实数据集进行的广泛实验评估证实了我们方法的有效性。

papers.title: SSC-Join: an Efficient Syntactic-Semantic Collaboration based Set Semantic Similarity Join Algorithm
papers.title_zh: SSC-Join：一种基于高效句法语义协作的集合语义相似度连接算法
papers.authors: Lianyin Jia, Chengchen Zeng, Mengjuan Li, Suprio Ray, Yinong Chen, Jiaman Ding, Xiuxing Li
papers.abstract: Existing semantic similarity join algorithms assume that all elements in the sets are semantic elements, overlooking the significant impact of syntactic elements. Processing semantic elements requires executing the Hungarian algorithm, leading to high processing costs. To address this challenge, we first introduce signature-based set partitioning, dividing each set into a semantic subset and a syntactic subset while maximizing the number of elements in the syntactic subset to lower semantic processing costs. Second, we design a novel filtering-verification framework. In the filtering phase, we propose efficient signature prefix filtering and collaborative difference filtering methods; signature prefix filtering effectively resolves the issues of conventional prefix filtering failures in set semantic similarity join, while collaborative difference filtering collaboratively exploits the lengths of the syntactic subset and the semantic subset, significantly reducing the number of candidates. Collaborative difference filtering uses only length information for filtering, making it simple and efficient. We theoretically prove that collaborative difference filtering has a higher filtering efficiency than length filtering. In the verification phase, we further propose a semantic-enhanced verification strategy that accelerates the validation speed of the syntactic subset by leveraging the lengths of the unprobed semantic subset. Based on these strategies, we present SSC-Join, which collaboratively utilizes semantic and syntactic subsets. Experimental results on multiple real world datasets demonstrate that SSC-Join can substantially reduce both the number and length of candidates requiring the Hungarian algorithm, offering a performance improvement of up to 679 × over existing algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的语义相似性连接算法假设集合中的所有元素都是语义元素，忽略了句法元素的显著影响。处理语义元素需要执行匈牙利算法，处理成本较高。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先引入基于签名的集合划分，将每个集合划分为语义子集和句法子集，同时最大化句法子集中的元素数量以降低语义处理成本。其次，我们设计了一种新颖的过滤验证框架。在过滤阶段，我们提出了高效的签名前缀过滤和协同差分过滤方法；签名前缀过滤有效解决了集合语义相似连接中传统前缀过滤失败的问题，而协同差分过滤则协同利用句法子集和语义子集的长度，显著减少了候选数。协同差分过滤仅使用长度信息进行过滤，简单高效。我们从理论上证明协同差分过滤比长度过滤具有更高的过滤效率。在验证阶段，我们进一步提出了一种语义增强验证策略，该策略通过利用未探测的语义子集的长度来加速语法子集的验证速度。基于这些策略，我们提出了 SSC-Join，它协作利用语义和句法子集。在多个现实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，SSC-Join 可以大幅减少需要匈牙利算法的候选数量和长度，与现有算法相比，性能提升高达 679 倍。

papers.title: Deferred Flushing for Out-of-Order Arrivals in Apache IoTDB
papers.title_zh: Apache IoTDB 中无序到达的延迟刷新
papers.authors: Xiaojian Zhang, Zhiheng Liu, Shaoxu Song, Xiangdong Huang, Chen Wang, Jianmin Wang
papers.abstract: Delays are inevitably associated with network transmission, leading to out-of-order time series arrivals. To store the data in time order, time series databases (TSDBs) choose to merge them via compaction in an LSM-tree. It incurs huge write amplification cost. We notice that the out-of-order arrivals are often delayed further for only a short while. By deferring a bit the flush of the latest data to disk, most out-of-order data arrivals can be sorted in memory. The problem is thus how to determine the size of data in memory deferred flushing, in order to reduce the disordered data for compaction. In this paper, we analyze the properties of delay distributions and determine a proper number $\kappa$ of the latest data that will be deferred in flushing for lower write amplification. The proposal has been deployed in time series database Apache IoTDB. Extensive experiments on real and synthetic workloads demonstrate that the proposed method can reduce write amplification from 2.0 to almost 1.0, i.e., eliminating most disordered data. While it may slightly incur some cost of maintaining the deferred $\kappa$ data points in writing, the compaction as well as query time costs are significantly reduced.
papers.abstract_zh: 延迟不可避免地与网络传输相关，导致时间序列到达无序。为了按时间顺序存储数据，时间序列数据库 (TSDB) 选择通过 LSM 树中的压缩来合并它们。它会产生巨大的写放大成本。我们注意到，无序到达的航班通常会进一步延迟一小段时间。通过稍微延迟将最新数据刷新到磁盘，大多数无序数据到达可以在内存中排序。那么问题就是如何确定内存延迟刷新中数据的大小，以减少compaction时的无序数据。在本文中，我们分析了延迟分布的特性，并确定了在刷新中延迟的最新数据的适当数量$\kappa$，以降低写入放大。该提案已部署在时间序列数据库 Apache IoTDB 中。对真实和合成工作负载的大量实验表明，所提出的方法可以将写放大从 2.0 降低到几乎 1.0，即消除大多数无序数据。虽然以书面形式维护延迟的 $\kappa$ 数据点可能会稍微产生一些成本，但压缩和查询时间成本会显著降低。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Efficient Traffic Forecasting on Large-Scale Road Network by Regularized Adaptive Graph Convolution
papers.title_zh: 通过正则化自适应图卷积进行大规模路网的高效交通预测
papers.authors: Kaiqi Wu, Weiyang Kong, Sen Zhang, Zitong Chen, Yubao Liu
papers.abstract: Traffic prediction is a critical task in spatial-temporal forecasting with broad applications in travel planning and urban management. To model the complex spatial-temporal dependencies in traffic data, Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (STGCNs) have been widely employed, achieving advanced performance. However, when applied to large-scale road networks, the quadratic computational complexity of traditional graph convolution operations severely limits their scalability. Several methods attempt to address this issue through approximation, compression, or spatial partitioning. Nevertheless, these methods often either fail to achieve sufficient computational efficiency or compromise prediction accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose a Regularized Adaptive Graph Convolution (RAGC) model. First, to ensure scalability on large road networks, we develop the Efficient Cosine Operator (ECO), which performs graph convolution based on the cosine similarity of node embeddings with linear time complexity. Second, we introduce a regularized adaptive graph convolution framework that combines Stochastic Shared Embedding (SSE) and adaptive graph convolution through a residual difference mechanism. This design enables the model to learn high-quality node embeddings, thereby improving prediction accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency. Extensive experiments on four large-scale real-world traffic datasets show that RAGC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of prediction accuracy and exhibits competitive computational efficiency. The code is available at: https://github.com/wkq-wukaiqi/RAGC.
papers.abstract_zh: 交通预测是时空预测的一项关键任务，在出行规划和城市管理中有着广泛的应用。为了对交通数据中复杂的时空依赖性进行建模，时空图卷积网络（STGCN）已被广泛采用，并实现了先进的性能。然而，当应用于大规模道路网络时，传统图卷积运算的二次计算复杂度严重限制了其可扩展性。有几种方法试图通过近似、压缩或空间分区来解决这个问题。然而，这些方法通常要么无法实现足够的计算效率，要么损害预测精度。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了正则化自适应图卷积（RAGC）模型。首先，为了确保大型道路网络的可扩展性，我们开发了高效余弦算子（ECO），它基于具有线性时间复杂度的节点嵌入的余弦相似性来执行图卷积。其次，我们引入了一种正则化自适应图卷积框架，该框架通过残差机制将随机共享嵌入（SSE）和自适应图卷积结合起来。这种设计使模型能够学习高质量的节点嵌入，从而在保持计算效率的同时提高预测精度。对四个大规模现实世界交通数据集的大量实验表明，RAGC 在预测精度方面始终优于最先进的方法，并表现出有竞争力的计算效率。代码位于：https://github.com/wkq-wukaiqi/RAGC。

时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: SaSPartitioner: A Self-adaptive Streaming Partitioner using Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: SaSPartitioner：使用深度强化学习的自适应流分区器
papers.authors: Shenghao Gong, Liu Liu, Ziquan Fang, Yunjun Gao, Yaofeng Tu
papers.abstract: Stream processing has been widely adopted in online services, such as e-commerce platforms and real-time query systems, due to its ability to leverage distributed parallel computing for low-latency, large-scale data processing. However, data skew, which results in imbalanced load distribution across computational nodes, can significantly increase processing latency and degrade resource efficiency. Most existing stream processing systems adopt partitioning strategies based on data volume, estimating system load using the volume of data in each partition. As a result, they often struggle to adapt promptly to dynamic changes in data distribution caused by streaming workloads. To this end, we propose SaSPartitioner, a self-adaptive partitioning framework based on system-metric modeling that leverages deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and real-time system metrics. Specifically, we formulate the streaming partitioning problem as a Markov decision process (MDP), collecting real-time metrics such as CPU and memory usage of streaming operators. Besides, we design both offline and online reinforcement learning models to enable seamless adaptation to dynamic shifts in data distribution. To further enhance efficiency, we introduce two acceleration methods, i.e., partition masking and hot key selection, to prune the state and action space of the DRL model. Extensive experiments on Apache Flink show that SaSPartitioner significantly outperforms existing stream partitioning methods, achieving up to a $44 \times$ increase in throughput while maintaining robustness under rapidly changing data distributions.
papers.abstract_zh: 流处理因其利用分布式并行计算进行低延迟、大规模数据处理的能力，已广泛应用于电子商务平台和实时查询系统等在线服务中。然而，数据倾斜会导致计算节点之间的负载分布不平衡，从而显著增加处理延迟并降低资源效率。现有的流处理系统大多采用基于数据量的分区策略，通过每个分区的数据量来估计系统负载。因此，他们常常难以迅速适应流工作负载引起的数据分布的动态变化。为此，我们提出了 SaSPartitioner，这是一种基于系统度量建模的自适应分区框架，利用深度强化学习（DRL）和实时系统度量。具体来说，我们将流分区问题表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），收集实时指标，例如流算子的 CPU 和内存使用情况。此外，我们设计了离线和在线强化学习模型，以实现无缝适应数据分布的动态变化。为了进一步提高效率，我们引入了两种加速方法，即分区屏蔽和热键选择，来修剪 DRL 模型的状态和动作空间。 Apache Flink 上的大量实验表明，SaSPartitioner 的性能显著优于现有的流分区方法，吞吐量提高了 44 倍，同时在快速变化的数据分布下保持了鲁棒性。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: AdaFedRec: Adaptive Heterogeneous Federated Recommender Systems across Multi-Device Users
papers.title_zh: AdaFedRec：跨多设备用户的自适应异构联合推荐系统
papers.authors: Zhenkai Li, Ming Hu, Chentao Jia, Yining Sun, Zhufeng Lu, Mingyang Yu, Yanxing Yang, Xiaofei Xie, Mingsong Chen
papers.abstract: Although Federated Learning (FL), as a distributed machine learning paradigm, is promising for privacy-preserving model training in recommender systems, it suffers from low training performance due to heterogeneous hardware resources across user devices, especially among users with multiple devices. Specifically, i) the limited hardware capabilities of some user devices prevent them from participating in training large, highperformance models, while the limited number of users with high-performance devices results in insufficient data for training the large model. ii) Recommender systems are often deployed on multiple heterogeneous devices (e.g., personal computers and mobile phones) of each user, which makes it challenging to migrate personalized features of users for heterogeneous recommender models training across various uncertain devices. To address this issue, this paper presents a novel heterogeneous FedRec framework, AdaFedRec, that adaptively assigns heterogeneous models for local training based on the available resources of user devices and employs an adaptive heterogeneous model migration mechanism across multiple devices of a specific user. Specifically, AdaFedRec adopts an encoder-decoder-based heterogeneous model generation strategy for collaborative model training among heterogeneous devices. Additionally, AdaFedRec incorporates a knowledge-diffusion-based model-migration mechanism for training models across users' heterogeneous devices. The experimental results demonstrate that AdaFedRec achieves the best results across all datasets. Our code can be accessed at https://github.com/Iridescentttttt/AdaFedRec.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管联邦学习（FL）作为一种分布式机器学习范例，在推荐系统中的隐私保护模型训练方面很有前景，但由于用户设备之间的异构硬件资源（尤其是在拥有多个设备的用户之间），它的训练性能较低。具体来说，i）一些用户设备的硬件能力有限，无法参与大型高性能模型的训练，而拥有高性能设备的用户数量有限，导致训练大型模型的数据不足。 ii）推荐系统通常部署在每个用户的多个异构设备（例如个人电脑和手机）上，这使得在各种不确定设备上迁移用户的个性化特征以进行异构推荐模型训练变得具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种新颖的异构 FedRec 框架 AdaFedRec，该框架根据用户设备的可用资源自适应地分配异构模型进行本地训练，并在特定用户的多个设备之间采用自适应异构模型迁移机制。具体来说，AdaFedRec采用基于编码器-解码器的异构模型生成策略来进行异构设备之间的协作模型训练。此外，AdaFedRec 还采用了基于知识扩散的模型迁移机制，用于跨用户异构设备训练模型。实验结果表明，AdaFedRec 在所有数据集上均取得了最佳结果。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/Iridescentttttt/AdaFedRec 访问。

papers.title: MatKV: Trading Compute for Flash Storage in LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: MatKV：LLM 推理中用计算换取闪存存储
papers.authors: Kun-Woo Shin, Jay H. Park, Moonwook Oh, Yohan Jo, Jaeyoung Do, Sang-Won Lee
papers.abstract: We observe two major trends in LLM-based generative AI: (1) inference is becoming the dominant factor in terms of cost and power consumption, surpassing training, and (2) retrieval augmented generation (RAG) is becoming prevalent. When processing long inputs in RAG, the prefill phase of computing the key-value vectors of input text is energy-intensive and time-consuming even with high-end GPUs. Thus, it is crucial to make the prefill phase in RAG inference efficient. To address this issue, we propose MatKV, a scheme that precomputes the key-value vectors (KVs) of RAG objects (e.g., documents), materializes them in inexpensive but fast and power-efficient flash storage, and reuses them at inference time instead of recomputing the KVs using costly and power-inefficient GPU. Experimental results using Hugging Face's Transformers library across state-of-the-art GPUs and flash memory SSDs confirm that, compared to full KV computation on GPUs, MatKV reduces both inference time and power consumption by half for RAG workloads, without severely impacting accuracy in the question-answering task. Furthermore, we demonstrate that MatKV enables additional optimizations in two ways. First, a GPU can decode text while simultaneously loading the materialized KVs for the next instance, reducing load latency. Second, since decoding speed is less sensitive to GPU performance than KV computation, low-end GPUs can be leveraged for decoding without significantly compromising speed once the materialized KVs are loaded into GPU memory. These findings underscore MatKV's potential to make large-scale generative AI applications more cost-effective, power-efficient, and accessible across a wider range of tasks and hardware environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们观察到基于大语言模型的生成式人工智能的两个主要趋势：（1）推理正在成为成本和功耗方面的主导因素，超过了训练；（2）检索增强生成（RAG）正在变得普遍。在 RAG 中处理长输入时，即使使用高端 GPU，计算输入文本的键值向量的预填充阶段也是能源密集型且耗时的。因此，提高 RAG 推理中预填充阶段的效率至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 MatKV，一种预先计算 RAG 对象（例如文档）的键值向量（KV）的方案，将它们具体化在廉价但快速且节能的闪存中，并在推理时重用它们，而不是使用昂贵且低能效的 GPU 重新计算 KV。在最先进的 GPU 和闪存 SSD 上使用 Hugging Face 的 Transformers 库进行的实验结果证实，与 GPU 上的完整 KV 计算相比，MatKV 将 RAG 工作负载的推理时间和功耗减少了一半，而不会严重影响问答任务的准确性。此外，我们证明 MatKV 通过两种方式实现额外的优化。首先，GPU 可以解码文本，同时加载下一个实例的具体化 KV，从而减少加载延迟。其次，由于解码速度对 GPU 性能的敏感度低于 KV 计算，因此一旦物化 KV 加载到 GPU 内存中，就可以利用低端 GPU 进行解码，而不会显著影响速度。这些发现强调了 MatKV 有潜力使大规模生成式 AI 应用程序更具成本效益、更节能，并且可以在更广泛的任务和硬件环境中访问。

papers.title: LUCID: an Updatable and Concurrent Learned Index for Larger-than-Memory Data Management
papers.title_zh: LUCID：用于大于内存数据管理的可更新和并发学习索引
papers.authors: Chaohong Ma, Xiaohui Yu, Yifan Li, Aishan Maoliniyazi, Xiaofeng Meng
papers.abstract: Learned indexes have shown great potential for improving data storage and access performance, but their adoption in real-world systems is limited when data exceed memory capacity. In-memory approaches become impractical at scale, while fully on-disk techniques often fail to meet the performance demands of diverse workloads. Hybrid storage architectures that combine memory's low latency with disk's high capacity offer a promising middle ground. However, deploying learned indexes in such environments, especially under dynamic and complex workloads, remains challenging. An effective solution must manage larger-than-memory datasets within constrained resources, support dynamic updates, and enable concurrent operations-requirements that existing methods do not satisfy simultaneously. This paper presents LUCID, an Updatable and Concurrent Learned Index for larger-than-memory Data management. LUCID is a learned tree structure that indexes data spanning memory and disk, offering robust support for dynamic and concurrent workloads. First, it employs model-guided buffering to optimize in-memory insertions. Second, it introduces an overflow strategy at the leaf level to reduce the cost of structural modifications during updates. Third, it adopts a flattened design to track on-disk data more precisely while minimizing memory overhead. Finally, LUCID incorporates a lightweight, optimistic locking mechanism tailored to the needs of larger-than-memory systems, enabling efficient concurrent access.
papers.abstract_zh: 学习索引在提高数据存储和访问性能方面表现出了巨大的潜力，但当数据超出内存容量时，它们在实际系统中的采用就会受到限制。内存方法在大规模上变得不切实际，而完全在磁盘上的技术通常无法满足不同工作负载的性能需求。混合存储架构将内存的低延迟与磁盘的高容量相结合，提供了一个有前途的中间立场。然而，在这种环境中部署学习索引，尤其是在动态和复杂的工作负载下，仍然具有挑战性。有效的解决方案必须在有限的资源内管理大于内存的数据集，支持动态更新，并实现现有方法无法同时满足的并发操作要求。本文介绍了 LUCID，一种用于大于内存数据管理的可更新和并发学习索引。 LUCID 是一种学习树结构，可以索引跨内存和磁盘的数据，为动态和并发工作负载提供强大的支持。首先，它采用模型引导缓冲来优化内存中插入。其次，它在叶级引入了溢出策略，以减少更新期间结构修改的成本。第三，它采用扁平化设计，可以更精确地跟踪磁盘数据，同时最大限度地减少内存开销。最后，LUCID 结合了针对大于内存系统的需求而定制的轻量级乐观锁定机制，从而实现高效的并发访问。

papers.title: CoLSE: A Lightweight and Robust Hybrid Learned Model for Single-Table Cardinality Estimation using Joint CDF
papers.title_zh: CoLSE：使用联合 CDF 进行单表基数估计的轻量级且鲁棒的混合学习模型
papers.authors: Lankadinee Rathuwadu, Christopher Leckie, Guanli Liu, Renata Borovica-Gajic
papers.abstract: Cardinality estimation (CE), the task of predicting the result size of queries is a critical component of query optimization. Accurate estimates are essential for generating efficient query execution plans. Recently, machine learning techniques have been applied to CE, broadly categorized into query-driven and data-driven approaches. Data-driven methods learn the joint distribution of data, while query-driven methods construct regression models that map query features to cardinalities. Ideally, a CE technique should strike a balance among three key factors: accuracy, efficiency, and memory footprint. However, existing state-of-the-art models often fail to achieve this balance. To address this, we propose CoLSE, a hybrid learned approach for single-table cardinality estimation. CoLSE directly models the joint probability over queried intervals using a novel algorithm based on copula theory and integrates a lightweight neural network to correct residual estimation errors. Experimental results show that CoLSE achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, training time, inference latency, and model size, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基数估计（CE），预测查询结果大小的任务是查询优化的关键组成部分。准确的估计对于生成高效的查询执行计划至关重要。最近，机器学习技术已应用于CE，大致分为查询驱动和数据驱动方法。数据驱动方法学习数据的联合分布，而查询驱动方法构建将查询特征映射到基数的回归模型。理想情况下，CE 技术应在三个关键因素之间取得平衡：准确性、效率和内存占用。然而，现有的最先进模型往往无法实现这种平衡。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 CoLSE，一种用于单表基数估计的混合学习方法。 CoLSE 使用基于 copula 理论的新颖算法直接对查询区间上的联合概率进行建模，并集成轻量级神经网络来纠正残差估计误差。实验结果表明，CoLSE 在准确性、训练时间、推理延迟和模型大小之间实现了有利的权衡，优于现有的最先进方法。

papers.title: An Encode-then-Decompose Approach to Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection on Contaminated Training Data
papers.title_zh: 对污染训练数据进行无监督时间序列异常检测的编码然后分解方法
papers.authors: Buang Zhang, Tung Kieu, Xiangfei Qiu, Chenjuan Guo, Jilin Hu, Aoying Zhou, Christian S. Jensen, Bin Yang
papers.abstract: Time series anomaly detection is important in modern large-scale systems and is applied in a variety of domains to analyze and monitor the operation of diverse systems. Unsupervised approaches have received widespread interest, as they do not require anomaly labels during training, thus avoiding potentially high costs and having wider applications. Among these, autoencoders have received extensive attention. They use reconstruction errors from compressed representations to define anomaly scores. However, representations learned by autoencoders are sensitive to anomalies in training time series, causing reduced accuracy. We propose a novel encode-then-decompose paradigm, where we decompose the encoded representation into stable and auxiliary representations, thereby enhancing the robustness when training with contaminated time series. In addition, we propose a novel mutual information based metric to replace the reconstruction errors for identifying anomalies. Our proposal demonstrates competitive or state-of-the-art performance on eight commonly used multi- and univariate time series benchmarks and exhibits robustness to time series with different contamination ratios.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列异常检测在现代大型系统中非常重要，并应用于各个领域来分析和监控不同系统的运行。无监督方法受到了广泛的关注，因为它们在训练过程中不需要异常标签，从而避免了潜在的高成本并具有更广泛的应用。其中，自动编码器受到了广泛的关注。他们使用压缩表示的重建误差来定义异常分数。然而，自动编码器学习的表示对训练时间序列中的异常敏感，导致准确性降低。我们提出了一种新颖的编码然后分解范例，将编码表示分解为稳定和辅助表示，从而增强了使用污染时间序列进行训练时的鲁棒性。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的基于互信息的度量来替代用于识别异常的重建误差。我们的建议在八个常用的多变量和单变量时间序列基准上展示了具有竞争力或最先进的性能，并表现出对不同污染率的时间序列的鲁棒性。

papers.title: GRACE: Alleviating Reconstruction Cost in Dynamic Graph Processing Systems
papers.title_zh: GRACE：降低动态图处理系统的重建成本
papers.authors: Hongru Gao, Shuhao Zhang, Xiaofei Liao, Hai Jin
papers.abstract: Efficient dynamic graph processing is critical for real-time applications. Recent systems utilize hybrid layouts combining Packed Memory Array (PMA) and Compressed Sparse Row (CSR) structures to balance updating and computing efficiency. However, these systems face key challenges, including costly global copying and traversal during reconstruction, which in turn induce excessive costly rebalancing processes during graph updating, limiting performance under intensive updates. To mitigate these, existing solutions either compromise cache efficiency by relaxing memory contiguity or apply OS-level techniques without exploiting graph structural properties, leaving large optimization space unexplored. In this paper, we propose GRACE, a lightweight extension for PMA-based CSR systems that leverages graph structural properties to improve reconstruction and support efficient updates without sacrificing layout contiguity. Specifically, GRACE incorporates 1) a propertyguided reservation strategy that partitions the PMA into regions and applies tailored methods, minimizing copying and traversal during reconstruction while providing optimized layout for rebalancing, and 2) a cousin-aware rebalancing strategy that assesses the impact of the vertices and confines rebalancing to smaller ranges by exploiting cousin segments of PMA tree, reducing redundant relocation during insertion. We implement GRACE as a modular plugin atop representative dynamic graph processing systems, including PPCSR, Terrace, and VCSR. Experimental results show that GRACE effectively accelerates their reconstruction and achieves substantial improvements in graph updating efficiency while maintaining comparable computing performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 高效的动态图处理对于实时应用程序至关重要。最近的系统利用组合内存阵列（PMA）和压缩稀疏行（CSR）结构的混合布局来平衡更新和计算效率。然而，这些系统面临着关键挑战，包括重建过程中昂贵的全局复制和遍历，这反过来又导致图更新过程中代价高昂的重新平衡过程，限制了密集更新下的性能。为了缓解这些问题，现有的解决方案要么通过放松内存连续性来降低缓存效率，要么应用操作系统级技术而不利用图结构属性，从而留下大量未开发的优化空间。在本文中，我们提出了 GRACE，它是基于 PMA 的 CSR 系统的轻量级扩展，它利用图结构属性来改进重建并支持高效更新，而无需牺牲布局连续性。具体来说，GRACE 包含 1) 属性引导保留策略，将 PMA 划分为区域并应用定制方法，最大限度地减少重建过程中的复制和遍历，同时为重新平衡提供优化布局；2) 表兄弟感知再平衡策略，评估顶点的影响，并通过利用 PMA 树的表兄弟段将重新平衡限制在更小的范围内，从而减少插入期间的冗余重定位。我们将 GRACE 作为具有代表性的动态图形处理系统（包括 PPCSR、Terrace 和 VCSR）之上的模块化插件来实现。实验结果表明，GRACE有效地加速了它们的重建，并在保持可比较的计算性能的同时，实现了图更新效率的实质性提高。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Task Assignment in Spatial Crowdsourcing via Implicit Human Feedback
papers.title_zh: 通过隐式人类反馈进行空间众包中的高保真任务分配
papers.authors: Qingshun Wu, Yafei Li, Lei Gao, Guanglei Zhu, Lei Chen, Mingliang Xu
papers.abstract: Dynamic task assignment that allocates spatial tasks to mobile workers based on time windows has emerged as a key research problem in spatial crowdsourcing (SC), where the major challenge lies in deciding the optimal window size. Recent studies use reinforcement learning models (RLMs) to adaptively partition task streams into time windows, showing promising performance. However, most RLMs are trained in simplified digital-worlds where travel times are estimated by static rules or distances, failing to capture physical-world dynamics such as congestion and lane changes. This misalignment of travel time leads to a significant performance gap when deployed RLMs in real-world SC environments. To bridge this gap, we study a novel High-Fidelity Task Assignment (HFTA) problem and present an effective Adaptive Matching with Implicit Human Feedback (AM-IHF) framework to solve it. AM-IHF comprises three key components: 1) a high-fidelity environment equipped with a taskoriented lane-changing model that capture realistic traffic-task dynamics, 2) an RLM-powered adaptive matcher with enhanced spatiotemporal state representations, and 3) a lightweight humanin-the-loop module, which enables implicit human guidance by adjusting learning parameters (i.e., time window boundaries) via visual feedback, thus injecting domain knowledge without increasing cognitive load. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that our lane-changing model contributes to 27.2% and $\mathbf{2 3. 4 \%}$ improvements in platform revenue and task completion rate, respectively, while the implicit human feedback mechanism accelerates RLM training by 41.6%.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于时间窗口向移动工作人员分配空间任务的动态任务分配已成为空间众包（SC）中的一个关键研究问题，其主要挑战在于确定最佳窗口大小。最近的研究使用强化学习模型（RLM）将任务流自适应地划分为时间窗口，显示出良好的性能。然而，大多数 RLM 都是在简化的数字世界中进行训练的，其中行程时间是通过静态规则或距离来估计的，无法捕获物理世界的动态，例如拥堵和车道变换。当在现实 SC 环境中部署 RLM 时，这种行程时间的错位会导致显著的性能差距。为了弥补这一差距，我们研究了一种新颖的高保真任务分配（HFTA）问题，并提出了一种有效的自适应匹配与隐式人类反馈（AM-IHF）框架来解决它。 AM-IHF 包含三个关键组件：1）配备面向任务的车道变换模型的高保真环境，可捕获真实的交通任务动态；2）具有增强的时空状态表示的 RLM 驱动的自适应匹配器；3）轻量级人机循环模块，该模块通过视觉反馈调整学习参数（即时间窗口边界）来实现隐式人类指导，从而在不增加认知负荷的情况下注入领域知识。对两个真实世界数据集的实验表明，我们的换道模型对平台收入和任务完成率分别贡献了 27.2% 和 $\mathbf{2 3. 4 \%}$ 改进，而隐式人类反馈机制将 RLM 训练加速了 41.6%。

papers.title: LAMP: A Dual-Mode Framework for Database Workload Memory Prediction
papers.title_zh: LAMP：数据库工作负载内存预测的双模式框架
papers.authors: Guoze Xue, Lu Chen, Ziquan Fang, Tianyi Li, Yushuai Li, Torben Bach Pedersen
papers.abstract: Precise prediction of working memory consumption for query workloads is crucial for preventing out-of-memory errors and optimizing resource utilization in modern database systems. While existing approaches focus on performance prediction for individual queries, they fail to capture the complex memory dynamics arising from concurrent execution and resource contention. To remedy this, we present Load-Aware Memory Prediction framework (LAMP), a novel framework that addresses workload-level memory prediction through two complementary operational modes: accuracy-oriented prediction for development environments and robustness-oriented prediction for production deployments. LAMP utilizes a neural model that integrates Tree Convolutional Neural Networks for encoding query execution plans alongside DeepSets-based aggregation to effectively manage variable-sized workloads while maintaining permutation invariance. This approach allows the model to capture both the unique characteristics of individual queries and the overarching patterns of collective memory consumption. In production environments, we propose an uncertaintyaware memory allocation strategy grounded in heteroscedastic regression. This strategy quantifies prediction confidence and facilitates risk-calibrated provisioning through the implementation of adaptive safety buffers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LAMP achieves up to 40.98% reduction in prediction error compared to state-of-the-art methods in accuracy-oriented mode, while in robustness-oriented mode it achieves the optimal tradeoff between system stability and prediction accuracy, providing database administrators with a principled approach to balance resource efficiency and system reliability.
papers.abstract_zh: 精确预测查询工作负载的工作内存消耗对于防止内存不足错误和优化现代数据库系统中的资源利用率至关重要。虽然现有方法侧重于单个查询的性能预测，但它们无法捕获并发执行和资源争用引起的复杂内存动态。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了负载感知内存预测框架（LAMP），这是一种新颖的框架，它通过两种互补的操作模式来解决工作负载级内存预测：针对开发环境的面向准确性的预测和针对生产部署的面向稳健性的预测。 LAMP 利用集成树卷积神经网络的神经模型来编码查询执行计划以及基于 DeepSets 的聚合，以有效管理可变大小的工作负载，同时保持排列不变性。这种方法允许模型捕获单个查询的独特特征和集体内存消耗的总体模式。在生产环境中，我们提出了一种基于异方差回归的不确定性内存分配策略。该策略量化了预测置信度，并通过实施自适应安全缓冲区来促进风险校准配置。大量实验表明，在面向精度的模式下，与最先进的方法相比，LAMP实现了高达40.98%的预测误差降低，而在面向鲁棒性的模式下，它实现了系统稳定性和预测精度之间的最佳权衡，为数据库管理员提供了平衡资源效率和系统可靠性的原则性方法。

papers.title: Efficient Model-Agnostic Continual Learning for Next POI Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 针对下一个 POI 推荐的高效模型无关持续学习
papers.authors: Chenhao Wang, Shanshan Feng, Lisi Chen, Fan Li, Shuo Shang
papers.abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation improves personalized location-based services by predicting users' next destinations based on their historical check-ins. However, most existing methods rely on static datasets and fixed models, limiting their ability to adapt to changes in user behavior over time. To address this limitation, we explore a novel task termed continual next POI recommendation, where models dynamically adapt to evolving user interests through continual updates. This task is particularly challenging, as it requires capturing shifting user behaviors while retaining previously learned knowledge. Moreover, it is essential to ensure efficiency in update time and memory usage for real-world deployment. To this end, we propose GIRAM (Generative Key-based Interest Retrieval and Adaptive Modeling), an efficient, model-agnostic framework that integrates context-aware sustained interests with recent interests. GIRAM comprises four components: (1) an interest memory to preserve historical preferences; (2) a context-aware key encoding module for unified interest key representation; (3) a generative key-based retrieval module to identify diverse and relevant sustained interests; and (4) an adaptive interest update and fusion module to update the interest memory and balance sustained and recent interests. In particular, GIRAM can be seamlessly integrated with existing next POI recommendation models. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that GIRAM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high efficiency in both update time and memory consumption.
papers.abstract_zh: 下一个兴趣点 (POI) 推荐通过根据用户的历史签到来预测用户的下一个目的地，从而改进基于位置的个性化服务。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于静态数据集和固定模型，限制了它们适应用户行为随时间变化的能力。为了解决这一限制，我们探索了一项称为持续下一个 POI 推荐的新颖任务，其中模型通过持续更新动态适应不断变化的用户兴趣。这项任务特别具有挑战性，因为它需要捕获不断变化的用户行为，同时保留以前学到的知识。此外，确保实际部署的更新时间和内存使用效率至关重要。为此，我们提出了 GIRAM（基于密钥的生成兴趣检索和自适应建模），这是一种高效的、与模型无关的框架，它将上下文感知的持续兴趣与近期兴趣集成在一起。 GIRAM由四个部分组成：（1）兴趣记忆，保存历史偏好； (2)用于统一兴趣密钥表示的上下文感知密钥编码模块； （3）基于生成键的检索模块，用于识别多样化且相关的持续兴趣； (4)自适应兴趣更新和融合模块，用于更新兴趣记忆并平衡持续兴趣和近期兴趣。特别是，GIRAM 可以与现有的下一代 POI 推荐模型无缝集成。对三个真实世界数据集的实验表明，GIRAM 始终优于最先进的方法，同时在更新时间和内存消耗方面保持高效率。

papers.title: GeoLayer: Towards Low-Latency and Cost-Efficient Geo-Distributed Graph Stores with Layered Graph
papers.title_zh: GeoLayer：利用分层图实现低延迟且经济高效的地理分布式图存储
papers.authors: Feng Yao, Xiaokang Yang, Shufeng Gong, Song Yu, Yanfeng Zhang, Ge Yu
papers.abstract: The inherent connectivity and dependency of graph-structured data, combined with its unique topology-driven access patterns, pose fundamental challenges to conventional data replication and request routing strategies in geo-distributed cloud storage systems. In this paper, we propose GeoLayer, a geo-distributed graph storage framework that jointly optimizes graph replica placement and pattern request routing. We first construct a latency-aware layered graph architecture that decomposes the graph topology into multiple layers, aiming to reduce the decision space and computational complexity of the optimization problem, while mitigating the impact of network heterogeneity in geo-distributed environments. Building on the layered graph, we introduce an overlap-centric replica placement scheme to accommodate the diversity of graph pattern accesses, along with a directed heat diffusion model that captures heat conduction and superposition effects to guide data allocation. For request routing, we develop a stepwise layered routing strategy that performs progressive expansion over the layered graph to efficiently retrieve the required data. Experimental results show that, compared to state-of-the-art replica placement and routing schemes, GeoLayer achieves a 1.34x - 3.67x improvement in response times for online graph pattern requests and a 1.28x - 3.56x speedup in offline graph analysis performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 图结构数据固有的连接性和依赖性，加上其独特的拓扑驱动的访问模式，对地理分布式云存储系统中的传统数据复制和请求路由策略提出了根本性挑战。在本文中，我们提出了 GeoLayer，一种地理分布式图存储框架，可联合优化图副本放置和模式请求路由。我们首先构建了一个延迟感知的分层图架构，将图拓扑分解为多个层，旨在减少优化问题的决策空间和计算复杂度，同时减轻地理分布式环境中网络异构性的影响。在分层图的基础上，我们引入了以重叠为中心的副本放置方案来适应图模式访问的多样性，以及定向热扩散模型，该模型捕获热传导和叠加效应以指导数据分配。对于请求路由，我们开发了一种逐步分层的路由策略，该策略在分层图上执行渐进扩展，以有效地检索所需的数据。实验结果表明，与最先进的副本放置和路由方案相比，GeoLayer 在线图模式请求的响应时间提高了 1.34 倍 - 3.67 倍，离线图分析性能提高了 1.28 倍 - 3.56 倍。

papers.title: Robust Index Benefit Estimation via Hierarchical and Two-dimensional Feature Representation
papers.title_zh: 通过分层和二维特征表示进行稳健的指数效益估计
papers.authors: Tao Li, Feng Liang, Jinqi Quan, Zihang Yang, Teng Wang, Runhuai Huang, Xiping Hu, Meng Li, Haipeng Dai
papers.abstract: In recent years, machine learning-based index advisors have gained success as they can estimate the benefit of a given index without actually evaluating it via what-if optimizers. However, existing methods often fail to capture indexrelevant features adequately, leading to limited accuracy and poor adaptability to changes in workload, schema, or data. To address these challenges, we propose Eddie, a novel index benefit estimation approach based on Hierarchical and Twodimensional Encoding. Our method encodes columns according to their positions in queries and indexes, consolidates indexrelated features into a compact representation, and leverages twodimensional attention to model both query plan structure and index interactions. Finally, Eddie can be seamlessly integrated with existing index advisors in real-world systems. 11https://github.com/quanjnq/Eddie Extensive evaluations demonstrate that it significantly outperforms stateof-the-art estimators in both accuracy and robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，基于机器学习的索引顾问取得了成功，因为它们可以估计给定索引的好处，而无需通过假设优化器实际评估它。然而，现有方法通常无法充分捕获索引相关特征，导致准确性有限且对工作负载、模式或数据变化的适应性较差。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Eddie，一种基于分层和二维编码的新型指数效益估计方法。我们的方法根据列在查询和索引中的位置对列进行编码，将索引相关的特征合并到紧凑的表示中，并利用二维注意力对查询计划结构和索引交互进行建模。最后，Eddie 可以与现实系统中现有的指数顾问无缝集成。 11https://github.com/quanjnq/Eddie 广泛的评估表明，它在准确性和鲁棒性方面都显著优于最先进的估计器。

papers.title: EC-RAG: Towards Efficient Edge-Cloud Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
papers.title_zh: EC-RAG：迈向高效的边缘云检索增强生成系统
papers.authors: Liang Wang, Kai Wang, Ranjun Jia, Kai Lu, Jiguang Wan, Hao Huo, Yulong Zhai, Zhiyuan Liang, Di Wang
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds the desired responses of large language models (LLMs) by connecting to external knowledge databases. However, deploying full-scale LLMs on resource-constrained edge servers is impractical. Instead, small language models (SLMs) enable efficient deployment at the edge, but their limited model capacity may compromise generation quality. In this paper, we propose EC-RAG, a novel edge-cloud RAG system that selectively decides whether the final response should be generated by the edge-based SLM or the API-accessed cloud-based LLM. Specifically, on top of standard RAG, EC-RAG integrates dynamic chunk pruning to retain only useful information for each query and achieves adaptive query routing based on the query complexity and the amount of retained information, balancing accuracy, latency, and API cost. Furthermore, we explore several system optimizations to improve SLM inference performance at the edge. Our evaluation across four datasets shows that EC-RAG incurs only a slight additional cost relative to the SLM-only RAG and closes much of the quality gap with the LLM-only RAG. EC-RAG delivers up to a 30% higher F1-score than the SLM-only RAG and reduces costs by 90% compared to the LLM-only RAG, while ensuring low average latency.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成 (RAG) 通过连接到外部知识数据库，为大型语言模型 (LLM) 提供所需的响应。然而，在资源有限的边缘服务器上部署全面的大语言模型是不切实际的。相反，小语言模型（SLM）可以在边缘进行高效部署，但其有限的模型容量可能会损害生成质量。在本文中，我们提出了 EC-RAG，一种新颖的边缘云 RAG 系统，它有选择地决定最终响应是由基于边缘的 SLM 还是由 API 访问的基于云的 LLM 生成。具体来说，在标准 RAG 之上，EC-RAG 集成了动态块剪枝，仅保留每个查询的有用信息，并根据查询复杂性和保留信息量实现自适应查询路由，平衡准确性、延迟和 API 成本。此外，我们还探索了多种系统优化来提高边缘的 SLM 推理性能。我们对四个数据集的评估表明，相对于仅 SLM 的 RAG，EC-RAG 仅产生轻微的额外成本，并且缩小了与仅 LLM RAG 的质量差距。 EC-RAG 的 F1 分数比仅采用 SLM 的 RAG 高出 30%，与仅采用 LLM 的 RAG 相比，成本降低了 90%，同时确保较低的平均延迟。
