papers.title: TabLoft: Tabular Data Generation Based on LLM with Ordered Features
papers.title_zh: TabLoft：基于LLM的有序特征的表格数据生成
papers.authors: Luyu Chen, Changhao Wu, Jingyi Li, Sen Liu, Guangnan Ye, Hongfeng Chai
papers.abstract: Tabular data is a fundamental format for storage and processing in databases. However, it often suffers from challenges such as limited sample size and privacy concerns in specific tasks. Tabular data generation offers a promising solution, and methods based on large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance. However, existing methods do not account for the unidirectional propagation inherent in the transformer architecture of LLMs. Consequently, the generation of preceding tokens cannot benefit from information in subsequent tokens, resulting the ordering of tabular features particularly critical. To address this limitation, we propose TabLoft, a Tabular data generation method based on LLM with ordered features. Inspired by the effectiveness of tree-based models in tabular tasks, we conduct a systematic analysis and design a feature ordering strategy accordingly. The ordered data is then encoded and used to fine-tune the LLM, enabling the generation of high-quality data. We introduce five evaluation metrics to quantitatively assess the quality of generated tabular data. The experimental results demonstrate that TabLoft achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to six baseline models.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据是数据库存储和处理的基本格式。然而，它经常面临样本量有限和特定任务中的隐私问题等挑战。表格数据生成提供了一种有前景的解决方案，并且基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的方法已展现出强大的性能。然而，现有方法没有考虑 LLM Transformer架构中固有的单向传播。因此，先前标记的生成无法从后续标记中的信息中受益，导致表格特征的排序尤其重要。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 TabLoft，一种基于 LLM 的具有有序特征的表格数据生成方法。受到基于树的模型在表格任务中的有效性的启发，我们进行了系统分析并相应地设计了特征排序策略。然后对有序数据进行编码并用于微调 LLM，从而生成高质量数据。我们引入了五个评估指标来定量评估生成的表格数据的质量。实验结果表明，与六个基线模型相比，TabLoft 实现了最先进的性能。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: CYANSQL: Unlock the Power of NL2SQL via Clustering-based Test-Time Scaling
papers.title_zh: CYANSQL：通过基于集群的测试时间扩展释放 NL2SQL 的强大功能
papers.authors: Haoyu Qin, Tonghui Ren, Zhenying He, X.Sean Wang, Jiashu Xing, Yanghuan Ye, Shifei Huang, Jinbao Li
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are playing an increasingly important role in the Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) task. Although LLMs exhibit strong inherent reasoning abilities, they often fail to generate correct SQL because they lack knowledge of the target logical operator composition. Few-shot learning is a commonly employed approach to provide relevant knowledge to LLMs, and many studies focus on how to select effective demonstrations. However, these methods are often limited by the quality of the selected demonstrations, resulting in a failure to fully exploit the rich logical operation information contained in the demonstrations. In this work, we propose CYANSQL (Cluster-aware Yielded Augmentation for NL2SQL), a method that leverages parallel test-time scaling to strengthen LLM reasoning. We first cluster the demonstrations based on SQL logical operator composition, then perform multi-path generation by injecting demonstrations from each cluster during LLM inference, followed by a ranking stage to identify the optimal SQL. CYANSQL achieves an execution accuracy of 73.47% and a state-of-the-art recall of 87.22% on the development set of the popular NL2SQL benchmark BIRD. The source code of this project is available at: https://github.com/zyddqhy/CYANSQL
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在自然语言转 SQL (NL2SQL) 任务中发挥着越来越重要的作用。尽管大语言模型表现出强大的固有推理能力，但他们经常无法生成正确的 SQL，因为他们缺乏对目标逻辑运算符组成的了解。少样本学习是为大语言模型提供相关知识的常用方法，许多研究都集中在如何选择有效的演示。然而，这些方法往往受到所选演示质量的限制，导致无法充分利用演示中包含的丰富逻辑操作信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了 CYANSQL（NL2SQL 的集群感知产量增强），这是一种利用并行测试时间扩展来加强 LLM 推理的方法。我们首先根据 SQL 逻辑运算符组合对演示进行集群，然后通过在 LLM 推理期间注入每个集群的演示来执行多路径生成，然后进行排名阶段以识别最佳 SQL。 CYANSQL 在流行的 NL2SQL 基准 BIRD 的开发集上实现了 73.47% 的执行准确率和 87.22% 的最先进召回率。该项目的源代码位于：https://github.com/zyddqhy/CYANSQL

papers.title: Effective Fairest Community Search over Heterogeneous Information Networks
papers.title_zh: 异构信息网络上有效最公平的社区搜索
papers.authors: Taige Zhao, Jianxin Li, Man Li, Wei Luo, Jingxian Cheng, Yuan Miao, Hua Wang
papers.abstract: Community search over heterogeneous information networks has been applied to wide domains, such as activity organization and team formation. Existing studies focus on identifying groups of members that meet the minimum engagement requirements. But in reality, given a group, its members may exhibit large gaps in their engagement levels with the group. It is easy to result in unfairness among the highly engaged members and lowly engaged members if we treat these members similarly. To fill in the research gap, we formally define the problem of individual fairest community search (denoted as IFCS) over heterogeneous information networks (HINs), which aims to find a set of vertices that have the same vertex type, motif-constrained relationships, and small variation in their engagement levels. Nonetheless, it is nontrivial to handle the IFCS problem due to its NP-hardness. To address the challenge, we first propose a baseline solution to identify the satisfied results by enumerating all the community candidates and computing their fairness score. To reduce the computational cost of community enumeration, we design a message-passing based strategy to filter out the vertices that are repeatedly checked for motif constraints, and further provide an optimization strategy to reduce the number of motif instances to be computed. To accelerate the search, we also derive the upper bound of the fairness score for community candidates and present a pruning-based optimization algorithm. Lastly, we conduct extensive experiments on four real-world datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our proposed IFCS methods, which achieve at least ×3 times faster than the baseline solution.
papers.abstract_zh: 异构信息网络上的社区搜索已应用于广泛的领域，例如活动组织和团队组建。现有的研究重点是确定满足最低参与要求的成员群体。但实际上，对于一个群体，其成员与该群体的参与程度可能存在巨大差距。如果对敬业度高的会员和敬业度低的会员一视同仁，很容易造成不公平。为了填补研究空白​​，我们正式定义了异构信息网络（HIN）上的个体最公平社区搜索（表示为IFCS）问题，其目的是找到一组具有相同顶点类型、主题约束关系以及参与度变化较小的顶点。尽管如此，由于 IFCS 问题的 NP 难度，处理它并不简单。为了应对这一挑战，我们首先提出一个基线解决方案，通过枚举所有社区候选者并计算其公平性分数来确定满意的结果。为了降低社区枚举的计算成本，我们设计了一种基于消息传递的策略来过滤掉重复检查模体约束的顶点，并进一步提供优化策略来减少要计算的模体实例的数量。为了加速搜索，我们还推导了社区候选者公平性得分的上限，并提出了一种基于剪枝的优化算法。最后，我们对四个真实世界数据集进行了广泛的实验，以证明我们提出的 IFCS 方法的有效性和效率，该方法比基准解决方案快至少 3 倍。

papers.title: IIT-Tree: An efficient index to support interval-based query on large temporal graphs
papers.title_zh: IIT-Tree：一种高效索引，支持大型时态图上基于区间的查询
papers.authors: Faming Li, Shengli Qiu, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang, Hengzhao Ma
papers.abstract: Graph is a powerful model to represent many-tomany relationships between entities and is widely used in mining social networks, managing communication networks, etc. The networks are usually not static and change over time. One of these types of networks is always represented by temporal graph, whose edges or vertices are available at a specific time. This incurs two challenges in managing temporal graphs: 1) a large amount of memory is required to store the graphs at different times, 2) querying or mining temporal graphs is inefficient as several graphs are involved within a query. Existing methods apply a $\Delta$ -based strategy to manage temporal graphs, which depend on the assumption that graphs within close time are similar. However, temporal graphs in the real world often fail to satisfy the above assumptions, which renders $\Delta$-based strategies ineffective in addressing the two challenges mentioned above. In this paper, we study two universal interval-based queries on the temporal graphs, i.e., durability query and existence query. To support the two kinds of queries, an index, IIT-Tree, is proposed without any assumption on the graphs. We also apply a compression strategy to further reduce the memory footprint of IIT-Tree, and integrate the optimized structure into an open-source system to enhance its applicability for graph-based applications. Extensive experiments on real data sets verify the superiority of IIT-Tree in managing and querying large temporal graphs.
papers.abstract_zh: 图是表示实体之间多对多关系的强大模型，广泛应用于挖掘社交网络、管理通信网络等。网络通常不是静态的，会随着时间的推移而变化。其中一种类型的网络始终由时间图表示，其边或顶点在特定时间可用。这在管理时态图方面带来了两个挑战：1）需要大量内存来存储不同时间的图，2）查询或挖掘时态图效率低下，因为查询中涉及多个图。现有方法应用基于 $\Delta$ 的策略来管理时间图，这取决于接近时间内的图相似的假设。然而，现实世界中的时间图往往无法满足上述假设，这使得基于 $\Delta$ 的策略无法有效解决上述两个挑战。在本文中，我们研究了两种基于时间图的通用区间查询，即持久性查询和存在性查询。为了支持这两种查询，提出了索引 IIT-Tree，而无需对图进行任何假设。我们还应用压缩策略进一步减少 IIT-Tree 的内存占用，并将优化后的结构集成到开源系统中，以增强其对基于图的应用程序的适用性。在真实数据集上的大量实验验证了IIT-Tree在管理和查询大型时序图方面的优越性。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: PORCA: Root Cause Analysis with Partially Observed Data
papers.title_zh: PORCA：使用部分观察数据进行根本原因分析
papers.authors: Chang  Gong, Di Yao, Jin Wang, Wenbin Li, Lanting Fang, Yongtao Xie, Kaiyu Feng, Peng Han, Jingping Bi
papers.abstract: Root Cause Analysis (RCA) aims at identifying the underlying causes of system faults by uncovering and analyzing the causal structure from complex systems. It has been widely used in many application domains. Reliable diagnostic conclusions are of great importance in mitigating system failures and financial losses. However, previous studies implicitly assume a full observation of the system, which neglect the effect of partial observation (i.e., missing nodes and latent malfunction). As a result, they fail in deriving reliable RCA results. In this paper, we unveil the issues of unobserved confounders and heterogeneity in partial observation and come up with a new problem of root cause analysis with partially observed data. To achieve this, we propose PORCA, a novel RCA framework which can explore reliable root causes under both unobserved confounders and unobserved heterogeneity. PORCA leverages magnified score-based causal discovery to efficiently optimize acyclic directed mixed graph under unobserved confounders. In addition, we also develop a heterogeneity-aware scheduling strategy to provide adaptive sample weights. Extensive experimental results on one synthetic and two real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 根本原因分析（RCA）旨在通过揭示和分析复杂系统的因果结构来识别系统故障的根本原因。它已广泛应用于许多应用领域。可靠的诊断结论对于减轻系统故障和财务损失非常重要。然而，以前的研究隐含地假设了对系统的全面观察，忽略了部分观察的影响（即缺失节点和潜在故障）。因此，他们无法得出可靠的 RCA 结果。在本文中，我们揭示了部分观察中未观察到的混杂因素和异质性问题，并提出了部分观察数据的根本原因分析的新问题。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了 PORCA，这是一种新颖的 RCA 框架，可以在未观察到的混杂因素和未观察到的异质性下探索可靠的根本原因。 PORCA 利用放大的基于分数的因果发现，在未观察到的混杂因素下有效优化非循环有向混合图。此外，我们还开发了一种异构感知调度策略来提供自适应样本权重。对一个合成数据集和两个真实世界数据集的广泛实验结果证明了所提出框架的有效性和优越性。

papers.title: Efficient and Scalable Search for Statistics
papers.title_zh: 高效且可扩展的统计搜索
papers.authors: Antoine Gauquier, Simon Ebel, Helena Galhardas, Théo Galizzi, Ioana Manolescu, Aurélien Peden, Pierre Senellart
papers.abstract: Informed public debate needs high-quality data. In this context, high-quality statistical data sources are a valuable category of reference information based on which a claim can be checked. To facilitate the work of journalists or other fact-checkers, users’ questions about a specific claim should be automatically answered based on statistical tables. This task is complicated by the large number, size, and variety of statistical datasets.We introduce the statistical table discovery problem (STD, in short), which aims, given a natural language question and a set of statistic datasets (multidimensional tables), to find the tables most relevant for the question. We then describe STAR, an algorithm for solving the STD problem. Unlike existing table discovery (TD) solutions aimed at relational tables, STAR is devised specifically for multidimensional ones. Further, STAR treats the space and time dimensions of statistical datasets separately. We experimentally show that these features, together, make STAR outperform state-of-the-art TD systems adapted to the STD problem, in terms of scalability, search quality, preprocessing and question answering time.
papers.abstract_zh: 知情的公共辩论需要高质量的数据。在这种情况下，高质量的统计数据源是一类有价值的参考信息，可以根据它来检查索赔。为了方便记者或其他事实核查人员的工作，应根据统计表自动回答用户关于特定主张的问题。由于统计数据集数量大、规模大、种类多，这项任务变得很复杂。我们引入了统计表发现问题（简称 STD），其目的是在给定一个自然语言问题和一组统计数据集（多维表）的情况下，找到与该问题最相关的表。然后我们描述 STAR，一种解决 STD 问题的算法。与针对关系表的现有表发现 (TD) 解决方案不同，STAR 是专门为多维表设计的。此外，STAR将统计数据集的空间和时间维度分开处理。我们通过实验证明，这些功能共同使 STAR 在可扩展性、搜索质量、预处理和问答时间方面优于适应 STD 问题的最先进的 TD 系统。
papers.search_extra: scalable search efficient search 可扩展的搜索 高效搜索

papers.title: Reconstructing TensorLog for Scalable End-to-end Rule Learning
papers.title_zh: 重构 TensorLog 以实现可扩展的端到端规则学习
papers.authors: Kunxun Qi, Jianfeng Du, Hai Wan, Wei Wang
papers.abstract: Logical rules play a crucial role in knowledge graph (KG) reasoning. They underpin various database applications and serve as pivotal components for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with KGs. In recent years, end-to-end rule learning has emerged as a promising paradigm to learn logical rules. The key insight of end-to-end rule learning is to transform the rule learning problem in a discrete space into the parameter learning problem in a continuous space, by employing TensorLog operators to simulate the inference of logical rules. However, these TensorLog-based methods struggle with limited scalability in learning rules from large-scale KGs. To improve the efficiency and scalability of end-to-end rule learning, we propose an efficient framework named FastLog which reconstructs TensorLog by reducing vector-matrix multiplications to vector computations. We theoretically show that FastLog has a lower time complexity than TensorLog. Furthermore, we propose a dynamic pruning strategy in FastLog to further improve efficiency. Thanks to this strategy, the time complexity of FastLog can be further reduced to a constant. Extensive experimental results on a variety of benchmark KGs demonstrate that FastLog improves the efficiency of end-to-end methods by a significant margin without efficacy degradation in link prediction. Notably, with our reconstruction of TensorLog, existing TensorLog-based methods are enabled to learn logical rules on two large-scale datasets with up to three hundred million triples, while achieving a high efficacy comparable with the most advanced rule learner.
papers.abstract_zh: 逻辑规则在知识图（KG）推理中起着至关重要的作用。它们支持各种数据库应用程序，并作为使用 KG 增强大型语言模型 (LLM) 的关键组件。近年来，端到端规则学习已成为学习逻辑规则的有前途的范式。端到端规则学习的关键在于，通过使用TensorLog算子来模拟逻辑规则的推理，将离散空间中的规则学习问题转化为连续空间中的参数学习问题。然而，这些基于 TensorLog 的方法在从大规模 KG 中学习规则时面临着有限的可扩展性。为了提高端到端规则学习的效率和可扩展性，我们提出了一种名为 FastLog 的高效框架，它通过将向量矩阵乘法减少为向量计算来重构 TensorLog。我们从理论上证明 FastLog 的时间复杂度低于 TensorLog。此外，我们在 FastLog 中提出了动态剪枝策略以进一步提高效率。得益于这种策略，FastLog的时间复杂度可以进一步降低到一个常数。对各种基准 KG 的大量实验结果表明，FastLog 显著提高了端到端方法的效率，而链路预测的效率没有下降。值得注意的是，通过我们对 TensorLog 的重构，现有的基于 TensorLog 的方法能够在两个多达三亿个三元组的大型数据集上学习逻辑规则，同时实现与最先进的规则学习器相当的高效率。

papers.title: HL-index: Fast Reachability Query in Hypergraphs
papers.title_zh: HL-index：超图中的快速可达性查询
papers.authors: Peiting Xie, Xiangjun Zai, Yanping Wu, Xiaoyang Wang, Wenjie Zhang, Lu Qin
papers.abstract: Reachability in hypergraphs is essential for modeling complex groupwise interactions in real-world applications such as co-authorship, social network, and biological analysis, where relationships go beyond pairwise interactions. In this paper, we introduce the notion of s-reachability, where two vertices are s-reachable if there exists a sequence of hyperedges (i.e., a walk) connecting them, such that each pair of consecutive hyperedges shares at least s vertices. Moreover, we define the max-reachability query as a generalized form of the s-reachability problem, which aims to find the largest value of s that allows one vertex to reach another. To answer max-reachability queries in hypergraphs, we first analyze limitations of the existing vertex-to-vertex and hyperedge-to-hyperedge indexing techniques. We then introduce the HL-index, a compact vertex-to-hyperedge index tailored for the max-reachability problem. To both efficiently and effectively construct a minimal HL-index, we develop a fast covering relationship detection method to eliminate fruitless hypergraph traversals during index construction. A lightweight neighbor-index is further proposed to avoid repeatedly exploring neighbor relationships in hypergraphs and hence accelerate the construction. Extensive experiments on 20 datasets demonstrate the efficiency and scalability of our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 超图中的可达性对于在现实应用中建模复杂的分组交互至关重要，例如共同作者、社交网络和生物分析，其中关系超出了成对交互的范围。在本文中，我们引入了 s 可达性的概念，其中如果存在连接两个顶点的超边序列（即步行），则两个顶点是 s 可达的，使得每对连续的超边至少共享 s 个顶点。此外，我们将最大可达性查询定义为 s 可达性问题的广义形式，其目的是找到允许一个顶点到达另一个顶点的 s 的最大值。为了回答超图中的最大可达性查询，我们首先分析现有的点到点和超边到超边索引技术的局限性。然后我们引入 HL 索引，这是一种专为最大可达性问题量身定制的紧凑顶点到超边索引。为了高效且有效地构建最小 HL 索引，我们开发了一种快速覆盖关系检测方法，以消除索引构建过程中无结果的超图遍历。进一步提出了一种轻量级的邻居索引，以避免重复探索超图中的邻居关系，从而加速构建。对 20 个数据集的广泛实验证明了我们方法的效率和可扩展性。

papers.title: Astraea: Efficient Pipelined Micro-batch Stream Processing with Non-hash Differentiated Partitioning
papers.title_zh: Astraea：具有非哈希差异化分区的高效流水线微批流处理
papers.authors: Sijie Wu, Hanhua Chen, Hai Jin, Haoran Cai
papers.abstract: Modern micro-batch stream processing systems have emerged to meet the requirement of real-time stream processing with extreme throughput. They leverage two-stage pipeline parallelism which overlaps stream buffering and data processing to speed up the system, while relying on a functional parallel computation framework (e.g., MapReduce) to process shortterm buffered large-scale data. How to partition data across processing tasks to improve performance of the pipelined microbatch stream processing is critical and challenging. The state-ofthe-art design exploits the statistics of the buffered stream data for optimizing the data partitioning among map tasks. However, it fails to effectively achieve a balanced reduce phase because collecting the global statistical information of the intermediate results from all finished map tasks is prohibitively costly. We show that employing a straightforward hash partitioning strategy for the intermediate data output by finished map tasks leads to a significantly unbalanced reduce phase and consequently suffers from poor performance. To solve the problem, this work proposes Astraea, a novel nonhash differentiated data partitioning scheme. To achieve load balanced reduce tasks, Astraea chooses different strategies for popular and rare keys. For a small number of high-frequency keys which are identified in the buffering stage, Astraea prearranges their reduce partitioning to avoid potential significant load gaps among reduce tasks; while for the remaining large fraction of low-frequency keys, Astraea collects the statistics of the local intermediate data on each finished map task to precisely fill up the actual gap of the pre-arrangement of the high-frequency keys. In this way, Astraea achieves efficient and well-balanced reduce data partitioning. We implement Astraea and evaluate its performance on diverse large-scale stream datasets collected from real-world systems. The results show that compared to the state-of-the-art design, Astraea significantly reduces the degree of load skewness by 42%, reduces the processing latency by 34%, and improves the system throughput by 27%.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代微批量流处理系统的出现是为了满足具有极高吞吐量的实时流处理的要求。他们利用两级管道并行性（重叠流缓冲和数据处理）来加速系统，同时依靠功能性并行计算框架（例如 MapReduce）来处理短期缓冲的大规模数据。如何跨处理任务划分数据以提高流水线微批量流处理的性能至关重要且具有挑战性。最先进的设计利用缓冲流数据的统计数据来优化映射任务之间的数据分区。然而，它无法有效地实现平衡的reduce阶段，因为从所有已完成的map任务中收集中间结果的全局统计信息的成本过高。我们表明，对已完成的映射任务的中间数据输出采用简单的哈希分区策略会导致减少阶段显著不平衡，从而导致性能不佳。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 Astraea，一种新颖的非哈希差异化数据分区方案。为了实现reduce任务的负载均衡，Astraea针对热门键和稀有键选择了不同的策略。对于在缓冲阶段识别出的少量高频键，Astraea预先安排它们的reduce分区，以避免reduce任务之间潜在的显著负载差距；而对于剩余的大部分低频键，Astraea 会统计每个已完成的 Map 任务的本地中间数据，以精确填补高频键预先排列的实际空白。通过这种方式，Astraea实现了高效且均衡的reduce数据分区。我们实现 Astraea 并评估其在从现实世界系统收集的各种大规模流数据集上的性能。结果表明，与最先进的设计相比，Astraea 显著降低了 42% 的负载偏斜程度，降低了 34% 的处理延迟，并提高了 27% 的系统吞吐量。

papers.title: Trajectory–User Linking via Heterogeneous Preference Graph and Dual-Encoder Mutual Distillation
papers.title_zh: 通过异构偏好图和双编码器相互蒸馏的轨迹-用户链接
papers.authors: ZEMING TIAN, Zixin Qin, Huaijie Zhu, Ningning Cui, Wei Liu, Jianxing Yu, Jian Yin
papers.abstract: Trajectory User Linking (TUL) is a critical task in spatio-temporal behavior analysis, which focuses on reidentifying users from anonymous mobility traces. While prior approaches have made progress by modeling the sequential patterns and behavioral dynamics of trajectories, they often neglect the heterogeneous semantics embedded in user interactions, such as varying check-in frequencies, transition patterns, and contextual associations. In this work, we propose Heterogeneous Preference Graph and Dual-Encoder Mutual Distillation (HPG-DEMD), a unified framework that combines multi-view trajectory encoding with structural preference modeling. Specifically, a heterogeneous interaction graph is constructed to learn user prototypes using a heterogeneous graph neural network, providing long-term preference priors. In parallel, an LSTM-based encoder captures short-term sequential behaviors, while a Transformer-based encoder models long-range temporal dependencies. The LSTM-based and Transformer-based encoders are jointly trained under a mutual distillation strategy, which encourages representation consistency and improves generalization. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the TUL task. HPG-DEMD consistently outperforms stateof-the-art methods, with up to +10.27%Acc@1 on Weeplaces, and +7.89%Acc@1 on Foursquare-TKY, demonstrating strong robustness and scalability. The source code is available at: https://github.com/Ledingburger/HPG-DEMD.
papers.abstract_zh: 轨迹用户链接（TUL）是时空行为分析中的一项关键任务，其重点是从匿名移动轨迹中重新识别用户。虽然先前的方法通过对轨迹的顺序模式和行为动态进行建模而取得了进展，但它们经常忽略用户交互中嵌入的异构语义，例如不同的签到频率、转换模式和上下文关联。在这项工作中，我们提出了异构偏好图和双编码器相互蒸馏（HPG-DEMD），这是一个将多视图轨迹编码与结构偏好建模相结合的统一框架。具体来说，构建异构交互图以使用异构图神经网络学习用户原型，提供长期偏好先验。同时，基于 LSTM 的编码器捕获短期顺序行为，而基于 Transformer 的编码器则对长期时间依赖性进行建模。基于 LSTM 和基于 Transformer 的编码器在相互蒸馏策略下联合训练，这鼓励了表示一致性并提高了泛化能力。对三个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，我们的模型在 TUL 任务上实现了最先进的性能。 HPG-DEMD 始终优于最先进的方法，在 Weeplaces 上高达 +10.27%Acc@1，在 Foursquare-TKY 上高达 +7.89%Acc@1，展示了强大的鲁棒性和可扩展性。源代码位于：https://github.com/Ledingburger/HPG-DEMD。

papers.title: PC-PS: A Multi-Dimensional Point-Cloud Data Publish/Subscribe System
papers.title_zh: PC-PS：多维点云数据发布/订阅系统
papers.authors: Yuanchi Fan, Lisi Chen, Shuo Shang, Christian Jensen
papers.abstract: With continued advances in LiDAR technologies, massive volumes of point-cloud data are being collected for use in an expanding range of applications. Point-cloud data include geographic coordinates along with additional attributes such as intensity and timestamp, enabling fine-grained modeling of urban and natural environments. With the growing deployment of 3D sensors in autonomous driving, robotics, and smart cities, there is an urgent need to support real-time, selective delivery of relevant information from high-volume point-cloud data streams. Existing methods use space-filling curves and OcTree to facilitate range queries on static 3D point-cloud data. However, the sheer volumes of data, rapid influx of data, and a growing number of diverse and fine-grained selective demands over point-cloud data pose significant challenges that remain to be addressed. To bridge this gap, we formulate and study the problem of continuous spatial range monitoring on high-volume streaming point-cloud data. We present PC-PS, a multi-dimensional Point-Cloud Publish/ Subscribe system that incorporates a Reverse Bounding Volume Hierarchical index designed to efficiently publish streaming point-cloud data and organize the continuous range queries. To achieve this with controlled memory overhead, PC-PS adopts a hybrid query registration strategy and a two-phase publishing mechanism triggered by incoming data points. In addition, it integrates an adaptive flush mechanism to ensure that the time buffered data remains in the system satisfies the latency constraint of each query. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets offer evidence that PC-PS achieves its design goals and demonstrates performance superiority over state-of-thearts in both latency and throughput. Our code is available at https://github.com/fanyuanchi/PointCloud.git.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着激光雷达技术的不断进步，大量的点云数据被收集起来，用于不断扩大的应用范围。点云数据包括地理坐标以及强度和时间戳等附加属性，从而能够对城市和自然环境进行细粒度建模。随着 3D 传感器在自动驾驶、机器人和智慧城市中的不断部署，迫切需要支持从大量点云数据流中实时、选择性地传递相关信息。现有方法使用空间填充曲线和八叉树来促进静态 3D 点云数据的范围查询。然而，数据量之大、数据的快速涌入以及对点云数据的日益多样化和细粒度的选择性需求带来了仍有待解决的重大挑战。为了弥补这一差距，我们制定并研究了大容量流点云数据的连续空间范围监测问题。我们提出了 PC-PS，这是一种多维点云发布/订阅系统，它包含反向边界体积层次索引，旨在有效地发布流式点云数据并组织连续范围查询。为了通过控制内存开销来实现这一点，PC-PS 采用混合查询注册策略和由传入数据点触发的两阶段发布机制。此外，它还集成了自适应刷新机制，以确保系统中保留的时间缓冲数据满足每个查询的延迟约束。对真实世界数据集的大量实验提供了证据，证明 PC-PS 实现了其设计目标，并在延迟和吞吐量方面展示了优于最先进技术的性能优势。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/fanyuanchi/PointCloud.git 获取。

papers.title: TransLGX: A Self-contained Model to Predict the Entire Lifecycle and complete state of Logistics Package Trajectories
papers.title_zh: TransLGX：预测物流包裹轨迹整个生命周期和完整状态的独立模型
papers.authors: Yichen Song, Jianfeng Zhou, Jian-Ya Ding, Renhao Cao
papers.abstract: This paper presents a novel logistics package trajectory prediction approach. This approach breaks away from the traditional Markov assumption for the first time by capturing the dynamic changes of the logistics network from previous trajectory events and covers the entire lifecycle and complete state of logistics package trajectories. Furthermore, based on this approach, we designed an industrial-grade prediction model, TransLGX. TransLGX captures previous trajectory within the latent space via causal attention, achieving self-containment and high robustness. It then employs an autoregressive architecture and a multi-scale address encoder to achieve highly accurate predictions of the entire lifecycle of packages from creation to delivery. Finally, TransLGX utilizes a two-stage multi-output head to jointly predict the complete state of the trajectory, including actions, locations, transit durations, and delivery time. The self-containment, high robustness, and high accuracy of TransLGX enhance the model's industrial-level practical applicability. Our extensive experiments on datasets comprising tens of millions of package trajectories from six countries demonstrate the effectiveness of TransLGX. We compare against multiple state-of-the-art baseline models from recent years, ensuring a rigorous and comprehensive evaluation. The billion-parameter TransLGX consistently achieves superior performance across all four complete state prediction tasks. Furthermore, TransLGX has been successfully deployed on the TikTok shop e-commerce platform, assisting millions of users in tracking their packages. This successful application not only validates the practical value of our model but also highlights the promise of non-Markovian sequence modeling methods, offering new research directions in this domain. Supplementary materials are available at: https://github.com/Scholar-Song/TransLGX/blob/main/
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的物流包裹轨迹预测方法。该方法首次摆脱了传统的马尔可夫假设，从先前的轨迹事件中捕获物流网络的动态变化，覆盖了物流包裹轨迹的整个生命周期和完整状态。此外，基于这种方法，我们设计了工业级预测模型 TransLGX。 TransLGX 通过因果注意力捕获潜在空间内的先前轨迹，实现自我包含和高鲁棒性。然后，它采用自回归架构和多尺度地址编码器来实现对包裹从创建到交付的整个生命周期的高精度预测。最后，TransLGX 利用两级多输出头来共同预测轨迹的完整状态，包括动作、位置、运输持续时间和交付时间。 TransLGX的独立性、高鲁棒性和高精度增强了模型的工业级实际适用性。我们对来自六个国家的数千万个包裹轨迹的数据集进行了广泛的实验，证明了 TransLGX 的有效性。我们与近年来最先进的多个基线模型进行比较，确保进行严格和全面的评估。十亿参数的 TransLGX 在所有四个完整的状态预测任务中始终如一地实现了卓越的性能。此外，TransLGX已成功部署在TikTok Shop电商平台上，帮助数百万用户追踪包裹。这一成功的应用不仅验证了我们模型的实用价值，而且凸显了非马尔可夫序列建模方法的前景，为该领域提供了新的研究方向。补充材料可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Scholar-Song/TransLGX/blob/main/

papers.title: Community-level Personalized Recommendation by Exploiting Evolving User-Item Micro-clusters
papers.title_zh: 利用不断演化的用户项微集群进行社区级个性化推荐
papers.authors: Xinyu Liu, Jinxia Guo, Qirui Hao, Zhongjing Yu, Qinli Yang, Junming Shao
papers.abstract: To achieve precise personalized recommendations, it is crucial to model user preference and item popularity simultaneously to capture their evolving characteristics. However, existing techniques often treat the evolution of user preference or item popularity with the same fixed decay rate, failing to capture the individual evolution pattern of each user or item. Beyond, the co-evolution patterns of users and items are not well learned due to the data sparsity of each user-item interaction. In this paper, we propose a new personalized recommendation algorithm, called EvoRec, by exploiting a set of dynamic user-item micro-clusters and modeling the evolving co-evolution patterns at the community level. Specifically, building upon temporal graph learning, each user or item embedding is represented as an evolving microcluster, and incrementally updated with a personalized decay factor. Afterwards, dynamic community structure of microclusters is uncovered to exploit the user-item co-evolution pattern, and finally support robust recommendation. Compared with established methods, EvoRec has several advantages: (a) It employs a unique adaptive learning mechanism that captures evolving dynamics of each user and item individually. (b) By exploring the user-item co-evolving patterns at the community level, EvoRec not only allows capturing intricate relationships between user-item interactions, but also support robust recommendation. Our experiments on real-world datasets indicate that EvoRec outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and has the capacity to promptly capture shifts in user preferences and item features.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了实现精确的个性化推荐，同时对用户偏好和项目流行度进行建模以捕获其不断变化的特征至关重要。然而，现有技术通常以相同的固定衰减率来处理用户偏好或项目流行度的演变，无法捕获每个用户或项目的个体演变模式。此外，由于每个用户-项目交互的数据稀疏，用户和项目的共同进化模式没有得到很好的学习。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的个性化推荐算法，称为 EvoRec，通过利用一组动态用户-项目微集群并在社区级别对不断演变的共同进化模式进行建模。具体来说，在时间图学习的基础上，每个用户或项目嵌入都被表示为一个不断发展的微集群，并使用个性化的衰减因子进行增量更新。然后，揭示微簇的动态社区结构，以利用用户-项目共同进化模式，并最终支持鲁棒推荐。与现有方法相比，EvoRec 有几个优点：（a）它采用独特的自适应学习机制，可以单独捕获每个用户和项目的动态变化。 (b) 通过探索社区层面的用户-项目共同演化模式，EvoRec 不仅可以捕获用户-项目交互之间的复杂关系，而且还支持稳健的推荐。我们对现实世界数据集的实验表明，EvoRec 的性能优于最先进的基线，并且能够迅速捕获用户偏好和项目特征的变化。
papers.search_extra: personalized recommendation recommender systems 个性化推荐 推荐系统

papers.title: SHMemora: Protective Key-Value Store on Distributed Shared Memory
papers.title_zh: SHMemora：分布式共享内存上的保护性键值存储
papers.authors: Jiajun Luo, Siyu Lin, Yunpeng Xu, Shengwei Liu, Jin Xia, Dong Liu, Zheng Liu, Huanchen Zhang, Teng Ma, Shuwen Deng
papers.abstract: Modern in-memory key-value stores (IMKVS) are essential for data-intensive applications but increasingly limited by memory capacity. Traditional scale-out over TCP/IP or RDMA incurs high overhead from network latency and data movement. Emerging Compute Express Link (CXL) enables nearlocal-latency shared memory across hosts, offering a promising path for scaling IMKVS. However, existing CXL-based systems prioritize performance and overlook security, leaving shared memory exposed to unauthorized access. In this work, we present SHMemora, to the best of our knowledge, the first protective multi-host IMKVS built on CXL-based shared memory in coherent Distributed Shared Memory (DSM) environments. SHMemora addresses three key challenges, including strict protection enforcement, fine-grained memory protection, and scalable metadata management. These are solved by SHMemora through Intel MPK-based memory isolation, a capability-based protection, and metadata batching, respectively. We implement SHMemora on real CXL hardware and evaluate its security through formal proofs and penetration tests, and its performance through microbenchmarks and real workloads, demonstrating both strong protection guarantees and practical scalability. SHMemora achieves an average of ${3. 4 5} \times$ throughput compared to Redis under multiple hosts, incurring an average of 1.68% throughput overhead for the security protection.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代内存键值存储 (IMKVS) 对于数据密集型应用程序至关重要，但越来越受到内存容量的限制。通过 TCP/IP 或 RDMA 的传统横向扩展会因网络延迟和数据移动而产生较高的开销。新兴的 Compute Express Link (CXL) 可实现跨主机的近本地延迟共享内存，为扩展 IMKVS 提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，现有的基于 CXL 的系统优先考虑性能而忽视安全性，导致共享内存遭受未经授权的访问。在这项工作中，据我们所知，我们展示了 SHMemora，这是第一个在相干分布式共享内存 (DSM) 环境中基于 CXL 共享内存构建的保护性多主机 IMKVS。 SHMemora 解决了三个关键挑战，包括严格的保护实施、细粒度的内存保护和可扩展的元数据管理。 SHMemora 分别通过基于 Intel MPK 的内存隔离、基于功能的保护和元数据批处理解决了这些问题。我们在真实的 CXL 硬件上实施 SHMemora，并通过形式证明和渗透测试评估其安全性，并通过微基准和真实工作负载评估其性能，展示了强大的保护保证和实际的可扩展性。 在多主机环境下，SHMemora 的吞吐量平均达到 Redis 的 3.45 倍，平均产生 1.68% 的安全防护吞吐量开销。

papers.title: More Than Pivot for Maximal Clique Enumeration
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是最大集团枚举的枢轴
papers.authors: Zhaoyi Zhong, Rui Zhou, Lu Chen, Xiaofan Li, Chengfei Liu
papers.abstract: The Maximal Clique Enumeration (MCE) problem is a classic and fundamental task in graph data mining and analysis. It has attracted widespread attention due to its broad applications in areas such as social network analysis and bioinformatics. A widely adopted framework for solving the MCE problem is the Bron-Kerbosch (BK) algorithm. Its efficiency can be significantly improved by incorporating the pivot strategy, which is the most effective pruning technique in BK-based algorithms. However, the pivot strategy is not an optimal solution for reducing search branches, and there remains room for further pruning unnecessary branches. To fill this gap, we propose a new heuristic pruning algorithm, called moreThanPivot, which focuses on further reducing search branches in the BK framework. This algorithm iteratively selects multiple vertices as splitters. For each splitter, the algorithm constructs its Residual Cover Set and Residual Pillar Set, ultimately returning refined search branches with fewer branches than the pivot strategy. Three alternative selection ranges and three greedy objectives are further proposed for selecting new splitters. Extensive experimental results on 14 real-world datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method. And experiments on synthetic datasets reflect that our method is especially effective on graphs with high edge density.
papers.abstract_zh: 最大派系枚举（MCE）问题是图数据挖掘和分析中的经典且基本的任务。由于其在社交网络分析和生物信息学等领域的广泛应用而受到广泛关注。解决 MCE 问题的广泛采用的框架是 Bron-Kerbosch (BK) 算法。通过结合枢轴策略可以显著提高其效率，这是基于 BK 的算法中最有效的剪枝技术。然而，枢轴策略并不是减少搜索分支的最佳解决方案，并且仍有进一步修剪不必要分支的空间。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新的启发式剪枝算法，称为 moreThanPivot，其重点是进一步减少 BK 框架中的搜索分支。该算法迭代地选择多个顶点作为分割器。对于每个分离器，该算法构建其残差覆盖集和残差支柱集，最终返回比枢轴策略分支更少的精炼搜索分支。进一步提出了三个替代选择范围和三个贪婪目标来选择新的分离器。 14 个真实世界数据集的广泛实验结果证明了我们方法的优越性。对合成数据集的实验表明，我们的方法对于具有高边缘密度的图尤其有效。

papers.title: ProvSQL: A General System for Keeping Track of the Provenance and Probability of Data
papers.title_zh: ProvSQL：用于跟踪数据来源和概率的通用系统
papers.authors: Aryak Sen, Silviu Maniu, Pierre Senellart
papers.abstract: We present the data model, design choices, and performance of ProvSQL, a general and easy-to-deploy provenance tracking and probabilistic database system implemented as a PostgreSQL extension. ProvSQL's data and query models closely reflect that of a large core of SQL, including multiset semantics, the full relational algebra, and aggregation. A key part of its implementation relies on generic provenance circuits stored in memory-mapped files. We propose benchmarks to measure the overhead of provenance and probabilistic evaluation and demonstrate its scalability and competitiveness with respect to other state-of-the-art systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 ProvSQL 的数据模型、设计选择和性能，ProvSQL 是一种通用且易于部署的来源跟踪和概率数据库系统，作为 PostgreSQL 扩展实现。 ProvSQL 的数据和查询模型密切反映了 SQL 的大型核心，包括多集语义、完整的关系代数和聚合。其实现的关键部分依赖于存储在内存映射文件中的通用起源电路。我们提出基准来衡量出处和概率评估的开销，并证明其相对于其他最先进系统的可扩展性和竞争力。

papers.title: Data Guard: A Fine-grained Purpose-based Access Control System for Large Data Warehouses
papers.title_zh: Data Guard：针对大型数据仓库的细粒度、基于目的的访问控制系统
papers.authors: Khai Tran, Sudarshan Vasudevan, Pratham Desai, Alex Gorelik, Mayank Mahuja, Athrey Venkateshababu, Mohit Verma, Dichao Hu, Walaa Moustafa, Vasanth Rajamani, Ankit Gupta, Issac Buenrostro, Kalinda Raina, Yanwen Lin
papers.abstract: The last few years have witnessed a spate of data protection regulations in conjunction with an ever-growing appetite for data usage in large businesses, which presents significant challenges for businesses to maintain compliance. To address this conflict, we present Data Guard - a fine-grained, purpose-based access control system for large data warehouses. Data Guard enables authoring policies based on semantic descriptions of data and purpose of data access. Data Guard then translates these policies into SQL views that mask data from the underlying warehouse tables. At access time, Data Guard ensures compliance by transparently routing each table access to the appropriate data-masking view based on the purpose of the access, thus minimizing the effort of adopting Data Guard in existing applications. Our enforcement solution allows masking data at much finer granularities than what traditional solutions allow. In addition to row and column level data masking, Data Guard can mask data at the sub-cell level for columns with non-atomic data types such as structs, arrays, and maps. This fine-grained masking allows Data Guard to preserve data utility for consumers while ensuring compliance. We implemented a number of performance optimizations to minimize the overhead of data masking operations. We perform numerous experiments to identify the key factors that influence the data masking overhead and demonstrate the efficiency of our implementation. Data Guard is deployed inside LinkedIn's production data warehouses and ensures compliance of more than 20,000 table accesses each day across different data processing engines.
papers.abstract_zh: 过去几年，出现了大量的数据保护法规，加上大型企业对数据使用的需求不断增长，这对企业保持合规性提出了重大挑战。为了解决这一冲突，我们推出了 Data Guard——一种针对大型数据仓库的细粒度、基于目的的访问控制系统。 Data Guard 支持基于数据语义描述和数据访问目的来制定策略。然后，Data Guard 将这些策略转换为 SQL 视图，从而屏蔽底层仓库表中的数据。在访问时，Data Guard 通过根据访问目的透明地将每个表访问路由到适当的数据屏蔽视图来确保合规性，从而最大限度地减少在现有应用程序中采用 Data Guard 的工作量。我们的执行解决方案允许以比传统解决方案更细的粒度屏蔽数据。除了行和列级别的数据屏蔽之外，Data Guard 还可以在子单元级别屏蔽具有非原子数据类型（例如结构、数组和映射）的列的数据。这种细粒度的屏蔽允许 Data Guard 为消费者保留数据实用性，同时确保合规性。我们实施了许多性能优化，以最大限度地减少数据屏蔽操作的开销。我们进行了大量实验来确定影响数据屏蔽开销的关键因素并证明我们实施的效率。 Data Guard 部署在 LinkedIn 的生产数据仓库内，确保每天跨不同数据处理引擎的 20,000 多次表访问的合规性。

papers.title: Fine-grained Manipulation Attacks to Local Differential Privacy Protocols for Range Query
papers.title_zh: 针对范围查询的本地差分隐私协议的细粒度操纵攻击
papers.authors: Xinyu Li, Wenda Chen, Xuebin Ren
papers.abstract: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) enables massive sensitive data collection and analysis without any trusted aggregator, thus having been widely deployed by large corporations. However, recent studies indicate that LDP protocols can be easily disrupted by poisoning or manipulation attacks. In particular, manipulation attackers can leverage injected/corrupted fake users to send falsified data, which induces the aggregator to derive LDP estimates close to some pre-set targets. Nevertheless, such manipulation attacks in existing studies are only focused on basic statistics (e.g., frequency estimation and mean/variance estimation). As an important analytic task, the vulnerability of LDP protocols for range query has not been thoroughly examined, especially against fine-grained manipulations. In this paper, we present a systematic study on the fine-grained manipulation attacks to LDP protocols for range query, considering both categories of the tree-based and grid-based protocols. By exploring the attack surfaces, we propose the general fine-grained manipulation frameworks for both categories with deliberate attacking processes. Based on the frameworks, we also develop specific attack algorithms for the representative LDP protocols for range queries. Finally, we explore a possible defense mechanism for mitigating these attacks. Besides theoretical analysis, we have validated both our attacks and defense through extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 本地差分隐私（LDP）无需任何可信聚合器即可实现大规模敏感数据收集和分析，因此已被大型企业广泛部署。然而，最近的研究表明，LDP 协议很容易被中毒或操纵攻击破坏。特别是，操纵攻击者可以利用注入/损坏的假用户来发送伪造的数据，这会导致聚合器得出接近某些预设目标的 LDP 估计值。然而，现有研究中的此类操纵攻击仅集中于基本统计数据（例如频率估计和均值/方差估计）。作为一项重要的分析任务，LDP 协议范围查询的漏洞尚未得到彻底检查，特别是针对细粒度操作。在本文中，我们系统地研究了针对范围查询的 LDP 协议的细粒度操纵攻击，同时考虑了基于树和基于网格的协议。通过探索攻击面，我们为具有故意攻击过程的两个类别提出了通用的细粒度操纵框架。基于这些框架，我们还为范围查询的代表性LDP协议开发了特定的攻击算法。最后，我们探索一种可能的防御机制来减轻这些攻击。除了理论分析之外，我们还通过对合成数据集和真实数据集进行大量实验来验证我们的攻击和防御。

papers.title: RL-Paxos: Relieving the Leader's Burden with Efficient Task Offloading in Distributed Consensus
papers.title_zh: RL-Paxos：通过分布式共识中的高效任务卸载来减轻领导者的负担
papers.authors: Chenhao Zhang, Jinquan Wang, Meng Han, Bing Wei, Xiaojian Liao, Limin Xiao, Shanchen Pang
papers.abstract: Existing state machine replication protocols are typically leader-based, with the leader responsible for all operations, leading to a scalability bottleneck. Despite extensive research efforts to address this issue, alleviating the leader's workload remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we provide an indepth analysis of the leader bottleneck and introduce RL-Paxos, which retains only the core function of ordering (e.g., establishing a global order and performing commutativity checks) for the leader, while offloading other tasks to the followers. We integrate RL-Paxos into the classic Paxos protocol and compare it with state-of-the-art protocols. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that RL-Paxos achieves high throughput and low wide-area latency under conditions of high concurrency, multinode deployment, mixed workloads, and read-only scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的状态机复制协议通常是基于领导者的，领导者负责所有操作，从而导致可扩展性瓶颈。尽管为解决这个问题进行了大量的研究工作，但减轻领导者的工作量仍然是一个重大挑战。在本文中，我们深入分析了领导者瓶颈，并引入了 RL-Paxos，它只保留领导者排序的核心功能（例如，建立全局顺序和执行交换性检查），而将其他任务卸载给追随者。我们将 RL-Paxos 集成到经典 Paxos 协议中，并将其与最先进的协议进行比较。大量的实验评估表明，RL-Paxos在高并发、多节点部署、混合工作负载和只读场景下实现了高吞吐量和低广域延迟。

papers.title: GPU-Accelerated OLTP: An In-Depth Analysis of Concurrency Control Schemes [Experiment, Analysis, and Benchmark]
papers.title_zh: GPU 加速 OLTP：并发控制方案的深入分析 [实验、分析和基准测试]
papers.authors: Zihan Sun, Yuyu Luo, Yong Zhang, Chao Li, Chunxiao Xing
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, GPUs have demonstrated significant potential in accelerating Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) operations. However, there remains a substantial gap in their application to Online Transaction Processing (OLTP), as GPUs were traditionally considered unsuitable for such workloads. Despite this perception, the massive parallelism and high memory bandwidth of GPUs offer a unique opportunity to process thousands of transactions concurrently, making them promising candidates for OLTP acceleration. Concurrency control schemes, which play a critical role in determining the performance of OLTP systems, may behave differently on GPUs due to their architectural differences from CPUs. This raises a key question: How well do concurrency control schemes designed for CPUs adapt to GPU environments? To answer this, we present gCCTB, the first testbed designed to evaluate concurrency control schemes on GPUs. We implement and benchmark eight CC schemes, including six classic CPUoriented schemes and two designed specifically for GPUs, on both the YCSB and TPC-C benchmarks under varied contention levels and GPU configurations. Our findings reveal that GPUoptimized schemes do not consistently outperform CPU-oriented schemes, particularly under specific workloads and contention levels. Moreover, GPU-specific parameters, such as the number of threads per warp and warps per block, significantly impact performance and require careful tuning. Finally, we find that conflict resolution overhead is a crucial factor influencing the performance of CPU-oriented schemes on GPUs, with optimistic concurrency control consistently minimizing this overhead and outperforming other CPU-oriented schemes across all workloads.
papers.abstract_zh: 在过去的十年中，GPU 在加速在线分析处理 (OLAP) 操作方面展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，它们在在线事务处理 (OLTP) 方面的应用仍然存在很大差距，因为传统上认为 GPU 不适合此类工作负载。尽管存在这种看法，GPU 的大规模并行性和高内存带宽提供了同时处理数千个事务的独特机会，使它们成为 OLTP 加速的有希望的候选者。并发控制方案在确定 OLTP 系统性能方面发挥着关键作用，但由于其架构与 CPU 的差异，其在 GPU 上的表现可能有所不同。这就提出了一个关键问题：为 CPU 设计的并发控制方案如何适应 GPU 环境？为了回答这个问题，我们推出了 gCCTB，这是第一个旨在评估 GPU 上并发控制方案的测试平台。我们在不同的争用级别和 GPU 配置下，在 YCSB 和 TPC-C 基准测试上实现了八种 CC 方案并对其进行了基准测试，其中包括六种经典的面向 CPU 的方案和两种专为 GPU 设计的方案。我们的研究结果表明，GPU 优化方案的性能并不总是优于面向 CPU 的方案，特别是在特定的工作负载和争用级别下。此外，GPU 特定的参数（例如每个扭曲的线程数和每个块的扭曲数）会显著影响性能，需要仔细调整。最后，我们发现冲突解决开销是影响 GPU 上面向 CPU 的方案性能的关键因素，乐观并发控制能够持续最小化这种开销，并在所有工作负载中优于其他面向 CPU 的方案。

papers.title: Semantic Publish/Subscribe over Evolving Topics
papers.title_zh: 不断变化的主题的语义发布/订阅
papers.authors: Yiming Yao, Lisi Chen, Shuo Shang
papers.abstract: The continued explosion of data from social media, news feeds, and online forums has intensified the demand for efficient and precise content dissemination. Traditional similaritybased publish/subscribe systems rely on text similarity metrics, failing to capture semantic distinctions between similar phrases. So far, transformer-based embedding models have demonstrated strong capabilities in capturing rich contextual and semantic relationships through high-dimensional representations. However, integrating these embeddings into publish/subscribe systems presents two key challenges: (1) How to generate and monitor topics of high-dimensional document vectors as they evolve in real-time? (2) How to support efficient matching between massive-scale high-dimensional subscriptions and a large number of evolving topics? To address these challenges, we propose DISPS (Dual-Index Semantic Publish/Subscribe), a novel publish/subscribe framework that integrates advanced semantic representations with collaborative hierarchical indexing. DISPS is capable of supporting dynamic topic discovery and real-time subscription matching over continuous document streams. We further develop a pivotbased topic representation mechanism to track semantic drift over time and a LocalPair Distance to improve the precision of topic assignments. These techniques enable scalable and real-time content dissemination with high semantic accuracy. Extensive experiments show that DISPS consistently outperforms baseline methods in capturing semantic similarity and processing efficiency. Our implementation of DISPS is available at: https://github.com/yyyyyyyan7/DISPS
papers.abstract_zh: 社交媒体、新闻推送和在线论坛的数据持续爆炸，加剧了对高效、精准内容传播的需求。传统的基于相似性的发布/订阅系统依赖于文本相似性度量，无法捕获相似短语之间的语义区别。到目前为止，基于 Transformer 的嵌入模型已经表现出了通过高维表示捕获丰富的上下文和语义关系的强大能力。然而，将这些嵌入集成到发布/订阅系统中面临两个关键挑战：（1）如何在高维文档向量实时演变时生成和监控它们的主题？ （2）如何支持海量高维订阅与大量不断演化的主题之间的高效匹配？为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DISPS（双索引语义发布/订阅），这是一种新颖的发布/订阅框架，它将高级语义表示与协作分层索引集成在一起。 DISPS 能够支持连续文档流上的动态主题发现和实时订阅匹配。我们进一步开发了基于枢轴的主题表示机制来跟踪随时间的语义漂移和本地对距离以提高主题分配的精度。这些技术能够实现具有高语义准确性的可扩展和实时内容传播。大量实验表明，DISPS 在捕获语义相似性和处理效率方面始终优于基线方法。我们的 DISPS 实现位于：https://github.com/yyyyyyyan7/DISPS

papers.title: FusAD: Time-Frequency Fusion with Adaptive Denoising for General Time Series Analysis
papers.title_zh: FusAD：用于一般时间序列分析的时频融合和自适应去噪
papers.authors: Da Zhang, Bingyu Li, Zhiyuan Zhao, Feiping Nie, Junyu Gao, Xuelong Li
papers.abstract: Time series analysis plays a vital role in fields such as finance, healthcare, industry, and meteorology, underpinning key tasks including classification, forecasting, and anomaly detection. Although deep learning models have achieved remarkable progress in these areas in recent years, constructing an efficient, multi-task compatible, and generalizable unified framework for time series analysis remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches are often tailored to single tasks or specific data types, making it difficult to simultaneously handle multi-task modeling and effectively integrate information across diverse time series types. Moreover, real-world data are often affected by noise, complex frequency components, and multi-scale dynamic patterns, which further complicate robust feature extraction and analysis. To ameliorate these challenges, we propose FusAD, a unified analysis framework designed for diverse time series tasks. FusAD features an adaptive time-frequency fusion mechanism, integrating both Fourier and Wavelet transforms to efficiently capture global-local and multi-scale dynamic features. With an adaptive denoising mechanism, FusAD automatically senses and filters various types of noise, highlighting crucial sequence variations and enabling robust feature extraction in complex environments. In addition, the framework integrates a general information fusion and decoding structure, combined with masked pre-training, to promote efficient learning and transfer of multi-granularity representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FusAD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models on mainstream time series benchmarks for classification, forecasting, and anomaly detection tasks, while maintaining high efficiency and scalability. Code is available at https://github.com/zhangda1018/FusAD.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列分析在金融、医疗保健、工业和气象等领域发挥着至关重要的作用，支撑着分类、预测和异常检测等关键任务。尽管深度学习模型近年来在这些领域取得了显著进展，但构建高效、多任务兼容且可泛化的统一时间序列分析框架仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的方法通常是针对单个任务或特定数据类型量身定制的，因此很难同时处理多任务建模并有效地集成不同时间序列类型的信息。此外，现实世界的数据经常受到噪声、复杂频率分量和多尺度动态模式的影响，这进一步使稳健的特征提取和分析变得复杂。为了缓解这些挑战，我们提出了 FusAD，一个专为不同时间序列任务设计的统一分析框架。 FusAD具有自适应时频融合机制，集成傅里叶变换和小波变换，以有效捕获全局局部和多尺度动态特征。凭借自适应降噪机制，FusAD 可自动感知和过滤各种类型的噪声，突出显示关键的序列变化，并在复杂环境中实现稳健的特征提取。此外，该框架集成了通用信息融合和解码结构，结合掩模预训练，促进多粒度表示的高效学习和迁移。大量实验表明，FusAD 在分类、预测和异常检测任务的主流时间序列基准上始终优于最先进的模型，同时保持高效率和可扩展性。代码可在 https://github.com/zhangda1018/FusAD 获取。

papers.title: Damba-ST: Domain-Adaptive Mamba for Efficient Urban Spatio-Temporal Prediction
papers.title_zh: Damba-ST：用于高效城市时空预测的域自适应 Mamba
papers.authors: Rui AN, Yifeng Zhang, Ziran Liang, Wenqi Fan, Yuxuan Liang, Xuequn Shang, Qing  Li
papers.abstract: Training urban spatio-temporal foundation models that generalize well across diverse regions and cities is critical for deploying urban services in unseen or data-scarce regions. Recent studies have typically focused on fusing cross-domain spatio-temporal data to train unified Transformer-based models. However, these models suffer from quadratic computational complexity and high memory overhead, limiting their scalability and practical deployment. Inspired by the efficiency of Mamba, a state space model with linear time complexity, we explore its potential for efficient urban spatio-temporal prediction. However, directly applying Mamba as a spatio-temporal backbone leads to negative transfer and severe performance degradation. This is primarily due to spatio-temporal heterogeneity and the recursive mechanism of Mamba's hidden state updates, which limit cross-domain generalization. To overcome these challenges, we propose Damba-ST, a novel domain-adaptive Mamba-based model for efficient urban spatio-temporal prediction. Damba-ST retains Mamba's linear complexity advantage while significantly enhancing its adaptability to heterogeneous domains. Specifically, we introduce two core innovations: (1) a domain-adaptive state space model that partitions the latent representation space into a shared subspace for learning cross-domain commonalities and independent, domain-specific subspaces for capturing intra-domain discriminative features; (2) three distinct Domain Adapters, which serve as domain-aware proxies to bridge disparate domain distributions and facilitate the alignment of cross-domain commonalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate the generalization and efficiency of Damba-ST. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on prediction tasks and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization, enabling seamless deployment in new urban environments without extensive retraining or fine-tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练能够在不同地区和城市之间良好推广的城市时空基础模型对于在看不见或数据稀缺的地区部署城市服务至关重要。最近的研究通常集中于融合跨域时空数据来训练基于 Transformer 的统一模型。然而，这些模型面临二次计算复杂性和高内存开销，限制了它们的可扩展性和实际部署。受到 Mamba（一种具有线性时间复杂度的状态空间模型）效率的启发，我们探索了其高效城市时空预测的潜力。然而，直接应用 Mamba 作为时空主干会导致负迁移和严重的性能下降。这主要是由于时空异构性和 Mamba 隐藏状态更新的递归机制限制了跨域泛化。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了 Damba-ST，这是一种基于域自适应 Mamba 的新型模型，用于高效的城市时空预测。 Damba-ST 保留了 Mamba 的线性复杂度优势，同时显著增强了其对异构领域的适应性。具体来说，我们引入了两个核心创新：（1）域自适应状态空间模型，将潜在表示空间划分为用于学习跨域共性的共享子空间和用于捕获域内判别特征的独立的、特定于域的子空间； (2) 三个不同的域适配器，用作域感知代理来桥接不同的域分布并促进跨域共性的对齐。大量实验证明了 Damba-ST 的泛化性和效率。它在预测任务上实现了最先进的性能，并展示了强大的零样本泛化能力，能够在新的城市环境中无缝部署，而无需进行大量的再训练或微调。

papers.title: Beyond Traditional Diagnostics: Transforming Patient-Side Information into Predictive Insights with Knowledge Graphs and Prototypes
papers.title_zh: 超越传统诊断：利用知识图和原型将患者端信息转化为预测见解
papers.authors: Yibowen Zhao, Yinan Zhang, Zhixiang Su, Lizhen Cui, Chunyan Miao
papers.abstract: Predicting diseases solely from patient-side information, such as demographics and self-reported symptoms, has attracted significant research attention due to its potential to enhance patient awareness, facilitate early healthcare engagement, and improve healthcare system efficiency. However, existing approaches encounter critical challenges, including imbalanced disease distributions and a lack of interpretability, resulting in biased or unreliable predictions. To address these issues, we propose the Knowledge graph-enhanced, Prototype-aware, and Interpretable (KPI) framework. KPI systematically integrates structured and trusted medical knowledge into a unified disease knowledge graph, constructs clinically meaningful disease prototypes, and employs contrastive learning to enhance predictive accuracy, which is particularly important for long-tailed diseases. Additionally, KPI utilizes large language models (LLMs) to generate patient-specific, medically relevant explanations, thereby improving interpretability and reliability. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that KPI outperforms state-of-the-art methods in predictive accuracy and provides clinically valid explanations that closely align with patient narratives, highlighting its practical value for patient-centered healthcare delivery.
papers.abstract_zh: 仅根据患者方信息（例如人口统计数据和自我报告的症状）预测疾病已引起了广泛的研究关注，因为它具有提高患者意识、促进早期医疗保健参与和提高医疗保健系统效率的潜力。然而，现有的方法遇到了严峻的挑战，包括疾病分布不平衡和缺乏可解释性，导致预测有偏差或不可靠。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了知识图增强、原型感知和可解释（KPI）框架。 KPI系统地将结构化的、可信的医学知识整合到统一的疾病知识图谱中，构建有临床意义的疾病原型，并采用对比学习来提高预测准确性，这对于长尾疾病尤为重要。此外，KPI 利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成针对患者的、医学相关的解释，从而提高可解释性和可靠性。对真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，KPI 在预测准确性方面优于最先进的方法，并提供与患者叙述密切相关的临床有效解释，突显了其对于以患者为中心的医疗服务的实用价值。

papers.title: SSFusion: Tensor Fusion with Selective Sparsification for Efficient Distributed DNN Training
papers.title_zh: SSFusion：具有选择性稀疏化的张量融合，用于高效分布式 DNN 训练
papers.authors: Zhangqiang Ming, Rui Wang, Yuchong Hu, Yuanhao Shu, Wenxiang Zhou, Xinjue Zheng, Dan Feng
papers.abstract: Distributed deep neural networks (DNN) training systems deployed across multiple workers have been widely used to accelerate the training of large models and datasets, while the communication overhead for synchronizing data (i.e., gradient tensor) among workers often becomes a performance bottleneck. To improve communication efficiency, two key techniques are often adopted: i) tensor fusion, which merges multiple tensors to transmit them together to reduce the communication startup overhead, and ii) gradient sparsification compression, which transmits only the largest gradient elements to reduce communication traffic. Recent studies focus on combining tensor fusion and sparsification: a straightforward way is to perform sparsification on each tensor before fusion (per-tensor sparsification), but it incurs significant sparsification overhead; alternatively, state-ofthe-art works first merge multiple tensors (i.e., fusion) and then perform sparsification on them to reduce sparsification overhead (multi-tensor sparsification). However, we observe that multi-tensor sparsification causes many tensors to be missing, leading to a significant decrease in convergence accuracy. In this paper, we revisit per-tensor sparsification for no tensor missing and propose a new selective sparsification mechanism tailored for fused tensors. This mechanism strategically selects a subset of fused tensors: the selected ones undergo individual sparsification, while the others remain unsparsified. This design achieves both low sparsification overhead (via selective sparsification) and high convergence performance (without tensor missing), which we term SSFusion. On top of SSFusion, we propose an efficient sparsification offloading scheme that offloads GPU-based gradient sparsification to the CPU to further speed up sparsification, and an interleaved communication scheme that improves communication efficiency through fusion separation. Evaluations on cloud and local clusters show that SSFusion improves the training throughput by $\mathbf{2 7. 5 \% - 1 0 6. 7 \%}$ over stateof-the-art solutions, while maintaining approximately the same convergence accuracy as the non-sparsification baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨多个工作人员部署的分布式深度神经网络（DNN）训练系统已被广泛用于加速大型模型和数据集的训练，而工作人员之间同步数据（即梯度张量）的通信开销往往成为性能瓶颈。为了提高通信效率，通常采用两种关键技术：i）张量融合，将多个张量合并在一起传输以减少通信启动开销；ii）梯度稀疏压缩，仅传输最大的梯度元素以减少通信流量。最近的研究重点是张量融合和稀疏化的结合：一种直接的方法是在融合之前对每个张量进行稀疏化（每张量稀疏化），但它会产生显著的稀疏化开销；或者，最先进的工作首先合并多个张量（即融合），然后对它们执行稀疏化以减少稀疏化开销（多张量稀疏化）。然而，我们观察到多张量稀疏化会导致许多张量丢失，从而导致收敛精度显著下降。在本文中，我们重新审视了每张量的稀疏化以保证张量不丢失，并提出了一种针对融合张量的新的选择性稀疏化机制。该机制策略性地选择融合张量的子集：所选张量进行单独稀疏化，而其他张量保持不稀疏化。该设计实现了低稀疏化开销（通过选择性稀疏化）和高收敛性能（无张量丢失），我们将其称为 SSFusion。在 SSFusion 之上，我们提出了一种高效的稀疏化卸载方案，将基于 GPU 的梯度稀疏化卸载到 CPU 以进一步加速稀疏化，以及一种通过融合分离提高通信效率的交错通信方案。对云和本地集群的评估表明，SSFusion 比最先进的解决方案将训练吞吐量提高 $\mathbf{2 7. 5 \% - 1 0 6. 7 \%}$，同时保持与非稀疏化基线大致相同的收敛精度。

papers.title: MojoFrame: Dataframe Library in Mojo Language
papers.title_zh: MojoFrame：Mojo 语言的数据框架库
papers.authors: Shengya Huang, Zhaoheng Li, Derek Werner, Yongjoo Park
papers.abstract: Mojo is an emerging programming language built on MLIR (Multi-Level Intermediate Representation) and supports JIT (Just-in-Time) compilation. It enables transparent hardware-specific optimizations (e.g., for CPUs and GPUs), while allowing users to express their logic using Python-like user-friendly syntax. Mojo has demonstrated strong performance on tensor operations; however, its capabilities for relational operations (e.g., filtering, join, and group-by aggregation) common in data science workflows, remain unexplored. To date, no dataframe implementation exists in the Mojo ecosystem. In this paper, we introduce the first Mojo-native dataframe library, called MojoFrame, that supports core relational operations and user-defined functions (UDFs). MojoFrame is built on top of Mojo's tensor to achieve fast operations on numeric columns, while utilizing a cardinality-aware approach to effectively integrate non-numeric columns for flexible data representation. To achieve high efficiency, MojoFrame takes significantly different approaches than existing libraries. We show that MojoFrame supports all operations for TPC-H queries and a selection of TPC-DS queries with promising performance, achieving up to 4.60x speedup versus existing dataframe libraries in other programming languages. Nevertheless, there remain optimization opportunities for MojoFrame (and the Mojo language), particularly in in-memory data representation and dictionary operations.
papers.abstract_zh: Mojo是一种基于MLIR（多级中间表示）的新兴编程语言，支持JIT（即时）编译。它支持透明的特定于硬件的优化（例如，针对 CPU 和 GPU），同时允许用户使用类似 Python 的用户友好语法来表达其逻辑。 Mojo在张量运算上表现出了强大的性能；然而，其在数据科学工作流程中常见的关系操作（例如过滤、联接和分组聚合）的功能仍有待探索。迄今为止，Mojo 生态系统中尚不存在数据框实现。在本文中，我们介绍了第一个 Mojo 原生数据框架库，称为 MojoFrame，它支持核心关系操作和用户定义函数（UDF）。 MojoFrame 构建在 Mojo 张量之上，可实现数字列的快速操作，同时利用基数感知方法有效集成非数字列以实现灵活的数据表示。为了实现高效率，MojoFrame 采用了与现有库截然不同的方法。我们表明，MojoFrame 支持 TPC-H 查询的所有操作以及具有良好性能的精选 TPC-DS 查询，与其他编程语言中的现有数据帧库相比，速度提升高达 4.60 倍。尽管如此，MojoFrame（和 Mojo 语言）仍然存在优化机会，特别是在内存数据表示和字典操作方面。

papers.title: Text2VectorSQL: Towards a Unified Interface for Vector Search and SQL Queries
papers.title_zh: Text2VectorSQL：面向矢量搜索和 SQL 查询的统一接口
papers.authors: Zhengren Wang, Dongwen Yao, Bozhou Li, Dongsheng Ma, Bo Li, Zhiyu Li, Feiyu Xiong, Bin Cui, Linpeng Tang, Wentao Zhang
papers.abstract: The proliferation of unstructured data poses a fundamental challenge to traditional database interfaces. While Text-to-SQL has democratized access to structured data, it remains incapable of interpreting semantic or multi-modal queries. Concurrently, vector search has emerged as the de facto standard for querying unstructured data, but its integration with SQL-termed VectorSQL-still relies on manual query crafting and lacks standardized evaluation methodologies, creating a significant gap between its potential and practical application. To bridge this fundamental gap, we introduce and formalize Text2VectorSQL, a novel task to establish a unified natural language interface for seamlessly querying both structured and unstructured data. To catalyze research in this new domain, we present a comprehensive foundational ecosystem, including: (1) A scalable and robust pipeline for synthesizing high-quality Text-to-VectorSQL training data. (2) VectorSQLBench, the first large-scale, multi-faceted benchmark for this task, encompassing 12 distinct combinations across three database backends (SQLite, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse) and four data sources (BIRD, Spider, arXiv, Wikipedia). (3) Several novel evaluation metrics designed for more nuanced performance analysis. Extensive experiments not only confirm strong baseline performance with our trained models, but also reveal the recall degradation challenge: the integration of SQL filters with vector search can lead to more pronounced result omissions than in conventional filtered vector search. By defining the core task, delivering the essential data and evaluation infrastructure, and identifying key research challenges, our work lays the essential groundwork to build the next generation of unified and intelligent data interfaces. Our repository is available at https://github.com/OpenDCAI/Text2VectorSQL.
papers.abstract_zh: 非结构化数据的激增对传统数据库接口提出了根本性挑战。虽然文本到 SQL 已经实现了对结构化数据的民主化访问，但它仍然无法解释语义或多模态查询。同时，矢量搜索已成为查询非结构化数据的事实标准，但其与 SQL 的集成（称为 VectorSQL）仍然依赖于手动查询设计，缺乏标准化的评估方法，其潜在应用与实际应用之间存在巨大差距。为了弥补这一根本差距，我们引入并形式化了 Text2VectorSQL，这是一项新任务，旨在建立统一的自然语言接口，以无缝查询结构化和非结构化数据。为了促进这一新领域的研究，我们提出了一个全面的基础生态系统，包括：（1）一个可扩展且强大的管道，用于合成高质量的 Text-to-VectorSQL 训练数据。 (2) VectorSQLBench，这是该任务的第一个大规模、多方面的基准测试，涵盖三个数据库后端（SQLite、PostgreSQL、ClickHouse）和四个数据源（BIRD、Spider、arXiv、Wikipedia）的 12 种不同组合。 (3) 几个新颖的评估指标，旨在进行更细致的绩效分析。大量的实验不仅证实了我们训练的模型具有强大的基线性能，而且还揭示了召回率下降的挑战：SQL 过滤器与向量搜索的集成可能会导致比传统过滤向量搜索更明显的结果遗漏。通过定义核心任务、提供必要的数据和评估基础设施以及确定关键的研究挑战，我们的工作为构建下一代统一和智能数据接口奠定了必要的基础。我们的存储库位于 https://github.com/OpenDCAI/Text2VectorSQL。

papers.title: AGRAG: Advanced Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLMs
papers.title_zh: AGRAG：面向大语言模型的高级图检索增强生成
papers.authors: Yubo Wang, Haoyang Li, Fei Teng, lei Chen
papers.abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (Graph-based RAG) has demonstrated significant potential in enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) with structured knowledge. However, existing methods face three critical challenges: Inaccurate Graph Construction, caused by LLM hallucination; Poor Reasoning Ability, caused by failing to generate explicit reasons telling LLM why certain chunks were selected; and Inadequate Answering, which only partially answers the query due to the inadequate LLM reasoning, making their performance lag behind NaiveRAG on certain tasks. To address these issues, we propose AGRAG, an advanced graph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework. When constructing the graph, AGRAG substitutes the widely used LLM entity extraction method with a statistics-based method, avoiding hallucination and error propagation. During retrieval, AGRAG formulates the graph reasoning procedure as the Minimum Cost Maximum Influence (MCMI) subgraph generation problem, where we try to include more nodes with high influence score, but with less involving edge cost, to make the generated reasoning paths more comprehensive. We prove this problem to be NP-hard, and propose a greedy algorithm to solve it. The MCMI subgraph generated can serve as explicit reasoning paths to tell LLM why certain chunks were retrieved, thereby making the LLM better focus on the query-related part contents of the chunks, reducing the impact of noise, and improving AGRAG's reasoning ability. Furthermore, compared with the simple tree-structured reasoning paths, our MCMI subgraph can allow more complex graph structures, such as cycles, and improve the comprehensiveness of the generated reasoning paths. The code and prompt of AGRAG are released at: https://github.com/Wyb0627/AGRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的检索增强生成（基于图的 RAG）已显示出在利用结构化知识增强大型语言模型 (LLM) 方面的巨大潜力。然而，现有方法面临三个关键挑战：LLM幻觉导致的图构建不准确；推理能力差，由于未能生成明确的原因告诉LLM为什么选择某些块而导致；以及Inadequate Answering，由于LLM推理不充分，只能部分回答查询，使得它们在某些任务上的性能落后于NaiveRAG。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 AGRAG，一种先进的基于图的检索增强生成框架。在构建图时，AGRAG用基于统计的方法替代了广泛使用的LLM实体提取方法，避免了幻觉和错误传播。在检索过程中，AGRAG 将图推理过程制定为最小成本最大影响（MCMI）子图生成问题，其中我们尝试包含更多具有高影响力得分的节点，但涉及较少的边成本，以使生成的推理路径更加全面。我们证明这个问题是NP-hard问题，并提出了一种贪心算法来解决它。生成的MCMI子图可以作为显式推理路径告诉LLM为什么检索某些chunk，从而使LLM更好地关注chunk中与查询相关的部分内容，减少噪声的影响，提高AGRAG的推理能力。此外，与简单的树结构推理路径相比，我们的MCMI子图可以允许更复杂的图结构，例如循环，并提高生成的推理路径的全面性。 AGRAG的代码和提示符发布于：https://github.com/Wyb0627/AGRAG。

papers.title: Rethinking Flexible Graph Similarity Computation: One-step Alignment with Global Guidance
papers.title_zh: 重新思考灵活的图相似性计算：与全局指导的一步对齐
papers.authors: Zhouyang Liu, Ning Liu, Yixin Chen, Jiezhong He, Shuai Ma, Dongsheng Li
papers.abstract: Graph Edit Distance (GED) is a widely used measure of graph similarity, valued for its flexibility in encoding domain knowledge through operation costs. However, existing learning-based approximation methods follow a modeling paradigm that decouples local candidate match selection from both operation costs and global dependencies between matches. This decoupling undermines their ability to capture the intrinsic flexibility of GED and often forces them to rely on costly iterative refinement to obtain accurate alignments. In this work, we revisit the formulation of GED and revise the prevailing paradigm, and propose Graph Edit Network (GEN), an implementation of the revised formulation that tightly integrates cost-aware expense estimation with globally guided one-step alignment. Specifically, GEN incorporates operation costs into node matching expenses estimation, ensuring match decisions respect the specified cost setting. Furthermore, GEN models match dependencies within and across graphs, capturing each match's impact on the overall alignment. These designs enable accurate GED approximation without iterative refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that GEN achieves up to a 37.8% reduction in GED predictive errors, while increasing inference throughput by up to 414x. These results highlight GEN's practical efficiency and the effectiveness of the revision. Beyond this implementation, our revision provides a principled framework for advancing learning-based GED approximation.
papers.abstract_zh: 图编辑距离（GED）是一种广泛使用的图相似度度量，因其通过操作成本编码领域知识的灵活性而受到重视。然而，现有的基于学习的近似方法遵循一种建模范式，该范式将本地候选匹配选择与操作成本和匹配之间的全局依赖性解耦。这种解耦削弱了他们捕捉 GED 内在灵活性的能力，并常常迫使他们依赖昂贵的迭代细化来获得准确的对齐。在这项工作中，我们重新审视 GED 的制定并修改了流行的范式，并提出了图形编辑网络（GEN），这是修订后的制定的一种实现，它将成本感知的费用估算与全球指导的一步调整紧密结合起来。具体来说，GEN 将运营成本纳入节点匹配费用估算中，确保匹配决策遵循指定的成本设置。此外，GEN 模型匹配图表内和图表之间的依赖关系，捕获每个匹配对整体对齐的影响。这些设计无需迭代细化即可实现精确的 GED 近似。对现实世界和综合基准的大量实验表明，GEN 的 GED 预测误差降低了 37.8%，同时推理吞吐量提高了 414 倍。这些结果凸显了GEN的实际效率和修订的有效性。除了这一实施之外，我们的修订版还为推进基于学习的 GED 近似提供了一个原则框架。

papers.title: Beyond Homophily: Community Search on Heterophilic Graphs
papers.title_zh: 超越同质性：异性图上的社区搜索
papers.authors: Qing Sima, Xiaoyang  Wang, Wenjie Zhang
papers.abstract: Community search aims to identify a refined set of nodes that are most relevant to a given query, supporting tasks ranging from fraud detection to recommendation. Unlike homophilic graphs, many real-world networks are heterophilic, where edges predominantly connect dissimilar nodes. Therefore, structural signals that once reflected smooth, low-frequency similarity now appear as sharp, high-frequency contrasts. However, both classical algorithms (e.g., k-core, k-truss) and recent ML-based models struggle to achieve effective community search on heterophilic graphs, where edge signs or semantics are generally unknown. Algorithm-based methods often return communities with mixed class labels, while GNNs, built on homophily, smooth away meaningful signals and blur community boundaries. Therefore, we propose Adaptive Community Search (AdaptCS), a lightweight framework featuring three key designs: (i) an AdaptCS Encoder that disentangles multi-hop and multi-frequency signals, enabling the model to capture both smooth (homophilic) and contrastive (heterophilic) relations; (ii) a memory-efficient low-rank optimization that removes the main computational bottleneck and ensures model scalability; and (iii) an Adaptive Community Score (ACS) that guides online search by balancing embedding similarity and topological relations. Extensive experiments on both heterophilic and homophilic benchmarks demonstrate that AdaptCS outperforms the best-performing baseline by an average of 11% in F1-score, retains robustness across heterophily levels, and achieves up to 2 orders of magnitude speedup over the strongest ML-based CS baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 社区搜索旨在识别与给定查询最相关的一组精细节点，支持从欺诈检测到推荐等任务。与同质图不同，许多现实世界的网络是异质的，其中边主要连接不同的节点。因此，曾经反映平滑、低频相似性的结构信号现在表现为尖锐、高频对比。然而，经典算法（例如 k-core、k-truss）和最近的基于 ML 的模型都难以在异性图上实现有效的社区搜索，其中边缘符号或语义通常是未知的。基于算法的方法通常会返回具有混合类标签的社区，而基于同质性构建的 GNN 会平滑有意义的信号并模糊社区边界。因此，我们提出了自适应社区搜索（AdaptCS），这是一个轻量级框架，具有三个关键设计：（i）AdaptCS编码器，可以解开多跳和多频率信号，使模型能够捕获平滑（同质）和对比（异质）关系； (ii) 内存高效的低阶优化，消除主要计算瓶颈并确保模型可扩展性； (iii) 自适应社区评分 (ACS)，通过平衡嵌入相似性和拓扑关系来指导在线搜索。对异性和同性基准的大量实验表明，AdaptCS 的 F1 分数平均优于性能最佳的基线 11%，在异性水平上保持鲁棒性，并且比最强的基于 ML 的 CS 基线实现高达 2 个数量级的加速。

papers.title: Efficient Cloud-edge Collaborative Approaches to SPARQL Queries over Large RDF graphs
papers.title_zh: 大型 RDF 图上 SPARQL 查询的高效云边缘协作方法
papers.authors: Shidan Ma, Peng Peng, Xu Zhou, M. Tamer Özsu, Lei Zou, Guo Chen
papers.abstract: With the increasing use of RDF graphs, storing and querying such data using SPARQL remains a critical problem. Current mainstream solutions rely on cloud-based data management architectures, but often suffer from performance bottlenecks in environments with limited bandwidth or high system load. To address this issue, this paper explores for the first time the integration of edge computing to move graph data storage and processing to edge environments, thereby improving query performance. This approach requires offloading query processing to edge servers, which involves addressing two challenges: data localization and network scheduling. First, the data localization challenge lies in computing the subgraphs maintained on edge servers to quickly identify the servers that can handle specific queries. To address this challenge, we introduce a new concept of pattern-induced subgraphs. Second, the network scheduling challenge involves efficiently assigning queries to edge and cloud servers to optimize overall system performance. We tackle this by constructing a overall system model that jointly captures data distribution, query characteristics, network communication, and computational resources. Accordingly, we further propose a joint formulation of query assignment and computational resource allocation, modeling it as a Mixed Integer Nonlinear Programming (MINLP) problem and solve this problem using a modified branch-and-bound algorithm. Experimental results on real datasets under a real cloud platform demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline methods in terms of efficiency. The codes are available on GitHub
papers.abstract_zh: 随着 RDF 图的使用越来越多，使用 SPARQL 存储和查询此类数据仍然是一个关键问题。目前的主流解决方案依赖于基于云的数据管理架构，但在带宽有限或系统负载较高的环境中往往会遇到性能瓶颈。针对这一问题，本文首次探索边缘计算的融合，将图数据存储和处理转移到边缘环境，从而提高查询性能。这种方法需要将查询处理卸载到边缘服务器，这涉及解决两个挑战：数据本地化和网络调度。首先，数据本地化的挑战在于计算边缘服务器上维护的子图，以快速识别可以处理特定查询的服务器。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了模式诱导子图的新概念。其次，网络调度挑战涉及有效地将查询分配给边缘和云服务器以优化整体系统性能。我们通过构建一个整体系统模型来解决这个问题，该模型共同捕获数据分布、查询特征、网络通信和计算资源。因此，我们进一步提出查询分配和计算资源分配的联合公式，将其建模为混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题，并使用改进的分支定界算法解决该问题。真实云平台下真实数据集的实验结果表明，我们提出的方法在效率方面优于最先进的基线方法。这些代码可以在 GitHub 上找到

papers.title: Generalizable Address-aware Semantic Prefetching for Scalable Transactional and Analytical Workloads
papers.title_zh: 用于可扩展事务和分析工作负载的通用地址感知语义预取
papers.authors: Farzaneh Zirak, Farhana Choudhury, Renata Borovica-Gajic
papers.abstract: Data prefetching plays a crucial role in reducing I/O overhead and improving the performance of database systems. While traditional prefetchers focus on sequential patterns, recent learning-based approaches, especially those leveraging data semantics, achieve higher accuracy for complex access patterns. However, these methods often struggle with today's dynamic, ever-growing datasets and require frequent, timely fine-tuning. Privacy constraints may also restrict access to complete datasets, necessitating prefetchers that can learn effectively from samples. To address these challenges, we present GrASP, a learningbased prefetcher designed for both analytical and transactional workloads. GrASP enhances prefetching accuracy and scalability by leveraging logical block address deltas and combining query representations with result semantics. It frames prefetching as a context-aware multi-label classification task, using multi-layer LSTMs to predict delta patterns from embedded context. This delta modeling approach enables GrASP to generalize predictions from small samples to larger, dynamic datasets without requiring extensive retraining. Experiments on real-world datasets and industrial benchmarks demonstrate that GrASP generalizes to datasets $\mathbf{2 5 0} \times$ larger than the training data, achieving up to 45% higher hit ratios, 60% lower I/O time, and 55% lower endto-end query execution latency compared to existing baselines. On average, GrASP attains a 91.4% hit ratio, a 90.8% I/O time reduction, and a 57.1% execution latency reduction.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据预取对于减少I/O开销、提高数据库系统的性能起着至关重要的作用。虽然传统的预取器专注于顺序模式，但最近基于学习的方法，尤其是利用数据语义的方法，可以为复杂的访问模式实现更高的准确性。然而，这些方法常常难以应对当今动态、不断增长的数据集，并且需要频繁、及时的微调。隐私限制还可能限制对完整数据集的访问，从而需要能够从样本中有效学习的预取器。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 GrASP，这是一种基于学习的预取器，专为分析和事务工作负载而设计。 GrASP 通过利用逻辑块地址增量并将查询表示与结果语义相结合，增强了预取的准确性和可扩展性。它将预取构建为上下文感知的多标签分类任务，使用多层 LSTM 从嵌入的上下文中预测增量模式。这种增量建模方法使 GrASP 能够将预测从小样本推广到更大的动态数据集，而无需进行大量的再训练。对真实数据集和工业基准的实验表明，GrASP 可以推广到比训练数据大 $\mathbf{2 5 0} \times$ 的数据集，与现有基准相比，命中率提高了 45%，I/O 时间缩短了 60%，端到端查询执行延迟降低了 55%。平均而言，GrASP 的命中率达到 91.4%，I/O 时间减少 90.8%，执行延迟减少 57.1%。

papers.title: AlignSketch: A Framework for Aligning Theoretical and Practical Estimation Errors
papers.title_zh: AlignSketch：对齐理论和实际估计误差的框架
papers.authors: Ce Zheng, Hanyue Zheng, Jingwei Shi, Xinye Xu, Wei Zhou, Tong Yang, Zhenyu Guan, Yong Cui
papers.abstract: Sketches are widely used in data streams and approximate query processing for their low memory and acceptable errors. They can be categorized into non-classificationbased and classification-based sketches. While the latter typically provide higher accuracy, they often involve fragmented stream processing, which increases the complexity of theoretical analysis and leads to a widened gap between theoretical bounds and practical estimation errors. To address the challenge, we propose AlignSketch, a general classification framework for data stream processing with provable theoretical guarantees. It achieves tight and verifiable alignment between theoretical error bounds and practical estimation errors. The framework ensures each stream item is recorded at only one tier at any given time, and that estimation errors do not accumulate across tiers but originate from a single one. An important strength of our design is its ability to leverage theoretical results on LRU and LFU miss rates, which have not been explored in existing sketches, to derive tight error bounds. Extensive experiments show that AlignSketch achieves closer alignment between theoretical and practical estimation errors compared to state-of-the-art methods while reducing practical estimation errors by nearly 1 to 2 orders of magnitude. The source code is available on GitHub 11https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AlignSketch.
papers.abstract_zh: 草图因其低内存和可接受的错误而广泛应用于数据流和近似查询处理。它们可以分为基于非分类的草图和基于分类的草图。虽然后者通常提供更高的精度，但它们通常涉及碎片流处理，这增加了理论分析的复杂性，并导致理论界限和实际估计误差之间的差距扩大。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 AlignSke​​tch，这是一种具有可证明的理论保证的数据流处理通用分类框架。它实现了理论误差范围和实际估计误差之间的紧密且可验证的一致性。该框架确保每个流项目在任何给定时间仅记录在一层，并且估计错误不会跨层累积，而是源自单个层。我们设计的一个重要优势是它能够利用 LRU 和 LFU 丢失率的理论结果（现有草图中尚未探索）来得出严格的误差范围。大量实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，AlignSke​​tch 实现了理论估计误差和实际估计误差之间的更接近，同时将实际估计误差减少了近 1 到 2 个数量级。源代码可在 GitHub 11 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AlignSke​​tch 上获取。

papers.title: FedCurrMM: A Federated Map Matching Framework with Curriculum-aware Client Selection
papers.title_zh: FedCurrMM：具有课程感知客户端选择的联合地图匹配框架
papers.authors: Minxiao Chen, Haitao Yuan, Haoning Wang, Nan Jiang, Zhihan Zheng, Ao Zhou, Shangguang Wang
papers.abstract: Federated map matching aims to align GPS trajectories collected by multiple decentralized clients to road networks in a privacy-preserving manner, and remains an unexplored yet critical problem for collaboration across clients. However, this task is highly challenging due to severe client heterogeneity, which hinder efficient and robust model convergence. This paper presents a novel federated learning framework that achieves high accuracy, communication efficiency, and robustness in heterogeneous environments. At the model-level, we design Gel-HMM, a graph-enhanced, learnable Hidden Markov Model that decouples client-specific information through specific graph structures and supports interpretable matching. At the framework-level, we propose a curriculum-aware client selection strategy that captures global learning dynamics and adaptively guides client participation. Furthermore, we develop a dual-speed parallel optimization scheme to decouple the co-training of the client matching model and the server-side selector. An adaptive knowledge distillation mechanism is also introduced to mitigate data quality variance across clients while preserving privacy. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with an average improvement of 20% on accuracy and a 60% reduction in communication cost.
papers.abstract_zh: 联合地图匹配旨在以保护隐私的方式将多个分散客户端收集的 GPS 轨迹与道路网络对齐，这对于跨客户端协作来说仍然是一个尚未探索但至关重要的问题。然而，由于严重的客户端异构性，这项任务非常具有挑战性，这阻碍了高效和鲁棒的模型收敛。本文提出了一种新颖的联邦学习框架，可在异构环境中实现高精度、通信效率和鲁棒性。在模型层面，我们设计了 Gel-HMM，这是一种图增强的、可学习的隐马尔可夫模型，它通过特定的图结构解耦客户特定的信息并支持可解释的匹配。在框架层面，我们提出了一种课程感知的客户选择策略，该策略可以捕捉全球学习动态并自适应地指导客户参与。此外，我们开发了一种双速并行优化方案来解耦客户端匹配模型和服务器端选择器的协同训练。还引入了自适应知识蒸馏机制，以减轻客户端之间的数据质量差异，同时保护隐私。对两个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的基线，准确率平均提高 20%，通信成本降低 60%。
