papers.title: Enabling Homomorphic Analytical Operations on Compressed Scientific Data with Multi-stage Decompression
papers.title_zh: 通过多级解压对压缩科学数据进行同态分析操作
papers.authors: Xuan Wu, Sheng Di, Tripti Agarwal, Kai Zhao, Xin Liang, Franck Cappello
papers.abstract: Error-controlled lossy compressors have been widely used in scientific applications to reduce the unprecedented size of scientific data while keeping data distortion within a user-specified threshold. While they significantly mitigate the pressure for data storage and transmission, they prolong the time to access the data because decompression is required to transform the binary compressed data into meaningful floating-point numbers. This incurs noticeable overhead for common analytical operations on scientific data that extract or derive useful information, because the time cost of the operations could be much lower than that of decompression. In this work, we design an error-controlled lossy compression and analytical framework that features multi-stage decompression and homomorphic analytical operation algorithms on intermediate decompressed data for reduced data access latency. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We abstract a generic compression pipeline with partial decompression to multiple intermediate data representations and implement four instances based on state-of-the-art high-throughput scientific data compressors. (2) We carefully design homomorphic algorithms to enable direct operations on intermediate decompressed data for three types of analytical operations on scientific data. (3) We evaluate our approach using five real-world scientific datasets. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our method achieves significant speedups when performing analytical operations on compressed scientific data across all three targeted analytical operation types.
papers.abstract_zh: 误差控制有损压缩器已广泛应用于科学应用中，以减少科学数据前所未有的大小，同时将数据失真保持在用户指定的阈值内。虽然它们显著减轻了数据存储和传输的压力，但它们延长了访问数据的时间，因为需要解压缩才能将二进制压缩数据转换为有意义的浮点数。这会给提取或导出有用信息的科学数据的常见分析操作带来显著的开销，因为操作的时间成本可能比减压的时间成本低得多。在这项工作中，我们设计了一个错误控制的有损压缩和分析框架，该框架具有对中间解压缩数据进行多级解压缩和同态分析操作算法的特点，以减少数据访问延迟。我们的贡献是三重的。 (1) 我们抽象了一个通用压缩管道，其部分解压缩为多个中间数据表示，并基于最先进的高吞吐量科学数据压缩器实现了四个实例。 （2）我们精心设计同态算法，以实现对中间解压数据的直接操作，以实现对科学数据的三种类型的分析操作。 (3) 我们使用五个真实世界的科学数据集评估我们的方法。实验评估表明，我们的方法在对所有三种目标分析操作类型的压缩科学数据执行分析操作时实现了显著的加速。

papers.title: DNA: A Distribution-and-Aggregation Solution for Spatiotemporal K-function-based Analysis
papers.title_zh: DNA：基于时空 K 函数分析的分布和聚合解决方案
papers.authors: Tsz Nam Chan, Bojian Zhu, Dingming Wu, Renchi Yang, Ruisheng Wang
papers.abstract: Generating a spatiotemporal $K$-function plot is frequently adopted to analyze point patterns by domain experts in a wide range of application domains, including criminology, transportation science, urban planning, and epidemiology. However, with the high worst-case time complexity of computing a spatiotemporal $K$-function plot, the state-of-the-art methods are unable to efficiently (or feasibly) support this tool. To overcome this issue, we develop Distribution-aNd-Aggregation (DNA), which is the first solution that can reduce the worst-case time complexity for supporting this tool. Experiment results on four large-scale location datasets show that DNA achieves speedups of 4.58x to 57.42x over the state-of-the-art methods, without incurring significant space overhead. The implementation of all methods can be found in https://github.com/edisonchan2013928/DNA.
papers.abstract_zh: 犯罪学、交通科学、城市规划和流行病学等广泛应用领域的领域专家经常采用生成时空 $K$ 函数图来分析点模式。然而，由于计算时空 $K$ 函数图的最坏情况时间复杂度很高，最先进的方法无法有效（或可行）支持该工具。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了分布聚合（DNA），这是第一个可以降低支持该工具的最坏情况时间复杂度的解决方案。在四个大规模位置数据集上的实验结果表明，DNA 比最先进的方法实现了 4.58 倍至 57.42 倍的加速，且不会产生显著的空间开销。所有方法的实现可以在https://github.com/edisonchan2013928/DNA中找到。

papers.title: Chubby: Robust Smart Contract Execution  Against  Dependency Over-declaration
papers.title_zh: Chubby：针对依赖过度声明的稳健智能合约执行
papers.authors: Junyu Wei, Xiaodong Qi, Qifeng Que, Zhao Zhang, Yanqin Yang, Cheqing Jin
papers.abstract: The adoption of pre-declared read/write sets (RWSets) in blockchains such as Solana enables parallel transaction execution by identifying non-conflicting transactions in advance. However, this approach is highly sensitive to RWSet accuracy: conservative over-approximation or adversarial manipulation can introduce false dependencies that unnecessarily serialize transactions, degrading throughput. We present Chubby, a robust parallel execution framework that tolerates RWSet imprecision by combining conservative scheduling with lightweight runtime RWSet checking. Rather than relying on precise upfront declarations, Chubby incrementally prunes false dependencies during execution, gradually uncovering latent parallelism without incurring the cost of full transaction execution. To improve efficiency, Chubby employs an impact-driven checking strategy that prioritizes transactions with the greatest performance impact using static heuristic impact values. In addition, Chubby adopts an execution-first coordination mechanism that prioritizes execution while opportunistically using idle resources for checking, ensuring throughput is less compromised. We implement Chubby atop the Solana codebase and test it on various workloads. The experimental results show that Chubby achieves up to $4.64 \times$ throughput speedup and reduces up to $3.22 \times$ P99 latency under workloads with inaccurate RWSet declarations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在 Solana 等区块链中采用预先声明的读/写集 (RWSet)，通过提前识别非冲突事务来实现并行事务执行。然而，这种方法对 RWSet 的准确性高度敏感：保守的过度逼近或对抗性操作可能会引入错误的依赖关系，从而不必要地序列化事务，从而降低吞吐量。我们提出了 Chubby，一个强大的并行执行框架，它通过将保守调度与轻量级运行时 RWSet 检查相结合来容忍 RWSet 不精确性。 Chubby 不依赖于精确的预先声明，而是在执行过程中逐步修剪错误的依赖关系，逐渐发现潜在的并行性，而不会产生完整事务执行的成本。为了提高效率，Chubby 采用了影响驱动的检查策略，该策略使用静态启发式影响值对性能影响最大的事务进行优先级排序。此外，Chubby 采用执行优先的协调机制，优先执行，同时机会性地使用空闲资源进行检查，确保吞吐量不受影响。我们在 Solana 代码库之上实现 Chubby 并在各种工作负载上对其进行测试。实验结果表明，在 RWSet 声明不准确的工作负载下，Chubby 实现了吞吐量最高达到原来的 4.64 倍，P99 延迟最高降低至原来的 1/3.22。

papers.title: PLAN: Fast and Approximate Gaussian Kernel Density Visualization in Road Networks
papers.title_zh: PLAN：道路网络中的快速近似高斯核密度可视化
papers.authors: Tsz Nam Chan, Hongwei Ye, Bojian Zhu, Leong Hou U, Dingming Wu, Ruisheng Wang, Joshua Zhexue Huang
papers.abstract: Network Kernel Density Visualization (NKDV) is a widely used spatial analysis tool in various communities, including transportation science, criminology, and urban planning. However, generating NKDV is very time-consuming, which does not scale to support large-scale datasets. Although many efficient algorithms have been developed for supporting this tool, most of these algorithms cannot be used for handling the most popular Gaussian kernel function. To tackle this issue, we first develop the pioneering Piecewise-Linear Approximate solutioN (PLAN), which can simultaneously (1) reduce the time complexity, (2) retain the similar space complexity, and (3) achieve the accuracy guarantee for generating NKDV with the Gaussian kernel. By providing further optimization for PLAN, our best method, called PLAN+, can achieve the lowest time complexity for supporting this tool. Experiment results on four large-scale datasets verify that both PLAN and PLAN+ achieve 32.47x to 2936.88x speedups, only incur 1.26x to 2.15x space overhead, and provide accurate NKDV results compared with the state-of-the-art solution (SOTA). The implementation of all methods can be found in https://github.com/edisonchan2013928/PLAN.
papers.abstract_zh: 网络核密度可视化 (NKDV) 是各种社区广泛使用的空间分析工具，包括交通科学、犯罪学和城市规划。然而，生成 NKDV 非常耗时，无法扩展以支持大规模数据集。尽管已经开发了许多有效的算法来支持该工具，但这些算法中的大多数不能用于处理最流行的高斯核函数。为了解决这个问题，我们首先开发了开创性的分段线性近似解决方案（PLAN），它可以同时（1）降低时间复杂度，（2）保留类似的空间复杂度，以及（3）实现用高斯核生成NKDV的精度保证。通过对 PLAN 进行进一步优化，我们的最佳方法（称为 PLAN+）可以实现支持该工具的最低时间复杂度。四个大型数据集上的实验结果验证了 PLAN 和 PLAN+ 均实现了 32.47 倍至 2936.88 倍的加速，仅产生 1.26 倍至 2.15 倍的空间开销，并且与最先进的解决方案 (SOTA) 相比，提供了准确的 NKDV 结果。所有方法的实现可以在https://github.com/edisonchan2013928/PLAN中找到。

papers.title: MINOR: Multivariate Time Series Iterative Cleaning Algorithm
papers.title_zh: MINOR：多元时间序列迭代清理算法
papers.authors: Aoqian Zhang, Yinru Sun, Pengxiang Hao, Yifeng Gong, Boyang Li, Jing Geng, Zheng Wang, Lianpeng Qiao
papers.abstract: Errors are common in time series data, such as sensor measurements. Existing methods tend to focus on single errors in univariate data, but do not provide satisfactory results for consecutive errors, especially in the more general multivariate data. Modeling each dimension separately in one run can lead to bias, as the correlation between dimensions and the effects of existing errors are not taken into account. We also note that current methods suffer from the problem of over-repair, i.e. clean observations may be modified after data cleaning. In this paper, we propose MINOR, an iterative cleaning algorithm for multivariate time series with limited labels. We formalize the repair problem and propose a bidirectional validation that uses a local speed constraint and the past and future information to solve the over-repair problem. We also present a unidirectional validation that supports online computations. We analyze the properties of our proposals and compare them with SOTA methods in terms of effectiveness, efficiency, and the impact of applications such as classification. Experiments on real datasets show that MINOR can have higher repair accuracy in various situations and improve time efficiency over the proposed incremental techniques. Interestingly, it can be effective even when there are few labels around 1%.
papers.abstract_zh: 错误在时间序列数据中很常见，例如传感器测量。现有方法往往关注单变量数据中的单个错误，但对于连续错误，特别是在更一般的多变量数据中，不能提供令人满意的结果。在一次运行中单独对每个维度进行建模可能会导致偏差，因为没有考虑维度之间的相关性和现有误差的影响。我们还注意到，当前的方法存在过度修复的问题，即数据清理后可能会修改干净的观察结果。在本文中，我们提出了 MINOR，一种针对具有有限标签的多元时间序列的迭代清理算法。我们将修复问题形式化，并提出使用局部速度约束以及过去和未来信息的双向验证来解决过度修复问题。我们还提出了支持在线计算的单向验证。我们分析了我们提案的特性，并将其与 SOTA 方法在有效性、效率以及分类等应用的影响方面进行了比较。在真实数据集上的实验表明，与所提出的增量技术相比，MINOR 在各种情况下都可以具有更高的修复精度，并提高时间效率。有趣的是，即使在 1% 左右的标签很少的情况下，它也能有效。

papers.title: Explaining GNN Negatives Globally and Locally
papers.title_zh: 解释 GNN 的全局和局部负数
papers.authors: Kehan Pang, Wenfei Fan, Min Xie, Dandan Lin
papers.abstract: This paper studies explanations for graph neural network (GNN) classifiers $\mathcal{M}$ when $\mathcal{M}$ makes negative predictions, such as loan denials, paper rejections, or job application turn-downs. The objective is to (a) provide global explanations of $\mathcal{M}$'s behavior and (b) generate counterfactual explanations locally at a vertex $u$, suggesting the minimal changes to features or topology around $u$ needed to flip $\mathcal{M}$'s prediction. We propose a class of rules that treat negative predictions as their consequences, and employ the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test as a predicate, which is at least as expressive as GNN classifiers. We develop algorithms to (a) learn such rules for global explanations and (b) apply them to compute local counterfactuals. Extensive experiments on real-world graphs show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods across major metrics.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了图神经网络 (GNN) 分类器 $\mathcal{M}$ 在 $\mathcal{M}$ 做出负面预测（例如贷款被拒绝、论文被拒绝或工作申请被拒绝）时的解释。目标是 (a) 提供 $\mathcal{M}$ 行为的全局解释，以及 (b) 在顶点 $u$ 本地生成反事实解释，建议对 $u$ 周围的特征或拓扑进行最小的更改，以翻转 $\mathcal{M}$ 的预测。我们提出了一类规则，将负面预测视为其后果，并采用一维 Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) 测试作为谓词，它至少与 GNN 分类器一样具有表达能力。我们开发算法来（a）学习全局解释的此类规则，以及（b）应用它们来计算局部反事实。对现实世界图表的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在主要指标上优于最先进的方法。

papers.title: Scaling Subsequence Similarity Join Based on Dynamic Time Warping
papers.title_zh: 基于动态时间扭曲的缩放子序列相似度连接
papers.authors: Zemin Chao, Qiaoyi Zheng, Xingxing Xiao, Boyu Xiao, Zhixin Qi, Hongzhi Wang
papers.abstract: Subsequence similarity join is an important operation in time series analysis, widely employed for the identification of conserved or recurring patterns. Although Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is widely recognized as an effective similarity measure due to its robustness to temporal distortions, its high computational cost has severely limited its applicability to large-scale subsequence similarity joins. To address this challenge, we propose an efficient DTW-based subsequence similarity join algorithm that significantly improves both time and space efficiency. Our approach improves upon the space complexity of the state-of-the-art method, enabling its scalable application on large datasets. Furthermore, we refine the DTW lower bounds by enhancing their effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that our CPU implementation achieves an average $7.80 \times$ speedup over existing approaches. Moreover, we present a GPU-accelerated variant that leverages massive parallelism to deliver up to two orders of magnitude speedup over our optimized CPU version, making DTW-based subsequence similarity join feasible at scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 子序列相似性连接是时间序列分析中的重要操作，广泛用于识别保守或重复出现的模式。尽管动态时间规整（DTW）由于其对时间扭曲的鲁棒性而被广泛认为是一种有效的相似性度量，但其高计算成本严重限制了其在大规模子序列相似性连接中的适用性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种高效的基于 DTW 的子序列相似性连接算法，该算法显著提高了时间和空间效率。我们的方法改进了最先进方法的空间复杂性，使其能够在大型数据集上进行可扩展的应用。此外，我们通过提高 DTW 的有效性来完善 DTW 下界。实验结果表明，我们的 CPU 实现比现有方法平均加速了 7.80 倍。此外，我们提出了一种 GPU 加速变体，它利用大规模并行性，比我们优化的 CPU 版本提供高达两个数量级的加速，从而使基于 DTW 的子序列相似性连接大规模可行。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Overcoming the Sync-Compute Dilemma in Parallel Graph-Based Vector Retrieval
papers.title_zh: 克服基于并行图的向量检索中的同步计算困境
papers.authors: Qiji Mo, Zhiyuan Hua, Zebin Yao, Lixiao Cui, Gang Wang, Xiaoguang Liu, Zijing Wei, Xinyu Liu, Tianxiao Tang, Shaozhi Liu, Lin Qu
papers.abstract: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) is fundamental to modern applications such as Retrieval-augmented Generation. Among various ANNS algorithms, graph-based methods have become the state-of-the-art due to their excellent search efficiency. The core of graph-based methods is to perform a Best-First Search (BFiS) on the proximity graph. However, with the continuous growth in data scale and dimensionality, the single-threaded BFiS algorithm is becoming increasingly inadequate to meet performance demands. In this paper, we first deconstruct the existing parallel graph-based ANNS algorithms (e.g., iQAN, Edge-wise). We find that they are constrained by the Bulk Synchronous Parallel model, which leads to a dilemma between reducing the synchronization overhead and reducing the computational overhead. To overcome this dilemma, we propose a decoupled search paradigm named ScatterSearch. In this paradigm, each thread independently conducts a full BFiS from a distinct entry point and maintains a private candidate queue, thereby eliminating explicit synchronization. Building on ScatterSearch, we further propose a leader-guided search pruning strategy to reduce computational overhead. It prunes search progress of some threads to avoid long-tail computation and redirects the pruned threads through a workstealing mechanism. Comprehensive experiments on real-world datasets show that with 16 threads and at Recall@100=0.99, our method reduces latency by up to 41.46% and increases throughput by up to $\mathbf{7 0. 8 2} {\%}$ compared to iQAN. Our method has been utilized on the Alibaba's taobao platform.
papers.abstract_zh: 近似最近邻搜索 (ANNS) 是检索增强生成等现代应用的基础。在各种 ANNS 算法中，基于图的方法因其出色的搜索效率而成为最先进的方法。基于图的方法的核心是在邻近图上执行最佳优先搜索（BFiS）。然而，随着数据规模和维度的不断增长，单线程BFiS算法越来越不能满足性能需求。在本文中，我们首先解构现有的基于并行图的 ANNS 算法（例如 iQAN、Edge-wise）。我们发现它们受到批量同步并行模型的约束，这导致了减少同步开销和减少计算开销之间的困境。为了克服这个困境，我们提出了一种名为 ScatterSearch 的解耦搜索范式。在这种范例中，每个线程从不同的入口点独立地执行完整的 BFiS 并维护一个私有候选队列，从而消除了显式同步。在 ScatterSearch 的基础上，我们进一步提出了一种领导者引导的搜索修剪策略，以减少计算开销。它修剪某些线程的搜索进度以避免长尾计算，并通过工作窃取机制重定向修剪的线程。对真实数据集的综合实验表明，与 iQAN 相比，使用 16 个线程且在 Recall@100=0.99 时，我们的方法可将延迟减少高达 41.46%，并将吞吐量提高高达 $\mathbf{7 0. 8 2} {\%}$。我们的方法已经在阿里巴巴的淘宝平台上得到了应用。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: \textsf{PROCore}: Robust Core-set Selection via Pareto Multi-dimensional Optimization from Noisy Data
papers.title_zh: PROCore：通过噪声数据的 Pareto 多维优化进行鲁棒核心集选择
papers.authors: Xiaoou Ding, Hongbin Hu, Songnan Jiang, Muyun Zhou, Chen Wang, Jingru Yang, Hongzhi Wang
papers.abstract: In large-scale, data-driven machine learning tasks, efficiently selecting representative subsets from noisy datasets is a key challenge for training efficiency and model robustness. Existing coreset selection methods typically rely on singleobjective criteria and lack principles to handle noise, leading to biased or unstable selections. To address this, we propose PROCore, a theoretically grounded solution for robust coreset selection from noisy data. PROCore integrates three key components: (1) structure-aware partitioning to decompose data into statistically stable substructures, (2) structure-alignment correction that leverages Mahalanobis and Wasserstein distances to adaptively reduce noise while preserving boundary samples, and (3) Pareto multi-objective optimization that jointly maximizes geometric coverage and gradient representativeness, with maximum-entropy tie-breaking to enhance diversity. We provide rigorous theoretical guarantees: a contraction-based convergence proof for noise correction, a bounded regret bound for entropybased selection, and a constant-factor approximation guarantee for the overall coreset quality. Experiments on five real-world datasets show that PROCore outperforms six state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 2 percentage points higher F1 score under mixed noise. It maintains consistent robustness across noise levels, and accelerating coreset construction by 5×, demonstrating superior accuracy, robustness, and scalability.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大规模数据驱动的机器学习任务中，从噪声数据集中有效选择代表性子集是训练效率和模型鲁棒性的关键挑战。现有的核心集选择方法通常依赖于单一目标标准，缺乏处理噪声的原则，导致选择有偏差或不稳定。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 PROCore，这是一种基于理论的解决方案，用于从噪声数据中选择稳健的核心集。 PROCore 集成了三个关键组件：(1) 结构感知分区，将数据分解为统计上稳定的子结构；(2) 结构对齐校正，利用 Mahalanobis 和 Wasserstein 距离自适应地降低噪声，同时保留边界样本；(3) Pareto 多目标优化，共同最大化几何覆盖范围和梯度代表性，并通过最大熵打破平局来增强多样性。我们提供严格的理论保证：用于噪声校正的基于收缩的收敛证明、用于基于熵的选择的有界遗憾界限以及对整体核心集质量的常数因子近似保证。对五个真实数据集的实验表明，PROCore 的性能优于六种最先进的方法，在混合噪声下 F1 分数提高了 2 个百分点。它在不同噪声水平下保持一致的鲁棒性，并将核心集构建速度提高了 5 倍，展示了卓越的准确性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。

papers.title: NebulaStream: An Adaptive and Efficient Multi-query Stream Processing Engine
papers.title_zh: NebulaStream：自适应且高效的多查询流处理引擎
papers.authors: Nils Schubert, Lukas Schwerdtfeger, Sara Schnaterbeck, Philipp Grulich, Bonaventura Del Monte, Steffen Zeuch, Volker Markl
papers.abstract: Existing Stream Processing Engines (SPEs), designed for scale-out in the cloud, often overlook the need for scaleup performance on heterogeneous hardware. As a result, they provide latency and throughput guarantees at the expense of high overhead on system resources, for example, memory and CPU usage. This over-provisioning is tolerable in cloud environments where resources are generously available. However, it is detrimental for low-end devices that are becoming increasingly common in today's cloud-edge environments. In this paper, we present the architecture of our adaptive and efficient multi-query stream processing engine, which is the core of the open-source system NebulaStream. Our engine is optimized for resource-constrained devices and their special requirements. In particular, our engine achieves better hardware utilization due to several key engine design decisions: 1) a task-based execution model for multi-query, scale-up execution based on an order-aware data flow model, 2) work-stealing-aware operators using hardware-tailored code generation, 3) runtime compute caching, and 4) work-stealing-aware state management. As a result, our novel engine outperforms general-purpose systems by at least one order of magnitude, executes hundreds of queries in parallel without performance degradation, and seamlessly reacts to fluctuating ingestion rates.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的流处理引擎 (SPE) 专为在云中横向扩展而设计，通常忽视了异构硬件上纵向扩展性能的需求。因此，它们提供延迟和吞吐量保证，但代价是系统资源（例如内存和 CPU 使用率）的高开销。在资源充足的云环境中，这种过度配置是可以容忍的。然而，这对于当今云边缘环境中日益普遍的低端设备来说是有害的。在本文中，我们提出了自适应高效的多查询流处理引擎的架构，它是开源系统NebulaStream的核心。我们的引擎针对资源受限的设备及其特殊要求进行了优化。特别是，由于几个关键的引擎设计决策，我们的引擎实现了更好的硬件利用率：1）基于任务的多查询执行模型，基于订单感知数据流模型的扩展执行，2）使用硬件定制的代码生成的工作窃取感知运算符，3）运行时计算缓存，以及4）工作窃取感知状态管理。因此，我们的新型引擎的性能优于通用系统至少一个数量级，并行执行数百个查询而不会降低性能，并且对波动的摄取率做出无缝反应。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: An LLM-Guided Query-Aware Inference System for GNN Models on Large Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: 用于大型知识图上的 GNN 模型的 LLM 引导查询感知推理系统
papers.authors: Waleed Afandi, Hussein Abdallah, Ashraf Aboulnaga, Essam Mansour
papers.abstract: Efficient inference for graph neural networks (GNNs) on large knowledge graphs (KGs) is essential for many real-world applications. GNN inference queries are computationally expensive and vary in complexity, as each involves a different number of target nodes linked to subgraphs of diverse densities and structures. Existing acceleration methods, such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, instantiate smaller models but do not adapt them to the structure or semantics of individual queries. They also store models as monolithic files that must be fully loaded, and miss the opportunity to retrieve only the neighboring nodes and corresponding model components that are semantically relevant to the target nodes. These limitations lead to excessive data loading and redundant computation on large KGs. This paper presents KG-WISE, a task-driven inference paradigm for large KGs. KG-WISE decomposes trained GNN models into fine-grained components that can be partially loaded based on the structure of the queried subgraph. It employs large language models (LLMs) to generate reusable query templates that extract semantically relevant subgraphs for each task, enabling query-aware and compact model instantiation. We evaluate KG-WISE on six large KGs with up to 42 million nodes and 166 million edges. KG-WISE achieves up to 28x faster inference and 98% lower memory usage than state-of-the-art systems while maintaining or improving accuracy across both commercial and open-weight LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在大型知识图 (KG) 上进行图神经网络 (GNN) 的高效推理对于许多实际应用至关重要。 GNN 推理查询的计算成本很高，并且复杂性各异，因为每个查询都涉及链接到不同密度和结构的子图的不同数量的目标节点。现有的加速方法，例如剪枝、量化和知识蒸馏，可以实例化较小的模型，但不能使它们适应单个查询的结构或语义。它们还将模型存储为必须完全加载的整体文件，并且错过了仅检索与目标节点语义相关的相邻节点和相应模型组件的机会。这些限制导致大型 KG 上的数据加载过多和冗余计算。本文提出了 KG-WISE，一种针对大型 KG 的任务驱动推理范例。 KG-WISE 将训练好的 GNN 模型分解为细粒度的组件，这些组件可以根据查询子图的结构进行部分加载。它采用大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成可重用的查询模板，为每个任务提取语义相关的子图，从而实现查询感知和紧凑的模型实例化。我们在具有多达 4200 万个节点和 1.66 亿条边的 6 个大型 KG 上评估 KG-WISE。与最先进的系统相比，KG-WISE 的推理速度提高了 28 倍，内存使用量降低了 98%，同时保持或提高了商业和开放权重大语言模型的准确性。

papers.title: Tetris: Lightweight Hyperparameter Auto-Tuning for Mitigating Performance Spikes in LSM-KVS
papers.title_zh: Tetris：轻量级超参数自动调优，用于缓解 LSM-KVS 中的性能峰值
papers.authors: YINA LV, Wenhao Zhu, Qiao Li, Quanqing Xu, Congming Gao, Chuanhui Yang, Xiaoli Wang, Chun Jason Xue
papers.abstract: LSM-trees have been widely adopted in modern database systems owing to their log-structured design and sequential write efficiency. This design makes them particularly suitable for write-intensive, large-scale scenarios. However, a critical challenge lies in the flush and compaction processes in the LSM-tree, which often lead to performance fluctuation. Existing tuning strategies, including manual configurations and machine learning or LLM-based methods, struggle to adapt to dynamic workload patterns (e.g., sequential vs. random writes, Zipfian vs. uniform distributions). These methods also incur high tuning overhead and fail to mitigate severe I/O contention and performance spikes. In this paper, we propose Tetris, a lightweight hyperparameter auto-tuning framework designed to mitigate performance spikes in LSM-based key-value stores. Tetris dynamically adjusts LSM-tree configurable parameters by monitoring performance spikes, workload patterns, and realtime resource utilization during runtime. It contains three key components: a performance-driven tuning trigger, which determines when to initiate parameter adjustments; a workload-aware parameter selector, which identifies what parameters to tune based on workload characteristics; and a resource-efficient autotuner, which optimizes resource utilization while adapting to the current LSM-tree status. We evaluate Tetris on RocksDB using db_bench benchmarks and real-world YCSB workloads. Experimental results show that Tetris mitigates performance spikes across various workloads with minimal overhead. Compared to ADOC, it reduces average latency by 18% (up to 62%) and improves throughput by 38% (up to 1.64×). For tail latency, Tetris cuts P99 and P99.9 read latency by 54% and 53%, respectively, while maintaining comparable write tail latency with a 66% lower standard deviation in write latency.
papers.abstract_zh: LSM树由于其日志结构设计和顺序写入效率而在现代数据库系统中被广泛采用。这种设计使得它们特别适合写入密集型、大规模的场景。然而，一个关键的挑战在于LSM树中的刷新和压缩过程，这通常会导致性能波动。现有的调优策略，包括手动配置和机器学习或基于 LLM 的方法，很难适应动态工作负载模式（例如，顺序写入与随机写入、Zipfian 与均匀分布）。这些方法还会产生较高的调优开销，并且无法缓解严重的 I/O 争用和性能峰值。在本文中，我们提出了 Tetris，这是一种轻量级超参数自动调整框架，旨在缓解基于 LSM 的键值存储中的性能峰值。 Tetris 通过监控运行时的性能峰值、工作负载模式和实时资源利用率来动态调整 LSM 树可配置参数。它包含三个关键组件：性能驱动的调整触发器，确定何时启动参数调整；工作负载感知参数选择器，它根据工作负载特征确定要调整的参数；以及一个资源高效的自动调节器，它可以优化资源利用率，同时适应当前的 LSM 树状态。我们使用 db_bench 基准测试和真实的 YCSB 工作负载在 RocksDB 上评估俄罗斯方块。实验结果表明，俄罗斯方块可以以最小的开销缓解各种工作负载的性能峰值。与 ADOC 相比，平均延迟降低了 18%（高达 62%），吞吐量提高了 38%（高达 1.64 倍）。对于尾部延迟，俄罗斯方块将 P99 和 P99.9 读取延迟分别缩短了 54% 和 53%，同时保持了相当的写入尾部延迟，写入延迟的标准差降低了 66%。

papers.title: Effective Dataset Distillation for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting with Bi-dimensional Compression
papers.title_zh: 二维压缩时空预测的有效数据集蒸馏
papers.authors: Taehyung Kwon, Yeonje Choi, Yeongho Kim, Kijung Shin
papers.abstract: Spatio-temporal time series are widely used in real-world applications, including traffic prediction and weather forecasting. They are sequences of observations over extensive periods and multiple locations, naturally represented as multidimensional data. Forecasting is a central task in spatio-temporal analysis, and numerous deep learning methods have been developed to address it. However, as dataset sizes and model complexities continue to grow in practice, training deep learning models has become increasingly time- and resource-intensive. A promising solution to this challenge is dataset distillation, which synthesizes compact datasets that can effectively replace the original data for model training. Although successful in various domains, including time series analysis, existing dataset distillation methods compress only one dimension, making them less suitable for spatio-temporal datasets, where both spatial and temporal dimensions jointly contribute to the large data volume. To address this limitation, we propose STemDist, the first dataset distillation method specialized for spatio-temporal time series forecasting. A key idea of our solution is to compress both temporal and spatial dimensions in a balanced manner, reducing training time and memory. We further reduce the distillation cost by performing distillation at the cluster level rather than the individual location level, and we complement this coarse-grained approach with a subset-based granular distillation technique that enhances forecasting performance. On five real-world datasets, we show empirically that, compared to both general and time-series dataset distillation methods, datasets distilled by our STemDist method enable model training (1) faster (up to 6X) (2) more memory-efficient (up to 8X), and (3) more effective (with up to 12% lower prediction error).
papers.abstract_zh: 时空时间序列广泛应用于现实世界的应用，包括交通预测和天气预报。它们是长时间和多个地点的观察序列，自然地表示为多维数据。预测是时空分析的核心任务，并且已经开发了许多深度学习方法来解决它。然而，随着实践中数据集大小和模型复杂性的不断增加，训练深度学习模型变得越来越耗时和资源密集。解决这一挑战的一个有前途的解决方案是数据集蒸馏，它合成紧凑的数据集，可以有效地替换模型训练的原始数据。尽管在包括时间序列分析在内的多个领域取得了成功，但现有的数据集蒸馏方法仅压缩一维，这使得它们不太适合时空数据集，其中空间和时间维度共同构成了大数据量。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 STemDist，这是第一个专门用于时空时间序列预测的数据集蒸馏方法。我们解决方案的一个关键思想是以平衡的方式压缩时间和空间维度，减少训练时间和内存。我们通过在集群级别而不是单个位置级别执行蒸馏来进一步降低蒸馏成本，并且我们使用基于子集的粒度蒸馏技术来补充这种粗粒度方法，从而增强预测性能。在五个真实数据集上，我们凭经验表明，与一般数据集蒸馏方法和时间序列数据集蒸馏方法相比，通过我们的 STemDist 方法蒸馏的数据集可以使模型训练 (1) 更快（高达 6 倍）（2）内存效率更高（高达 8 倍），(3) 更有效（预测误差降低高达 12%）。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: COLE + Towards Practical Column-based Learned Storage for Blockchain Systems
papers.title_zh: COLE + 迈向区块链系统实用的基于列的学习存储
papers.authors: Ce Zhang, Cheng Xu, Haibo Hu, Jianliang Xu
papers.abstract: Blockchain provides a decentralized and tamper-resistant ledger for securely recording transactions across a network of untrusted nodes. While its transparency and integrity are beneficial, the substantial storage requirements for maintaining a complete transaction history present significant challenges. For example, Ethereum nodes require around 23TB of storage, with an annual growth rate of 4TB. Prior studies have employed various strategies to mitigate the storage challenges. Notably, COLE significantly reduces storage size and improves throughput by adopting a column-based design that incorporates a learned index, effectively eliminating data duplication in the storage layer. However, this approach has limitations in supporting chain reorganization during blockchain forks and state pruning to minimize storage overhead. In this paper, we propose COLE$^+$, an enhanced storage solution designed to address these limitations. COLE$^+$ incorporates a novel rewind-supported in-memory tree structure for handling chain reorganization, leveraging content-defined chunking (CDC) to maintain a consistent hash digest for each block. For on-disk storage, a new two-level Merkle Hash Tree (MHT) structure, called prunable version tree, is developed to facilitate efficient state pruning. Both theoretical and empirical analyses show the effectiveness of COLE$^+$ and its potential for practical application in real-world blockchain systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 区块链提供了一个去中心化且防篡改的分类账，用于安全地记录不可信节点网络上的交易。虽然其透明度和完整性是有益的，但维护完整交易历史记录的大量存储需求提出了重大挑战。例如，以太坊节点需要约 23TB 的存储空间，年增长率为 4TB。先前的研究已经采用了各种策略来缓解存储挑战。值得注意的是，COLE通过采用基于列的设计并结合学习索引，显著减小了存储大小并提高了吞吐量，有效消除了存储层的数据重复。然而，这种方法在支持区块链分叉期间的链重组和状态修剪以最小化存储开销方面存在局限性。在本文中，我们提出了 COLE$^+$，这是一种旨在解决这些限制的增强存储解决方案。 COLE$^+$ 结合了一种新颖的支持倒带的内存树结构，用于处理链重组，利用内容定义分块 (CDC) 来维护每个块的一致哈希摘要。对于磁盘存储，开发了一种新的两级默克尔哈希树（MHT）结构，称为可剪枝版本树，以促进高效的状态剪枝。理论和实证分析都表明了 COLE$^+$ 的有效性及其在现实世界区块链系统中实际应用的潜力。

papers.title: Efficient Meta-path Constrained Reachability Query on Heterogeneous Information Networks
papers.title_zh: 异构信息网络高效元路径约束可达性查询
papers.authors: Chao Ni, Zi Chen, Long Yuan, Bolong Zheng, Lu Qin
papers.abstract: Heterogeneous information networks (HINs) are prevalent in real-world applications, capturing complex semantic relationships through multiple types of entities and links. Metapath constrained reachability (MCR) queries, which ask whether two vertices are connected via a simple path under given metapath pattern, are fundamental to HIN analysis. However, existing methods are inadequate, they either fail to represent complex meta-path constrains or cannot efficiently answer MCR queries on large-scale HINs. To address these limitations, we present a novel hybrid indexing framework, MCR-Index, that integrates partial tree decomposition with anchor-based indexing and a compact meta-path Aho-Corasick automaton for meta-path representation. Based on MCR-Index, we develop an efficient query processing algorithm and a scalable index construction method. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world HINs demonstrate that our MCR-Index significantly outperforms existing solutions in query efficiency, index size, and construction time, enabling practical and scalable meta-path reachability query processing for large-scale HINs.
papers.abstract_zh: 异构信息网络（HIN）在现实应用中普遍存在，通过多种类型的实体和链接捕获复杂的语义关系。元路径约束可达性 (MCR) 查询是 HIN 分析的基础，它询问两个顶点是否在给定元路径模式下通过简单路径连接。然而，现有的方法是不够的，它们要么无法表示复杂的元路径约束，要么无法有效地回答大规模 HIN 上的 MCR 查询。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种新颖的混合索引框架 MCR-Index，它将部分树分解与基于锚的索引和用于元路径表示的紧凑元路径 Aho-Corasick 自动机集成在一起。基于MCR-Index，我们开发了高效的查询处理算法和可扩展的索引构建方法。对各种现实世界 HIN 的大量实验表明，我们的 MCR 索引在查询效率、索引大小和构建时间方面显著优于现有解决方案，从而为大规模 HIN 提供实用且可扩展的元路径可达性查询处理。

papers.title: Hexgen-Flow: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Scheduling for Agentic Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: Hexgen-Flow：优化代理文本到 SQL 的 LLM 推理请求调度
papers.authors: You Peng, Youhe Jiang, Wenqi Jiang, Chen Wang, Binhang Yuan
papers.abstract: Recent advances in agentic large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved Text-to-SQL, enabling users without database expertise to query databases intuitively. However, deploying agentic LLM-based Text-to-SQL systems in production remains challenging due to multi-stage dependencies, strict latency requirements, and deployment complexity across heterogeneous GPUs in enterprise clusters. Existing LLM serving frameworks are designed mainly for independent inference tasks, leading to suboptimal performance and frequent service-level objective (SLO) violations for Text-to-SQL workloads. In this paper, we introduce Hexgen-Flow, a framework for scheduling and executing agentic multi-stage LLM-based Text-to-SQL workflows on heterogeneous GPU clusters serving multi-tenant requests. Hexgen-Flow adopts a hierarchical scheduler that combines global workload-balanced task dispatching with an adaptive local priority queue, guided by a systematic analysis of agentic Text-to-SQL workflows. We also propose a lightweight simulation-based method to tune key scheduling hyperparameters, improving robustness and adaptability. Evaluations on realistic Text-to-SQL benchmarks show that Hexgen-Flow significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LLM serving frameworks. Across all traces, Hexgen-Flow reduces P95 tail latency by $1.42{\sim}1.56\times$ and increases throughput by $1.49{\sim}1.81\times$, demonstrating consistent gains under diverse workloads.
papers.abstract_zh: 代理大语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展极大地改进了文本到 SQL，使没有数据库专业知识的用户能够直观地查询数据库。然而，由于多阶段依赖性、严格的延迟要求以及企业集群中异构 GPU 的部署复杂性，在生产中部署基于代理的基于 LLM 的文本到 SQL 系统仍然具有挑战性。现有的 LLM 服务框架主要针对独立推理任务而设计，导致文本到 SQL 工作负载的性能不佳和频繁违反服务级别目标 (SLO)。在本文中，我们介绍了 Hexgen-Flow，这是一个框架，用于在服务于多租户请求的异构 GPU 集群上调度和执行基于 LLM 的代理多阶段文本到 SQL 工作流程。 Hexgen-Flow 采用分层调度程序，将全局工作负载平衡任务调度与自适应本地优先级队列相结合，并以代理文本到 SQL 工作流程的系统分析为指导。我们还提出了一种基于轻量级模拟的方法来调整关键调度超参数，提高鲁棒性和适应性。对实际文本到 SQL 基准的评估表明，Hexgen-Flow 显著优于最先进的 LLM 服务框架。在所有跟踪中，Hexgen-Flow 将 P95 尾部延迟降低了 $1.42{\sim}1.56\times$，并将吞吐量提高了 $1.49{\sim}1.81\times$，证明了在不同工作负载下的一致增益。

papers.title: Krone: Hierarchical and Modular Log Anomaly Detection
papers.title_zh: Krone：分层和模块化日志异常检测
papers.authors: Lei Ma, Jinyang Liu, Tieying Zhang, Peter VanNostrand, Dennis Hofmann, Lei Cao, Elke Rundensteiner, Jianjun Chen
papers.abstract: Log anomaly detection is crucial for uncovering system failures and security risks. Although logs originate from nested component executions with clear boundaries, this structure is lost when stored as flat sequences. As a result, state-of-the-art methods often miss true dependencies within executions while learning spurious correlations across unrelated events. We propose KRONE, the first hierarchical anomaly detection framework that automatically derives execution hierarchies from flat logs to enable modular, multi-level anomaly detection. At its core, the KRONE Log Abstraction Model extracts application-specific semantic hierarchies, which are used to recursively decompose log sequences into coherent execution units, referred to as KRONE Seqs. This transforms sequence-level detection into a set of modular KRONE Seq-level detection tasks. For each test KRONE Seq, KRONE adopts a hybrid modular detection strategy that routes between an efficient level-independent Local-Context detector for rapid filtering and a Nested-Aware detector that captures cross-level semantic dependencies, augmented with LLM-based anomaly detection and explanation. KRONE further optimizes detection through cached result reuse and early-exit strategies along the hierarchy. Experiments on three public benchmarks and one industrial dataset from ByteDance Cloud demonstrate that KRONE achieves substantial improvements in accuracy (42.49% to 87.98%), F1 score, data efficiency (117.3x reduction), resource efficiency (43.7x reduction), and interpretability. KRONE improves F1-score by 10.07% (82.76% to 92.83%) over prior methods while reducing LLM usage to only 1.1% to 3.3% of the test data. Code: https://github.com/LeiMa0324/KRONE Demo: https://leima0324.github.io/KRONE_Demo_official/
papers.abstract_zh: 日志异常检测对于发现系统故障和安全风险至关重要。尽管日志源自具有清晰边界的嵌套组件执行，但当存储为平面序列时，这种结构就会丢失。因此，最先进的方法常常会错过执行中的真实依赖关系，同时学习不相关事件之间的虚假相关性。我们提出了 KRONE，这是第一个分层异常检测框架，它自动从平面日志中派生执行层次结构，以实现模块化、多级异常检测。 KRONE 日志抽象模型的核心是提取特定于应用程序的语义层次结构，用于将日志序列递归地分解为连贯的执行单元，称为 KRONE Seq。这将序列级检测转换为一组模块化 KRONE Seq 级检测任务。对于每个测试 KRONE Seq，KRONE 采用混合模块化检测策略，在用于快速过滤的高效的独立于级别的本地上下文检测器和捕获跨级别语义依赖性的嵌套感知检测器之间进行路由，并通过基于 LLM 的异常检测和解释进行增强。 KRONE 通过缓存结果重用和沿层次结构的提前退出策略进一步优化检测。在三个公共基准和字节跳动云的一个工业数据集上进行的实验表明，KRONE 在准确率（42.49% 至 87.98%）、F1 分数、数据效率（降低 117.3 倍）、资源效率（降低 43.7 倍）和可解释性方面实现了大幅提升。与之前的方法相比，KRONE 将 F1 分数提高了 10.07%（82.76% 至 92.83%），同时将 LLM 使用率减少到测试数据的 1.1% 至 3.3%。代码：https://github.com/LeiMa0324/KRONE 演示：https://leima0324.github.io/KRONE_Demo_official/

papers.title: MINT: Multi-Vector Search Index Tuning
papers.title_zh: MINT：多向量搜索索引调整
papers.authors: Jiongli Zhu, Yue Wang, Bailu Ding, Philip Bernstein, Vivek Narasayya, Surajit Chaudhuri
papers.abstract: Vector search plays a crucial role in many real-world applications. In addition to single-vector search, multi-vector search becomes important for multi-modal and multi-feature scenarios today. In a multi-vector database, each row is an item, each column represents a feature of items, and each cell is a high-dimensional vector. In multi-vector databases, the choice of indexes can have a significant impact on performance. Although index tuning for relational databases has been extensively studied, index tuning for multi-vector search remains unclear and challenging. In this paper, we define multi-vector search index tuning and propose a framework to solve it. Specifically, given a multi-vector search workload, we develop algorithms to find indexes that minimize latency and meet storage and recall constraints. Compared to the baseline, our latency achieves 2.1X to 8.3X speedup.
papers.abstract_zh: 矢量搜索在许多实际应用中起着至关重要的作用。除了单向量搜索之外，多向量搜索对于当今的多模态和多特征场景也变得很重要。在多向量数据库中，每一行是一个项目，每一列代表项目的一个特征，每个单元格是一个高维向量。在多向量数据库中，索引的选择会对性能产生重大影响。尽管关系数据库的索引调优已被广泛研究，但多向量搜索的索引调优仍然不清楚且具有挑战性。在本文中，我们定义了多向量搜索索引调整并提出了一个解决它的框架。具体来说，考虑到多向量搜索工作负载，我们开发了算法来查找可最小化延迟并满足存储和调用约束的索引。与基线相比，我们的延迟实现了 2.1 倍到 8.3 倍的加速。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: LLM4Hint: Leveraging Large Language Models for Hint Recommendation in Offline Query Optimization
papers.title_zh: LLM4Hint：利用大型语言模型在离线查询优化中进行提示推荐
papers.authors: Suchen Liu, Yang Lin, Yinjun Han, Jun Gao
papers.abstract: Query optimization is essential for efficient SQL query execution in DBMS, and remains attractive over time due to the growth of data volumes and advances in hardware. Existing traditional optimizers struggle with the cumbersome hand-tuning required for complex workloads, and the learning-based methods face limitations in ensuring generalization. With the great success of Large Language Model (LLM) across diverse downstream tasks, this paper explores how LLMs can be incorporated to enhance the generalization of learned optimizers. Though promising, such an incorporation still presents challenges, mainly including high model inference latency, and the substantial fine-tuning cost and suboptimal performance due to inherent discrepancy between the token sequences in LLM and structured SQL execution plans with rich numerical features. In this paper, we focus on recurring queries in offline optimization to alleviate the issue of high inference latency, and propose LLM4Hint that leverages moderate-sized backbone LLMs to recommend query optimization hints. LLM4Hint achieves the goals through: (i) integrating a lightweight model to produce a soft prompt, which captures the data distribution in DBMS and the SQL predicates to provide sufficient optimization features while simultaneously reducing the context length fed to the LLM, (ii) devising a query rewriting strategy using a larger commercial LLM, so as to simplify SQL semantics for the backbone LLM and reduce fine-tuning costs, and (iii) introducing an explicit matching prompt to facilitate alignment between the LLM and the lightweight model, which can accelerate convergence of the combined model. Experiments show that LLM4Hint, by leveraging the LLM's stronger capability to understand the query statement, can outperform the state-of-the-art learned optimizers in terms of both effectiveness and generalization.
papers.abstract_zh: 查询优化对于 DBMS 中高效的 SQL 查询执行至关重要，并且由于数据量的增长和硬件的进步，随着时间的推移，查询优化仍然具有吸引力。现有的传统优化器难以应对复杂工作负载所需的繁琐的手动调整，并且基于学习的方法在确保泛化方面面临局限性。随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 在各种下游任务中取得的巨大成功，本文探讨了如何结合 LLM 来增强学习优化器的泛化能力。尽管前景广阔，但这种结合仍然面临挑战，主要包括高模型推理延迟，以及由于 LLM 中的标记序列与具有丰富数值特征的结构化 SQL 执行计划之间固有的差异而导致的大量微调成本和次优性能。在本文中，我们专注于离线优化中的重复查询，以缓解高推理延迟的问题，并提出 LLM4Hint ，利用中等规模的骨干 LLM 来推荐查询优化提示。 LLM4Hint通过以下方式实现目标：（i）集成轻量级模型以生成软提示，捕获DBMS中的数据分布和SQL谓词以提供足够的优化功能，同时减少馈送到LLM的上下文长度，（ii）使用更大的商业LLM设计查询重写策略，从而简化骨干LLM的SQL语义并降低微调成本，以及（iii）引入显式匹配提示以促进LLM和轻量级模型之间的对齐，这可以加速组合模型的收敛。实验表明，LLM4Hint利用LLM更强的查询语句理解能力，在有效性和泛化性方面都优于最先进的学习优化器。

papers.title: CFDGraph: Privacy-Preserving Graph Processing for Large-Scale Collaborative Fraud Detection
papers.title_zh: CFDGraph：用于大规模协作欺诈检测的隐私保护图形处理
papers.authors: Qiulin Wu, Amelie Chi Zhou, Tristan Allard, Shadi Ibrahim, Yuhong Feng, Lichun Li, Amr Abbadi
papers.abstract: Fraud detection is a critical task in finance and e-commerce, but fraudsters increasingly evade detection by distributing their activities across multiple institutions. While this makes collaborative fraud detection (CFD) essential, it is hindered by two fundamental barriers: stringent data privacy regulations and constrained communication networks. Existing systems are impractical, as they either incur prohibitive overheads or cannot attain the high detection accuracy required to manage financial risk. This paper introduces CFDGraph, the first privacy-preserving graph processing system designed to overcome these challenges by synergistically balancing accuracy, privacy, and communication efficiency. CFDGraph's novelty lies in three interconnected innovations. First, it employs differential privacy with adaptive quantization to simultaneously reduce both privacy-induced noise and communication overhead. Second, it introduces accuracy-aware noise mitigation techniques to preserve the high recall essential for fraud detection. Third, it implements privacy-aware message compression to dramatically reduce data transmission volume. Evaluations show CFDGraph achieves 100% recall in identifying top-k fraudulent accounts while reducing manual investigation costs by up to 99.5% compared to state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 欺诈检测是金融和电子商务领域的一项关键任务，但欺诈者越来越多地通过将活动分布在多个机构来逃避检测。虽然这使得协作欺诈检测 (CFD) 变得至关重要，但它受到两个基本障碍的阻碍：严格的数据隐私法规和受限的通信网络。现有系统不切实际，因为它们要么会产生高昂的管理费​​用，要么无法达到管理财务风险所需的高检测精度。本文介绍了 CFDGraph，这是第一个保护隐私的图形处理系统，旨在通过协同平衡准确性、隐私和通信效率来克服这些挑战。 CFDGraph 的新颖之处在于三个相互关联的创新。首先，它采用具有自适应量化的差分隐私来同时减少隐私引起的噪声和通信开销。其次，它引入了准确性感知的噪声缓解技术，以保持欺诈检测所必需的高召回率。第三，它实现了隐私感知消息压缩，以大幅减少数据传输量。评估显示，CFDGraph 在识别前 k 个欺诈账户方面实现了 100% 的召回率，同时与最先进的方法相比，手动调查成本降低了高达 99.5%。

papers.title: SNI-GNN: SmartNIC-Assisted Full-Graph GNN Training with In-Network Embedding Prediction
papers.title_zh: SNI-GNN：SmartNIC 辅助全图 GNN 训练与网内嵌入预测
papers.authors: Guofan Yu, Sitian Chen, Zhenheng Tang, Xiaowen Chu, Amelie Chi Zhou
papers.abstract: Full-graph GNN training delivers high accuracy but scales poorly on multi-server clusters due to heavy, irregular inter-node embedding exchanges. We present SNI-GNN, a SmartNIC-assisted full-graph training system that reduces communication while preserving accuracy by predicting remote embeddings in-network. SNI-GNN deploys a lightweight linear-trend predictor on SmartNICs to refine cached historical embeddings, coupled with an importance-based boundary-node sampling policy and an asynchronous DPU--GPU data pipeline with intermediate-result reuse. We provide error and convergence bounds showing that predictor bias remains controlled under bounded second-order dynamics and yields standard non-convex convergence with inexact gradients. Implemented on NVIDIA BlueField-3, SNI-GNN integrates with state-of-the-art full-graph systems, cuts communication by 21--45\%, achieves 1.3--3.6$\times$ end-to-end speedups over BNS-GCN and up to 1.29$\times$ over baseline SANCUS, with accuracy loss $\leq 0.01$, and scales efficiently to 16 GPUs on graphs with up to tens of millions of edges. These results indicate SmartNIC-based in-network prediction is a practical complement to partitioning and compression techniques for communication-efficient full-graph GNN training at scale.
papers.abstract_zh: 全图 GNN 训练具有很高的准确性，但由于节点间嵌入交换繁重、不规则，因此在多服务器集群上的扩展性很差。我们提出了 SNI-GNN，这是一种 SmartNIC 辅助的全图训练系统，它通过预测网络中的远程嵌入来减少通信，同时保持准确性。 SNI-GNN 在 SmartNIC 上部署轻量级线性趋势预测器，以细化缓存的历史嵌入，并结合基于重要性的边界节点采样策略和具有中间结果重用的异步 DPU-GPU 数据管道。我们提供误差和收敛界限，表明预测器偏差在有界二阶动力学下保持受控，并产生具有不精确梯度的标准非凸收敛。 SNI-GNN 在 NVIDIA BlueField-3 上实现，与最先进的全图系统集成，将通信减少 21--45%，与 BNS-GCN 相比实现 1.3--3.6$\times$ 端到端加速，比基线 SANCUS 提高高达 1.29$\times$，精度损失 $\leq 0.01$，并可有效扩展到 16 个 GPU具有多达数千万条边的图。这些结果表明，基于 SmartNIC 的网内预测是对大规模通信高效全图 GNN 训练的分区和压缩技术的实用补充。

papers.title: A Robust and Globally Accurate Hierarchical Hub Labeling Index for SP-Distance Queries in Dynamic Road Networks
papers.title_zh: 用于动态道路网络中 SP 距离查询的稳健且全局准确的分层枢纽标签索引
papers.authors: Wei Liu, Ziqiang Yu, Xiaohui Yu, Yang Liu, Simu Liu
papers.abstract: Computing shortest-path distances between two points in road networks, typically modeled as dynamic weighted graphs due to fluctuating travel times, is fundamental to many location-based services demanding both accuracy and low latency. Existing hierarchical distance indexes for such graphs often face a trade-off: some rely on unstable hierarchies that increase update costs, while others use locally accurate labels that compromise query efficiency. To address this issue, we propose RAHL (Robust and globally-Accurate hierarchical Hub Labeling) index, built via recursive graph partitioning using hub (cut) vertex sets. RAHL ensures stable, invariant hub sets that maintain the global cut property and stores globally accurate distance labels for all vertices. This allows shortest-path queries to be answered simply via lowest-common-ancestor hub lookups. Since hub sets remain stable as edge weights change, updates involve only incremental adjustments to a small set of affected labels, significantly reducing maintenance overhead. Empirical evaluation on real road networks shows that RAHL delivers SOTA query performance while matching or improving index-maintenance efficiency compared with leading baselines, providing a practical balance of low-latency queries and low update cost for large, dynamic networks.
papers.abstract_zh: 计算道路网络中两点之间的最短路径距离（通常由于行程时间波动而建模为动态加权图）是许多要求准确性和低延迟的基于位置的服务的基础。此类图的现有分层距离索引通常面临权衡：有些依赖不稳定的层次结构，从而增加更新成本，而另一些则使用本地准确的标签，从而损害查询效率。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 RAHL（鲁棒且全局准确的分层集线器标签）索引，该索引是通过使用集线器（切割）顶点集的递归图分区构建的。 RAHL 确保稳定、不变的中心集，以维护全局切割属性并存储所有顶点的全局准确距离标签。这允许简单地通过最低共同祖先集线器查找来回答最短路径查询。由于集线器集随着边权重的变化而保持稳定，因此更新仅涉及对一小部分受影响标签的增量调整，从而显著减少了维护开销。对真实道路网络的实证评估表明，与领先的基线相比，RAHL 提供了 SOTA 查询性能，同时匹配或提高了索引维护效率，为大型动态网络提供了低延迟查询和低更新成本的实际平衡。

papers.title: TRADER: Real-Time Arbitrage Detection via Negative Cycles on Dynamic Graphs
papers.title_zh: TRADER：通过动态图上的负循环进行实时套利检测
papers.authors: Bingqiao Luo, Yuhang Chen, Jiaxin Jiang, Yuheng Cong, Ziyu He, Shixuan Sun, Bingsheng  He, Wee Howe Ang
papers.abstract: Real-time arbitrage detection in decentralized finance (DeFi) is challenging, as opportunities, which are often represented by negative cycles in token graphs, appear and disappear within milliseconds. High update rates and algorithmic complexity make real-time detection difficult, while existing approaches either operate only on static snapshots, which quickly become outdated, or recompute all affected cycles after each update, which is prohibitively expensive. Both approaches fail to meet the latency and throughput requirements of modern trading systems. To address the challenge, we present TRADER, an incremental solution for high-performance real-Time aRbitrAge DEtection via negative cycles on dynamic gRaphs. TRADER uses a dynamic programming-based algorithm with incremental state updates and localized propagation to detect and maintain arbitrage opportunities within milliseconds on fast-changing crypto token graphs. It supports edge updates in batch and employs an edge grouping strategy to filter out non-impactful updates, reducing latency and boosting throughput. On realworld DeFi datasets, TRADER achieves up to $5.8 \times$ speedup over baselines while maintaining high detection accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 去中心化金融（DeFi）中的实时套利检测具有挑战性，因为机会（通常以代币图中的负周期表示）会在几毫秒内出现和消失。高更新率和算法复杂性使得实时检测变得困难，而现有方法要么仅对静态快照进行操作，这很快就会过时，要么在每次更新后重新计算所有受影响的周期，这非常昂贵。这两种方法都无法满足现代交易系统的延迟和吞吐量要求。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了 TRADER，这是一种通过动态图表上的负循环进行高性能实时 aRbitrAge 检测的增量解决方案。 TRADER 使用基于动态编程的算法，通过增量状态更新和本地化传播来检测和维护快速变化的加密代币图上的套利机会。它支持批量边缘更新，并采用边缘分组策略来过滤掉无影响的更新，从而减少延迟并提高吞吐量。在现实世界的 DeFi 数据集上，TRADER 在保持高检测准确性的同时，相对基线实现了最高 5.8 倍加速。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Decomposition-Driven Multi-Table Retrieval and Reasoning for Numerical Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 分解驱动的数值问答多表检索和推理
papers.authors: Feng Luo, Hai Lan, Hui Luo, Zhifeng Bao, Xiaoli Wang, J.Shane Culpepper, Shazia Sadiq
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of numerical multi-table question answering (MTQA) over large-scale table collections (e.g., online data repositories). This task is essential in many analytical applications. Existing MTQA solutions, such as text-to-SQL or open-domain MTQA methods, are designed for databases and struggle when applied to large-scale table collections. The key limitations include: (1) Limited support for complex table relationships; (2) Ineffective retrieval of relevant tables at scale; (3) Inaccurate answer generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose DMRAL, a Decomposition-driven Multi-table Retrieval and Answering framework for MTQA over large-scale table collections, which consists of: (1) constructing a table relationship graph to capture complex relationships among tables; (2) Table-Aligned Question Decomposer and Coverage-Aware Retriever, which jointly enable the effective identification of relevant tables from large-scale corpora by enhancing the question decomposition quality and maximizing the question coverage of retrieved tables; and (3) Sub-question Guided Reasoner, which produces correct answers by progressively generating and refining the reasoning program based on sub-questions. Experiments on two MTQA datasets demonstrate that DMRAL significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art MTQA methods, with an average improvement of 24% in table retrieval and 55% in answer accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了大规模表集合（例如在线数据存储库）上的数值多表问答（MTQA）问题。这项任务在许多分析应用中至关重要。现有的 MTQA 解决方案（例如文本到 SQL 或开放域 MTQA 方法）是为数据库设计的，在应用于大规模表集合时会遇到困难。主要限制包括：（1）对复杂表关系的支持有限； （2）大规模相关表格检索无效； (3) 答案生成不准确。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 DMRAL，一种用于大规模表集合上的 MTQA 的分解驱动的多表检索和应答框架，其包括：（1）构建表关系图以捕获表之间的复杂关系； （2）表对齐问题分解器和覆盖感知检索器，通过提高问题分解质量和最大化检索表的问题覆盖率，共同实现大规模语料库中相关表的有效识别； (3)子问题引导推理器，通过基于子问题逐步生成和细化推理程序来产生正确答案。在两个 MTQA 数据集上的实验表明，DMRAL 显著优于现有最先进的 MTQA 方法，表检索平均提高 24%，答案准确率平均提高 55%。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: HaS: Accelerating RAG through Homology-Aware Speculative Retrieval
papers.title_zh: HaS：通过同源感知推测检索加速 RAG
papers.authors: Peng Peng, Weiwei Lin, Wentai Wu, Xinyang Wang, Yongheng Liu
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) expands the knowledge boundary of large language models (LLMs) at inference by retrieving external documents as context. However, retrieval becomes increasingly time-consuming as the knowledge databases grow in size. Existing acceleration strategies either compromise accuracy through approximate retrieval, or achieve marginal gains by reusing results of strictly identical queries. We propose HaS, a homology-aware speculative retrieval framework that performs low-latency speculative retrieval over restricted scopes to obtain candidate documents, followed by validating whether they contain the required knowledge. The validation, grounded in the homology relation between queries, is formulated as a homologous query re-identification task: once a previously observed query is identified as a homologous re-encounter of the incoming query, the draft is deemed acceptable, allowing the system to bypass slow full-database retrieval. Benefiting from the prevalence of homologous queries under real-world popularity patterns, HaS achieves substantial efficiency gains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HaS reduces retrieval latency by 23.74% and 36.99% across datasets with only a 1-2% marginal accuracy drop. As a plug-and-play solution, HaS also significantly accelerates complex multi-hop queries in modern agentic RAG pipelines. Source code is available at: https://github.com/ErrEqualsNil/HaS.
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成 (RAG) 通过检索外部文档作为上下文，扩展了大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理时的知识边界。然而，随着知识数据库规模的增大，检索变得越来越耗时。现有的加速策略要么通过近似检索来损害准确性，要么通过重用完全相同的查询结果来实现边际收益。我们提出了 HaS，一种同源感知推测检索框架，它在有限范围内执行低延迟推测检索以获得候选文档，然后验证它们是否包含所需的知识。基于查询之间的同源关系的验证被制定为同源查询重新识别任务：一旦先前观察到的查询被识别为传入查询的同源重新遇到，则草稿被认为是可接受的，从而允许系统绕过缓慢的全数据库检索。受益于现实世界流行模式下同源查询的流行，HaS 实现了显著的效率提升。大量实验表明，HaS 将数据集的检索延迟减少了 23.74% 和 36.99%，而边际准确率仅下降 1-2%。作为即插即用的解决方案，HaS 还可以显著加速现代代理 RAG 管道中的复杂多跳查询。源代码位于：https://github.com/ErrEqualsNil/HaS。

papers.title: SaCal: An Efficient Saliency-Guided Causal Framework for Interpretable Healthcare Analytics
papers.title_zh: SaCal：用于可解释医疗保健分析的高效显著性引导因果框架
papers.authors: Feixuan Lin, Chenyu You, Zhongle Xie, Zhaojing Luo, Meihui Zhang
papers.abstract: Multi-modal Electronic Health Records (EHRs) enable comprehensive patient assessment and facilitate multi-task prediction in healthcare. Current relevant studies mainly focus on three aspects: multi-modal learning (MML), multi-task learning (MTL), and multi-modal multi-task learning (MM-MTL). MML approaches attempt to extract latent information for multimodal fusion, but the process remains opaque and provides limited flexibility of adjustment over modality contributions, with potential underemphasis of task-relevant modalities. MTL methods typically feed features directly into models, without taking the spurious correlations between features and tasks into account, which hampers performance. While existing MM-MTL methods combine MML and MTL, they did not address the problems of obscure multi-modal fusion and multi-task learning with spurious correlations. In this paper, we propose a saliency-guided causal framework named SaCal for interpretable MM-MTL healthcare analytics. Specifically, a saliency-based mechanism that can quantify modality importance and adjust modality proportion accordingly is proposed to guide the modality fusion. With the aim of separating spurious correlations from truly causal features for MTL, we propose an innovative Task-to-Module Graph Learning structure based on causal theory for improved prediction. Considering the high dimensionality and redundancy in multi-modal data, we design the de-correlation regularization to ensure that the learned representations are diversified and discriminative. Moreover, an adaptive activation and graph sparsity strategy is designed to enhance overall model efficiency and reduce computational overhead. SaCal is capable of offering saliency-driven interpretation for different medical prediction tasks. Experimental results on four MIMIC series clinical databases and five healthcare prediction tasks confirm SaCal's effectiveness in improving predictive performance compared to seven state-of-the-art baselines, also demonstrating its efficiency and interpretability.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态电子健康记录 (EHR) 可实现全面的患者评估并促进医疗保健中的多任务预测。目前的相关研究主要集中在三个方面：多模态学习（MML）、多任务学习（MTL）和多模态多任务学习（MM-MTL）。 MML 方法试图提取多模态融合的潜在信息，但该过程仍然不透明，并且对模态贡献的调整灵活性有限，可能会低估与任务相关的模态。 MTL 方法通常将特征直接输入到模型中，而不考虑特征和任务之间的虚假相关性，这会影响性能。虽然现有的 MM-MTL 方法结合了 MML 和 MTL，但它们没有解决模糊的多模态融合和具有虚假相关性的多任务学习的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一个名为 SaCal 的显著性引导因果框架，用于可解释的 MM-MTL 医疗保健分析。具体来说，提出了一种基于显著性的机制，可以量化模态重要性并相应地调整模态比例来指导模态融合。为了将 MTL 的虚假相关性与真正的因果特征分开，我们提出了一种基于因果理论的创新任务到模块图学习结构，以改进预测。考虑到多模态数据的高维性和冗余性，我们设计了去相关正则化以确保学习到的表示的多样性和判别性。此外，设计了自适应激活和图稀疏策略来提高整体模型效率并减少计算开销。 SaCal 能够为不同的医学预测任务提供显著性驱动的解释。四个 MIMIC 系列临床数据库和五个医疗预测任务的实验结果证实了 SaCal 与七个最先进的基线相比在提高预测性能方面的有效性，也证明了其效率和可解释性。

papers.title: BOND: A Co-Designed Framework for LLM-Powered Analytics Over Relational Data
papers.title_zh: BOND：LLM 支持的关系数据分析的共同设计框架
papers.authors: Lixiang Chen, Qin Zheng, Zhicheng Pan, Chengcheng Yang, Rong Zhang, Xuan Zhou
papers.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into database systems through SQL has made the data analytics workflow elegant. However, this integration introduces significant computational overhead, as conventional LLM inference is not optimized for relational workloads. Existing optimization techniques are often designed for unpredictable online request streams and treat the LLM engine as a black box, failing to leverage the prior knowledge of the entire data batch available in database operations. To bridge this gap, we propose BOND, a co-designed framework that deeply integrates batch-aware optimizations on both the inference engine and data organization sides. Specifically, BOND consists of two main components. First, a batch-efficient LLM inference engine indexes incoming prompts using a radix tree to identify shared prefix. Then, it models batch creation as a bin-packing problem, grouping computations to align with GPU hardware characteristics. As a result, it effectively mitigates tile-quantization effects. Second, a prefix-oriented data re-organizer optimizes the relational data before inference. This process uses a tree-based framework to find a data layout that maximizes prefix sharing and cache localities. Finally, these two components are bridged by a bubble-free task scheduler that ensures continuous GPU utilization in distributed environments. Experimental results show that our approach could reduce query execution time by up to 71.8%.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过 SQL 将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到数据库系统中，使数据分析工作流程更加优雅。然而，这种集成会带来大量的计算开销，因为传统的 LLM 推理并未针对关系工作负载进行优化。现有的优化技术通常是针对不可预测的在线请求流而设计的，并将LLM引擎视为黑匣子，无法利用数据库操作中可用的整个数据批次的先验知识。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 BOND，这是一个共同设计的框架，在推理引擎和数据组织方面深度集成了批处理感知优化。具体来说，BOND 由两个主要部分组成。首先，批量高效的 LLM 推理引擎使用基数树对传入提示进行索引以识别共享前缀。然后，它将批量创建建模为装箱问题，对计算进行分组以符合 GPU 硬件特性。因此，它有效地减轻了平铺量化效应。其次，面向前缀的数据重组器在推理之前优化关系数据。此过程使用基于树的框架来找到最大化前缀共享和缓存位置的数据布局。最后，这两个组件通过无气泡任务调度程序桥接，确保分布式环境中 GPU 的持续利用。实验结果表明，我们的方法可以将查询执行时间减少多达 71.8%。

papers.title: Efficient Top-k Nearest Neighbors Search in Dynamic Road Networks
papers.title_zh: 动态道路网络中高效的 Top-k 最近邻搜索
papers.authors: Junhua Zhang, Yamei Song, Wentao Li, Lu Qin
papers.abstract: Top-k Nearest Neighbors $(k \text{NN})$ search is a fundamental problem in road networks, which finds the $k$ nearest objects to a query point in the network and has numerous applications in location-based services. Existing solutions mainly focus on static road networks, they fail to address the dynamic nature of real-world road networks. To fill this gap, we propose a new indexing approach that enables efficient query processing while supporting dynamic changes of objects and roads in the road networks. Unlike existing index-based methods that rely on distance indexes, our approach adopts a simple and lightweight $\boldsymbol{k} \mathbf{N N}$ index that stores only the $k$ nearest neighbors for each vertex, making it feasible to maintain the index when the objects or the road network change. To construct the index efficiently, we formulate a generalized $\boldsymbol{k} \mathbf{N} \mathbf{N}$ search problem and develop efficient algorithms by leveraging dynamic programming techniques. We also develop efficient index maintenance algorithms, these algorithms can incrementally and efficiently update the index when the objects or the road network change. We conduct extensive experiments on real-world road networks, which show that our approach outperforms existing solutions by 1-2 orders of magnitude in query processing, index construction, and index size. Furthermore, the result also demonstrates the efficiency of our methods in handling changes in road networks.
papers.abstract_zh: Top-k 最近邻 $(k \text{NN})$ 搜索是道路网络中的一个基本问题，它查找网络中距离查询点最近的 $k$ 个对象，并且在基于位置的服务中有大量应用。现有的解决方案主要关注静态道路网络，无法解决现实世界道路网络的动态特性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新的索引方法，该方法可以实现高效的查询处理，同时支持道路网络中对象和道路的动态变化。与依赖距离索引的现有基于索引的方法不同，我们的方法采用简单且轻量级的 $\boldsymbol{k} \mathbf{N N}$ 索引，该索引仅存储每个顶点的 $k$ 最近邻居，使得在对象或道路网络发生变化时维护索引成为可能。为了有效地构建索引，我们制定了广义的 $\boldsymbol{k} \mathbf{N} \mathbf{N}$ 搜索问题，并利用动态编程技术开发有效的算法。我们还开发了高效的索引维护算法，这些算法可以在对象或路网发生变化时增量且高效地更新索引。我们对现实世界的道路网络进行了广泛的实验，结果表明我们的方法在查询处理、索引构建和索引大小方面优于现有解决方案 1-2 个数量级。此外，结果还证明了我们的方法在处理道路网络变化方面的效率。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: An Efficient and Scalable Approach for Path Queries on Public Transportation Networks
papers.title_zh: 一种高效且可扩展的公共交通网络路径查询方法
papers.authors: Junhua Zhang, Wentao Li, Wenjie Zhang, Lu Qin, Xiaochun Yang
papers.abstract: Public transportation is crucial for mitigating environmental pollution and alleviating traffic congestion. As a fundamental problem in public transportation networks, path query aims to find the optimal path from a source vertex to a destination vertex. Several methods have been proposed to speed up the path queries by utilizing indexes. However, these methods suffer from significant performance issues in both query processing and index construction, limiting their scalability on large networks. To this end, we analyze the performance bottlenecks of existing methods and design a new efficient index-based method leveraging the properties of graph tree decomposition, the tree decomposition based index ensures that only a small set of labels is examined during query processing. Additionally, we develop linear-time, cache-friendly algorithms to efficiently handle multi-edges in public transportation networks, which avoids the expensive Dijkstra search and check operations in index construction, thereby addressing the performance bottlenecks of existing methods. Building on these techniques, we present new algorithms for both query processing and index construction. Furthermore, we theoretically analyze the time complexity of our method and existing methods regarding index construction and prove that our method scales better for large number of parallel edges. We also showcase the effectiveness of our method in handling numerous parallel edges by integrating them in other tree decomposition based index frameworks. Extensive experiments on 13 real-world public transportation networks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches by one to three orders of magnitude in both query processing and index construction.
papers.abstract_zh: 公共交通对于减轻环境污染和缓解交通拥堵至关重要。路径查询作为公共交通网络中的一个基本问题，旨在找到从源顶点到目的顶点的最优路径。已经提出了几种利用索引来加速路径查询的方法。然而，这些方法在查询处理和索引构建方面都存在严重的性能问题，限制了它们在大型网络上的可扩展性。为此，我们分析了现有方法的性能瓶颈，并利用图树分解的特性设计了一种新的高效的基于索引的方法，基于树分解的索引确保在查询处理过程中仅检查一小部分标签。此外，我们开发了线性时间、缓存友好的算法来有效处理公共交通网络中的多边，避免了索引构建中昂贵的 Dijkstra 搜索和检查操作，从而解决了现有方法的性能瓶颈。基于这些技术，我们提出了用于查询处理和索引构建的新算法。此外，我们从理论上分析了我们的方法和现有索引构建方法的时间复杂度，并证明我们的方法对于大量平行边具有更好的扩展性。我们还通过将我们的方法集成到其他基于树分解的索引框架中来展示我们的方法在处理大量平行边方面的有效性。对 13 个现实世界公共交通网络的大量实验表明，我们的方法在查询处理和索引构建方面均优于现有方法一到三个数量级。

papers.title: Truth ≠ Frequency: Leveraging Dependencies for Subset Repair
papers.title_zh: 真相≠频率：利用依赖关系进行子集修复
papers.authors: Haoda Li, Jiahui Chen, Yu Sun, Shaoxu Song, Haiwei Zhang, Xiaojie Yuan
papers.abstract: Inconsistent values are commonly encountered in real-world applications, which can negatively impact data analysis and decision-making. While existing research primarily focuses on identifying the smallest removal set to resolve inconsistencies, recent studies have shown that the minimum repairing principle is often incorrect as it ignores the signals provided by the attribute values. Some approaches use the most frequent values as guidance for the subset repair. This strategy has been criticized for its potential to inaccurately identify errors. To address these issues, we consider the dependencies between attribute values to determine a more appropriate subset repair. Our main contributions include (1) formalizing the optimal subset repair problem with attribute dependencies and analyzing its computational hardness; (2) computing the exact solution using integer linear programming; (3) developing an approximate algorithm with performance guarantees based on cliques and LP relaxation; and (4) designing a probabilistic approach with an approximation bound for efficiency. Experimental results on realworld datasets validate the effectiveness of our methods in both subset repair performance and downstream applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 在实际应用中经常会遇到不一致的值，这可能会对数据分析和决策产生负面影响。虽然现有的研究主要集中在确定最小去除集来解决不一致问题，但最近的研究表明，最小修复原则通常是不正确的，因为它忽略了属性值提供的信号。一些方法使用最常见的值作为子集修复的指导。这种策略因其可能不准确地识别错误而受到批评。为了解决这些问题，我们考虑属性值之间的依赖性，以确定更合适的子集修复。我们的主要贡献包括（1）将具有属性依赖性的最优子集修复问题形式化并分析其计算难度； (2) 使用整数线性规划计算精确解； (3)开发基于派系和LP松弛的具有性能保证的近似算法； (4) 设计一种具有效率近似界限的概率方法。真实数据集的实验结果验证了我们的方法在子集修复性能和下游应用中的有效性。

papers.title: iKSP: A Path Enumeration Index in Road Networks
papers.title_zh: iKSP：道路网络中的路径枚举索引
papers.authors: Zihan Luo, Lei Li, Mengxuan Zhang, Xinjie Zhou, Zizhuo Xu, Xiaofang Zhou
papers.abstract: Enumerating the top- $k$ simple shortest path (KSP) is a fundamental searching strategy for many path-related applications. However, the efficiency of current solutions is not acceptable, especially when the required $k$ is large, which becomes a bottleneck for many downstream tasks like Diversified KSP (DkSP) and Constrained Shortest Path. Besides, it seems infeasible to build a KSP index specifically when $k$ is unknown beforehand. To break through these barriers, in this paper, we first propose an index $\boldsymbol{i}$ KSP for top-k path enumeration. Then we dive into the path concatenation relationship, and propose novel pruning techniques to efficiently detect the loopful and repeated paths for KSP computation. Finally, the experiment on real-life road networks demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithm over the state-of-the-art, and the application in DkSP shows the practicality of our algorithm.
papers.abstract_zh: 枚举 top-$k$ 简单最短路径 (KSP) 是许多与路径相关的应用程序的基本搜索策略。然而，当前解决方案的效率不可接受，特别是当所需的$k$很大时，这成为许多下游任务（例如多样化KSP（DkSP）和约束最短路径）的瓶颈。此外，在事先未知$k$的情况下专门构建KSP索引似乎是不可行的。为了突破这些障碍，在本文中，我们首先提出了一个用于 top-k 路径枚举的索引 $\boldsymbol{i}$ KSP。然后，我们深入研究路径串联关系，并提出新颖的剪枝技术来有效检测 KSP 计算的循环和重复路径。最后，在现实道路网络上的实验证明了我们的算法相对于现有技术的有效性和效率，并且在DkSP中的应用表明了我们算法的实用性。

papers.title: Novel Table Search
papers.title_zh: 小说表搜索
papers.authors: Besat Kassaie, Renee J. Miller
papers.abstract: Avoiding redundancy in query results has been extensively studied in relational databases and information retrieval, yet its implications for data lakes remain largely unexplored. We bridge this gap by investigating how to discover unionable tables that contribute new information for a given query table in large-scale data lakes. We formally define Novel Table Search (NTS) as the problem of finding tables that are novel with respect to a given query table and identify two desirable properties that any scoring function for NTS should satisfy. We introduce a concrete scoring mechanism designed to maximize syntactic novelty, prove that it satisfies the proposed properties, and show that the associated optimization problem is NP-hard. To address this challenge, we develop an efficient approximation technique based on penalization, i.e., Attribute-Based Novel Table Search (ANTs). We propose three additional NTS variants to achieve syntactic novelty and introduce two evaluation metrics for syntactic novelty. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that ANTs outperforms other methods in capturing syntactic novelty across evaluation metrics and various benchmarks, while also achieving the lowest execution time.
papers.abstract_zh: 避免查询结果中的冗余已在关系数据库和信息检索中得到广泛研究，但其对数据湖的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们通过研究如何发现可联合表来弥补这一差距，这些表为大规模数据湖中的给定查询表提供新信息。我们将新颖表搜索 (NTS) 正式定义为查找相对于给定查询表新颖的表的问题，并确定 NTS 的任何评分函数都应满足的两个理想属性。我们引入了一种具体的评分机制，旨在最大限度地提高句法新颖性，证明它满足所提出的属性，并表明相关的优化问题是 NP 困难的。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种基于惩罚的有效近似技术，即基于属性的小说表搜索（ANT）。我们提出了三个额外的 NTS 变体来实现句法新颖性，并引入了两种句法新颖性的评估指标。通过大量的实验，我们证明 ANT 在跨评估指标和各种基准捕获语法新颖性方面优于其他方法，同时还实现了最短的执行时间。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: Query-Guided Analysis and Mitigation of Data Verification Errors
papers.title_zh: 查询引导分析和减少数据验证错误
papers.authors: Ran Schreiber, Yael Amsterdamer
papers.abstract: Data verification, the process of labeling data items as correct or incorrect, is a preprocessing step that may critically affect the quality of results in data-driven pipelines. Despite recent advances, verification can still produce erroneous labels that propagate to downstream query results in complex ways. We present a framework that complements existing verification tools by assessing the impact of potential labeling errors on query outputs and guiding additional verification steps to improve result reliability. To this end, we introduce Maximal Error Score (MES), a worst-case uncertainty metric that quantifies the reliability of query output tuples independently of the underlying data distribution. As an auxiliary indicator, we identify risky tuples - input tuples for which reducing label uncertainty may counterintuitively increase the output uncertainty. We then develop efficient algorithms for computing MES and detecting risky tuples, as well as a generic algorithm, named MESReduce, that builds on both indicators and interacts with external verifiers to select effective additional verification steps. We implement our techniques in a prototype system and evaluate them on real and synthetic datasets, demonstrating that MESReduce can substantially and effectively reduce the MES and improve the accuracy of verification results.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据验证是将数据项标记为正确或不正确的过程，是一个可能严重影响数据驱动管道中结果质量的预处理步骤。尽管最近取得了进展，验证仍然会产生错误的标签，并以复杂的方式传播到下游查询结果。我们提出了一个框架，通过评估潜在标签错误对查询输出的影响并指导额外的验证步骤以提高结果可靠性，来补充现有的验证工具。为此，我们引入了最大错误分数（MES），这是一种最坏情况的不确定性度量，它独立于底层数据分布来量化查询输出元组的可靠性。作为辅助指标，我们识别风险元组 - 输入元组，降低标签不确定性可能会违反直觉地增加输出不确定性。然后，我们开发用于计算 MES 和检测风险元组的有效算法，以及名为 MESReduce 的通用算法，该算法基于两个指标并与外部验证者交互以选择有效的附加验证步骤。我们在原型系统中实施我们的技术，并在真实和合成数据集上对其进行评估，证明 MESReduce 可以大幅有效地降低 MES 并提高验证结果的准确性。

papers.title: ImmortalChopper: Real-Time and Resilient Distributed Transactions in the Edge-Cloud
papers.title_zh: ImmortalChopper：边缘云中的实时、弹性分布式事务
papers.authors: Juncheng Fang, Farzad Habibi, Binbin Gu, Faisal Nawab
papers.abstract: Emerging applications in the areas of real-time Internet of Things (IoT) and edge technologies require fast processing and response times. This motivates the utilization of edge nodes for storing and processing data close to the user. In settings with a vast number of edge nodes, the state of the data is distributed across a large number of edge nodes. This makes it expensive to perform distributed transactions, as these transactions would span edge nodes that are connected via less reliable and relatively slow network infrastructure. It is prohibitive to use existing protocols like 2PC that require many rounds of communication across participants. In this paper, we propose ImmortalChopper, a distributed transaction processing protocol designed for the edge-cloud environment. The goal of ImmortalChopper is to provide One-Node Response (InResponse), a guarantee of transaction commitment by contacting only one node without waiting for coordination with the other nodes. To achieve this, we build on and extend the literature of transaction chopping and lazy replication. Transaction chopping breaks transactions into smaller hops. If the first hop commits, the rest of the transaction is guaranteed to commit, accomplishing the goal of 1n-Response. Each hop is replicated to tolerate temporary node failure, and we apply lazy replication on the first hop to maintain 1n-Response. However, combining transaction chopping and lazy replication without special care can lead to transactions operating on a stale state and potentially violating serializability. We present a new transaction chopping theory called ChopperGraph that integrates the notion of lazy replication and speculative execution. It ensures 1n-Response while preserving serializability. We evaluate ImmortalChopper on three applications, and the result shows that it achieves 1 n-Response in real-time and can quickly recover from node failure.
papers.abstract_zh: 实时物联网 (IoT) 和边缘技术领域的新兴应用需要快速的处理和响应时间。这促使利用边缘节点来存储和处理靠近用户的数据。在具有大量边缘节点的设置中，数据的状态分布在大量边缘节点上。这使得执行分布式事务变得昂贵，因为这些事务将跨越通过不太可靠且相对较慢的网络基础设施连接的边缘节点。禁止使用像 2PC 这样需要参与者之间进行多轮通信的现有协议。在本文中，我们提出了 ImmortalChopper，一种专为边缘云环境设计的分布式事务处理协议。 ImmortalChopper 的目标是提供单节点响应（InResponse），即通过仅联系一个节点而不等待与其他节点协调来保证事务提交。为了实现这一目标，我们建立并扩展了事务斩波和惰性复制的文献。事务切割将事务分解为更小的跳跃。如果第一跳提交，则保证事务的其余部分提交，从而实现 1n-Response 的目标。每跳都会被复制以容忍临时节点故障，并且我们在第一跳上应用惰性复制以维持 1n-Response。然而，如果不特别小心地结合事务砍伐和惰性复制可能会导致事务在陈旧状态下运行，并可能违反可串行性。我们提出了一种名为 ChopperGraph 的新事务斩波理论，它集成了惰性复制和推测执行的概念。它确保 1n-Response，同时保留可串行性。我们在三个应用程序上对 ImmortalChopper 进行了评估，结果表明它实现了 1 n-Response 实时性，并且可以从节点故障中快速恢复。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: SpendableStore: A UTXO-based Decentralized Data Store
papers.title_zh: SpendableStore：基于 UTXO 的去中心化数据存储
papers.authors: YINAN ZHOU, Faisal Nawab
papers.abstract: The literature on blockchain-based databases is divided into permissioned blockchains and permissionless account-based blockchains. However, the former is not fully decentralized, and the latter suffers from challenges in scalability and practicality. We propose SpendableStore, a hybrid on/off-chain database that operates on top of permissionless UTXO-based blockchains as a novel approach to the problem of data decentralization. Our design integrates atomic data units into individual UTXOs to create a new blockchain concept called Spendable Data Objects that perform traditional CRUD operations. The integrity, immutability, and ownership of these Spendable Data Objects are safeguarded directly by the blockchain peer nodes, thus constraining the power of database administrators to achieve true data decentralization. We further support database transactions and propose an isolation mechanism called Future Now Snapshot Isolation to reason about transactional correctness in SpendableStore. We performed experiments on a major blockchain's Mainnet and observed up to 16x better throughput compared to a state-of-the-art blockchain-based database.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于区块链的数据库文献分为许可型区块链和非许可型基于账户的区块链。然而，前者并未完全去中心化，后者在可扩展性和实用性方面面临挑战。我们提出 SpendableStore，这是一种混合链上/链下数据库，在基于 UTXO 的无许可区块链之上运行，作为解决数据去中心化问题的一种新方法。我们的设计将原子数据单元集成到各个 UTXO 中，以创建一个名为 Spendable Data Objects 的新区块链概念，用于执行传统的 CRUD 操作。这些可消耗数据对象的完整性、不变性和所有权由区块链对等节点直接保护，从而限制了数据库管理员实现真正数据去中心化的能力。我们进一步支持数据库事务，并提出了一种称为“Future Now Snapshot Isolation”的隔离机制，以推断 SpendableStore 中事务的正确性。我们在主要区块链的主网上进行了实验，发现与最先进的基于区块链的数据库相比，吞吐量提高了 16 倍。

papers.title: DIFFCOM: Conditional Discrete Diffusion Model for Community Search
papers.title_zh: DIFFCOM：用于社区搜索的条件离散扩散模型
papers.authors: Ling Li, Liang Bai, Siqiang Luo, Yejiang Wang, Yuhai Zhao
papers.abstract: Learning-based community search methods have attracted widespread attention due to their effectiveness. Recently, continuous diffusion models have been introduced for community search, achieving strong performance. However, such continuous diffusion models may introduce boundary ambiguity, making it difficult to convert continuous scores into high-quality discrete community selections. To address these issues, we propose DIF-FCOM, a discrete diffusion model-based method for community search. Our method instantiates a query-conditioned discrete diffusion process directly in the binary membership space, where a conditional graph neural network integrates query semantics and community-level context at each denoising step to provide richer conditioning for the reverse process. It further incorporates an edge-level structural loss to model pairwise connectivity within a community and employs a threshold-free decoding strategy that jointly leverages node and edge confidences to determine the final community. Experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that DIFFCOM achieves state-of-the-art performance on almost all datasets for single-node queries and remains competitive for multi-node queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于学习的社区搜索方法因其有效性而引起了广泛的关注。最近，连续扩散模型被引入社区搜索，取得了很强的性能。然而，这种连续扩散模型可能会引入边界模糊性，从而难以将连续分数转换为高质量的离散社区选择。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 DIF-FCOM，一种基于离散扩散模型的社区搜索方法。我们的方法直接在二元隶属空间中实例化查询条件离散扩散过程，其中条件图神经网络在每个去噪步骤中集成查询语义和社区级上下文，为反向过程提供更丰富的条件。它进一步结合了边缘级结构损失来对社区内的成对连接进行建模，并采用无阈值解码策略，共同利用节点和边缘置信度来确定最终社区。对真实数据集和合成数据集的实验表明，DIFFCOM 在几乎所有数据集的单节点查询上都实现了最先进的性能，并且在多节点查询方面仍然具有竞争力。

papers.title: Geco: A Confidentiality-Preserving and High-Performance Permissioned Blockchain Framework for General Smart Contracts
papers.title_zh: Geco：适用于通用智能合约的保密且高性能许可区块链框架
papers.authors: Songxiao Guo, Rongxin Guan, Ji Qi, Zongyuan Zhang, Tianyang Duan, Sen Wang, Yanjun Wu, Heming Cui
papers.abstract: Data confidentiality is essential for blockchain applications that handle sensitive data. A promising approach to achieving data confidentiality is executing smart contracts on homomorphic encrypted ciphertext and then verifying correctness through non-interactive zero-knowledge proofs (NIZKPs). However, existing solutions cannot tolerate non-deterministic (ND) contracts whose correct execution cannot be proven by NIZKPs, and suffer from poor performance for deterministic contracts due to the use of using homomorphic encryption. We present Geco, a confidentiality-preserving and highperformance permissioned blockchain framework for general smart contracts. Geco shifts part of correctness enforcement from cryptographic primitives to the blockchain layer, thereby tolerating ND contracts and maintaining verifiable correctness at the system level. To support fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) without incurring significant performance overhead, we present Стм protocol, which merges multiple conflicting transactions into a single one, thereby reducing both conflicting aborts and expensive cryptographic computations. Geco ensures strong confidentiality and supports general smart contracts. It outperforms four confidentiality-preserving blockchains by achieving up to 7.1 times higher throughput and reducing 99% tail latency down to 48.2% of the baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据机密性对于处理敏感数据的区块链应用程序至关重要。实现数据机密性的一种有前途的方法是在同态加密密文上执行智能合约，然后通过非交互式零知识证明（NIZKP）验证正确性。然而，现有的解决方案无法容忍非确定性（ND）合约，其正确执行无法由 NIZKP 证明，并且由于使用同态加密，确定性合约的性能较差。我们推出 Geco，一个用于通用智能合约的保密且高性能的许可区块链框架。 Geco 将部分正确性执行从加密原语转移到区块链层，从而容忍 ND 合约并在系统级别保持可验证的正确性。为了支持完全同态加密（FHE）而不产生显著的性能开销，我们提出了 Стм 协议，它将多个冲突事务合并为一个事务，从而减少冲突中止和昂贵的加密计算。 Geco 确保强大的保密性并支持通用智能合约。它的吞吐量比四个保密区块链高出 7.1 倍，并将尾部延迟从 99% 减少到基线的 48.2%。
