papers.title: Efficient Community Search on Attributed Public-Private Graphs
papers.title_zh: 归因公私图的高效社区搜索
papers.authors: Yuqi Chen, Weihan Zhang, Xin Huang
papers.abstract: Public-private graph, where a public network is visible to everyone and every user is also associated with its own small private graph accessed by itself only, widely exists in real-world applications of social networks and financial networks. Most existing work on community search, finding a query-dependent community containing a given query, only studies on a public graph, neglecting the privacy issues in public-private networks. However, considering both the public and private attributes of users enables community search to be more accurate, comprehensive, and personalized to discover hidden patterns. In this paper, we study a novel problem of attributed community search in public-private graphs (ACS-PP), aiming to find a connected k-core community that shares the most keywords with the query node. This problem uncovers structurally cohesive communities, such as interest-based user groups or core teams in collaborative networks. To optimize search efficiency, we propose an integrated scheme of constructing a public global graph index and a private personalized graph index. For the private index, we developed a compact structure of the PP-FP-tree index. The PP-FP-tree is constructed based on the public and private neighbors of the query node in the public-private graph, serving as an efficient index to mine frequent node sets that share the most common attributes with the query node. Extensive experiments on real public-private graph datasets validate both the efficiency and quality of our proposed PP-FP search algorithm against existing competitors. The case study on public-private collaboration networks provides insights into the discovery of public-private communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 公私图广泛存在于社交网络和金融网络的现实应用中，其中公共网络对每个人都可见，并且每个用户也与自己只能访问的小型私有图相关联。大多数现有的社区搜索工作，寻找包含给定查询的依赖于查询的社区，仅在公共图上进行研究，忽略了公私网络中的隐私问题。然而，同时考虑用户的公共和私人属性使得社区搜索能够更加准确、全面和个性化地发现隐藏的模式。在本文中，我们研究了公私图属性社区搜索（ACS-PP）的新问题，旨在找到与查询节点共享最多关键字的连接的k-核心社区。这个问题揭示了结构上有凝聚力的社区，例如协作网络中基于兴趣的用户组或核心团队。为了优化搜索效率，我们提出了构建公共全局图索引和私有个性化图索引的集成方案。对于私有索引，我们开发了一个紧凑结构的PP-FP-tree索引。 PP-FP树是基于公私图中查询节点的公私邻居构建的，作为挖掘与查询节点共享最常见属性的频繁节点集的有效索引。对真实公私图数据集的大量实验验证了我们提出的 PP-FP 搜索算法相对于现有竞争对手的效率和质量。关于公私协作网络的案例研究提供了对公私社区发现的见解。

papers.title: Batcher: Learning to Construct Cost-Efficient Batches of Small Queries in Big Data Processing Platforms
papers.title_zh: Batcher：学习在大数据处理平台中构建经济高效的小批量查询
papers.authors: Yeonsu Park, Taesung Lee, Byungchul Tak, Wook-Shin Han
papers.abstract: Diverse big data processing platforms play critical roles in modern data analytics systems. Their strengths lie in processing queries on huge volumes of data with high parallelism on distributed nodes. However, one type of workload, made of an excessive number of small queries, is known to pose performance issues by preventing big data processing platforms from reaching their intended performance. A recent technique of merging small queries into a large query mitigated this issue by enabling higher parallelism during query processing. However, we hypothesize that the methodical rearranging of queries into batches by similarity and submitting them, instead of one large single query, can produce significantly higher performance gains. To validate this, we have designed and implemented a system, called Batcher, that could learn the optimal batching strategies by utilizing a query batch cost estimation model and multi-staged cluster refinements to handle the NP-hard batch forming task with low overhead. Our evaluations of Batcher using a largescale real-world dataset showed that our strategy could achieve up to 5.4× improved performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 多样化的大数据处理平台在现代数据分析系统中发挥着关键作用。它们的优势在于在分布式节点上以高并行性处理海量数据的查询。然而，已知一种由过多小查询组成的工作负载会阻止大数据处理平台达到其预期性能，从而造成性能问题。最近将小查询合并到大查询中的技术通过在查询处理期间启用更高的并行性来缓解这个问题。然而，我们假设，通过相似性将查询重新排列成批次并提交它们，而不是一个大型的单个查询，可以产生显著更高的性能增益。为了验证这一点，我们设计并实现了一个名为 Batcher 的系统，该系统可以通过利用查询批量成本估计模型和多阶段集群细化来学习最佳批处理策略，以低开销处理 NP 难批量形成任务。我们使用大规模现实世界数据集对 Batcher 进行的评估表明，我们的策略可以实现高达 5.4 倍的性能提升。

papers.title: Improving GPU Tensor Query Processing for Resource-Constrained Environments
papers.title_zh: 改进资源受限环境的 GPU 张量查询处理
papers.authors: Qian Xu, Feng Zhang, Shijie Gao, Kun Chen, Jianhua Wang, Zheng Chen, Xiaoyong Du
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence (AI) has made remarkable strides, driven by researchers, engineers, and vendors who have relentlessly developed high-performance libraries across heterogeneous hardware and software. Recently, researchers in the database (DB) community have begun to harness this progress by representing data as tensors and redefining large-scale data operations through tensor-based computations. This approach seeks to leverage the rapid advancements in AI technologies. Typically, AI computing devices are heterogeneous, with limited and fixed on-device memory. We identify the lack of ability to process large-scale data as the biggest challenge in bridging the gap between the worlds of AI and databases. We propose TensorSlim, a memory-efficient big data analytical system incorporating three key innovations. First, we build a highly optimized operator execution engine that keeps GPU usage bounded by reusing buffers and releasing intermediates early. Second, we propose a tensor-driven processing framework that treats peak GPU memory as a first-class constraint and performs operator-aware GPU memory budgeting to guide query partitioning. Third, we develop a dependency-aware hybrid CPU–GPU query optimizer to manage dataflow dependencies and device placements, avoiding large GPU-resident intermediates. We demonstrate that TensorSlim can deliver 25.5× faster query speeds than traditional GPU-based solutions while achieving 6.4× speedup over CPU-based solutions on average. Additionally, TensorSlim reduces peak memory usage by 73.5%.
papers.abstract_zh: 过去十年，在研究人员、工程师和供应商的推动下，人工智能 (AI) 取得了显著的进步，他们不懈地开发跨异构硬件和软件的高性能库。最近，数据库（DB）社区的研究人员开始利用这一进展，将数据表示为张量，并通过基于张量的计算重新定义大规模数据操作。这种方法旨在利用人工智能技术的快速进步。通常，人工智能计算设备是异构的，设备上的内存有限且固定。我们认为缺乏处理大规模数据的能力是弥合人工智能和数据库世界之间差距的最大挑战。我们提出 TensorSlim，一种内存高效的大数据分析系统，融合了三项关键创新。首先，我们构建了一个高度优化的算子执行引擎，通过重用缓冲区和尽早释放中间体来限制 GPU 使用。其次，我们提出了一个张量驱动的处理框架，将峰值 GPU 内存视为第一类约束，并执行操作员感知的 GPU 内存预算来指导查询分区。第三，我们开发了一个依赖项感知的混合 CPU-GPU 查询优化器来管理数据流依赖项和设备放置，避免大量驻留在 GPU 的中间体。我们证明，TensorSlim 的查询速度比传统的基于 GPU 的解决方案快 25.5 倍，同时比基于 CPU 的解决方案平均加速 6.4 倍。此外，TensorSlim 将峰值内存使用量降低了 73.5%。

papers.title: UTune: Towards Uncertainty-Aware Online Index Tuning
papers.title_zh: UTune：迈向不确定性感知在线索引调整
papers.authors: chenning wu, Sifan Chen, Wentao Wu, Yinan Jing, Zhengying He, Kai Zhang, X.Sean Wang
papers.abstract: There have been a flurry of recent proposals on learned benefit estimators for index tuning. Although these learned estimators show promising improvement over what-if query optimizer calls in terms of the accuracy of estimated index benefit, they face significant limitations when applied to online index tuning, an arguably more common and more challenging scenario in real-world applications. There are two major challenges for learned index benefit estimators in online tuning: (1) limited amount of query execution feedback that can be used to train the models, and (2) constant coming of new unseen queries due to workload drifts. The combination of the two hinders the generalization capability of existing learned index benefit estimators. To overcome these challenges, we present UTune, an uncertainty-aware online index tuning framework that employs operator-level learned models with improved generalization over unseen queries. At the core of UTune is an uncertainty quantification mechanism that characterizes the inherent uncertainty of the operator-level learned models given limited online execution feedback. We further integrate uncertainty information into index selection and configuration enumeration, the key component of any index tuner, by developing a new variant of the classic $ε$-greedy search strategy with uncertainty-weighted index benefits. Experimental evaluation shows that UTune not only significantly improves the workload execution time compared to state-of-the-art online index tuners but also reduces the index exploration overhead, resulting in faster convergence when the workload is relatively stable.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近出现了一系列关于用于索引调整的学习效益估计器的提案。尽管这些学习估计器在估计索引收益的准确性方面显示出比假设查询优化器调用有希望的改进，但它们在应用于在线索引调整时面临着显著的限制，这在现实应用程序中可以说是更常见和更具挑战性的场景。学习索引收益估计器在在线调优中面临两个主要挑战：（1）可用于训练模型的查询执行反馈数量有限，（2）由于工作负载漂移而不断出现新的看不见的查询。两者的结合阻碍了现有学习指数收益估计器的泛化能力。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了 UTune，一种不确定性感知的在线索引调优框架，它采用操作员级学习模型，改进了对未见过的查询的泛化能力。 UTune 的核心是一种不确定性量化机制，该机制描述了在有限的在线执行反馈的情况下操作员级学习模型的固有不确定性。通过开发具有不确定性加权索引优势的经典$ε$贪婪搜索策略的新变体，我们进一步将不确定性信息集成到索引选择和配置枚举中，这是任何索引调整器的关键组成部分。实验评估表明，与最先进的在线索引调优器相比，UTune 不仅显著提高了工作负载执行时间，而且还减少了索引探索开销，从而在工作负载相对稳定时实现更快的收敛。

papers.title: RAMSeS: Robust and Adaptive Model Selection for Time-Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms
papers.title_zh: RAMSeS：时间序列异常检测算法的鲁棒自适应模型选择
papers.authors: Mohamed Ahmed Abdelmaksoud Mohamed, Sheng Ding, Andrey Morozov, Ziawasch Abedjan
papers.abstract: Time-series data vary widely across domains, making a universal anomaly detector impractical. Methods that perform well on one dataset often fail to transfer because what counts as an anomaly is context dependent. The key challenge is to design a method that performs well in specific contexts while remaining adaptable across domains with varying data complexities. We present the Robust and Adaptive Model Selection for Time-Series Anomaly Detection RAMSeS framework. RAMSeS comprises two branches: (i) a stacking ensemble optimized with a genetic algorithm to leverage complementary detectors. (ii) An adaptive model-selection branch identifies the best single detector using techniques including Thompson sampling, robustness testing with generative adversarial networks, and Monte Carlo simulations. This dual strategy exploits the collective strength of multiple models and adapts to dataset-specific characteristics. We evaluate RAMSeS and show that it outperforms prior methods on F1.
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列数据在不同领域之间差异很大，使得通用异常检测器不切实际。在一个数据集上表现良好的方法通常无法迁移，因为什么算作异常是依赖于上下文的。关键的挑战是设计一种在特定环境下表现良好的方法，同时保持跨数据复杂性不同领域的适应性。我们提出了用于时间序列异常检测 RAMSeS 框架的鲁棒自适应模型选择。 RAMSeS 包含两个分支：(i) 使用遗传算法优化的堆叠集成，以利用互补检测器。 (ii) 自适应模型选择分支使用汤普森采样、生成对抗网络的鲁棒性测试和蒙特卡罗模拟等技术来识别最佳的单个检测器。这种双重策略利用了多个模型的集体力量并适应数据集特定的特征。我们评估 RAMSeS 并表明它在 F1 上优于先前的方法。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: CARROT: A Learned Cost-Constrained Retrieval Optimization System for RAG
papers.title_zh: CARROT：RAG 的学习成本约束检索优化系统
papers.authors: Ziting Wang, Haitao Yuan, Wei Dong, Gao Cong, Feifei Li
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive ability in generation and reasoning tasks but struggle with handling up-to-date knowledge, leading to inaccuracies or hallucinations. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates this by retrieving and incorporating external knowledge into input prompts. In particular, due to LLMs' context window limitations and long-context hallucinations, only the most relevant "chunks" are retrieved. However, current RAG systems face three key challenges: (1) chunks are often retrieved independently without considering their relationships, such as redundancy and ordering; (2) the utility of chunks is non-monotonic, as adding more chunks can degrade quality; and (3) retrieval strategies fail to adapt to the unique characteristics of different queries. To overcome these challenges, we design a cost-constrained retrieval optimization framework for RAG. We adopt a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) based strategy to find the optimal chunk combination order, which considers the chunks' correlations. In addition, to address the non-monotonicity of chunk utility, instead of treating budget exhaustion as the termination condition, we design a utility computation strategy to identify the optimal chunk combination without necessarily exhausting the budget. Furthermore, we propose a configuration agent that predicts optimal configurations for each query domain, improving our framework's adaptability and efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate up to a 30% improvement over baseline models, highlighting the framework's effectiveness, scalability, and suitability. Our source code has been released at https://github.com/wang0702/CARROT.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在生成和推理任务方面表现出了令人印象深刻的能力，但在处理最新知识方面遇到了困难，导致不准确或产生幻觉。检索增强生成（RAG）通过检索外部知识并将其合并到输入提示中来缓解这一问题。特别是，由于大语言模型的上下文窗口限制和长上下文幻觉，仅检索最相关的“块”。然而，当前的RAG系统面临三个关键挑战：（1）块通常是独立检索的，而不考虑它们之间的关系，例如冗余和排序； （2）块的效用是非单调的，因为添加更多的块会降低质量； (3)检索策略未能适应不同查询的独特特征。为了克服这些挑战，我们为 RAG 设计了一个成本受限的检索优化框架。我们采用基于蒙特卡罗树搜索（MCTS）的策略来找到最佳的块组合顺序，该顺序考虑了块的相关性。此外，为了解决块效用的非单调性，我们没有将预算耗尽作为终止条件，而是设计了一种效用计算策略来识别最佳块组合，而不必耗尽预算。此外，我们提出了一个配置代理，可以预测每个查询域的最佳配置，从而提高我们框架的适应性和效率。实验结果表明，与基准模型相比，性能提高了 30%，凸显了该框架的有效性、可扩展性和适用性。我们的源代码已发布在 https://github.com/wang0702/CARROT。

papers.title: SLGParser: Practical and Efficient Label-Free Log Parsing Using Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: SLGParser：使用大型语言模型进行实用且高效的无标签日志解析
papers.authors: Yibing Hu, Cong Wang, Lixin Zhao, Aimin Yu
papers.abstract: Logs serve as crucial artifacts for recording runtime system states and play a vital role in system diagnostics, security analysis, and performance optimization. Log parsing, the process of converting semi-structured logs into structured formats, is a pivotal preliminary step for enabling automated log analysis and utilization. Recently, semantic-based parsers leverage labeled data, which is labor-intensive. Unsupervised LLM-based log parsers perform comparative analysis on a set of logs that share similar static text, and we refer to this set of logs as a log group. Through a comprehensive analysis of unsupervised methods, we identify three limitations. 1) Validity: existing parsers fail to adequately capture the variable parts of log entries in selecting log groups. 2) Generalizability: the absence of log groups often leads to suboptimal performance when relying solely on groupbased reasoning strategy. 3) Practicality: handling large volumes of log entries incurs substantial computational overhead and poses a great challenge in parsing efficiency. To overcome above limitations, we introduce SLGParser, a universal and efficient unsupervised log parsing approach. Specifically, we propose a Suitable Log Group (SLG) selector that maximizes variable differences among logs to enhance the validity of SLGParser. Furthermore, we develop a hint-enhanced strategy to address the performance degradation caused by the absence of log groups. Additionally, we employ an efficient Log Matcher mechanism to reduce LLM query and time overhead. SLGParser reveals several significant inaccuracies in the manually labeled ground truth of the Loghub-2.0 benchmark. To validate the effectiveness of SLGParser, we perform extensive experiments on the revised datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that SLGParser significantly outperforms state-of-the-art log parsers in terms of accuracy and efficiency, providing an efficient and practical solution for real-world deployment.
papers.abstract_zh: 日志是记录运行时系统状态的重要工件，在系统诊断、安全分析和性能优化中发挥着至关重要的作用。日志解析是将半结构化日志转换为结构化格式的过程，是实现自动化日志分析和利用的关键初步步骤。最近，基于语义的解析器利用标签数据，这是劳动密集型的。基于LLM的无监督日志解析器对一组共享相似静态文本的日志进行比较分析，我们将这组日志称为日志组。通过对无监督方法的综合分析，我们发现了三个局限性。 1）有效性：现有解析器在选择日志组时无法充分捕获日志条目的可变部分。 2）通用性：当仅依靠基于组的推理策略时，日志组的缺失通常会导致性能不佳。 3）实用性：处理大量的日志条目会产生大量的计算开销，并对解析效率提出巨大的挑战。为了克服上述限制，我们引入了 SLGParser，一种通用且高效的无监督日志解析方法。具体来说，我们提出了一个合适的日志组（SLG）选择器，它可以最大化日志之间的变量差异，以增强 SLGParser 的有效性。此外，我们开发了一种提示增强策略来解决由于缺少日志组而导致的性能下降。此外，我们采用高效的 Log Matcher 机制来减少 LLM 查询和时间开销。 SLGParser 揭示了 Loghub-2.0 基准手动标记的基本事实中的几个重大错误。为了验证 SLGParser 的有效性，我们对修订后的数据集进行了广泛的实验。实验结果表明，SLGParser 在准确性和效率方面显著优于最先进的日志解析器，为实际部署提供了高效实用的解决方案。

papers.title: Unifying Graph Traversals and Time Series Joins in Hybrid Graphs
papers.title_zh: 在混合图中统一图遍历和时间序列连接
papers.authors: Gianluca Rossi, Angela Bonifati, Riccardo Tommasini
papers.abstract: Graphs are highly expressive data structures for modelling and analysing relationships between real-world objects, with several applications, such as fraud detection, social and transportation networks. Traditionally, graphs and time series have been treated and studied as separate entities. However, the growing complexity of dynamic systems has highlighted the need to unify and analyse them altogether. In this paper, we address this gap for the first time by proposing an integrated approach that combines graph topology with time series data, enabling a new class of analytical queries that capture both evolving relationships and temporal patterns. We present the first declarative subgraph matching algorithm for hybrid graphs, where we leverage the subsequence join operation enriched with Allen's interval algebra to navigate the graph by computing the recurrent patterns present in time series: in this way, we can traverse the graph employing topological data and time series data to construct the resulting path. Our extensive experimental study demonstrates the efficiency and scalability of integrating time series similarity with graph pattern analysis.
papers.abstract_zh: 图是具有高度表现力的数据结构，用于建模和分析现实世界对象之间的关系，具有多种应用，例如欺诈检测、社交和交通网络。传统上，图表和时间序列被视为独立的实体并进行研究。然而，动态系统日益复杂，凸显了对它们进行统一和分析的必要性。在本文中，我们通过提出一种将图拓扑与时间序列数据相结合的集成方法，首次解决了这一差距，从而实现了一类新的分析查询，可以捕获不断变化的关系和时间模式。我们提出了第一个用于混合图的声明性子图匹配算法，其中我们利用艾伦区间代数丰富的子序列连接操作，通过计算时间序列中存在的循环模式来导航图：这样，我们可以使用拓扑数据和时间序列数据来遍历图来构造结果路径。我们广泛的实验研究证明了将时间序列相似性与图形模式分析相结合的效率和可扩展性。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: RFOD: Random Forest-based Outlier Detection for Mixed-Type Tabular Data
papers.title_zh: RFOD：混合类型表格数据的基于随机森林的异常值检测
papers.authors: Yihao Ang, Peicheng Yao, Yifan Bao, Yushuo Feng, Qiang Huang, Anthony K. H. Tung, Zhiyong Huang
papers.abstract: Outlier detection in tabular data is crucial for safeguarding data integrity in high-stakes domains such as cybersecurity, financial fraud detection, and healthcare, where anomalies can lead to severe operational and economic risks. Despite advances in both data mining and deep learning, existing methods often struggle with mixed-type tabular data, where numerical and categorical features coexist with complex dependencies and skewed distributions. They typically rely on global heuristics that overlook context-dependent irregularities, while deep neural models require heavy preprocessing and sacrifice interpretability. To overcome these challenges, we introduce RFOD, a Random Forest-based Outlier Detection framework that reformulates anomaly detection as a series of feature-wise conditional reconstruction tasks. Each random forest predicts a feature conditioned on the others, capturing localized dependencies and uncovering both global and subsetspecific anomalies without explicit context definition. For precise and interpretable detection, RFOD integrates adjusted Gower's distance (AGD), which adapts to skewed numerical data and accounts for categorical confidence, with uncertainty-weighted averaging (UWA) to aggregate cell-level scores into robust rowlevel anomaly scores. Extensive experiments on 15 real-world datasets show that RFOD consistently outperforms ten stateof-the-art baselines, achieving an average AUC-ROC gain of 16.9% over data-mining methods and 25.7% over deep-learning approaches, while maintaining superior robustness, scalability, and interpretability on mixed-type tabular data. Code is available at https://github.com/YihaoAng/RFOD/.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据中的异常值检测对于保护网络安全、金融欺诈检测和医疗保健等高风险领域的数据完整性至关重要，这些领域的异常可能导致严重的运营和经济风险。尽管数据挖掘和深度学习都取得了进步，但现有方法常常难以处理混合类型的表格数据，其中数值和分类特征与复杂的依赖关系和偏态分布共存。它们通常依赖于全局启发法，而忽略了上下文相关的不规则性，而深度神经模型需要大量的预处理并牺牲可解释性。为了克服这些挑战，我们引入了 RFOD，这是一种基于随机森林的异常值检测框架，它将异常检测重新表述为一系列特征方面的条件重建任务。每个随机森林预测一个以其他随机森林为条件的特征，捕获局部依赖性并在没有明确上下文定义的情况下发现全局和子集特定的异常。为了实现精确且可解释的检测，RFOD 集成了调整后的高尔距离 (AGD)，该距离可适应倾斜的数值数据并考虑分类置信度，并与不确定性加权平均 (UWA) 相结合，将单元格级别分数聚合为稳健的行级别异常分数。对 15 个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，RFOD 始终优于 10 个最先进的基线，与数据挖掘方法相比，平均 AUC-ROC 增益提高 16.9%，与深度学习方法相比，平均 AUC-ROC 增益提高 25.7%，同时在混合类型表格数据上保持卓越的鲁棒性、可扩展性和可解释性。代码可在 https://github.com/YihaoAng/RFOD/ 获取。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
papers.title_zh: CAMMSR：用于多模态顺序推荐的类别引导专家的细心混合
papers.authors: Jinfeng Xu, Zheyu Chen, Shuo Yang, Jinze Li, Hewei Wang, Yijie Li, Jianheng Tang, Yunhuai Liu, Edith Ngai
papers.abstract: The explosion of multimedia data in information-rich environments has intensified the challenges of personalized content discovery, positioning recommendation systems as an essential form of passive data management. Multimodal sequential recommendation, which leverages diverse item information such as text and images, has shown great promise in enriching item representations and deepening the understanding of user interests. However, most existing models rely on heuristic fusion strategies that fail to capture the dynamic and context-sensitive nature of user-modal interactions. In real-world scenarios, user preferences for modalities vary not only across individuals but also within the same user across different items or categories. Moreover, the synergistic effects between modalities-where combined signals trigger user interest in ways isolated modalities cannot-remain largely underexplored. To this end, we propose CAMMSR, a Category-guided Attentive Mixture of Experts model for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation. At its core, CAMMSR introduces a category-guided attentive mixture of experts (CAMoE) module, which learns specialized item representations from multiple perspectives and explicitly models inter-modal synergies. This component dynamically allocates modality weights guided by an auxiliary category prediction task, enabling adaptive fusion of multimodal signals. Additionally, we design a modality swap contrastive learning task to enhance cross-modal representation alignment through sequence-level augmentation. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that CAMMSR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating its effectiveness in achieving adaptive, synergistic, and user-centric multimodal sequential recommendation.
papers.abstract_zh: 信息丰富的环境中多媒体数据的爆炸式增长加剧了个性化内容发现的挑战，将推荐系统定位为被动数据管理的基本形式。多模态顺序推荐利用文本和图像等多种项目信息，在丰富项目表示和加深对用户兴趣的理解方面显示出巨大的前景。然而，大多数现有模型依赖于启发式融合策略，无法捕获用户模式交互的动态和上下文敏感性质。在现实场景中，用户对模式的偏好不仅因个体而异，而且同一用户对不同项目或类别的偏好也不同。此外，模式之间的协同效应——组合信号以孤立模式无法激发用户兴趣的方式——在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了 CAMMSR，一种用于多模态顺序推荐的类别引导的注意混合专家模型。 CAMMSR 的核心是引入了类别引导的细心混合专家 (CAMoE) 模块，该模块从多个角度学习专门的项目表示，并显式地模拟模间协同效应。该组件在辅助类别预测任务的指导下动态分配模态权重，从而实现多模态信号的自适应融合。此外，我们设计了模态交换对比学习任务，以通过序列级增强来增强跨模态表示对齐。对四个公共数据集的广泛实验表明，CAMMSR 始终优于最先进的基线，验证了其在实现自适应、协同和以用户为中心的多模态顺序推荐方面的有效性。

papers.title: CactusDB: Unlock Co-Optimization Opportunities for SQL Queries and AI/ML Model Inferences
papers.title_zh: CactusDB：解锁 SQL 查询和 AI/ML 模型推理的协同优化机会
papers.authors: Lixi Zhou, Kanchan Chowdhury, Lulu Xie, Jaykumar  Tandel, Hong Guan, Zhiwei Fan, Xinwei Fu, Jia Zou
papers.abstract: There is a growing demand for supporting inference queries that combine Structured Query Language (SQL) and Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (AI/ML) model inferences in database systems, to avoid data denormalization and transfer, facilitate management, and alleviate privacy concerns. Co-optimization techniques for executing inference queries in database systems without accuracy loss fall into four categories: (O1) Relational algebra optimization treating AI/ML models as black-box user-defined functions (UDFs); (O2) Factorized AI/ML inferences; (O3) Tensor-relational transformation; and (O4) General cross-optimization techniques. However, we found none of the existing database systems support all these techniques simultaneously, resulting in suboptimal performance. In this work, we identify two key challenges to address the above problem: (1) the difficulty of unifying all co-optimization techniques that involve disparate data and computation abstractions in one system; and (2) the lack of an optimizer that can effectively explore the exponential search space. To address these challenges, we present CactusDB, a novel system built atop Velox - a highperformance, UDF-centric database engine, open-sourced by Meta. CactusDB features a three-level Intermediate Representations (IR) that supports relational operators, expression operators, and ML functions to enable flexible optimization of arbitrary sub-computations. Additionally, we propose a novel Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based optimizer with query embedding, co-designed with our unique three-level IR, enabling shared and reusable optimization knowledge across different queries. Evaluation of 12 representative inference workloads and 2, 000 randomly generated inference queries on well-known datasets, such as MovieLens and TPCx-AI, shows that CactusDB achieves up to 441× speedup compared to alternative systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们越来越需要支持在数据库系统中结合结构化查询语言 (SQL) 和人工智能/机器学习 (AI/ML) 模型推理的推理查询，以避免数据非规范化和传输、方便管理并减轻隐私问题。在数据库系统中执行推理查询而不损失准确性的协同优化技术分为四类： (O1) 将 AI/ML 模型视为黑盒用户定义函数 (UDF) 的关系代数优化； (O2) 因子式 AI/ML 推理； (O3) 张量关系变换； (O4) 一般交叉优化技术。然而，我们发现现有的数据库系统都没有同时支持所有这些技术，从而导致性能不佳。在这项工作中，我们确定了解决上述问题的两个关键挑战：（1）在一个系统中统一涉及不同数据和计算抽象的所有协同优化技术的困难； (2)缺乏能够有效探索指数搜索空间的优化器。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 CactusDB，这是一个构建在 Velox 之上的新颖系统，Velox 是一个高性能、以 UDF 为中心的数据库引擎，由 Meta 开源。 CactusDB 具有三级中间表示 (IR)，支持关系运算符、表达式运算符和 ML 函数，以实现任意子计算的灵活优化。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的基于蒙特卡罗树搜索（MCTS）的优化器，具有查询嵌入功能，与我们独特的三级 IR 共同设计，实现跨不同查询的共享和可重用优化知识。对著名数据集（例如 MovieLens 和 TPCx-AI）上 12 个代表性推理工作负载和 2, 000 个随机生成的推理查询的评估表明，与替代系统相比，CactusDB 实现了高达 441 倍的加速。

papers.title: DistVec: Efficient Distributed Machine Learning in Parallel Database Systems
papers.title_zh: DistVec：并行数据库系统中的高效分布式机器学习
papers.authors: Xinyi Zhang, Liangzu Liu, Xupeng Miao, Yinjun  Wu, Zhen Chen, Wei Lu, Xiaoyong Du, Bin Cui
papers.abstract: Embedding vectors are widely used in various database-related domains. However, efficiently training largescale embeddings directly on DB-resident data remains a challenge, despite the ongoing efforts on supporting machine learning algorithms in database management systems, known as in-DBMS ML. Although current UDAF-based (User-Defined Aggregate Function) approach can support distributed training across parallel DBMS nodes, it enforces strict consistency during model synchronization, leading to high synchronization overhead. Additionally, the incompatibility between DBMS storage architectures and ML workloads further complicates efficient integration. To address these challenges, we propose DistVec, an inDBMS ML framework for efficient distributed training. DistVec introduces multi-query training primitives, that map distributed ML training tasks into concurrent database queries, allowing bounded staleness in model parameters to reduce synchronization costs. Besides, DistVec features an ML-customized model processing pipeline in database, including model materialization, buffer pool eviction, and hotness-aware caching, which minimize disk I/O and remote communication for the ML training workload. Experiments on the Greenplum database show that DistVec achieves an average speedup of 4.53× over UDAF-based training approaches while preserving the model quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 嵌入向量广泛应用于各种数据库相关领域。然而，尽管人们一直在努力支持数据库管理系统中的机器学习算法（称为 DBMS 内 ML），但直接在数据库驻留数据上有效地训练大规模嵌入仍然是一个挑战。虽然当前基于 UDAF（用户定义聚合函数）的方法可以支持跨并行 DBMS 节点的分布式训练，但它在模型同步过程中强制执行严格的一致性，导致较高的同步开销。此外，DBMS 存储架构和 ML 工作负载之间的不兼容进一步使高效集成变得复杂。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DistVec，一种用于高效分布式训练的 inDBMS ML 框架。 DistVec 引入了多查询训练原语，将分布式 ML 训练任务映射到并发数据库查询中，允许模型参数的有限陈旧性以降低同步成本。此外，DistVec 在数据库中具有 ML 定制的模型处理管道，包括模型实现、缓冲池驱逐和热感知缓存，可最大限度地减少 ML 训练工作负载的磁盘 I/O 和远程通信。 Greenplum 数据库上的实验表明，与基于 UDAF 的训练方法相比，DistVec 平均加速了 4.53 倍，同时保持了模型质量。

papers.title: Geography-Aware Large Language Model for Next POI Recommendation
papers.title_zh: 用于下一个 POI 推荐的地理感知大型语言模型
papers.authors: Wei Liu, Zhao Liu, Muzu Xie, Huaijie Zhu, Jianxing Yu, Jian Yin, Wang-Chien Lee
papers.abstract: The next Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation task, which predicts a user's subsequent destination based on historical mobility data, is a key problem in location-based services and personalized data management. Accurate next POI recommendation requires effective modeling of geographic dependencies and collaborative transition relations between POIs. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic and contextual reasoning capabilities, their direct applications to spatial recommendation remains limited due to two major challenges: (1) Sparse coordinate semantics, where the infrequent appearance of specific GPS coordinates impairs fine-grained spatial representation learning; and (2) Lack of transition priors, where the absence of POI-POI transition knowledge constrains LLMs' ability to infer movement patterns. To address these challenges, we propose Geography-Aware Large Language Model (GA-LLM), a unified framework that injects spatial and transition knowledge into LLMs. The Geographic Coordinate Injection Module (GCIM) transforms GPS coordinates into hierarchical and continuous spectral embeddings, enabling multi-scale geographic understanding. The POI Alignment Module (PAM) integrates collaborative transition relations into the LLM's semantic manifold, allowing it to infer global POI associations and generalize to unseen POIs for users. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that GA-LLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-arts by up to 24.10% in next-POI recommendation accuracy (e.g., Acc@5 and MRR@5). Source code is available at: https://github.com/hugh2009hugh/GA-LLM.
papers.abstract_zh: 下一个兴趣点（POI）推荐任务根据历史移动数据预测用户的后续目的地，是基于位置的服务和个性化数据管理的关键问题。准确的下一个POI推荐需要对POI之间的地理依赖关系和协作转换关系进行有效的建模。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）表现出强大的语义和上下文推理能力，但由于两个主要挑战，它们在空间推荐中的直接应用仍然受到限制：（1）稀疏坐标语义，其中特定GPS坐标的罕见出现损害了细粒度的空间表示学习； (2) 缺乏转换先验，缺乏 POI-POI 转换知识限制了大语言模型推断运动模式的能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了地理感知大语言模型（GA-LLM），这是一个将空间和转换知识注入大语言模型的统一框架。地理坐标注入模块 (GCIM) 将 GPS 坐标转换为分层且连续的光谱嵌入，从而实现多尺度地理理解。 POI 对齐模块 (PAM) 将协作转换关系集成到 LLM 的语义流形中，使其能够推断全局 POI 关联并推广到用户未见过的 POI。对三个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，GA-LLM 在下一个 POI 推荐准确度（例如 Acc@5 和 MRR@5）方面始终优于最先进的技术高达 24.10%。源代码位于：https://github.com/hugh2009hugh/GA-LLM。

papers.title: Label-Constrained Column Annotation with Language Models and Graph Neural Networks
papers.title_zh: 使用语言模型和图神经网络进行标签约束列注释
papers.authors: Duo Yang, Ioannis Dasoulas, Anastasia Dimou
papers.abstract: Assigning semantic labels to table columns and identifying relations between columns pose significant challenges in data management. Automatic column annotation has been widely treated as classification, with recent works using language models trained on annotated tables with type and property labels. While these language models have effectively modeled individual tables, they often overlook the underlying graph structure of the label space, where constraints can exist between certain types and properties within and across tables. To fill this gap, we propose RODEO, a two-tower architecture that integrates a language model and a graph neural network (GNN) to model the table and semantic labels, respectively. We reformulate column annotation tasks from classification to matching problems, where column and column-pair embeddings are aligned with embeddings that represent their corresponding semantic types (nodes) and properties (edges) within the graph. These embeddings, derived from the language model and GNN, are co-trained end-to-end using triplet loss with an online negative mining strategy. The training process brings semantically related columns and labels closer in the embedding space by minimizing their distances. Our approach, evaluated on publicly available benchmark datasets, outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both column type and column property annotation, highlighting that modeling label constraints through the graph significantly improves overall performance. Ablation studies on the triplet loss and GNN show the robustness of our framework's training procedure.
papers.abstract_zh: 为表列分配语义标签并识别列之间的关系给数据管理带来了重大挑战。自动列注释已被广泛视为分类，最近的工作使用在带有类型和属性标签的注释表上训练的语言模型。虽然这些语言模型有效地对各个表进行了建模，但它们经常忽略标签空间的底层图形结构，其中表内和表间的某些类型和属性之间可能存在约束。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 RODEO，这是一种两塔架构，集成了语言模型和图神经网络（GNN），分别对表和语义标签进行建模。我们重新制定从分类到匹配问题的列注释任务，其中列和列对嵌入与表示其在图中相应语义类型（节点）和属性（边）的嵌入对齐。这些嵌入源自语言模型和 GNN，使用三元组损失和在线负挖掘策略进行端到端联合训练。训练过程通过最小化它们的距离，使语义相关的列和标签在嵌入空间中更加接近。我们的方法在公开可用的基准数据集上进行了评估，在列类型和列属性注释方面都优于最先进的方法，这凸显了通过图形对标签约束进行建模显著提高了整体性能。对三元组损失和 GNN 的消融研究表明了我们框架训练过程的稳健性。

papers.title: When Complex Event Recognition Meets Cloud-Native Architectures
papers.title_zh: 当复杂事件识别遇到云原生架构
papers.authors: Shizhe Liu, Haipeng Dai, Meng Li, Yuemeng Zhang, Shaoxu Song, Zhifeng Bao, Hancheng Wang, Xiaofeng Gao, Guihai Chen
papers.abstract: Complex Event Recognition (CER) aims to detect a predefined pattern composed of multiple primitive events. With the growing adoption of cloud-native techniques (i.e., computing and storage separation), which offer elasticity, availability, and cost efficiency, many database vendors are migrating their products to such architectures. However, when CER operates in cloud-native architectures, network becomes a performance bottleneck. To mitigate network-induced performance degradation, our key insight is to identify shorter time intervals that contain matches and transmit only the events within those intervals, hence reducing the transfer of irrelevant events. Upon this insight, we first propose a dual-filtering strategy that leverages both temporal and predicate constraints under multiple round-trips to incrementally shrink the time intervals. Then, we design two specialized filters: the shrinking window filter which reduces the complexity of time intervals maintenance from $O(N \log N)$ to $O(N)$, and the window-wise join filter, which enables low-cost round-trips for processing equality conditions. Furthermore, we propose a cost model to eliminate detrimental round-trips and prevent inefficiencies caused by excessively fine-grained round-trips. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate CER in cloud-native architectures. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach reduces transmission cost by over $\mathbf{7 0 \%}$ and achieves a $\mathbf{1. 2} \times$ to $\mathbf{2 5} \times$ end-to-end query speedup across various evaluation engines (e.g., Flink and Esper) on the real-world and synthetic datasets, compared with the state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 复杂事件识别（CER）旨在检测由多个原始事件组成的预定义模式。随着提供弹性、可用性和成本效率的云原生技术（即计算和存储分离）的日益采用，许多数据库供应商正在将其产品迁移到此类架构。然而，当CER运行在云原生架构中时，网络成为性能瓶颈。为了减轻网络引起的性能下降，我们的关键见解是识别包含匹配的较短时间间隔，并仅传输这些间隔内的事件，从而减少不相关事件的传输。基于这一见解，我们首先提出了一种双重过滤策略，该策略在多次往返下利用时间和谓词约束来逐步缩小时间间隔。然后，我们设计了两个专门的过滤器：收缩窗口过滤器，将时间间隔维护的复杂性从 $O(N \log N)$ 降低到 $O(N)$，以及窗口明智的连接过滤器，它支持处理相等条件的低成本往返。此外，我们提出了一种成本模型，以消除有害的往返并防止由于过于细粒度的往返而导致效率低下。据我们所知，这是第一项调查云原生架构中 CER 的研究。广泛的评估表明，我们的方法将传输成本降低了超过 $\mathbf{7 0 \%}$，并实现了 $\mathbf{1. 2} \times$ 到 $\mathbf{2 5} \times$ 与最先进的方法相比，在现实世界和合成数据集上的各种评估引擎（例如 Flink 和 Esper）的端到端查询加速。

papers.title: RISK: Efficiently processing rich spatial-keyword queries on encrypted geo-textual data
papers.title_zh: 风险：有效处理加密地理文本数据上丰富的空间关键字查询
papers.authors: Zhen Lv, Cong Cao, Hongwei Huo, Jiangtao Cui, Yanguo Peng, Hui Li, Yingfan Liu
papers.abstract: Symmetric searchable encryption (SSE) for geo-textual data has attracted significant attention. However, existing schemes rely on task-specific, incompatible indices for isolated specific secure queries (e.g., range or k-nearest neighbor spatial-keyword queries), limiting practicality due to prohibitive multi-index overhead. To address this, we propose RISK, a model for rich spatial-keyword queries on encrypted geo-textual data. In a textual-first-then-spatial manner, RISK is built on a novel k-nearest neighbor quadtree (kQ-tree) that embeds representative and regional nearest neighbors, with the kQ-tree further encrypted using standard cryptographic tools (e.g., keyed hash functions and symmetric encryption). Overall, RISK seamlessly supports both secure range and k-nearest neighbor queries, is provably secure under IND-CKA2 model, and extensible to multi-party scenarios and dynamic updates. Experiments on three real-world and one synthetic datasets show that RISK outperforms state-of-the-art methods by at least 0.5 and 4 orders of magnitude in response time for 1% range queries and 10-nearest neighbor queries, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 用于地理文本数据的对称可搜索加密（SSE）引起了广泛关注。然而，现有方案依赖于特定于任务的、不兼容的索引来进行隔离的特定安全查询（例如，范围或k最近邻空间关键字查询），由于多索引开销过高而限制了实用性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 RISK，一种针对加密地理文本数据进行丰富空间关键字查询的模型。以先文本后空间的方式，RISK 建立在一种新颖的 k 近邻四叉树（kQ 树）之上，该四叉树嵌入代表性和区域最近邻，并且 kQ 树使用标准加密工具（例如密钥哈希函数和对称加密）进一步加密。总体而言，RISK无缝支持安全范围和k近邻查询，在IND-CKA2模型下可证明安全，并且可扩展到多方场景和动态更新。对三个真实数据集和一个合成数据集的实验表明，对于 1% 范围查询和 10 个最近邻查询，RISK 的响应时间分别比最先进的方法至少高出 0.5 和 4 个数量级。

papers.title: ABC: Numerical Data Collection under Local Differential Privacy without Prior Knowledge
papers.title_zh: ABC：本地差分隐私下无先验知识的数值数据收集
papers.authors: Incheol Baek, Hyungbin Kim, Yon Dohn Chung
papers.abstract: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) provides strong privacy guarantees for collecting numerical data. A fundamental challenge, however, is that existing LDP mechanisms require a predefined data domain, which is often unknown in practice. This lack of prior knowledge creates a critical dilemma for the data collector: if the chosen domain is too narrow, values outside the range are clipped, leading to information loss. Conversely, if the domain is too wide, excessive noise is added during the privatization process, which degrades the quality of collected data. This highlights the need for methods that can dynamically estimate the data domain. In this work, we propose an adaptive LDP framework that addresses this problem. In our method, each user sends two pieces of information: their perturbed numerical data, and a privatized signal indicating if their original value was clipped by the current domain. By aggregating these signals, our proposed method, Adaptive Bounding of Clipping regions (ABC) method, iteratively adjusts the domain to fit the underlying data distribution without prior knowledge. Our theoretical analysis shows that the estimated data domain converges to an appropriate range. In the empirical evaluation, the results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves the quality of numerical data collection across various datasets and underlying LDP mechanisms. We also show that the estimated range successfully converges in practice and our approach is robust to its hyperparameters through comprehensive ablation studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 本地差分隐私 (LDP) 为收集数值数据提供了强有力的隐私保证。然而，一个根本的挑战是现有的 LDP 机制需要预定义的数据域，而这在实践中通常是未知的。缺乏先验知识给数据收集者带来了一个严重的困境：如果选择的域太窄，范围之外的值就会被剪掉，从而导致信息丢失。相反，如果域太宽，则会在私有化过程中添加过多的噪声，从而降低收集数据的质量。这凸显了对能够动态估计数据域的方法的需求。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个自适应 LDP 框架来解决这个问题。在我们的方法中，每个用户发送两条信息：他们受到干扰的数值数据，以及指示其原始值是否被当前域剪切的私有化信号。通过聚合这些信号，我们提出的方法，即自适应裁剪区域边界（ABC）方法，可以迭代调整域以适应基础数据分布，而无需先验知识。我们的理论分析表明，估计的数据域收敛到适当的范围。在实证评估中，结果表明我们的框架显著提高了跨各种数据集和底层 LDP 机制的数值数据收集的质量。我们还表明，估计范围在实践中成功收敛，并且通过全面的消融研究，我们的方法对其超参数具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: REMON: Remote External Memory Over the Network
papers.title_zh: REMON：通过网络远程外部存储器
papers.authors: Shiquan Zhang, Michail Bachras, Yuqiu Zhang, Yunhao Mao, Hans-Arno Jacobsen
papers.abstract: Modern database systems face significant challenges in managing memory efficiently, especially under conditions of resource heterogeneity, constrained local memory, and growing dataset sizes. To address these issues, we introduce REMON, a lightweight, software-based disaggregated memory system that leverages remote memory resources over the standard networking stack. REMON employs page-level memory management and efficient swapping mechanisms, enabling seamless memory allocation, release, and swapping between compute and memory nodes. Across standard analytics benchmarks, REMON reduces average latency by up to 34% over disk swapping under memory pressure and incurs less than 15% performance loss relative to fully in-memory execution when data fits in RAM. Compared to the RDMA-based remote-memory baseline, REMON is on average 11% slower but remains deployable and cost-effective on commodity cloud instances; its benefits are strongest in lowlatency, high-bandwidth in-region clusters. With its user-space design over commodity TCP/IP and cloud-native compatibility, REMON offers a versatile, cost-effective memory extension for cloud databases.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代数据库系统在有效管理内存方面面临着重大挑战，特别是在资源异构、本地内存受限和数据集大小不断增长的情况下。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了 REMON，这是一种基于软件的轻量级分解内存系统，可通过标准网络堆栈利用远程内存资源。 REMON 采用页级内存管理和高效的交换机制，实现计算节点和内存节点之间的无缝内存分配、释放和交换。在标准分析基准测试中，与内存压力下的磁盘交换相比，REMON 将平均延迟降低了高达 34%，并且当数据适合 RAM 时，相对于完全内存执行，性能损失不到 15%。与基于 RDMA 的远程内存基准相比，REMON 平均慢 11%，但在商用云实例上仍然可部署且经济高效；它的优势在低延迟、高带宽的区域内集群中最为明显。凭借其基于商品 TCP/IP 的用户空间设计和云原生兼容性，REMON 为云数据库提供了多功能、经济高效的内存扩展。

papers.title: Incremental GNN Embedding Computation on Streaming Graphs
papers.title_zh: 流图上的增量 GNN 嵌入计算
papers.authors: Qiange Wang, Haoran Lv, Yanfeng Zhang, Weng-Fai Wong, Bingsheng He
papers.abstract: Graph Neural Network (GNN) on streaming graphs has gained increasing popularity. However, its practical deployment remains challenging, as the inference process relies on Runtime Embedding Computation (RTEC) to capture recent graph changes. This process incurs heavyweight multi-hop graph traversal overhead, which significantly undermines computation efficiency. We observe that the intermediate results for large portions of the graph remain unchanged during graph evolution, and thus redundant computations can be effectively eliminated through carefully designed incremental methods. In this work, we propose an efficient framework for incrementalizing RTEC on streaming graphs.The key idea is to decouple GNN computation into a set of generalized, fine-grained operators and safely reorder them, transforming the expensive full-neighbor GNN computation into a more efficient form over the affected subgraph. With this design, our framework preserves the semantics and accuracy of the original full-neighbor computation while supporting a wide range of GNN models with complex message-passing patterns. To further scale to graphs with massive historical results, we develop a GPU-CPU co-processing system that offloads embeddings to CPU memory with communication-optimized scheduling. Experiments across diverse graph sizes and GNN models show that our method reduces computation by 64%-99% and achieves 1.7x-145.8x speedups over existing solutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 流图上的图神经网络（GNN）越来越受欢迎。然而，其实际部署仍然具有挑战性，因为推理过程依赖运行时嵌入计算（RTEC）来捕获最近的图形变化。这个过程会产生重量级的多跳图遍历开销，这显著降低了计算效率。我们观察到，在图的演化过程中，图的大部分的中间结果保持不变，因此通过精心设计的增量方法可以有效地消除冗余计算。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种在流图上增量 RTEC 的有效框架。关键思想是将 GNN 计算解耦为一组广义的、细粒度的运算符，并安全地重新排序它们，将昂贵的全邻居 GNN 计算转换为受影响子图上更有效的形式。通过这种设计，我们的框架保留了原始全邻居计算的语义和准确性，同时支持具有复杂消息传递模式的各种 GNN 模型。为了进一步扩展到具有大量历史结果的图表，我们开发了一个 GPU-CPU 协同处理系统，通过通信优化的调度将嵌入卸载到 CPU 内存。跨不同图尺寸和 GNN 模型的实验表明，我们的方法将计算量减少了 64%-99%，并且比现有解决方案实现了 1.7x-145.8x 的加速。

papers.title: Lightweight 2-Hop Labels for Reachability Queries on Large-Scale Graphs
papers.title_zh: 用于大规模图上的可达性查询的轻量级 2 跳标签
papers.authors: Yishu Wang, Jinlong  Chu, Ye Yuan, Yu  Gu, Lianpeng Qiao
papers.abstract: Reachability queries are a fundamental problem in graph analysis. To avoid the high cost of traversal-based methods, indexing techniques have been widely studied, among which 2-hop labeling is particularly attractive due to its simplicity and query efficiency. However, maintaining reachability information for all vertices often leads to prohibitively large index sizes. Existing approaches mainly reduce index size either through carefully designed construction orders or by compressing the graph structure, but ordering-based methods suffer from limited scalability, while compression-based methods may lose reachability information. To address these issues, we propose a contraction-based 2-hop indexing framework that integrates vertex contraction into index construction, reducing the number of iterations while preserving complete reachability information on the original graph. We further design a dominance-aware contraction order and pruning strategies to significantly reduce index size. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that our method reduces index size by 1-2 orders of magnitude compared to state-of-the-art approaches, while maintaining comparable index construction and query performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 可达性查询是图分析中的一个基本问题。为了避免基于遍历的方法的高成本，索引技术被广泛研究，其中2跳标记由于其简单性和查询效率而特别有吸引力。然而，维护所有顶点的可达性信息通常会导致索引大小过大。现有方法主要通过精心设计的构造顺序或压缩图结构来减小索引大小，但基于排序的方法的可扩展性有限，而基于压缩的方法可能会丢失可达性信息。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于收缩的 2 跳索引框架，它将顶点收缩集成到索引构建中，减少迭代次数，同时保留原始图上的完整可达性信息。我们进一步设计了一种优势感知收缩顺序和修剪策略，以显著减小索引大小。对真实数据集的大量实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，我们的方法将索引大小减少了 1-2 个数量级，同时保持了可比的索引构建和查询性能。
papers.search_extra: reachability queries large-scale graphs graph reachability 可达性查询 大比例尺图表 图可达性

papers.title: WikiDBGraph: A Data Management Benchmark Suite for Collaborative Learning over Database Silos [Experiment, Analysis, and Benchmark]
papers.title_zh: WikiDBGraph：用于跨数据库孤岛进行协作学习的数据管理基准套件 [实验、分析和基准]
papers.authors: Zhaomin Wu, Ziyang Wang, Bingsheng He
papers.abstract: Relational databases are often fragmented across organizations, creating data silos that hinder distributed data management and mining. Collaborative learning (CL)-techniques that enable multiple parties to train models jointly without sharing raw data-offers a principled approach to this challenge. However, existing CL frameworks (e.g., federated and split learning) remain limited in real-world deployments. Current CL benchmarks and algorithms primarily target the learning step under assumptions of isolated, aligned, and joinable databases, and they typically neglect the end-to-end data management pipeline, especially preprocessing steps such as table joins and data alignment. In contrast, our analysis of the real-world corpus WikiDBs shows that databases are interconnected, unaligned, and sometimes unjoinable, exposing a significant gap between CL algorithm design and practical deployment. To close this evaluation gap, we build WikiDBGraph, a large-scale dataset constructed from 100,000 real-world relational databases linked by 17 million weighted edges. Each node (database) and edge (relationship) is annotated with 13 and 12 properties, respectively, capturing a hybrid of instance- and feature-level overlap across databases. Experiments on WikiDBGraph demonstrate both the effectiveness and limitations of existing CL methods under realistic conditions, highlighting previously overlooked gaps in managing real-world data silos and pointing to concrete directions for practical deployment of collaborative learning systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 关系数据库通常在各个组织中分散，形成阻碍分布式数据管理和挖掘的数据孤岛。协作学习 (CL) 技术使多方能够在不共享原始数据的情况下联合训练模型，为应对这一挑战提供了原则性方法。然而，现有的 CL 框架（例如联合学习和分割学习）在现实世界的部署中仍然受到限制。当前的 CL 基准和算法主要针对隔离、对齐和可连接数据库假设下的学习步骤，它们通常忽略端到端数据管理管道，尤其是表连接和数据对齐等预处理步骤。相比之下，我们对现实世界语料库 WikiDB 的分析表明，数据库是互连的、未对齐的，有时甚至是不可连接的，这暴露了 CL 算法设计和实际部署之间的巨大差距。为了弥补这一评估差距，我们构建了 WikiDBGraph，这是一个由 100,000 个现实世界关系数据库构建而成的大型数据集，这些数据库通过 1700 万条加权边连接起来。每个节点（数据库）和边缘（关系）分别用 13 个和 12 个属性进行注释，捕获跨数据库的实例级和特征级重叠的混合。 WikiDBGraph 上的实验证明了现有 CL 方法在现实条件下的有效性和局限性，突出了以前在管理现实世界数据孤岛方面被忽视的差距，并为协作学习系统的实际部署指明了具体方向。

papers.title: Clue-RAG: Towards Accurate and Cost-Efficient Graph-based RAG via Multi-Partite Graph-based Index
papers.title_zh: Clue-RAG：通过基于多部分图的索引实现准确且经济高效的基于图的 RAG
papers.authors: Yaodong Su, Yixiang Fang, Yingli Zhou, Chuanhui Yang
papers.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of Large Language Models (LLMs), their performance in question answering (QA) remains limited by the lack of domain-specific and up-to-date knowledge. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by incorporating external information, often from graph-structured data. However, existing graph-based RAG methods suffer from poor graph quality due to incomplete extraction and insufficient utilization of query information during retrieval. To overcome these limitations, we propose Clue-RAG, a novel approach that introduces (1) a multi-partite graph index that incorporates text Chunk, knowledge unit, and entity to capture semantic content at multiple levels of granularity, coupled with a hybrid extraction strategy that reduces LLM token usage while still producing accurate and disambiguated knowledge units, and (2) Q-Iter, a query-driven iterative retrieval strategy that enhances relevance through semantic search and constrained graph traversal. Experiments on three QA benchmarks show that Clue-RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving 32.55%/12.42% higher average F1 score/Accuracy while delivering $2.2 \times-2.4 \times$ faster offline indexing and $2.7 \times-3.9\times$ lower online query latency compared to strong baseline HippoRAG2. Remarkably, Clue-RAG matches or outperforms baselines even without using an LLM for indexing. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and cost-efficiency of Clue-RAG in advancing graph-based RAG systems. The source code is available in https://github.com/Feesuu/ClueRAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）取得了显著的进步，但它们在问答（QA）方面的表现仍然受到缺乏特定领域和最新知识的限制。检索增强生成 (RAG) 通过合并外部信息（通常来自图形结构数据）来解决此限制。然而，现有的基于图的RAG方法由于提取不完整和检索过程中查询信息利用不足而导致图质量较差。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 Clue-RAG，这是一种新颖的方法，它引入了（1）一种多部分图索引，它结合了文本块、知识单元和实体，以捕获多个粒度级别的语义内容，再加上混合提取策略，减少了 LLM 令牌的使用，同时仍然生成准确和消除歧义的知识单元；（2）Q-Iter，一种查询驱动的迭代检索策略，通过语义搜索和约束图遍历来增强相关性。对三个 QA 基准的实验表明，Clue-RAG 的性能显著优于最先进的基线，与强大的基线 HippoRAG2 相比，平均 F1 分数/准确度提高了 32.55%/12.42%，同时离线索引速度达到其 2.2 至 2.4 倍，在线查询延迟降至其 1/2.7 至 1/3.9。值得注意的是，即使不使用 LLM 进行索引，Clue-RAG 也能匹配或优于基线。这些结果证明了 Clue-RAG 在推进基于图的 RAG 系统方面的有效性和成本效益。源代码可在 https://github.com/Feesuu/ClueRAG 中获取。

papers.title: Vireo: Human-in-the-Loop DBMS Fuzzing with Visualization and LLM Support
papers.title_zh: Vireo：具有可视化和 LLM 支持的人在环 DBMS 模糊测试
papers.authors: Jie Liang, Zhiyong Wu, Jingzhou Fu, Chi Zhang, Runpei Miao, Zhuo Su, Yu Jiang, Shuai Ma
papers.abstract: DBMSs are critical infrastructures that directly affect the security and correctness of many dependent applications. Recent advances in DBMS fuzzing have improved coverage and efficiency, discovering many bugs. However, in practice, many DBMS fuzzers explore only a limited state space, as many functionalities involve complex constraints that require specific sequences of SQL statements and configurations, which automated methods struggle to satisfy. Moreover, many testing approaches lack an understanding of the DBMS testing state and typically run under a single configuration with fixed fuzzing strategies. Consequently, as testing progresses, coverage growth slows, and potential bugs may remain undetected. In this paper, we propose VIREO, a human-in-the-loop DBMS fuzzing framework with visualization and LLM support with two stages. In the preparation stage, VIREO analyzes source code and documentation, leveraging LLMs to construct mappings between each function module and its associated grammar rules and configurations. During the fuzzing stage, VIREO visualizes module-level coverage and bug distributions to reveal potential test boundaries. Test engineers use their domain knowledge to select modules for focused exploration. VIREO then provides the corresponding grammar rules and configuration adjustments, which engineers review to guide the fuzzer, and may also use to construct SQL queries to further enhance testing of the target modules. We have implemented VIREO and evaluated it on 5 welltested DBMSs like PostgreSQL and MySQL. VIREO discovered a total of 25 previously unknown bugs, all of which were confirmed, and 10 have been fixed. Developers provided positive feedback. For example, PostgreSQL developers acknowledged that one identified bug exposed a planner assumption “previously believed unreachable by crafted input.”
papers.abstract_zh: DBMS 是直接影响许多相关应用程序的安全性和正确性的关键基础设施。 DBMS 模糊测试的最新进展提高了覆盖范围和效率，发现了许多错误。然而，在实践中，许多 DBMS 模糊器仅探索有限的状态空间，因为许多功能涉及复杂的约束，需要特定的 SQL 语句序列和配置，而自动化方法很难满足这些要求。此外，许多测试方法缺乏对 DBMS 测试状态的理解，并且通常在具有固定模糊测试策略的单一配置下运行。因此，随着测试的进展，覆盖范围增长放缓，并且潜在的错误可能仍未被发现。在本文中，我们提出了 VIREO，一种人机循环 DBMS 模糊测试框架，具有可视化和两阶段 LLM 支持。在准备阶段，VIREO分析源代码和文档，利用LLM构建每个功能模块与其相关语法规则和配置之间的映射。在模糊测试阶段，VIREO 可视化模块级覆盖范围和错误分布，以揭示潜在的测试边界。测试工程师利用他们的领域知识来选择模块进行重点探索。然后，VIREO 提供相应的语法规则和配置调整，工程师可以对其进行审查以指导模糊器，也可以使用它们构建 SQL 查询以进一步增强对目标模块的测试。我们已经实现了 VIREO，并在 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 等 5 个经过充分测试的 DBMS 上对其进行了评估。 VIREO 共发现了 25 个以前未知的 bug，目前已全部确认，其中 10 个已修复。开发人员提供了积极的反馈。例如，PostgreSQL 开发人员承认，一个已识别的错误暴露了规划者的假设“以前认为通过精心设计的输入无法实现”。

papers.title: LEAF-SQL: Level-wise Exploration with Adaptive Fine-graining for Text-to-SQL Skeleton Prediction
papers.title_zh: LEAF-SQL：使用自适应细粒度进行逐级探索，用于文本到 SQL 骨架预测
papers.authors: Zhao Tan, Xiping Liu, Qing Shu, Qizhi Wan, Dexi Liu, Changxuan Wan
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL translates natural language questions into executable SQL queries, enabling intuitive database access for non-experts. While large language models achieve strong performance on Text-to-SQL with prompting, they still struggle with complex queries that involve deeply nested logic or multiple clauses. A widely used approach employs SQL skeletons--intermediate representations of query logic--to streamline generation, but existing methods are limited by their reliance on a single structural hypothesis and lack of progressive reasoning. To overcome these limitations, we propose LEAF-SQL, a novel framework that reframes skeleton prediction as a coarse-to-fine tree search process. LEAF-SQL enables systematic exploration of diverse structural hypotheses with adaptive refinement. Several key techniques are employed in LEAF-SQL: (1) a three-level skeleton hierarchy to guide the search, (2) a Skeleton Formulation Agent to generate diverse candidates, and (3) a Skeleton Evaluation Agent to efficiently prune the search space. This integrated design yields skeleton candidates that are both structurally diverse and granularity-adaptive, providing a stronger foundation for the SQL generation. Extensive experiments show that LEAF-SQL consistently improves the performance of various LLM backbones. On the official hidden test set of the challenging BIRD benchmark, our method achieves 71.6 execution accuracy, which outperforms leading search-based and skeleton-based methods, affirming its effectiveness for complex queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到 SQL 将自然语言问题转换为可执行的 SQL 查询，使非专家能够直观地访问数据库。虽然大型语言模型通过提示在文本到 SQL 上实现了强大的性能，但它们仍然难以处理涉及深度嵌套逻辑或多个子句的复杂查询。一种广泛使用的方法采用 SQL 骨架（查询逻辑的中间表示）来简化生成，但现有方法由于依赖单一结构假设且缺乏渐进式推理而受到限制。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 LEAF-SQL，这是一种新颖的框架，它将骨架预测重新构建为从粗到细的树搜索过程。 LEAF-SQL 能够通过自适应细化系统地探索不同的结构假设。 LEAF-SQL 采用了多项关键技术：(1) 一个三级骨架层次结构来指导搜索，(2) 一个骨架制定代理来生成不同的候选者，(3) 一个骨架评估代理来有效地修剪搜索空间。这种集成设计产生了结构多样且粒度自适应的候选骨架，为 SQL 生成提供了更坚实的基础。大量实验表明，LEAF-SQL 持续提高了各种 LLM 主干的性能。在具有挑战性的 BIRD 基准的官方隐藏测试集上，我们的方法实现了 71.6 的执行精度，优于领先的基于搜索和基于骨架的方法，证实了其对于复杂查询的有效性。

papers.title: An Efficient and Effective Evaluator for Text2SQL Models on Unseen and Unlabeled Data
papers.title_zh: 针对未见和未标记数据的 Text2SQL 模型的高效评估器
papers.authors: Khanh Trinh Pham, Thanh Tam Nguyen, Viet Huynh, Hongzhi Yin, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models have strengthened Text2SQL systems that translate natural language questions into database queries. A persistent deployment challenge is to assess a newly trained Text2SQL system on an unseen and unlabeled dataset when no verified answers are available. This situation arises frequently because database content and structure evolve, privacy policies slow manual review, and carefully written SQL labels are costly and time-consuming. Without timely evaluation, organizations cannot approve releases or detect failures early. FusionSQL addresses this gap by working with any Text2SQL models and estimating accuracy without reference labels, allowing teams to measure quality on unseen and unlabeled datasets. It analyzes patterns in the system's own outputs to characterize how the target dataset differs from the material used during training. FusionSQL supports pre-release checks, continuous monitoring of new databases, and detection of quality decline. Experiments across diverse application settings and question types show that FusionSQL closely follows actual accuracy and reliably signals emerging issues. Our code is available at https://github.com/phkhanhtrinh23/FusionSQL.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的最新进展增强了将自然语言问题转换为数据库查询的 Text2SQL 系统。持续的部署挑战是在没有经过验证的答案可用时，在看不见且未标记的数据集上评估新训练的 Text2SQL 系统。这种情况经常出现，因为数据库内容和结构不断变化、隐私策略减慢了人工审核速度、精心编写的 SQL 标签成本高昂且耗时。如果没有及时评估，组织就无法批准发布或及早发现故障。 FusionSQL 通过使用任何 Text2SQL 模型并在没有参考标签的情况下估计准确性来解决这一差距，从而允许团队测量看不见和未标记的数据集的质量。它分析系统自身输出中的模式，以描述目标数据集与训练期间使用的材料有何不同。 FusionSQL支持预发布检查、新数据库持续监控以及质量下降检测。跨不同应用程序设置和问题类型的实验表明，FusionSQL 紧密遵循实际准确性并可靠地发出新出现的问题信号。我们的代码可从 https://github.com/phkhanhtrinh23/FusionSQL 获取。

papers.title: Boosting Small Language Models for Text-to-SQL with Fine-Grained Execution Feedback and Cost-Efficient Rewards
papers.title_zh: 通过细粒度的执行反馈和经济高效的奖励来增强文本到 SQL 的小型语言模型
papers.authors: Thanh Dat Hoang, Thanh Trung Huynh, Matthias Weidlich, Thanh Tam Nguyen, Tong Chen, Hongzhi Yin, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen
papers.abstract: Large language models have driven major advances in Text-to-SQL generation. However, they suffer from high computational cost, long latency, and data privacy concerns, which make them impractical for many real-world applications. A natural alternative is to use small language models (SLMs), which enable efficient and private on-premise deployment. Yet, SLMs often struggle with weak reasoning and poor instruction following. Conventional reinforcement learning methods based on sparse binary rewards (0/1) provide little learning signal when the generated SQLs are incorrect, leading to unstable or collapsed training. To overcome these issues, we propose FINER-SQL, a scalable and reusable reinforcement learning framework that enhances SLMs through fine-grained execution feedback. Built on group relative policy optimization, FINER-SQL replaces sparse supervision with dense and interpretable rewards that offer continuous feedback even for incorrect SQLs. It introduces two key reward functions: a memory reward, which aligns reasoning with verified traces for semantic stability, and an atomic reward, which measures operation-level overlap to grant partial credit for structurally correct but incomplete SQLs. This approach transforms discrete correctness into continuous learning, enabling stable, critic-free optimization. Experiments on the BIRD and Spider benchmarks show that FINER-SQL achieves up to 67.73% and 85% execution accuracy with a 3B model - matching much larger LLMs while reducing inference latency to 5.57 s/sample. These results highlight a cost-efficient and privacy-preserving path toward high-performance Text-to-SQL generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/thanhdath/finer-sql.
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型推动了文本到 SQL 生成的重大进步。然而，它们面临高计算成本、长延迟和数据隐私问题，这使得它们对于许多现实世界的应用程序来说不切实际。自然的替代方案是使用小型语言模型 (SLM)，它可以实现高效且私密的本地部署。然而，SLM 常常面临推理薄弱和指令遵循不力的问题。当生成的 SQL 不正确时，基于稀疏二元奖励 (0/1) 的传统强化学习方法提供的学习信号很少，从而导致训练不稳定或崩溃。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了 FINER-SQL，这是一种可扩展且可重用的强化学习框架，可通过细粒度的执行反馈来增强 SLM。 FINER-SQL 基于组相关策略优化而构建，用密集且可解释的奖励取代了稀疏的监督，即使对于不正确的 SQL，也能提供持续的反馈。它引入了两个关键的奖励函数：一个是内存奖励，它将推理与经过验证的痕迹结合起来以实现语义稳定性；另一个是原子奖励，它测量操作级别的重叠，为结构正确但不完整的 SQL 授予部分信用。这种方法将离散正确性转化为连续学习，从而实现稳定、无批评的优化。 BIRD 和 Spider 基准测试表明，FINER-SQL 在 3B 模型中实现了高达 67.73% 和 85% 的执行精度 - 匹配更大的 LLM，同时将推理延迟降低到 5.57 秒/样本。这些结果凸显了一条实现高性能文本到 SQL 生成的经济高效且保护隐私的路径。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/thanhdath/finer-sql 获取。

papers.title: PAT: Towards Transaction Routing with Page Affinity in Shared-Cache Databases
papers.title_zh: PAT：在共享缓存数据库中实现具有页面亲和力的事务路由
papers.authors: Zhongqin Tan, Haoyuan Zhang, Yanfeng Zhang, Zeshun Peng, Weixing Zhou, Jinyu Zhang, Yang Ren, Guoliang Li, Ge Yu
papers.abstract: Shared-cache architectures decouple compute from storage and employ local caches in compute nodes to reduce the latency of accessing shared storage, achieving high availability and elasticity. However, this design suffers from local cache misses and cache coherence overhead. Transaction routing has been widely used to mitigate these issues by routing transactions that access the same data to the same nodes, improving cache locality. Most existing routing approaches rely on row affinity, i.e., routing transactions that access the same set of rows to the same nodes. Since shared-cache databases typically maintain distributed cache coherence at the page level, this mismatch can cause redundant coherence traffic and degrade performance. In this paper, we present PAT, a shared-cache database system with page affinity-based routing, which routes transactions that access frequently co-accessed pages to the same compute node, reducing local cache misses and cache coherence overhead. Since SQL does not reveal which pages will be accessed before execution, PAT abstracts pages using key ranges to enable page affinity-based routing. This is based on the ordering property of widely used clustered indexes. Moreover, page updates may cause key ranges to become misaligned with pages, leading to significant cache coherence overhead. To address this issue, we introduce the route-aware page reorganization mechanism. Experiments show that PAT achieves $\mathbf{1. 0 3} \times \mathbf{- 1 4. 3 6} \times$ higher throughput than state-of-the-art approaches under TPC-C and YCSB.
papers.abstract_zh: 共享缓存架构将计算与存储解耦，并在计算节点中使用本地缓存来减少访问共享存储的延迟，从而实现高可用性和弹性。然而，这种设计会受到本地缓存未命中和缓存一致性开销的影响。事务路由已被广泛用于通过将访问相同数据的事务路由到相同节点来缓解这些问题，从而改善缓存局部性。大多数现有的路由方法依赖于行亲和性，即将访问同一行集的事务路由到相同的节点。由于共享缓存数据库通常在页面级别维护分布式缓存一致性，因此这种不匹配可能会导致冗余一致性流量并降低性能。在本文中，我们提出了 PAT，这是一种具有基于页面亲和力的路由的共享缓存数据库系统，它将访问频繁共同访问的页面的事务路由到同一计算节点，从而减少本地缓存未命中和缓存一致性开销。由于 SQL 不会透露在执行之前将访问哪些页面，因此 PAT 使用键范围抽象页面以启用基于页面关联的路由。这是基于广泛使用的聚集索引的排序属性。此外，页面更新可能会导致键范围与页面不对齐，从而导致显著的缓存一致性开销。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了路由感知的页面重组机制。实验表明PAT达到了1.03 至 14.36 倍 吞吐量比 TPC-C 和 YCSB 下最先进的方法高。

papers.title: Density Decomposition of Multilayer Graphs
papers.title_zh: 多层图的密度分解
papers.authors: Jiaqi Jiang, Rong-Hua Li, Yalong Zhang
papers.abstract: Multilayer graphs have emerged as a powerful model for representing complex systems with diverse types of interactions. Identifying cohesive subgraphs in such graphs is a fundamental task with broad applications in community detection, fraud analysis, and e-commerce recommendation. However, existing models either lack explicit density guarantees or fail to preserve across-layer structural cohesiveness. To address these limitations, in this paper, we propose a novel k-dense subgraph model, denoted as $D_{\mathrm{k}}$, which enforces layer-wise density constraints. Given a density vector $\mathbf{k}=\left[k_{\ell}\right]_{\ell \in L} \in \mathbb{Z}^{\vert L\vert}$, our model guarantees that the induced subgraph on each layer satisfies a minimum density threshold $k_{\ell}$. We further study the density decomposition problem: computing all non-empty $D_{\mathrm{k}} \mathrm{s}$ for feasible density vectors k. To this end, we design a suite of efficient algorithms. For computing a single $D_{\mathrm{k}}$, we first propose SLFBE, which uses network flow techniques to extract layer-wise subgraphs satisfying density thresholds. We then develop LCVSP, which combines k-core pruning and layerconstrained vertex set propagation to eliminate irrelevant vertices and accelerate convergence. For full density decomposition, we leverage the density lattice structure and propose HPDD, which incrementally constructs subgraphs by extending partial vectors layer by layer, enabling localized exploration and early pruning. To further improve scalability, we develop the HPDD+ algorithm, which adopts a recursive depth-first hierarchical strategy to lower memory cost. Additionally, HPDD+ employs an adaptive upperbounded divide-and-conquer approach that eliminates redundant computations. Extensive experiments on 9 real-world multilayer graphs demonstrate that our model discovers significantly higherquality subgraphs than existing methods, while our algorithms exhibit superior efficiency and scalability.
papers.abstract_zh: 多层图已成为表示具有多种交互类型的复杂系统的强大模型。识别此类图中的内聚子图是一项基本任务，在社区检测、欺诈分析和电子商务推荐中具有广泛的应用。然而，现有模型要么缺乏明确的密度保证，要么无法保持跨层结构内聚性。为了解决这些限制，在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的 k 密集子图模型，表示为 $D_{\mathrm{k}}$，它强制执行逐层密度约束。给定密度向量 $\mathbf{k}=\left[k_{\ell}\right]_{\ell \in L} \in \mathbb{Z}^{\vert L\vert}$，我们的模型保证每层上的导出子图满足最小密度阈值 $k_{\ell}$。我们进一步研究密度分解问题：计算可行密度向量k的所有非空$D_{\mathrm{k}} \mathrm{s}$。为此，我们设计了一套高效的算法。为了计算单个$D_{\mathrm{k}}$，我们首先提出SLFBE，它使用网络流技术来提取满足密度阈值的分层子图。然后，我们开发了 LCVSP，它将 k 核剪枝和层约束顶点集传播相结合，以消除不相关的顶点并加速收敛。对于全密度分解，我们利用密度格结构并提出 HPDD，它通过逐层扩展部分向量来增量构造子图，从而实现局部探索和早期剪枝。为了进一步提高可扩展性，我们开发了 HPDD+ 算法，该算法采用递归深度优先分层策略来降低内存成本。此外，HPDD+ 采用自适应上限分而治之方法，消除了冗余计算。对 9 个真实世界多层图的大量实验表明，我们的模型发现的子图质量明显高于现有方法，而我们的算法则表现出卓越的效率和可扩展性。

papers.title: AOEH: An Efficient Extendable Hashing to Reduce Read/Write Amplification for Persistent Memory
papers.title_zh: AOEH：一种有效的可扩展哈希，可减少持久内存的读/写放大
papers.authors: SHIHAO ZHANG, CHI ZHANG, YUNFEI GU, CHENTAO WU, JIE LI, JUNZHE LV
papers.abstract: With the exponential growth of data volumes and index sizes, DRAM capacity has become a critical bottleneck in modern high-performance systems. Expanded memory architectures, particularly those leveraging Persistent Memory (PM), offer a promising solution by combining high capacity, byteaddressability, and non-volatile characteristics with near-DRAM performance. Although significant efforts have been made to adapt hashing schemes for PM, existing PM-optimized hash indexes still suffer from substantial read and write amplification, severely degrading overall performance. To address that, this paper proposes AOEH, an Efficient Extendible Hashing scheme to Reduce Read/Write Amplification for Persistent Memory. Based on our systematic PM I/O amplification analysis, AOEH integrates a principled EH-based structure with a compact, self-adapting fingerprint to eliminate key dereferencing and reduce read amplification, complemented by a one-way lock-free mechanism with deterministic semantics to tackle write amplification. Extensive evaluation on YCSB workloads shows that AOEH delivers superior throughput across diverse workloads, reaching an average of $3.62 \times$ and $3.28 \times$ the throughput of the baseline designs in read-intensive and writeintensive scenarios, respectively, while reducing read and write amplification by 49% and 21% over the best-performing baseline.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着数据量和索引大小的指数级增长，DRAM 容量已成为现代高性能系统的关键瓶颈。扩展内存架构，特别是那些利用持久内存 (PM) 的架构，通过将高容量、字节寻址能力和非易失性特性与接近 DRAM 的性能相结合，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。尽管已经做出了巨大的努力来适应 PM 的哈希方案，但现有的 PM 优化哈希索引仍然遭受大量的读写放大，严重降低了整体性能。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 AOEH，一种有效的可扩展哈希方案，用于减少持久内存的读/写放大。基于我们系统的 PM I/O 放大分析，AOEH 将基于 EH 的原理性结构与紧凑的自适应指纹集成在一起，以消除密钥解引用并减少读放大，并辅以具有确定性语义的单向无锁机制来解决写放大问题。对 YCSB 工作负载的广泛评估表明，AOEH 在不同的工作负载中提供了卓越的吞吐量，在读取密集型和写入密集型场景中分别达到基准设计吞吐量的平均 3.62 倍和 3.28 倍，同时与最佳性能基准相比，将读取和写入放大减少了 49% 和 21%。

papers.title: Nezha: A Key-Value Separated Distributed Store with Optimized Raft Integration
papers.title_zh: Nezha：优化 Raft 集成的键值分离分布式存储
papers.authors: Yangyang Wang, Yucong Dong, Ziqian Cheng, Zichen Xu
papers.abstract: Distributed key-value stores are widely adopted to support elastic big data applications, leveraging purpose-built consensus algorithms like Raft to ensure data consistency. However, through systematic analysis, we reveal a critical performance issue in such consistent stores, i.e., overlapping persistence operations between consensus protocols and underlying storage engines result in significant I/O overhead. To address this issue, we present Nezha, a prototype distributed storage system that innovatively integrates key-value separation with Raft to provide scalable throughput in a strong consistency guarantee. Nezha redesigns the persistence strategy at the operation level and incorporates leveled garbage collection, significantly improving read and write performance while preserving Raft's safety properties. Experimental results demonstrate that, on average, Nezha achieves throughput improvements of 460.2%, 12.5%, and 72.6% for put, get, and scan operations, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 分布式键值存储被广泛采用来支持弹性大数据应用程序，利用 Raft 等专用共识算法来确保数据一致性。然而，通过系统分析，我们揭示了这种一致性存储中的一个关键性能问题，即共识协议和底层存储引擎之间重叠的持久性操作会导致大量的 I/O 开销。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Nezha，一个原型分布式存储系统，它创新地将键值分离与 Raft 集成，在强一致性保证的情况下提供可扩展的吞吐量。 Nezha在操作层面重新设计了持久化策略，加入了分级垃圾回收，在保证Raft安全特性的同时，显著提升了读写性能。实验结果表明，Nezha 的 put、get 和 scan 操作的吞吐量平均分别提高了 460.2%、12.5% 和 72.6%。

papers.title: Process Faster, Pay Less: Functional Isolation for Stream Processing
papers.title_zh: 处理速度更快，费用更少：流处理的功能隔离
papers.authors: Eleni Zapridou, Michael Koepf, Panagiotis Sioulas, Ioannis Mytilinis, Anastasia Ailamaki
papers.abstract: Concurrent workloads often extract insights from high-throughput, real-time data streams. Existing stream processing engines isolate each query's resources, ensuring robust performance but incurring high infrastructure costs. In contrast, sharing work reduces the amount of necessary resources but introduces inter-query interference, leading to performance degradation for some queries. We introduce FunShare, a stream-processing system that improves resource efficiency without compromising performance by dynamically grouping queries based on their performance characteristics. FunShare strategically relaxes query interdependencies and minimizes redundant computation while preserving individual query performance. It achieves this by using an adaptive optimization framework that monitors execution metrics, accurately estimates computation overlaps, and reconfigures execution plans on the fly in response to changes in the underlying data streams. Our evaluation demonstrates that FunShare minimizes resource consumption compared to isolated execution while maintaining or improving throughput for all queries.
papers.abstract_zh: 并发工作负载通常从高吞吐量、实时数据流中提取见解。现有的流处理引擎隔离每个查询的资源，确保稳健的性能，但会产生高昂的基础设施成本。相反，共享工作减少了必要的资源量，但引入了查询间干扰，导致某些查询的性能下降。我们引入 FunShare，这是一种流处理系统，它通过根据性能特征对查询进行动态分组，在不影响性能的情况下提高资源效率。 FunShare 战略性地放松了查询相互依赖性并最大限度地减少冗余计算，同时保留单个查询性能。它通过使用自适应优化框架来实现这一目标，该框架监视执行指标，准确估计计算重叠，并动态重新配置执行计划以响应底层数据流的变化。我们的评估表明，与独立执行相比，FunShare 最大限度地减少了资源消耗，同时维持或提高了所有查询的吞吐量。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: SQAC: Scalable Querying of Attribute-Constrained (α, β)-Cores over Large Bipartite Graphs
papers.title_zh: SQAC：大型二分图上属性约束（α，β）核心的可扩展查询
papers.authors: Xin Deng, Peng Peng, Baoqing Sun, Shuo Dai, Zheng Qin, Lijun Chang
papers.abstract: Many important real-world networks can be effectively modeled as bipartite graphs, where vertex attributes convey critical semantic information essential for graph analysis. As a fundamental subgraph structure in bipartite graphs, (α, β)-cores have attracted extensive attention and been widely used. However, existing studies have largely ignored the attribute property in bipartite graphs, which hinders attribute-aware applications in the real world. In this paper, we formulate a new problem of querying attribute-constrained (α, β)-cores over bipartite graphs, and study index-based methods. We first propose a vertex-based core index (VC-Index), which maintains some pivotal attribute sets for each vertex and each possible (α, β) pair. To improve the query efficiency, we then design an attribute-based core index (AC-Index) that computes an index for each possible attribute set. However, these two indexes suffer from either unsatisfactory query performance or excessive space overhead. Therefore, we further construct the minimized AC-Index, named MAC-Index, which significantly reduces the index size by leveraging the containment relationship of the attribute sets for the (α, β) cores, while guaranteeing efficient query processing. Extensive experiments over real-world datasets confirm the efficiency and effectiveness of our index-based algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 许多重要的现实世界网络可以有效地建模为二部图，其中顶点属性传达对图分析至关重要的关键语义信息。作为二分图中的基本子图结构，(α,β)-核引起了广泛的关注并得到了广泛的应用。然而，现有的研究很大程度上忽略了二分图中的属性属性，这阻碍了属性感知在现实世界中的应用。在本文中，我们提出了在二分图上查询属性约束（α，β）核的新问题，并研究了基于索引的方法。我们首先提出一个基于顶点的核心索引（VC-Index），它为每个顶点和每个可能的（α，β）对维护一些关键属性集。为了提高查询效率，我们设计了一个基于属性的核心索引（AC-Index），为每个可能的属性集计算一个索引。然而，这两个索引要么查询性能不理想，要么空间开销过大。因此，我们进一步构造了最小化的AC-Index，命名为MAC-Index，它利用(α,β)核的属性集的包含关系显著减小了索引大小，同时保证了高效的查询处理。对现实世界数据集的大量实验证实了我们基于索引的算法的效率和有效性。

papers.title: Listing Minimal Cores in Large Real-World Graphs
papers.title_zh: 列出大型现实世界图中的最小核心
papers.authors: Yukai Sun, Kaiqiang Yu, Shengxin Liu, Cheng Long, Raymond Chi-Wing Wong, Xun Zhou, Min Zhang
papers.abstract: Cohesive subgraph mining is a fundamental task in graph data analytics. We re-visit the problem of listing all minimal $k$-cores, where a $k$-core is a subgraph in which every vertex has degree at least $k$, and minimality requires that no proper subset remains a $k$-core. Existing methods are computationally prohibitive due to explosive branching and costly branch state update, leading to the trivial worst-case bound $O^{*}\left(2^{n}\right)$ for the basic branch-and-bound baseline wh, where $O^{*}$ suppresses polynomial factors and $n$ is the number of vertices. In this paper, we present an improved method IMinC based on three key ideas: (i) a principled branching state with lineartime update; (ii) a pivot strategy that guides branching toward promising vertices; and (iii) a divide-and-conquer framework that initializes each subproblem to enable our pivot strategy throughout and reduce recursion depth. We further introduce three reduction rules that aggressively prune infeasible branches. Together, these components yield the worst-case time complexity of $O^{*}\left(\alpha_{\ell}^{n}\right)$, where $\alpha_{\ell}$ is a positive number strictly smaller than 2. We also extend IMinC to list minimal $k$-cores under a size bound, addressing practical needs such as size-bounded community search. Extensive experiments on 12 real-world graphs demonstrate that IMinC outperforms the baselines by up to 2 order of magnitude, delivering substantial gains in efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 内聚子图挖掘是图数据分析中的一项基本任务。我们重新讨论列出所有最小 $k$-core 的问题，其中 $k$-core 是一个子图，其中每个顶点的度至少为 $k$，并且极简性要求没有适当的子集仍然是 $k$-core。由于爆炸性分支和昂贵的分支状态更新，现有方法在计算上受到限制，导致基本分支定界基线 wh 的最坏情况边界 $O^{*}\left(2^{n}\right)$，其中 $O^{*}$ 抑制多项式因子，$n$ 是顶点数。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于三个关键思想的改进方法 IMinC：（i）具有线性时间更新的原则分支状态； (ii) 引导分支走向有希望的顶点的枢轴策略； (iii) 一个分而治之的框架，它初始化每个子问题，以使我们的枢轴策略贯穿始终并减少递归深度。我们进一步引入了三个减少规则，积极修剪不可行的分支。这些组件共同产生 $O^{*}\left(\alpha_{\ell}^{n}\right)$ 的最坏情况时间复杂度，其中 $\alpha_{\ell}$ 是严格小于 2 的正数。我们还扩展了 IMinC，以列出大小限制下的最小 $k$ 个核心，满足大小限制的社区搜索等实际需求。对 12 个真实世界图进行的大量实验表明，IMinC 的性能优于基线高达 2 个数量级，从而显著提高了效率。

papers.title: Time-Frequency Conditioned Diffusion for Multivariate Time Series Imputation
papers.title_zh: 多元时间序列插补的时频条件扩散
papers.authors: Yumeng Liu, Zheng Wang, Jikui Liu, Kaisa Zhang, Weidong Gao, Xiaomao Fan
papers.abstract: Time series data underpin critical applications in domains including healthcare and meteorology, yet their utility is frequently compromised by pervasive missing values. While diffusion-based generative models offer promise for imputation, existing approaches are constrained by their limited ability to effectively capturing dynamic shifts or variations in inherent periodic patterns present within the observed portions of the multivariate time series data. To address this gap, we propose a novel time-frequency conditioned diffusion called CDTI for multivariate time series imputation, integrating time-frequency representations as structured spectral priors to explicitly guiding the denoising process. CDTI transforms observed data into a spectrogram, extracts deep features of periodic dynamics via a dedicated time-frequency feature learning (TFFL) module, and injects these features via a cross-view interaction (CVI) mechanism at each denoising step. This synergistic fusion of temporal and spectral domains enables CDTI to perceive complex periodic shifts and abrupt changes, constraining the reverse process for high-fidelity reconstruction. Extensive evaluations on five benchmark datasets show that CDTI achieves consistently competitive performance across a wide range of missing data scenarios and missing rates, demonstrating robust imputation capability compared with existing state-of-the-art methods. The source code is available at URL(https://github.com/Cofeesy/CDTI).
papers.abstract_zh: 时间序列数据支撑着医疗保健和气象学等领域的关键应用，但其效用经常因普遍存在的缺失值而受到损害。虽然基于扩散的生成模型为插补提供了希望，但现有方法因其有效捕获多元时间序列数据的观察部分中存在的固有周期性模式的动态变化或变化的能力有限而受到限制。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种称为 CDTI 的新型时频条件扩散，用于多元时间序列插补，将时频表示集成为结构化谱先验，以明确指导去噪过程。 CDTI 将观测数据转换为频谱图，通过专用时频特征学习 (TFFL) 模块提取周期性动态的深层特征，并在每个去噪步骤中通过跨视图交互 (CVI) 机制注入这些特征。这种时域和谱域的协同融合使 CDTI 能够感知复杂的周期性变化和突变，从而限制了高保真重建的逆过程。对五个基准数据集的广泛评估表明，CDTI 在各种缺失数据场景和缺失率中实现了一致的竞争性能，与现有最先进的方法相比，展示了强大的插补能力。源代码可在 URL（https://github.com/Cofeesy/CDTI）获取。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Low-Latency Stateful Stream Processing through Timely and Accurate Prefetching
papers.title_zh: 通过及时准确的预取实现低延迟状态流处理
papers.authors: Eleni Zapridou, Anastasia Ailamaki
papers.abstract: Mission-critical applications often run "forever" and process large data volumes in real time while demanding low latency. To handle the large state of these applications, modern streaming engines rely on key-value stores and store state on local storage or remotely, but accessing such state inflates latency. As today's engines tightly couple the data path with state I/O, a tuple triggers state access only when it reaches a stateful operator, placing I/O on the critical path and stalling the CPU. However, the keys used to access the state are frequently known earlier in the query plan. Building on this insight, we propose Keyed Prefetching, which decouples the data path from state access by extracting future access keys at upstream operators and proactively staging the corresponding state in memory before tuples arrive. This overlaps I/O with ongoing computation and hides the latency of large-state accesses. We pair Keyed Prefetching with Timestamp-Aware Caching, a cache-eviction policy that jointly manages previously accessed and prefetched entries to use memory efficiently. Together, these techniques reduce latency for long-running, real-time queries without sacrificing throughput.
papers.abstract_zh: 任务关键型应用程序通常“永远”运行并实时处理大量数据，同时要求低延迟。为了处理这些应用程序的大状态，现代流引擎依赖于键值存储并将状态存储在本地存储或远程存储上，但访问此类状态会增加延迟。由于当今的引擎将数据路径与状态 I/O 紧密耦合，因此元组仅在到达有状态运算符时才会触发状态访问，从而将 I/O 置于关键路径上并停止 CPU。然而，用于访问状态的键通常在查询计划的早期就已知。基于这一见解，我们提出了键控预取（Keyed Prefetching），它通过在上游运算符处提取未来的访问密钥并在元组到达之前主动将相应的状态暂存在内存中，从而将数据路径与状态访问解耦。这将 I/O 与正在进行的计算重叠，并隐藏大状态访问的延迟。我们将键控预取与时间戳感知缓存结合起来，后者是一种缓存驱逐策略，可联合管理先前访问和预取的条目以有效地使用内存。这些技术共同减少了长时间运行的实时查询的延迟，而不牺牲吞吐量。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据
