papers.title: HYDRA: Breaking the Global Ordering Barrier in Multi-BFT Consensus
papers.title_zh: HYDRA：打破多重BFT共识的全球订购壁垒
papers.authors: Hanzheng Lyu, Shaokang Xie, Jianyu Niu, Mohammad Sadoghi, Yinqian Zhang, Cong Wang, Ivan Beschastnikh, Chen Feng
papers.abstract: Multi-Byzantine Fault Tolerant (Multi-BFT) consensus, which runs multiple BFT instances in parallel, has recently emerged as a promising approach to overcome the leader bottleneck in classical BFT protocols. However, existing designs rely on a global ordering layer to serialize blocks across instances, an intuitive yet costly mechanism that constrains scalability, amplifies failure propagation, and complicates deployment. In this paper, we challenge this conventional wisdom. We present HYDRA, the first Multi-BFT consensus framework that eliminates global ordering altogether. HYDRA introduces an object-centric execution model that partitions transactions by their accessed objects, enabling concurrent yet deterministic execution across instances. To ensure consistency, HYDRA combines lightweight lock-based coordination with a deadlock resolution mechanism, achieving both scalability and correctness. We implement HYDRA and evaluate it on up to 128 replicas in both LAN and WAN environments. Experimental results show HYDRA outperforms several state-of-the-art Multi-BFT protocols in the presence of a straggler. These results demonstrate strong consistency and high performance by removing global ordering, opening a new direction toward scalable Multi-BFT consensus design.
papers.abstract_zh: 并行运行多个 BFT 实例的多拜占庭容错 (Multi-BFT) 共识最近成为克服经典 BFT 协议中领导者瓶颈的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的设计依赖于全局排序层来跨实例序列化块，这是一种直观但成本高昂的机制，会限制可扩展性、放大故障传播并使部署复杂化。在本文中，我们挑战了这种传统观点。我们推出了 HYDRA，这是第一个完全消除全局排序的 Multi-BFT 共识框架。 HYDRA 引入了一种以对象为中心的执行模型，该模型根据访问的对象对事务进行分区，从而实现跨实例的并发且确定性的执行。为了确保一致性，HYDRA 将轻量级的基于锁的协调与死锁解决机制相结合，实现了可扩展性和正确性。我们实施 HYDRA 并在 LAN 和 WAN 环境中的多达 128 个副本上对其进行评估。实验结果表明，在存在落后者的情况下，HYDRA 的性能优于多种最先进的 Multi-BFT 协议。这些结果通过消除全局排序展示了强大的一致性和高性能，为可扩展的 Multi-BFT 共识设计开辟了新方向。

papers.title: F5: A Robust SIMD-Accelerated MSD Radix Sort
papers.title_zh: F5：稳健的 SIMD 加速 MSD 基数排序
papers.authors: Arif Arman, Dmitri Loguinov
papers.abstract: Sorting is a building block of many data-intensive applications, databases, MapReduce pipelines, and large-scale distributed systems. In this paper, we focus on MSD (mostsignificant digit first) radix sort, in which we identify three main bottlenecks - slow small-bucket sorts at the end of recursion, partitioning algorithms susceptible to read-after-write stalls, and unnecessarily deep recursion chains on non-uniform distributions. We overcome these issues in a framework we call F5, which consists of a) vectorized small sorts that perform well on a wide range of input sizes; b) a partitioning engine that delivers bursts of keys into buckets at significantly increased speed; c) a prefix extractor and sortedness checker that allow jumping over common bits and terminating recursion early; and d) an adaptive radix selector that optimally decides the number of bits for each level of partitioning. Results show that F5 often doubles the speed of prior methods, including recent AVX-512 endeavors from Google [13] and Intel [19], on both uniform/skewed distributions, while also remaining in-place.
papers.abstract_zh: 排序是许多数据密集型应用程序、数据库、MapReduce 管道和大型分布式系统的构建块。在本文中，我们重点关注 MSD（最高有效数字在前）基数排序，其中我们确定了三个主要瓶颈 - 递归结束时缓慢的小桶排序、容易受到写后读停顿影响的分区算法以及非均匀分布上不必要的深度递归链。我们在称为 F5 的框架中克服了这些问题，该框架由 a) 在各种输入大小上表现良好的矢量化小型排序组成； b) 分区引擎，以显著提高的速度将密钥突发传送到存储桶中； c) 前缀提取器和排序检查器，允许跳过公共位并提前终止递归； d) 自适应基数选择器，用于最佳地决定每个分区级别的位数。结果表明，F5 通常使先前方法的速度翻倍，包括 Google [13] 和 Intel [19] 最近的 AVX-512 努力，在均匀/倾斜分布上，同时也保持原样。

papers.title: Telescope: A Learned What-If Call for Column Store Selection in HTAP Databases
papers.title_zh: Telescope：HTAP 数据库中列存储选择的学习假设调用
papers.authors: Yidong Zhang, Chao Zhang, Zhengkun Wu, Ju Fan, Xinyi Zhang, Hong Chen, Yuxing Chen, Anqun Pan
papers.abstract: Recently, we have witnessed that various HTAP databases have integrated the primary row store with an inmemory column store to benefit from both storage engines, i.e., row store for OLTP and column store for OLAP. Nevertheless, existing systems cannot evaluate the true benefit of the column store on query processing without actually loading them into the storage. Furthermore, even though the columns could be loaded with manual effort, the existing what-if estimators fail to provide satisfactory performance as their cost models cannot well capture the impact of the transactional workloads. Such drawbacks hinder the efficient query processing in HTAP databases. In this paper, we propose Telescope, a learned what-if call for column store selection in HTAP databases. Given an SQL query and a candidate column set, the goal is to estimate the query cost accurately in the context of HTAP. Solving such a problem poses two key challenges: (1) generating the true query plan without loading the columns on-the-fly, and (2) estimating the query cost efficiently and effectively under both static and dynamic scenarios. Telescope addresses these challenges through priority-based plan generation and learned cost estimation. First, it assigns a priority to the candidate column set based on its join order for different query templates. Such a method just requires examining a subset of candidate column sets, thereby pruning unnecessary loading overhead. Second, it provides a learned model, called HtapFormer, that can accurately predict the query cost with the consideration of transactional impact based on the attention model. Extensive experimental results show that our approach outperforms the baselines significantly, reducing up to 42% of plan generation error and 68% cost estimation error. Additionally, integrating our method into column selection can significantly improve the column recommendation quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 最近，我们看到各种 HTAP 数据库已将主行存储与内存中列存储集成在一起，以受益于两种存储引擎，即用于 OLTP 的行存储和用于 OLAP 的列存储。然而，现有系统无法在不实际将列存储加载到存储中的情况下评估列存储对查询处理的真正好处。此外，即使可以通过手动操作来加载列，现有的假设估计器也无法提供令人满意的性能，因为它们的成本模型无法很好地捕获事务工作负载的影响。这些缺点阻碍了 HTAP 数据库中高效的查询处理。在本文中，我们提出了 Telescope，这是一种用于 HTAP 数据库中列存储选择的学习假设调用。给定一个 SQL 查询和一个候选列集，目标是在 HTAP 上下文中准确估计查询成本。解决这样的问题面临两个关键挑战：(1) 生成真实的查询计划，而无需动态加载列；(2) 在静态和动态场景下高效且有效地估计查询成本。 Telescope 通过基于优先级的计划生成和学习成本估算来应对这些挑战。首先，它根据不同查询模板的连接顺序为候选列集分配优先级。这种方法只需要检查候选列集的子集，从而修剪不必要的加载开销。其次，它提供了一个名为 HtapFormer 的学习模型，可以基于注意力模型考虑事务影响来准确预测查询成本。大量的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于基线，减少了高达 42% 的计划生成误差和 68% 的成本估算误差。此外，将我们的方法集成到列选择中可以显著提高列推荐质量。

papers.title: TORepair: Diffusion-based Task-Oriented Error Repair via Differentiable Bi-Level Optimization
papers.title_zh: TORepair：通过可微双层优化进行基于扩散的面向任务的错误修复
papers.authors: Wei Ni, Xiaoye Miao, Xiangyu Zhao, Yangyang Wu, Jianwei Yin
papers.abstract: Error repair in tabular data is crucial for downstream task utility. Existing methods either pursue data fidelity, potentially degrading task performance, or are task-oriented but require manual effort or extensive retraining, while lacking theoretical guarantees. In this paper, we propose TORepair, a novel framework that enables efficient task-oriented error repair through a differentiable bi-level optimization formulation. It features two co-evolving components, i.e., an inner optimization to update the task model with the latest repaired data, and an outer optimization to improve the repair model using the updated task model's guidance. Through a direct gradient-based feedback from the downstream task, the repair model is guided toward maximizing task performance. Meanwhile, to handle mixed data types and explore rich repair candidates, we adopt a conditional denoising diffusion mechanism that iteratively refines repairs in a continuous embedding space. The repair model is then jointly optimized with task-guidance for task utility and self-supervised learning for data fidelity regularization. We theoretically prove that our bi-level framework guarantees improvement over the no-repair condition. Extensive experiments on 11 real-world datasets demonstrate that TORepair enhances downstream task performance by 35% on average and outperforms state-of-theart error repair methods by 13% on average with efficiency, even surpassing clean data performance in several cases.
papers.abstract_zh: 表格数据中的错误修复对于下游任务实用程序至关重要。现有方法要么追求数据保真度，可能会降低任务性能，要么以任务为导向，但需要人工或大量的再训练，同时缺乏理论保证。在本文中，我们提出了 TORepair，这是一种新颖的框架，可通过可微的双层优化公式实现高效的面向任务的错误修复。它具有两个共同进化的组件，即使用最新修复数据更新任务模型的内部优化，以及使用更新的任务模型的指导改进修复模型的外部优化。通过来自下游任务的基于梯度的直接反馈，修复模型被引导以最大化任务性能。同时，为了处理混合数据类型并探索丰富的修复候选者，我们采用了条件去噪扩散机制，在连续嵌入空间中迭代地细化修复。然后，修复模型与任务实用性的任务指导和数据保真度正则化的自监督学习联合优化。我们从理论上证明，我们的双层框架保证了对无修复条件的改进。对 11 个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，TORepair 将下游任务性能平均提高了 35%，在效率上比最先进的错误修复方法平均提高了 13%，甚至在某些情况下超过了干净数据的性能。

papers.title: SPARQ: A Cost-Efficient Framework for Offline Table Question Answering via Adaptive Routing
papers.title_zh: SPARQ：通过自适应路由进行离线表问答的经济高效框架
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Mengyi Yan, Jiao Xue, Weilong Ren, Yutong Ye, Haoyi Zhou, Zhumin Chen, Jianxin Li
papers.abstract: Table Question Answering (TQA), which aims to answer natural language questions over tabular data, has recently attracted growing interest in the database community. While state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods based on online Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve remarkable accuracy, they suffer from several drawbacks, including data privacy risks, high latency, high cost, and overthinking due to excessively long reasoning chains. To address these challenges, we propose SPARQ (Sufficient Precise Adaptive Routing for TableQA), a cost-efficient TQA framework designed for robust offline deployment. SPARQ extends the operator pool for table reasoning and introduces an adaptive query routing mechanism that dynamically selects optimal operators, assisted by a verifier with rollback/fallback strategies. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that SPARQ achieves remarkable performance in an offline setting: it improves accuracy by over 5% on WikiTQ and Tab Fact datasets, while reducing the average end-to-end latency by up to 10.19× on consumer-grade hardware (e.g., RTX 4090). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic framework that deploys offline LLMs to achieve SOTA performance for TQA under realistic hardware constraints, balancing both effectiveness and efficiency. Code, full version and artifacts are provided. 11https://github.com/authurlord/SPARQ
papers.abstract_zh: 表问答 (TQA) 旨在回答有关表格数据的自然语言问题，最近引起了数据库社区越来越多的兴趣。虽然基于在线大型语言模型（LLM）的最先进（SOTA）方法取得了显著的准确性，但它们也存在一些缺点，包括数据隐私风险、高延迟、高成本以及由于推理链过长而导致的过度思考。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SPARQ（Sufficient Precise Adaptive Routing for TableQA），这是一种经济高效的 TQA 框架，专为稳健的离线部署而设计。 SPARQ 扩展了用于表推理的运算符池，并引入了自适应查询路由机制，该机制可动态选择最佳运算符，并由具有回滚/回退策略的验证器协助。通过广泛的评估，我们证明 SPARQ 在离线环境中实现了卓越的性能：它在 WikiTQ 和 Tab Fact 数据集上的准确性提高了 5% 以上，同时在消费级硬件（例如 RTX 4090）上将平均端到端延迟降低了高达 10.19 倍。据我们所知，这是第一个部署离线LLM以在现实硬件限制下实现TQA SOTA性能的系统框架，平衡有效性和效率。提供代码、完整版本和工件。 11https://github.com/authurlord/SPARQ

papers.title: A-Scan: Efficient Scale-up Analytics via Throughput-Guided Data Movement
papers.title_zh: A-Scan：通过吞吐量引导的数据移动进行高效的扩展分析
papers.authors: Hamish Nicholson, Aunn Raza, Viktor Sanca, Anastasia Ailamaki
papers.abstract: Modern scale-up analytical systems, from single servers to rack-scale deployments, face increasing complexity in data movement across their storage hierarchies, NUMA nodes, and high-speed interconnects like CXL and PCIe. The performance gap between optimal and suboptimal data-movement strategies can be substantial, as the best approach depends on complex interactions between hardware capabilities (storage bandwidth, interconnect speeds, near-storage compute) and workload characteristics such as query selectivity, access patterns, and data volume. While existing systems employ datamovement strategies fixed at query planning time, the growing diversity of storage technologies, memory topologies, and analytical workloads makes such static approaches brittle, demanding adaptive runtime selection. We propose Throughput-Guided Data Movement that uses end-to-end operator-pipeline throughput as the adaptation signal to select how and where bytes are realized at query runtime. Throughput implicitly captures the interplay between hardware and query properties without an explicit performance model for data movement. We integrate throughput-guided data movement into a leaf operator, Adaptive Scan (A-Scan), that encapsulates data-movement within the operator and selects among them at runtime to maximize observed end-to-end throughput. A-Scan keeps the query plan fixed and presents the same rowset interface to its parent operator while internally controlling how and where data are realized across nodes and memories. We validate A-Scan by implementing it in a push-based, code-generating analytical engine, showing that it approaches the per-query best static choice across tested configurations and interference conditions, without hardware-specific tuning.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代纵向扩展分析系统，从单一服务器到机架规模部署，都面临着跨存储层次结构、NUMA 节点以及 CXL 和 PCIe 等高速互连的数据移动日益增加的复杂性。最佳和次优数据移动策略之间的性能差距可能很大，因为最佳方法取决于硬件功能（存储带宽、互连速度、近存储计算）与工作负载特征（例如查询选择性、访问模式和数据量）之间的复杂交互。虽然现有系统采用在查询规划时固定的数据移动策略，但存储技术、内存拓扑和分析工作负载的日益多样化使得这种静态方法变得脆弱，需要自适应运行时选择。我们提出吞吐量引导数据移动，它使用端到端运算符管道吞吐量作为适应信号来选择在查询运行时如何以及在何处实现字节。吞吐量隐式捕获硬件和查询属性之间的相互作用，而无需用于数据移动的显式性能模型。我们将吞吐量引导的数据移动集成到叶算子 Adaptive Scan (A-Scan) 中，该算子将数据移动封装在算子内，并在运行时在其中进行选择，以最大化观察到的端到端吞吐量。 A-Scan 保持查询计划固定，并向其父操作员提供相同的行集接口，同时在内部控制跨节点和内存实现数据的方式和位置。我们通过在基于推送的代码生成分析引擎中实现 A-Scan 来对其进行验证，表明它在测试的配置和干扰条件下接近每个查询的最佳静态选择，而无需特定于硬件的调整。

papers.title: C²TC: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Tabular Data Condensation
papers.title_zh: C²TC：高效表格数据压缩的免训练框架
papers.authors: Sijia Xu, Fan Li, Xiaoyang Wang, Zhengyi Yang, Xuemin Lin
papers.abstract: Tabular data, organized in rows and columns, represents the most common data format in industrial relational databases, underpinning modern data analytics and decisionmaking. However, the ever-increasing scale of tabular data poses significant computational and storage challenges to learningbased analytical systems. This highlights the need for dataefficient learning, which maximizes the utility of available data to enable effective model training and generalization using substantially fewer samples. Dataset condensation (DC) has recently emerged as a promising data-centric paradigm that synthesizes small yet informative datasets to preserve data utility while greatly reducing storage and training costs. However, existing DC methods are computationally intensive due to reliance on complex gradient-based optimization. Moreover, they often overlook key characteristics of tabular data, such as heterogeneous features and class imbalance. To address these limitations, we introduce $\mathbf{C}^{2} \mathbf{T C}$ (Class-Adaptive Clustering for Tabular Condensation), the first training-free tabular dataset condensation framework that jointly optimizes class allocation and feature representation, enabling efficient and scalable condensation. Specifically, we reformulate the dataset condensation objective into a novel class-adaptive cluster allocation problem (CCAP), which eliminates costly training and integrates adaptive label allocation to handle class imbalance. To solve the NP-hard CCAP, we develop HFILS, a heuristic local search that alternates between soft allocation and class-wise clustering to efficiently obtain high-quality solutions. Moreover, a hybrid categorical feature encoding (HCFE) is proposed for semantics-preserving clustering of heterogeneous discrete attributes. Extensive experiments on 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that $\mathbf{C}^{\mathbf{2}} \mathbf{T C}$ improves efficiency by at least 2 orders of magnitude over state-of-the-art baselines, while achieving superior downstream performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 按行和列组织的表格数据代表了工业关系数据库中最常见的数据格式，支撑着现代数据分析和决策。然而，表格数据规模的不断增加给基于学习的分析系统带来了巨大的计算和存储挑战。这凸显了对数据高效学习的需求，即最大限度地利用可用数据，从而使用更少的样本进行有效的模型训练和泛化。数据集压缩（DC）最近成为一种有前途的以数据为中心的范式，它合成小型但信息丰富的数据集以保留数据效用，同时大大降低存储和训练成本。然而，由于依赖于复杂的基于梯度的优化，现有的 DC 方法计算量很大。此外，他们经常忽视表格数据的关键特征，例如异构特征和类别不平衡。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了$\mathbf{C}^{2} \mathbf{T C}$（表格压缩的类自适应聚类），这是第一个免训练的表格数据集压缩框架，可联合优化类分配和特征表示，从而实现高效且可扩展的压缩。具体来说，我们将数据集压缩目标重新表述为一种新颖的类自适应集群分配问题（CCAP），它消除了昂贵的训练并集成自适应标签分配来处理类不平衡。为了解决 NP-hard CCAP，我们开发了 HFILS，这是一种启发式局部搜索，可以在软分配和类聚类之间交替进行，以有效地获得高质量的解决方案。此外，提出了一种混合分类特征编码（HCFE），用于异构离散属性的语义保留聚类。对 10 个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，$\mathbf{C}^{\mathbf{2}} \mathbf{T C}$ 比最先进的基线提高了至少 2 个数量级的效率，同时实现了卓越的下游性能。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: ShareFlow: An Efficient Framework for Multi-Query Continuous Subgraph Matching
papers.title_zh: ShareFlow：多查询连续子图匹配的高效框架
papers.authors: Peiqi Yuan, Zhaohang Feng, Ruiqi Xu, Keming Li, Rui Mao, Bo Tang
papers.abstract: In this work, we study the Multi-Query Continuous Subgraph Matching (MQCSM) problem in dynamic graphs, which is widely used in various real-world applications, e.g., fraud detection, anomaly detection, and social network analysis. Existing work on Continuous Subgraph Matching (CSM) is either single-query-oriented, too resource-intensive to be applied to multiple simultaneous queries, or multi-query-oriented with significant limitations, including ineffective indices, repeated search, etc. Motivated by them, we propose an efficient MQCSM framework ShareFlow in this work. It first introduces an annotated graph structure that merges multiple queries into a compact representation and enables shared computations. Then, a twolevel indexing mechanism is devised in ShareFlow to accelerate MQCSM processing. In particular, it includes a shared candidate graph (SCG) and an effective candidate graph (ECG) that reduce search space and improve backtracking efficiency. Next, a block-based search (BBS) engine is designed in ShareFlow to avoid repeated search paths in the Cartesian products of matches of sub-blocks. Experimental evaluations on real datasets confirm that ShareFlow offers substantial performance benefits over existing algorithms. Its components collectively contribute to a more efficient and scalable approach to MQCSM, outperforming NewSP, RapidFlow, CaLiG, Symbi, and MQ-Match by up to 18.85×, 14.27×, 457.74×, 172.03 ×, and 202.45×, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究动态图中的多查询连续子图匹配（MQCSM）问题，该问题广泛应用于各种实际应用中，例如欺诈检测、异常检测和社交网络分析。现有的连续子图匹配（CSM）工作要么是面向单查询，资源过于密集，无法应用于多个同时查询，要么是面向多查询，有很大的局限性，包括无效索引、重复搜索等。受其启发，我们在这项工作中提出了一种高效的 MQCSM 框架 ShareFlow。它首先引入了一个带注释的图结构，该结构将多个查询合并为一个紧凑的表示并支持共享计算。然后，在ShareFlow中设计了双层索引机制来加速MQCSM处理。特别是，它包括共享候选图（SCG）和有效候选图（ECG），可以减少搜索空间并提高回溯效率。接下来，在ShareFlow中设计了基于块的搜索（BBS）引擎，以避免子块匹配的笛卡尔积中的重复搜索路径。对真实数据集的实验评估证实，ShareFlow 比现有算法具有显著的性能优势。其组件共同为 MQCSM 提供了一种更高效、更可扩展的方法，其性能分别优于 NewSP、RapidFlow、CaLiG、Symbi 和 MQ-Match 高达 18.85×、14.27×、457.74×、172.03×和 202.45×。

papers.title: L³C: Leaf-Centric Continuous Codes for Natural Language-Driven Table Discovery
papers.title_zh: L³C：用于自然语言驱动的表发现的以叶为中心的连续代码
papers.authors: Qiyuan Zhang, Ruochun Jin, Jixin Zhang, Yuhua Tang, Xiang Zhao, Shixuan Liu
papers.abstract: Natural language (NL)-driven table discovery aims to retrieve relevant tables from massive repositories using intuitive user queries. While recent approaches leverage dense vector retrieval or discrete identifier generation, they either suffer from limited semantic expressiveness or rigid hierarchical constraints that hinder fine-grained discrimination among structurally similar tables. In this work, we propose $\mathbf{L}^{3} \mathbf{C}$ (Leaf-Centric Continuous Code), a novel differentiable indexing framework that represents each table as a continuous vector anchored to its semantic cluster center with a learnable local offset. Unlike prior methods that rely on fixed embeddings or autoregressive discrete IDs, $\mathbf{L}^{3} \mathbf{C}$ decouples global semantic organization from local table uniqueness: a hierarchical clustering tree over multiview table representations defines leaf-level semantic neighborhoods, while each table learns a residual offset that captures its distinctive content within that neighborhood. During training, an encoder-decoder model learns to map NL queries directly to these continuous codes, enabling end-to-end optimization of both indexing structure and query-table alignment. At inference time, the model generates a continuous code that is efficiently matched against precomputed table codes via approximate nearest neighbor search-combining the flexibility of dense retrieval with the semantic coherence of hierarchical indexing. To support dynamic table ingestion, we further introduce a memory-efficient continual learning strategy that freezes base representations and only adapts local offsets for new tables, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that $L^{3} C$ outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 6.5 points in P@1, while maintaining scalable inference and robustness under continual updates.
papers.abstract_zh: 自然语言 (NL) 驱动的表发现旨在使用直观的用户查询从海量存储库中检索相关表。虽然最近的方法利用密集向量检索或离散标识符生成，但它们要么受到有限的语义表达，要么受到严格的层次结构约束，阻碍了结构相似表之间的细粒度区分。在这项工作中，我们提出了 $\mathbf{L}^{3} \mathbf{C}$ （以叶为中心的连续代码），这是一种新颖的可微分索引框架，它将每个表表示为锚定到其语义聚类中心的连续向量，并具有可学习的局部偏移量。与依赖固定嵌入或自回归离散 ID 的先前方法不同， $\mathbf{L}^{3} \mathbf{C}$ 将全局语义组织与局部表唯一性解耦：多视图表表示上的分层聚类树定义叶级语义邻域，而每个表学习一个残差偏移量，以捕获其在该邻域内的独特内容。在训练过程中，编码器-解码器模型学习将 NL 查询直接映射到这些连续代码，从而实现索引结构和查询表对齐的端到端优化。在推理时，该模型生成一个连续代码，该代码通过近似最近邻搜索将密集检索的灵活性与分层索引的语义连贯性相结合，与预先计算的表代码进行有效匹配。为了支持动态表摄取，我们进一步引入了一种内存高效的持续学习策略，该策略冻结基本表示并仅调整新表的本地偏移量，从而有效地减轻灾难性遗忘。对三个基准的大量实验表明，$L^{3} C$ 在 P@1 中比最先进的方法高出 6.5 个点，同时在持续更新下保持可扩展的推理和鲁棒性。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: APEX: Adaptive Variable-wise Parallel Execution for Worst-Case Optimal Joins on Graph Queries
papers.title_zh: APEX：图查询上最坏情况最优连接的自适应变量并行执行
papers.authors: Yipeng Liu, Yuming Lin, Zhicheng Pan, Chengcheng Yang, you li, Aoying Zhou
papers.abstract: Graph queries are ubiquitous in graph databases and knowledge graphs, supporting applications such as recommender systems, question answering, and semantic search. In recent years, worst-case optimal join (WCOJ) algorithms play a critical role in evaluating graph queries. However, their practical performance is hindered by load imbalance in parallelization and poor execution order of join variables. In this paper, we propose APEX, Adaptive variable-wise Parallel EXecution for WCOJ on graph queries. First, APEX parallelizes the core intersection operations in Leapfrog Triejoin by materializing and organizing all intersection results for a variable at once. This is enabled by a candidate propagation graph, which captures dependencies among variables and their intersection results. Second, we further propose a reinforcement learning policy with a graph convolutional network encoder that selects the next variable based on query structure and runtime feedback. To accelerate lookups on the candidate propagation graph, we introduce two techniques: (i) dependency-source detection to prune the traversal space, and (ii) a Bloom filter to avoid redundant checks. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that APEX achieves up to $\mathbf{2. 4 2 - 5. 7 9} \boldsymbol{\times}$ speedup over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.abstract_zh: 图查询在图数据库和知识图谱中无处不在，支持推荐系统、问答和语义搜索等应用。近年来，最坏情况最优连接（WCOJ）算法在评估图查询方面发挥着关键作用。然而，它们的实际性能受到并行化负载不平衡和连接变量执行顺序不佳的阻碍。在本文中，我们提出了 APEX，即针对图查询上的 WCOJ 的自适应变量并行执行。首先，APEX 通过一次性具体化和组织变量的所有交集结果，并行化 Leapfrog Triejoin 中的核心交集运算。这是通过候选传播图实现的，该图捕获变量及其交集结果之间的依赖关系。其次，我们进一步提出了一种带有图卷积网络编码器的强化学习策略，该编码器根据查询结构和运行时反馈选择下一个变量。为了加速候选传播图的查找，我们引入了两种技术：（i）依赖源检测来修剪遍历空间，以及（ii）布隆过滤器来避免冗余检查。对各种真实世界和合成数据集的大量实验表明，APEX 的性能高达 $\mathbf{2. 4 2 - 5. 7 9} \boldsymbol{\times}$ 比最先进的基线加速。

papers.title: SINDI: An Efficient Index for Sparse Vector Approximate Maximum Inner Product Search
papers.title_zh: SINDI：稀疏向量近似最大内积搜索的有效索引
papers.authors: Ruoxuan Li, Xiaoyao Zhong, Jiabao Jin, Peng Cheng, Wangze Ni, Zhitao Shen, Wei Jia, Xiangyu Wang, Heng Tao Shen, Jingkuan Song
papers.abstract: Sparse vector Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS) is crucial in multi-path retrieval for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Recent inverted index-based and graph-based algorithms have achieved high search accuracy with practical efficiency. However, their performance in production environments is often limited by redundant distance computations and frequent random memory accesses. Furthermore, the compressed storage format of sparse vectors hinders the use of SIMD acceleration. In this paper, we propose the sparse inverted non-redundant distance index (SINDI), which incorporates three key optimizations: (i) Efficient Inner Product Computation: SINDI leverages SIMD acceleration and eliminates redundant identifier lookups, enabling batched inner product computation; (ii) Memory-Friendly Design: SINDI replaces random memory accesses to original vectors with sequential accesses to inverted lists, substantially reducing memory-bound latency. (iii) Vector Pruning: SINDI retains only the high-magnitude non-zero entries of vectors, improving query throughput while maintaining accuracy. We evaluate SINDI on multiple real-world datasets. Experimental results show that SINDI achieves state-of-the-art performance across datasets of varying scales, languages, and models. On the MsMarco dataset, when Recall@50 exceeds 99%, SINDI delivers single-thread query-per-second (QPS) improvements ranging from 4.2 to 26.4 times compared with SEISMIC and PyANNs. Notably, SINDI has been integrated into Ant Group's open-source vector search library, VSAG.
papers.abstract_zh: 稀疏向量最大内积搜索 (MIPS) 对于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的多路径检索至关重要。最近的基于倒排索引和基于图的算法已经实现了高搜索精度和实用效率。然而，它们在生产环境中的性能通常受到冗余距离计算和频繁的随机内存访问的限制。此外，稀疏向量的压缩存储格式阻碍了SIMD加速的使用。在本文中，我们提出了稀疏倒排非冗余距离索引（SINDI），它包含三个关键优化：（i）高效内积计算：SINDI利用SIMD加速并消除冗余标识符查找，从而实现批量内积计算； (ii) 内存友好型设计：SINDI 将原始向量的随机内存访问替换为对倒排列表的顺序访问，从而大大减少了内存限制的延迟。 (iii)向量剪枝：SINDI仅保留向量的高幅度非零条目，在保持准确性的同时提高查询吞吐量。我们在多个真实数据集上评估 SINDI。实验结果表明，SINDI 在不同规模、语言和模型的数据集上实现了最先进的性能。在 MsMarco 数据集上，当 Recall@50 超过 99% 时，SINDI 的每秒单线程查询 (QPS) 与 SEISMIC 和 PyANN 相比提高了 4.2 到 26.4 倍。值得注意的是，SINDI 已被集成到蚂蚁集团的开源向量搜索库 VSAG 中。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: Information Leakage from Prices in Query-based Data Markets
papers.title_zh: 基于查询的数据市场中价格的信息泄漏
papers.authors: Teng Tu, Huanhuan Peng, Xiaoye Miao, Guanjie Cheng, Shuiguang Deng, JIanwei Yin
papers.abstract: Query-based pricing enables personalized data acquisition for buyers, exhibiting strong potential in data markets. Prior studies design arbitrage-free price functions to accelerate query price computation. However, the proposed prices often correlate with query answers, leaking information about the underlying data. In this paper, we study information leakage and attack surfaces in query pricing with the goal of designing mitigation strategies that mislead attackers at the pricing stage, which maintains bounded overpayment for buyers. We introduce three price-only inference attacks that derive sensitive information at no financial cost, when investigating how query prices leak information about data existence and cardinality. To reduce the leakage risk, we propose PerPricer, a perturbationbased pricing framework that releases masked prices computed on perturbed data with bounded overpayment guarantees for buyers. It is suitable for existing query pricing mechanisms. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets and benchmarks verify the existence of information leakage in query pricing and the effectiveness of the proposed PerPricer.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于查询的定价可以为买家提供个性化的数据获取，在数据市场上展现出强大的潜力。先前的研究设计了无套利价格函数来加速查询价格计算。然而，建议的价格通常与查询答案相关，从而泄露有关基础数据的信息。在本文中，我们研究了查询定价中的信息泄漏和攻击面，目的是设计在定价阶段误导攻击者的缓解策略，从而维持买家的有限超额支付。在调查查询价格如何泄露有关数据存在和基数的信息时，我们引入了三种仅价格推理攻击，这些攻击无需财务成本即可获取敏感信息。为了降低泄漏风险，我们提出了 PerPricer，这是一种基于扰动的定价框架，它发布根据扰动数据计算出的掩盖价格，并为买家提供有限的超额付款保证。它适用于现有的查询定价机制。对现实世界数据集和基准的大量实验验证了查询定价中信息泄漏的存在以及所提出的 PerPricer 的有效性。

papers.title: Maximum Balanced Clique Search on Large Directed Graphs
papers.title_zh: 大有向图上的最大平衡团搜索
papers.authors: Jianhua Wang, Jianye Yang, Zhaoquan Gu, Dian Ouyang, Ziyi Ma, Ying Zhang
papers.abstract: The classical maximum clique problem, which aims to identify the largest clique, has various applications, such as community search, team formation, motif detection, etc. Recent studies mainly focus on undirected graphs. For directed graphs, a simple method is to consider the undirected version. However, neglecting the direction information may lead to unsatisfactory results. In this work, we aim to discover the maximum balanced clique, where each vertex has the same number of incoming and outgoing neighbors. This problem is computationally challenging because of its NP-hardness. In addition, there are currently no scalable algorithms for it. To fill the gap, we first introduce a branch-and-bound algorithm, namely DMBC, which incorporates several techniques to avoid unneeded computations. To further enhance the performance of DMBC, we then devise two types of optimizations, i.e., advanced pruning rules to discard useless branches and effective search strategies to improve the pruning capacity. Last, to discover a large enough and balanced clique, we develop a heuristic approach with high efficiency and accuracy. Extensive evaluations on 14 real-world datasets state that our methods achieve substantial improvements over existing baselines by up to 2 orders of magnitude.
papers.abstract_zh: 经典的最大派系问题旨在识别最大派系，具有多种应用，例如社区搜索、团队形成、主题检测等。最近的研究主要集中在无向图。对于有向图，一个简单的方法是考虑无向图。然而，忽略方向信息可能会导致不令人满意的结果。在这项工作中，我们的目标是发现最大平衡派，其中每个顶点具有相同数量的传入和传出邻居。由于其 NP 难度，该问题在计算上具有挑战性。此外，目前还没有可扩展的算法。为了填补这一空白，我们首先引入一种分支定界算法，即 DMBC，它结合了多种技术来避免不必要的计算。为了进一步提高 DMBC 的性能，我们设计了两种类型的优化，即丢弃无用分支的高级剪枝规则和提高剪枝能力的有效搜索策略。最后，为了发现足够大且平衡的派系，我们开发了一种高效且准确的启发式方法。对 14 个真实世界数据集的广泛评估表明，我们的方法比现有基线实现了高达 2 个数量级的实质性改进。

papers.title: Online Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Prediction: A Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Contrastive Framework
papers.title_zh: 在线多模态时空预测：强化学习和动态对比框架
papers.authors: Ziquan Fang, Tinghui Luo, Xiaole Pan, Lu Chen, Surun Ji, Mingfan Lu
papers.abstract: Spatio-temporal prediction is fundamental for traffic management, environmental monitoring, and weather forecasting. While integrating multi-modal information can substantially improve predictive accuracy, the dynamic and evolving nature of spatio-temporal data poses three major challenges: (i) the necessity to adaptively adjust modality contributions as data distributions shift over time; (ii) the presence of sensor noise and unreliable modalities, which undermine prediction robustness; and (iii) the computational overhead of large multi-modal architectures that limits online deployment. To overcome these issues, we propose ROMST, a Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Contrastive Framework for Online Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Prediction. ROMST introduces a reinforcement learning-based adaptive fusion mechanism that continuously optimizes inter-modal weights under streaming and non-stationary conditions. Besides, a Dynamic Contrastive Learning (DCL) module exploits spatio-temporal correlations to distinguish informative signals from noise, improving robustness in dynamic environments. To enhance efficiency, ROMST leverages the Mamba state-space architecture for linear-complexity sequence modeling and applies unstructured pruning to large language models (LLMs) for lightweight textual encoding. Extensive experiments on four real-world multi-modal datasets demonstrate that ROMST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 37.06% improvement in accuracy and 72.15% reduction in computational cost. The source code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/ZJU-DAILY/ROMST.
papers.abstract_zh: 时空预测是交通管理、环境监测和天气预报的基础。虽然整合多模态信息可以显著提高预测准确性，但时空数据的动态和不断发展的性质提出了三个主要挑战：（i）随着数据分布随时间的变化而自适应调整模态贡献的必要性； (ii) 传感器噪声和不可靠模式的存在会损害预测的稳健性； (iii) 大型多模态架构的计算开销限制了在线部署。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了 ROMST，一种用于在线多模态时空预测的强化学习和动态对比框架。 ROMST引入了基于强化学习的自适应融合机制，可以在流和非平稳条件下持续优化模间权重。此外，动态对比学习（DCL）模块利用时空相关性来区分信息信号和噪声，从而提高动态环境中的鲁棒性。为了提高效率，ROMST 利用 Mamba 状态空间架构进行线性复杂性序列建模，并将非结构化剪枝应用于大型语言模型 (LLM) 以实现轻量级文本编码。对四个真实世界多模态数据集的大量实验表明，ROMST 始终优于最先进的基线，准确率提高了 37.06%，计算成本降低了 72.15%。源代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/ZJU-DAILY/ROMST 上公开获取。

papers.title: Mirror Asymmetry Perfect Hashing: A Memory-Efficient and Load-Intensive-Optimized Hashing Index on Hybrid DRAM-PMem Architecture
papers.title_zh: 镜像不对称完美哈希：混合 DRAM-PMem 架构上的内存高效且负载密集型优化的哈希索引
papers.authors: Jingcheng Ju, Zirui Liu, Kaicheng Yang, Tong Yang, Yikai Zhao, Feng Liu, Guodong Yang, Xingchun Wang, Duohe Ma
papers.abstract: The increasing demand for high-performance key-value (KV) stores has driven the adoption of hierarchical memory architectures combining fast DRAM with persistent memory (PMem). Current solutions struggle to balance high load factors with high write performance and low DRAM overhead. This arises from the PMem-DRAM speed gap, which makes PMemside collision resolution a performance bottleneck, and mitigating this often requires maintaining more complex DRAM-side mapping metadata. This paper proposes Mirror Asymmetry Perfect Hashing (MAPH), a cuckoo hashing-based hybrid DRAM-PMem KV store with a dynamic perfect hashing index, that achieves DRAM-only collision resolution through asymmetric position decoupling across memory tiers, enabling high load factors with minimal DRAM metadata overhead. Our approach simultaneously achieves high load factors, low latency, and high concurrent throughput. Experimental evaluation demonstrates $\mathbf{2. 8} \times-\mathbf{1 3. 6} \times$ lower latency and significantly higher throughput than state-ofthe-art solutions, while incurring lower DRAM space overhead and competitive PMem efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: 对高性能键值 (KV) 存储的需求不断增长，推动了将快速 DRAM 与持久内存 (PMem) 相结合的分层内存架构的采用。当前的解决方案很难在高负载系数与高写入性能和低 DRAM 开销之间取得平衡。这是由 PMem-DRAM 速度差距引起的，这使得 PMemside 冲突解决成为性能瓶颈，而缓解这一问题通常需要维护更复杂的 DRAM 端映射元数据。本文提出了镜像不对称完美哈希 (MAPH)，这是一种基于布谷鸟哈希的混合 DRAM-PMem KV 存储，具有动态完美哈希索引，通过跨内存层的不对称位置解耦实现仅 DRAM 的冲突解决，从而以最小的 DRAM 元数据开销实现高负载因子。我们的方法同时实现了高负载因子、低延迟和高并发吞吐量。实验评估证明了$\mathbf{2. 8} \times-\mathbf{1 3. 6} \times$ 与最先进的解决方案相比，延迟更低，吞吐量显著提高，同时 DRAM 空间开销更低，PMem 效率具有竞争力。

papers.title: Elena: An Explainability-aided Online Query Optimization Framework
papers.title_zh: Elena：可解释性辅助的在线查询优化框架
papers.authors: Yuan Dong, Yuanyuan Yao, Yangyang Wu, Lu Chen, Rong Zhu
papers.abstract: In recent years, learned query optimizers have achieved remarkable progress in reducing overall execution latency by leveraging machine learning methods and large language models. However, in online scenarios, the continuous accumulation of training samples results in substantial retraining overhead. Though some studies try to reduce the training scale through sample selection strategies, such as choosing the most recent samples or using another grading model to decide their reservation, these approaches cannot guarantee the quality of the selected samples because the selection process lacks interpretability. Therefore, achieving high query performance with low training costs in online scenarios remains a critical challenge. To address this limitation, we propose an Explainability-aided onLine quEry optimizatioN frAmework, Elena, designed to achieve high query performance while minimizing retraining overhead. Elena designs two interpretable modules: (i) Dynamic sample selector which utilizes influence score to retain the highquality samples from the historical samples and applies a tailored similarity measurement to capture valued and diverse new samples, while guaranteeing the bounded training set size by theoretical proof; (ii) Adaptive feature selector which automatically identifies the features most critical to model performance, guiding the training and inference towards active features to improve the performance. Experiments across multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that Elena significantly reduces the retraining cost of learned optimizers by up to 67% while maintaining performance, resulting in up to 18% reduction in plan execution time. These results highlight that Elena can achieve novel performance under an extremely limited training set.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，学习查询优化器通过利用机器学习方法和大型语言模型，在减少整体执行延迟方面取得了显著进展。然而，在线场景下，训练样本的不断积累会导致大量的再训练开销。尽管一些研究试图通过样本选择策略来减少训练规模，例如选择最新的样本或使用其他评分模型来决定其保留，但这些方法不能保证所选样本的质量，因为选择过程缺乏可解释性。因此，在线场景下以低训练成本实现高查询性能仍然是一个严峻的挑战。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了一种可解释性辅助的在线查询优化框架 Elena，旨在实现高查询性能，同时最大限度地减少再训练开销。 Elena 设计了两个可解释的模块：（i）动态样本选择器，利用影响力分数保留历史样本中的高质量样本，并应用定制的相似性测量来捕获有价值且多样化的新样本，同时通过理论证明保证有界训练集大小； (ii) 自适应特征选择器，自动识别对模型性能最关键的特征，指导对主动特征的训练和推理以提高性能。跨多个公共基准的实验表明，Elena 在保持性能的同时，将学习优化器的再训练成本显著降低了高达 67%，从而使计划执行时间缩短了高达 18%。这些结果表明，Elena 可以在极其有限的训练集下实现新颖的表现。

papers.title: PRIME: Efficient Algorithm for Token Graph Routing Problem
papers.title_zh: PRIME：令牌图路由问题的高效算法
papers.authors: Haotian Xu, Yuqing Zhu, Yuming Huang, Jing Tang
papers.abstract: Optimizing asset exchanges on blockchain-driven platforms poses a novel and challenging graph query optimization problem. In this model, assets represent vertices and exchanges form edges, recasting the graph query task as a routing problem over a large-scale, dynamic graph. However, the existing solutions fail to solve the problem efficiently due to the non-linear nature of the edge weights defined by a concave swap function. To address the challenge, we propose PRIME, a two-stage iterative graph algorithm designed for the Token Graph Routing Problem (TGRP). The first stage employs a pruned graph search to efficiently identify a set of high-potential routing paths. The second stage formulates the allocation task as a strongly convex optimization problem, which we solve using our novel Adaptive Sign Gradient Method (ASGM) with a linear convergence rate. Extensive experiments on real-world Ethereum data confirm PRIME's advantages over industry baselines. PRIME consistently outperforms the widely-used Uniswap routing algorithm, achieving up to 8.42 basis points (bps) better execution prices on large trades while reducing computation up to 96.7%. The practicality of PRIME is further validated by its deployment in hedge fund production environments, demonstrating its viability as a scalable graph query processing solution for high-frequency decentralized markets.
papers.abstract_zh: 在区块链驱动的平台上优化资产交换提出了一个新颖且具有挑战性的图查询优化问题。在这个模型中，资产代表顶点，交换形成边，将图查询任务重新定义为大规模动态图上的路由问题。然而，由于凹交换函数定义的边权重的非线性性质，现有的解决方案无法有效地解决该问题。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 PRIME，这是一种专为令牌图路由问题（TGRP）设计的两阶段迭代图算法。第一阶段采用修剪图搜索来有效识别一组高潜力路由路径。第二阶段将分配任务表述为强凸优化问题，我们使用具有线性收敛速度的新颖的自适应符号梯度法（ASGM）来解决该问题。对现实世界以太坊数据的大量实验证实了 PRIME 相对于行业基线的优势。 PRIME 始终优于广泛使用的 Uniswap 路由算法，在大额交易中实现了高达 8.42 个基点 (bps) 的更好执行价格，同时减少了高达 96.7% 的计算量。 PRIME 的实用性通过其在对冲基金生产环境中的部署得到进一步验证，证明了其作为高频去中心化市场的可扩展图形查询处理解决方案的可行性。

papers.title: Fast and Accurate Element-Level Streaming CP Decomposition for Higher-Order Tensors
papers.title_zh: 高阶张量的快速准确的元素级流式 CP 分解
papers.authors: Jeongyoung Lee, SeungJoo Lee, U Kang
papers.abstract: How can we efficiently and accurately analyze a tensor when only partial observations arrive over time? In an element-level streaming setting, only a subset of entries within the newest slice of a tensor is revealed at each update, either individually or in small groups. This formulation naturally arises when seasonal multivariate time-series are folded into higherorder tensors to separate periodic components (e.g., day-of-week) from longer trends, and new data appear as elements rather than full slices. Existing streaming tensor decomposition methods, designed for slice-level updates, become inefficient or inaccurate when applied to element-level streams. In this paper, we propose ENTP (Element-Level Streaming CP Decomposition), a fast and accurate online tensor decomposition method specifically designed for element-level tensor streams. ENTP partitions observations into structured subtensors and reformulates the optimization to include only the newly revealed entries, enabling accurate updates that affect only the relevant factors while avoiding redundant computation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that ENTP achieves up to $28 \times$ speed-up over state-of-the-art baselines for streaming tensor decomposition, while maintaining comparable or higher accuracy. We further demonstrate that ENTP delivers strong predictive performance and scalability, confirming its effectiveness for realtime applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 当随着时间的推移只有部分观测值到达时，我们如何有效、准确地分析张量？在元素级流设置中，每次更新时仅单独或以小组形式显示张量最新切片内的条目子集。当季节性多元时间序列被折叠成高阶张量以将周期性成分（例如，星期几）与较长趋势分开时，这种公式自然会出现，并且新数据显示为元素而不是完整的切片。专为切片级更新而设计的现有流式张量分解方法在应用于元素级流时会变得低效或不准确。在本文中，我们提出了ENTP（元素级流CP分解），这是一种专为元素级张量流设计的快速准确的在线张量分解方法。 ENTP 将观察结果划分为结构化子张量，并重新制定优化以仅包括新发现的条目，从而实现仅影响相关因素的准确更新，同时避免冗余计算。对现实世界数据集的大量实验表明，ENTP 在流式张量分解的最先进基线上实现了高达 28 倍的加速，同时保持相当或更高的精度。我们进一步证明 ENTP 具有强大的预测性能和可扩展性，证实了其对于实时应用程序的有效性。

papers.title: Answering Federated Range Queries with Local Differential Privacy
papers.title_zh: 使用本地差异隐私回答联合范围查询
papers.authors: Yuemin Zhang, Qingqing Ye, Junxu Liu, Wei Dong
papers.abstract: Answering range queries under local differential privacy (LDP) is a well-studied problem, which enables service providers to gain insights into decentralized data distributions. However, existing approaches operate exclusively in a single-party setting and prove challenging to extend to practical cross-party environments. In this paper we study the problem of federated range queries under LDP, which addresses cross-party range queries in decentralized settings. Applying LDP to federated range queries amplifies statistical heterogeneity challenges, as utility deterioration stems from not only the accumulated LDP noise, but also the unrealistic uniform- or linear-distribution assumption in existing methods. Our solution, the private cubic spline (PrivCS) mechanism, employs a hierarchical interval tree structure to model the underlying data distribution and accurately answer arbitrary range queries, effectively addressing the problem while satisfying $\epsilon$-LDP. Additionally, we introduce the collaborative frequency filtering aggregation that adaptively calibrates and masks frequency estimates by leveraging relationships among across-party frequencies and analyzing pruning bias, thereby reducing the cumulative noise. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to explore federated range queries in cross-party scenarios, under the stringent LDP guarantee. Comprehensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本地差分隐私（LDP）下回答范围查询是一个经过充分研究的问题，它使服务提供商能够深入了解去中心化的数据分布。然而，现有的方法仅在单方环境中运行，并且证明很难扩展到实际的跨方环境。在本文中，我们研究了 LDP 下的联合范围查询问题，它解决了去中心化设置中的跨方范围查询。将 LDP 应用于联合范围查询会放大统计异质性挑战，因为效用恶化不仅源于累积的 LDP 噪声，还源于现有方法中不切实际的均匀分布或线性分布假设。我们的解决方案，私有三次样条（PrivCS）机制，采用分层区间树结构对底层数据分布进行建模并准确回答任意范围查询，在满足$\epsilon$-LDP的同时有效解决问题。此外，我们引入了协作频率过滤聚合，它通过利用跨方频率之间的关系并分析修剪偏差来自适应地校准和屏蔽频率估计，从而减少累积噪声。据我们所知，这是第一个在严格的 LDP 保证下探索跨方场景中联合范围查询的研究。对现实世界和合成数据集的综合实验证明了我们机制的有效性。

papers.title: GoCache: Accelerating Out-of-Core Graph Queries with Pattern-Driven Caching
papers.title_zh: GoCache：通过模式驱动的缓存加速核外图查询
papers.authors: Zheng Yang, Yicheng Zhang, Lixiao Cui, Luofan Chen, Chongzhuo Yang, Xiaojian Luo, Sijie Shen, Wenyuan Yu, Jingren Zhou, Cheng Li
papers.abstract: Modern graph applications require low-latency query processing, but the increasing scale of graph data forces the use of out-of-core processing. Conventional cache designs perform poorly in this setting, causing severe throughput degradation and low SSD utilization. Our analysis of the LDBC SNB benchmark traces these issues to two root causes: the inefficient handling of warm data and the underutilization of I/O parallelism inherent in graph traversals. This paper presents GoCache, a high-performance userspace cache that accelerates out-of-core graph queries through two key innovations: (1) dSIEVE, a two-layer eviction policy that protects warm data from premature eviction, significantly reducing miss rates; and (2) an intelligent I/O subsystem that exploits inherent parallelism in graph traversals by injecting batched I/O operations into query execution plans, dramatically improving SSD bandwidth utilization and reducing I/O latency. Implemented in 3,900 lines of C++ and integrated with GraphScope, GoCache achieves 37-80% higher throughput than MMAP and 89-118% higher than TriCache, effectively alleviating the I/O bottleneck in large-scale graph processing. We hope the results demonstrates its effectiveness as a deployable, high-performance caching solution for large-scale graph query workloads. We plan to open-source the system upon acceptance.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代图应用程序需要低延迟查询处理，但图数据规模的不断增加迫使使用核外处理。传统的缓存设计在这种情况下表现不佳，导致吞吐量严重下降和 SSD 利用率低。我们对 LDBC SNB 基准的分析将这些问题追溯到两个根本原因：热数据的低效处理和图遍历中固有的 I/O 并行性的利用不足。本文介绍了 GoCache，一种高性能用户空间缓存，它通过两项关键创新来加速核外图查询：(1) dSIEVE，一种两层逐出策略，可保护热数据免遭过早逐出，显著降低丢失率； (2) 智能 I/O 子系统，通过将批量 I/O 操作注入查询执行计划，利用图遍历中固有的并行性，显著提高 SSD 带宽利用率并减少 I/O 延迟。 GoCache用3900行C++实现，并与GraphScope集成，吞吐量比MMAP高37-80%，比TriCache高89-118%，有效缓解大规模图处理的I/O瓶颈。我们希望结果能够证明其作为大规模图形查询工作负载的可部署高性能缓存解决方案的有效性。我们计划在接受后开源该系统。

papers.title: SkyNet: Solving Skyline Queries with Neural Networks
papers.title_zh: SkyNet：使用神经网络解决天际线查询
papers.authors: Jinfei Liu, Jiayao Zhang, Pengyun Zhu, Li Xiong, Jian Pei
papers.abstract: Skyline computation, aiming at identifying a set of skyline points that are not dominated by any other point, is particularly useful for multi-criteria data analysis and decision making. The long-standing time complexity for computing skyline is $O\left(n \log ^{d-1} n\right)$, where $n$ is the number of points and $d$ is the number of dimensions. This can be prohibitively expensive in high dimensional space. One major challenge for the skyline problem is how to further scale it up with better time cost, especially for high dimensional space. In this paper, we propose the first neural architecture based on graph neural networks to learn skyline patterns (SkyNet). We define three types of skyline graphs to map points into graph structures. Given SkyNet, we can predict the skyline rather than compute the skyline using traditional comparison-based algorithms. To further enhance accuracy, we introduce a new Spatial Graph Attention mechanism (SGAT). SGAT captures deep relative spatial information between points, which is crucial for identifying dominance relationships and predicting the skyline. We also propose space-aware and layer-based loss functions, so that the trained model can better learn the spatial relationship between points. Extensive experiments show that SkyNet and its variants achieve high accuracy, efficiency, and transferability.
papers.abstract_zh: 天际线计算旨在识别一组不受任何其他点支配的天际线点，对于多标准数据分析和决策特别有用。计算天际线的长期时间复杂度为 $O\left(n \log ^{d-1} n\right)$，其中 $n$ 是点数，$d$ 是维度数。在高维空间中，这可能非常昂贵。天际线问题的一大挑战是如何以更好的时间成本进一步扩大规模，特别是对于高维空间。在本文中，我们提出了第一个基于图神经网络的神经架构来学习天际线模式（SkyNet）。我们定义了三种类型的天际线图来将点映射到图结构中。给定 SkyNet，我们可以预测天际线，而不是使用传统的基于比较的算法来计算天际线。为了进一步提高准确性，我们引入了一种新的空间图注意力机制（SGAT）。 SGAT 捕获点之间的深层相对空间信息，这对于识别优势关系和预测天际线至关重要。我们还提出了空间感知和基于图层的损失函数，以便训练后的模型可以更好地学习点之间的空间关系。大量实验表明，SkyNet 及其变体实现了高精度、高效率和可转移性。

papers.title: LLMIA: An Out-of-the-Box Index Advisor via In-Context Learning with LLMs
papers.title_zh: LLMIA：通过大语言模型上下文学习实现开箱即用的索引顾问
papers.authors: Xinxin Zhao, Xinmei Huang, Haoyang Li, Jing Zhang, Shuai Wang, Tieying Zhang, Jianjun Chen, Rui Shi, Cuiping Li, Hong Chen
papers.abstract: Index recommendation is crucial for optimizing database performance. However, existing heuristic- and learning-based methods often rely on inefficient exhaustive search and estimated costs, leading to low efficiency (due to the vast search space) and unsatisfactory actual latency (due to inaccurate estimations). Inspired by the refinement strategies of experienced DBAs-who efficiently identify and iteratively refine indexes with database feedback-we present LLMIA, an out-of-the-box, tuning-free index advisor leveraging large language models (LLMs) through in-context learning for index recommendation. LLMIA injects database expertise into the LLM using a high-quality demonstration pool and comprehensive workload feature extraction, while iteratively incorporating database feedback to guide the index refinement. This design enables LLMIA to emulate the decision-making process of expert DBAs: efficiently recommending and refining indexes for various workloads within just a few interactions with the DBMS. We validate LLMIA with extensive experiments on five standard OLAP benchmarks (TPC-H with different scales, JOB, TPC-DS, SSB), where it consistently outperforms or matches 12 baselines by producing superior index recommendations with minimal database interactions. Additionally, LLMIA demonstrates robust generalization on two real-world commercial workloads, delivering high-quality recommendations without the need for additional adaptation or retraining, highlighting its out-of-the-box capability.
papers.abstract_zh: 索引推荐对于优化数据库性能至关重要。然而，现有的启发式和基于学习的方法通常依赖于低效的穷举搜索和估计成本，导致效率低下（由于搜索空间巨大）和不令人满意的实际延迟（由于不准确的估计）。受经验丰富的 DBA 的细化策略（他们通过数据库反馈有效识别和迭代地细化索引）的启发，我们推出了 LLMIA，这是一种开箱即用、免调整的索引顾问，通过上下文学习进行索引推荐，利用大型语言模型 (LLM)。 LLMIA 使用高质量的演示池和全面的工作负载特征提取，将数据库专业知识注入 LLM，同时迭代地合并数据库反馈来指导索引细化。这种设计使 LLMIA 能够模拟专家 DBA 的决策过程：只需与 DBMS 进行几次交互即可有效地推荐和细化各种工作负载的索引。我们通过对五个标准 OLAP 基准（具有不同规模的 TPC-H、JOB、TPC-DS、SSB）进行大量实验来验证 LLMIA，通过以最少的数据库交互生成卓越的索引建议，它始终优于或匹配 12 个基准。此外，LLMIA 展示了对两个现实世界商业工作负载的强大泛化能力，无需额外的调整或重新训练即可提供高质量的建议，凸显了其开箱即用的功能。

papers.title: Approximate Diverse k-nearest Neighbor Search in Vector Database
papers.title_zh: 向量数据库中的近似多样化 k 最近邻搜索
papers.authors: Jiachen ZHAO, Xiao Yan, Eric Lo
papers.abstract: Approximate $k$-nearest neighbor search (A$k$-NNS) is a core operation in vector databases, underpinning applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and image retrieval. In these scenarios, users often prefer diverse result sets to minimize redundancy and enhance information value. However, existing greedy-based diverse methods frequently yield sub-optimal results, failing to adequately approximate the optimal similarity score under certain diversification level. Furthermore, there is a need for flexible algorithms that can adapt to varying user-defined result sizes and diversity requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach that seamlessly integrates result diversification into state-of-the-art (SOTA) A$k$-NNS methods. Our approach introduces a progressive search framework, consisting of iterative searching, diversification, and verification phases. Carefully designed diversification and verification steps enable our approach to efficiently approximate the optimal diverse result set according to user-specified diversification levels without additional indexing overhead. We evaluate our method on three million-scale benchmark datasets, LAION-art, Deep1M, and Txt2img, using latency, similarity, and recall as performance metrics across a range of $k$ values and diversification thresholds. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently retrieves near-optimal diverse results with minimal latency overhead, particularly under medium and high diversity settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 近似 $k$-最近邻搜索 (A$k$-NNS) 是矢量数据库中的核心操作，为检索增强生成 (RAG) 和图像检索等应用提供基础。在这些场景中，用户通常更喜欢多样化的结果集，以最大限度地减少冗余并提高信息价值。然而，现有的基于贪婪的多样化方法经常产生次优结果，无法在一定多样化水平下充分近似最佳相似度得分。此外，需要灵活的算法来适应不同的用户定义的结果大小和多样性要求。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，将结果多样化无缝集成到最先进的 (SOTA) A$k$-NNS 方法中。我们的方法引入了渐进式搜索框架，包括迭代搜索、多样化和验证阶段。精心设计的多样化和验证步骤使我们的方法能够根据用户指定的多样化水平有效地近似最佳多样化结果集，而无需额外的索引开销。我们在 300 万规模的基准数据集、LAION-art、Deep1M 和 Txt2img 上评估我们的方法，使用延迟、相似性和召回率作为一系列 $k$ 值和多样化阈值的性能指标。实验结果表明，我们的方法始终以最小的延迟开销检索接近最佳的多样化结果，特别是在中和高多样性设置下。

papers.title: RaSE-KGC: A Relation-Aware Segment Encoding Approach for Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.title_zh: RaSE-KGC：一种用于知识图补全的关系感知分段编码方法
papers.authors: Chenxiao Lin, Ye Luo, Kunhong Liu, Qingqiang Wu
papers.abstract: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) have shown strong potential for knowledge graph completion (KGC) by leveraging the rich semantic information contained in entity descriptions. However, their performance is often limited by fixed input length constraints, which lead to the truncation of important textual cues. Existing solutions, such as context compression and multi-segment encoding, can process longer texts but either lose fine-grained semantic details or introduce substantial computational overhead. Moreover, they lack the ability to adaptively focus on the segment that is most relevant to a given query. To address these limitations, we propose RaSE-KGC, a relation-aware segment encoding approach for KGC that employs hierarchical cross-attention to dynamically capture the most informative segments of entity descriptions with respect to the query relation. RaSE-KGC organizes the information of incomplete triples into three hierarchical levels—sentence, description, and entity—and selectively aggregates their representations through relation-guided attention. To enhance discriminative representation learning while ensuring training efficiency, RaSE-KGC incorporates (1) a recursive encoder that progressively processes only the most salient tokens through shared parameters, and (2) a dynamic corpus refinement strategy that discards sentences and neighbors receiving low attention from the query relation. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets of varying scales show that RaSE-KGC achieves state-of-theart performance while preserving high computational efficiency, offering a new direction for adaptive and scalable PLM-based KGC.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过利用实体描述中包含的丰富语义信息，预训练语言模型 (PLM) 在知识图谱补全 (KGC) 方面表现出了强大的潜力。然而，它们的性能通常受到固定输入长度约束的限制，这会导致重要文本提示的截断。现有的解决方案（例如上下文压缩和多段编码）可以处理较长的文本，但要么会丢失细粒度的语义细节，要么会引入大量的计算开销。此外，它们缺乏自适应地关注与给定查询最相关的片段的能力。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 RaSE-KGC，这是一种用于 KGC 的关系感知片段编码方法，它采用分层交叉注意力来动态捕获与查询关系有关的实体描述中信息最丰富的片段。 RaSE-KGC 将不完整三元组的信息组织成三个层次级别——句子、描述和实体——并通过关系引导的注意力有选择地聚合它们的表示。为了在确保训练效率的同时增强判别性表示学习，RaSE-KGC 结合了（1）递归编码器，通过共享参数逐步仅处理最显著的标记，以及（2）动态语料库细化策略，丢弃从查询关系中受到低关注的句子和邻居。对不同规模的基准数据集进行的大量实验表明，RaSE-KGC 在保持高计算效率的同时实现了最先进的性能，为基于 PLM 的自适应和可扩展的 KGC 提供了新的方向。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: A Set-Theoretic Approach to Detecting Logic Bugs in DBMS Inner Join Optimizations
papers.title_zh: 检测 DBMS 内连接优化中逻辑错误的集合论方法
papers.authors: Ce Lyu, Changzheng Wei, Yanhao  Wang, Jie Liang, Li Lin, Hanghang Wu, Minghao Zhao, Ying Yan, Aoying Zhou
papers.abstract: The query optimizer is a fundamental component of database management systems that determines the most efficient execution strategy for a given query by evaluating alternative query plans. Among its tasks, join optimization plays a central role, as the order of joins in multi-table queries can significantly affect execution performance. However, due to the inherent complexity of join optimization, logical bugs are inevitable and often difficult to detect. While existing fuzzing tools have shown notable success in uncovering crash- and performance-related errors, effectively identifying logical bugs -- cases in which the system produces incorrect query results -- remains largely unresolved. In this paper, we propose a metamorphic testing approach to detect DBMS bugs related to INNER JOIN optimization through the lens of set theory. For each testing case, equivalent queries are generated based on a basic set operation -- intersection -- and three semantics-preserving transformation rules, i.e., symmetric join transformation, asymmetric difference transformation, and symmetric difference transformation, are introduced. These rules rewrite a simple NATURAL/INNER JOIN query into a more complex, yet semantically equivalent, form. We implement this design in JoinEquiv, which serves as a testing oracle to systematically uncover logical inconsistencies in DBMS query processing by comparing the results of original and transformed queries. Using JoinEquiv, we uncovered 29 previously unknown issues in mainstream DBMSs (MySQL, TiDB, DuckDB, and Percona), and 27 of them were officially confirmed. JoinEquiv reveals deep logical flaws in DBMS optimizers and executors, underscoring its value in enhancing DBMS robustness.
papers.abstract_zh: 查询优化器是数据库管理系统的基本组件，它通过评估替代查询计划来确定给定查询的最有效执行策略。在其任务中，连接优化起着核心作用，因为多表查询中的连接顺序会显著影响执行性能。然而，由于连接优化固有的复杂性，逻辑错误是不可避免的，并且通常难以检测。虽然现有的模糊测试工具在发现与崩溃和性能相关的错误方面取得了显著的成功，但有效识别逻辑错误（系统产生错误查询结果的情况）在很大程度上仍未得到解决。在本文中，我们提出了一种变质​​测试方法，通过集合论的视角来检测与 INNER JOIN 优化相关的 DBMS 错误。对于每个测试用例，基于基本集合操作（​​交集）生成等效查询，并引入三种保留语义的变换规则，即对称连接变换、非对称差分变换和对称差分变换。这些规则将简单的 NATURAL/INNER JOIN 查询重写为更复杂但语义等效的形式。我们在 JoinEquiv 中实现了这一设计，它作为一个测试预言机，通过比较原始查询和转换后的查询结果来系统地发现 DBMS 查询处理中的逻辑不一致。使用 JoinEquiv，我们发现了主流 DBMS（MySQL、TiDB、DuckDB 和 Percona）中的 29 个以前未知的问题，其中 27 个已得到官方确认。 JoinEquiv 揭示了 DBMS 优化器和执行器中的深层逻辑缺陷，强调了其在增强 DBMS 稳健性方面的价值。

papers.title: C2graph: A Compression-Collaboration Algorithm for CPU-GPU Hybrid Weighted Graph Traversals
papers.title_zh: C2graph：一种用于 CPU-GPU 混合加权图遍历的压缩协作算法
papers.authors: Ning Wang, Huaibei Li, Shen Su, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Zhigang Wang, Dawei Zhao, Hui Lu, Zhihong Tian
papers.abstract: Most graph algorithms need to iteratively traverse vertices along a large number of edges as well as their weights, rendering them inefficient in both time and space complexities, especially when multi-tenants issue many traversal queries on a given graph. Traditional distributed/parallel solutions mitigate these challenges at the expense of huge hardware investments and high communication delay. Recent studies resort to the modern commodity GPU accelerator and possibly CPUs equipped on a single device, but still face limitations on the memory scalability and the underutilization of compute power. This paper investigates the redundant traversal behaviors and accordingly presents a compression algorithm to prune not only graph topology but also edge weights, reducing noticeable memory usage. We compensate for the lost messages caused by pruned edges and give a theoretical guarantee for correctness. Further, we capture the dynamic workload variation of a traversal query. Motivated by the peak-compute requirements, multiple traversals can adaptively select reasonable accelerators between GPUs and CPUs. Our query optimization minimizes the CPU-GPU collaboration cost and fully utilizes their compute power, improving significant query throughput. Extensive experiments show that compared against state-of-the-art techniques, our compression technique achieves up to $\mathbf{3 6} \%$ memory reduction in the case of a single traversal query. When processing multiple traversal queries, our new collaboration framework achieves a 1.9X runtime decrease.
papers.abstract_zh: 大多数图算法需要沿着大量边及其权重迭代地遍历顶点，这使得它们在时间和空间复杂度上效率低下，特别是当多租户在给定图上发出许多遍历查询时。传统的分布式/并行解决方案以巨大的硬件投资和高通信延迟为代价来缓解这些挑战。最近的研究诉诸于现代商用 GPU 加速器以及可能在单个设备上配备的 CPU，但仍然面临内存可扩展性和计算能力利用率不足的限制。本文研究了冗余遍历行为，并相应地提出了一种压缩算法，不仅可以修剪图拓扑，还可以修剪边权重，从而减少显著的内存使用。我们补偿了由于修剪边缘而导致的消息丢失，并为正确性提供了理论上的保证。此外，我们捕获遍历查询的动态工作负载变化。在峰值计算需求的推动下，多次遍历可以在 GPU 和 CPU 之间自适应地选择合理的加速器。我们的查询优化最大限度地降低了 CPU-GPU 协作成本并充分利用它们的计算能力，从而显著提高查询吞吐量。大量的实验表明，与最先进的技术相比，我们的压缩技术在单个遍历查询的情况下可实现高达 $\mathbf{3 6} \%$ 的内存减少。当处理多个遍历查询时，我们的新协作框架实现了 1.9 倍的运行时间减少。

papers.title: Accelerating Metadata Management of DFS via Speculative Permission Checking
papers.title_zh: 通过推测性权限检查加速 DFS 的元数据管理
papers.authors: Yiduo Wang, Linghang Meng, Liang Li, Jie Wu
papers.abstract: Modern distributed file systems face a critical metadata bottleneck as cloud computing and large-scale machine learning applications generate massive datasets with billions of files. Traditional metadata managements suffer from expensive path resolution: each operation requires $O(N)$ remote procedure calls and database queries to recursively check permissions and locate inodes across hierarchical namespaces. This paper revisits real-world namespace structures and reveals that the vast majority of metadata exhibits a permission descending pattern, enabling safe shortcuts for permission checking. We leverage this insight to design SPMeta, a scalable metadata management that integrates two key techniques: (1) Speculative Permission Checking, which bypasses expensive permission checking while preserving POSIX semantics, and (2) MART, a metadata-optimized trie structure that accelerates both permission checking and inode indexing. By combining these, SPMeta reduces the number of remote procedure calls (RPCs) and database queries for most metadata operations from $O(N)$ to $O(1)$. Evaluation in five real-world namespaces shows that SPMeta achieves superior metadata performance in read-only and mixed workloads, improving aggregate throughput by $\mathbf{1. 4 4} \times$ to $\mathbf{2. 8 6} \times$ over state-of-the-art baselines while scaling to distributed file systems with tens of billions of files.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着云计算和大规模机器学习应用程序生成包含数十亿个文件的海量数据集，现代分布式文件系统面临着关键的元数据瓶颈。传统的元数据管理受到昂贵的路径解析的困扰：每个操作都需要 $O(N)$ 远程过程调用和数据库查询来递归检查权限并跨分层命名空间定位 inode。本文重新审视了现实世界的命名空间结构，并揭示了绝大多数元数据都表现出权限递减模式，从而为权限检查提供了安全的快捷方式。我们利用这种洞察力设计了 SPMeta，这是一种可扩展的元数据管理，它集成了两种关键技术：(1) 推测权限检查，它绕过昂贵的权限检查，同时保留 POSIX 语义；(2) MART，一种元数据优化的 trie 结构，可以加速权限检查和 inode 索引。通过结合这些，SPMeta 将大多数元数据操作的远程过程调用 (RPC) 和数据库查询的数量从 $O(N)$ 减少到 $O(1)$。对五个实际命名空间的评估表明，SPMeta 在只读和混合工作负载中实现了卓越的元数据性能，将聚合吞吐量提高了 $\mathbf{1. 4 4} \times$ 到 $\mathbf{2. 8 6} \times$ 超过最先进的基线，同时扩展到具有数百亿个文件的分布式文件系统。

papers.title: Prompt-Guided Community Search under Extreme Few-Shot Supervision
papers.title_zh: 极少数镜头监督下的快速引导社区搜索
papers.authors: Wenxin Yang, Kaiyu Feng, Lanting Fang, Kangfei  Zhao, Xia Wu
papers.abstract: Community search, which aims to identify cohesive subgraphs containing given query nodes, is a fundamental task in graph analysis. Existing learning-based methods depend heavily on abundant labeled communities, making them ineffective in realistic settings where labels are extreme scarce. Although several methods have been proposed to mitigate label scarcity, they still fail to perform robustly across both sparsely and densely labeled datasets due to three key limitations: (i) a query-nodecentric design that always treats the query node as the community center, causing errors when the query lies near the community boundary; (ii) lack of connectivity guarantee, as similarity-based expansions may yield disconnected results; and (iii) dependence on labeled data, where unsupervised models lack supervision while semi-supervised ones easily overfit when labels are rare. To address these issues, we propose Prompt-Guided Community Search (PGCS), a novel “pre-train, prompt, and search” framework. We design novel pretraining tasks that capture structural characteristics such as density and cohesiveness. We introduce a prompt function that measures the goodness of subgraph expansion, effectively bridging pretrained knowledge with community search. To overcome label scarcity, we propose a dual-prompt mix-training strategy, which utilize both ground truth communities and soft labels generated from unlabeled nodes. Finally, we develop an online search algorithm that expands from the query node into a coherent and connected community. Extensive experiments on nine real-world datasets show that PGCS consistently outperforms traditional and recent learning-based baselines in both accuracy and efficiency. On average, our proposed method outperforms SOTAs by up to 35.16% across all datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 社区搜索旨在识别包含给定查询节点的内聚子图，是图分析中的一项基本任务。现有的基于学习的方法在很大程度上依赖于丰富的标记社区，这使得它们在标签极其稀缺的现实环境中无效。尽管已经提出了几种方法来减轻标签稀缺性，但由于三个关键限制，它们仍然无法在稀疏和密集标记数据集上稳健地执行：（i）以查询节点为中心的设计始终将查询节点视为社区中心，当查询位于社区边界附近时会导致错误； (ii) 缺乏连通性保证，因为基于相似性的扩展可能会产生不连贯的结果； (iii) 对标记数据的依赖，其中无监督模型缺乏监督，而当标签很少时，半监督模型很容易过度拟合。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了提示引导社区搜索（PGCS），这是一种新颖的“预训练、提示和搜索”框架。我们设计了新颖的预训练任务来捕获密度和内聚性等结构特征。我们引入了一个提示函数来衡量子图扩展的优点，有效地将预训练的知识与社区搜索联系起来。为了克服标签稀缺性，我们提出了一种双提示混合训练策略，该策略利用真值社区和未标记节点生成的软标签。最后，我们开发了一种在线搜索算法，该算法从查询节点扩展到连贯且连接的社区。对九个真实世界数据集的广泛实验表明，PGCS 在准确性和效率方面始终优于传统和最新的基于学习的基线。平均而言，我们提出的方法在所有数据集上的性能比 SOTA 高出 35.16%。

papers.title: Robust Single-message Shuffle Differential Privacy Protocol for Accurate Distribution Estimation
papers.title_zh: 用于准确分布估计的鲁棒单消息随机差分隐私协议
papers.authors: Xiaoguang Li, Hanyi Wang, Yaowei Huang, Jungang Yang, Qingqing Ye, Haonan Yan, Ke Pan, Zhe Sun, Hui Li
papers.abstract: Shuffler-based differential privacy (shuffle-DP) is a privacy paradigm providing high utility by involving a shuffler to permute noisy report from users. Existing shuffle-DP protocols mainly focus on the design of shuffler-based categorical frequency oracle (SCFO) for frequency estimation on categorical data. However, numerical data is a more prevalent type and many real-world applications depend on the estimation of data distribution with ordinal nature. In this paper, we study the distribution estimation under pure shuffle model, which is a prevalent shuffle-DP framework without strong security assumptions. We initially attempt to transplant existing SCFOs and the naïve distribution recovery technique to this task, and demonstrate that these baseline protocols cannot simultaneously achieve outstanding performance in three metrics: 1) utility, 2) message complexity; and 3) robustness to data poisoning attacks. Therefore, we further propose a novel single-message adaptive shuffler-based piecewise (ASP) protocol with high utility and robustness. In ASP, we first develop a randomizer by parameter optimization using our proposed tighter bound of mutual information. We also design an Expectation Maximization with Adaptive Smoothing (EMAS) algorithm to accurately recover distribution with enhanced robustness. To quantify robustness, we propose a new evaluation framework to examine robustness under different attack targets, enabling us to comprehensively understand the protocol resilience under various adversarial scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ASP outperforms baseline protocols in all three metrics. Especially under small $ε$ values, ASP achieves an order of magnitude improvement in utility with minimal message complexity, and exhibits over threefold robustness compared to baseline methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于洗牌器的差分隐私（shuffle-DP）是一种隐私范例，通过使用洗牌器来排列来自用户的嘈杂报告，从而提供高实用性。现有的 shuffle-DP 协议主要集中于设计基于 shuffler 的 Calcategories 频率预言机（SCFO），用于分类数据的频率估计。然而，数值数据是一种更普遍的类型，许多现实世界的应用依赖于对具有序数性质的数据分布的估计。在本文中，我们研究了纯shuffle模型下的分布估计，这是一种流行的shuffle-DP框架，没有很强的安全性假设。我们最初尝试将现有的 SCFO 和简单的分发恢复技术移植到此任务中，并证明这些基线协议无法同时在三个指标上实现出色的性能：1）实用性，2）消息复杂性； 3）对数据中毒攻击的鲁棒性。因此，我们进一步提出了一种具有高实用性和鲁棒性的新颖的单消息 基于自适应洗牌器的分段 (ASP) 协议。在 ASP 中，我们首先使用我们提出的更紧密的互信息界限通过参数优化来开发随机发生器。我们还设计了一种 自适应平滑期望最大化 (EMAS) 算法，以准确恢复分布并增强鲁棒性。为了量化鲁棒性，我们提出了一个新的评估框架来检查不同攻击目标下的鲁棒性，使我们能够全面了解各种对抗场景下的协议弹性。大量实验表明 ASP 在所有三个指标上均优于基准协议。特别是在较小的 $ε$ 值下，ASP 以最小的消息复杂性实现了效用的一个数量级改进，并且与基线方法相比表现出三倍以上的稳健性。

papers.title: City-wide Origin-destination Matrix Generation via Cascaded Graph Denoising Diffusion
papers.title_zh: 通过级联图去噪扩散生成全市出发地-目的地矩阵
papers.authors: Can Rong, Jingtao Ding, Zhicheng Liu, Peng Lu, Yong Li
papers.abstract: The Origin-destination (OD) matrix provides an estimation of population mobility flow between regions, which is the backbone of modern spatial data systems, enabling critical tasks like urban simulation, traffic analysis and resource scheduling. However, expanding these systems to new cities is often hindered by data scarcity, lacking of historical mobility logs due to privacy or cost constraints. This calls for computational models to act as generative operators within spatial data pipelines, synthesizing dynamic mobility behaviors from static urban space. Existing works typically treat matrix entries as independent variables, overlooking the global relational structure of the flows. Consequently, these methods inevitably lose critical topological consistencies, resulting in synthetic data that lacks inherent network properties (e.g., sparsity and scaling behaviors), severely limiting its utility for complex spatial queries and analysis. Our research introduces a novel approach that views the OD matrix generation from a network perspective, utilizing the graph diffusion model to learn the joint probability distribution of matrix elements (edge weights) condition on regional city characteristics (node features). To overcome the difficulty of modeling city-wide OD matrix covering thousands of regions with millions of potential flows, our method employs a cascaded schema, initially constructing the network topology to pinpoint non-zero elements, i.e., OD flows. This design acts as a sparsity-aware filter, restricting the computationally expensive flow generation to only valid edges. This drastically improves the modeling efficiency, ensuring the scalability for large-scale, sparse spatial databases. To thoroughly reproduce important network properties contained in city-wide OD matrices, we design an elaborated graph denoising network integrating a node property augmentation module based on the graph transformer. Empirical experiments on three large US cities have verified that our method can generate OD matrices for new cities with network statistics remarkably similar to the ground truth, further achieving superior performance over competitive baselines in terms of the realism.
papers.abstract_zh: 出发地-目的地 (OD) 矩阵提供了对区域之间人口流动的估计，这是现代空间数据系统的支柱，可实现城市模拟、交通分析和资源调度等关键任务。然而，将这些系统扩展到新城市往往会受到数据稀缺、由于隐私或成本限制而缺乏历史移动日志的阻碍。这就需要计算模型在空间数据管道中充当生成算子，综合静态城市空间的动态移动行为。现有的工作通常将矩阵条目视为自变量，忽略了流的全局关系结构。因此，这些方法不可避免地会失去关键的拓扑一致性，导致合成数据缺乏固有的网络属性（例如稀疏性和缩放行为），严重限制了其在复杂空间查询和分析中的实用性。我们的研究引入了一种从网络角度看待OD矩阵生成的新方法，利用图扩散模型来学习矩阵元素（边权重）条件对区域城市特征（节点特征）的联合概率分布。为了克服对覆盖数千个区域和数百万个潜在流量的全市 OD 矩阵进行建模的困难，我们的方法采用级联模式，首先构建网络拓扑来精确定位非零元素，即 OD 流量。该设计充当稀疏感知过滤器，将计算成本高昂的流生成限制为仅有效边缘。这极大地提高了建模效率，确保了大规模、稀疏空间数据库的可扩展性。为了彻底再现全市 OD 矩阵中包含的重要网络属性，我们设计了一个精心设计的图去噪网络，集成了基于图转换器的节点属性增强模块。对美国三个大城市的实证实验证明，我们的方法可以为新城市生成 OD 矩阵，其网络统计数据与真实数据非常相似，进一步在真实性方面实现优于竞争基线的性能。

papers.title: Beyond Imputation: A Semantic Unification Framework for Data and Its Missingness in Multimodal Healthcare Analytics
papers.title_zh: 超越插补：多模态医疗保健分析中数据及其缺失的语义统一框架
papers.authors: Chaohe Zhang, Liantao Ma, Shiwei Lyu, Xin Gao, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang, Xu Chu
papers.abstract: Managing and analyzing multimodal data with pervasive missingness is a fundamental challenge in data engineering. This problem is particularly acute in domains like healthcare, where Electronic Health Records (EHRs) integrate diverse data types (structured tables, time-series, text) that are inherently incomplete at both the granular feature level and the coarsegrained modality level. Conventional strategies that either discard incomplete records or rely on error-prone imputation are illsuited for this reality, often introducing bias or a cascade of errors, especially when both missingness types co-exist. To address this challenge, We propose $\Sigma$-Care, a novel data representation and processing framework that fundamentally reframes data missingness not as a data quality defect to be repaired, but as an intrinsic semantic signal to be modeled. The core contribution is a semantic unification scheme that transforms heterogeneous, incomplete data, comprising present values, their provenance, explicit absence semantics and the task context, into a unified sequence of tokens. This representation sidesteps imputation and enables a task- and modality-aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to adaptively fuse these diverse information types. Extensive experiments demonstrated that $\Sigma$-Care outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple clinical tasks. Further analyses underscore its superior robustness against data scarcity, severe multi-level missingness, and co-existing patterns of featureand modality-level missingness. $\Sigma$-Care presents a new data engineering perspective for handling complex data: by directly modeling the structure and semantics of the available information, including its absence, we can build more resilient and effective analytical systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 管理和分析普遍缺失的多模态数据是数据工程中的一项基本挑战。这个问题在医疗保健等领域尤其严重，其中电子健康记录 (EHR) 集成了多种数据类型（结构化表、时间序列、文本），这些数据类型在粒度特征级别和粗粒度模态级别上本质上都是不完整的。丢弃不完整记录或依赖容易出错的插补的传统策略不适合这一现实，通常会引入偏差或一系列错误，特别是当两种缺失类型共存时。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 $\Sigma$-Care，这是一种新颖的数据表示和处理框架，它从根本上将数据缺失重新构建为要建模的内在语义信号，而不是要修复的数据质量缺陷。核心贡献是一种语义统一方案，它将异构的、不完整的数据（包括当前值、其来源、显式缺席语义和任务上下文）转换为统一的标记序列。这种表示方式回避了插补，并使任务和模态感知的专家混合 (MoE) 架构能够自适应地融合这些不同的信息类型。大量实验表明，$\Sigma$-Care 在多项临床任务中均优于最先进的基线。进一步的分析强调了其对数据稀缺、严重的多级缺失以及特征和模态级缺失共存模式的卓越鲁棒性。 $\Sigma$-Care 提出了处理复杂数据的新数据工程视角：通过直接对可用信息（包括其缺失）的结构和语义进行建模，我们可以构建更具弹性和有效的分析系统。
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成

papers.title: VisiFold: Long-Term Traffic Forecasting via Temporal Folding Graph and Node Visibility
papers.title_zh: VisiFold：通过时间折叠图和节点可见性进行长期流量预测
papers.authors: Zhiwei Zhang, Xinyi Du, Weihao Wang, Xuanchi Guo, Wenjuan Han
papers.abstract: Traffic forecasting is a cornerstone of intelligent transportation systems. While existing research has made significant progress in short-term prediction, long-term forecasting remains a largely uncharted and challenging frontier. Extending the prediction horizon intensifies two critical issues: escalating computational resource consumption and increasingly complex spatial-temporal dependencies. Current approaches, which rely on spatial-temporal graphs and process temporal and spatial dimensions separately, suffer from snapshot-stacking inflation and cross-step fragmentation. To overcome these limitations, we propose VisiFold. Our framework introduces a novel temporal folding graph that consolidates a sequence of temporal snapshots into a single graph. Furthermore, we present a node visibility mechanism that incorporates node-level masking and subgraph sampling to overcome the computational bottleneck imposed by large node counts. Extensive experiments show that VisiFold not only drastically reduces resource consumption but also outperforms existing baselines in long-term forecasting tasks. Remarkably, even with a high mask ratio of 80\%, VisiFold maintains its performance advantage. By effectively breaking the resource constraints in both temporal and spatial dimensions, our work paves the way for more realistic long-term traffic forecasting. The code is available at~ https://github.com/PlanckChang/VisiFold.
papers.abstract_zh: 交通预测是智能交通系统的基石。尽管现有研究在短期预测方面取得了重大进展，但长期预测仍然是一个很大程度上未知且具有挑战性的领域。扩展预测范围加剧了两个关键问题：不断增加的计算资源消耗和日益复杂的时空依赖性。当前的方法依赖于时空图并分别处理时间和空间维度，受到快照堆叠膨胀和跨步骤碎片的影响。为了克服这些限制，我们提出 VisiFold。我们的框架引入了一种新颖的时间折叠图，它将一系列时间快照合并到单个图中。此外，我们提出了一种节点可见性机制，该机制结合了节点级屏蔽和子图采样，以克服大节点数带来的计算瓶颈。大量实验表明，VisiFold 不仅大幅减少了资源消耗，而且在长期预测任务中的表现优于现有基线。值得注意的是，即使具有 80% 的高遮罩率，VisiFold 仍保持其性能优势。通过有效打破时间和空间维度上的资源限制，我们的工作为更现实的长期交通预测铺平了道路。代码可在〜https://github.com/PlanckChang/VisiFold 获取。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Resystance: Unleashing Hidden Performance of Compaction in LSM-trees via eBPF
papers.title_zh: Resystance：通过 eBPF 释放 LSM 树中压缩的隐藏性能
papers.authors: Hongsu Byun, Seungjae Lee, Honghyoen Yoo, MyoungJoon Kim, Sungyong Park
papers.abstract: The development of high-speed storage devices such as NVMe SSDs has shifted the primary I/O bottleneck from hardware to software. Modern database systems also rely on kernel-based I/O paths, where frequent system call invocations and kernel-user space transitions lead to relatively large overheads and performance degradation. This issue is particularly pronounced in Log-Structured Merge-tree (LSM-tree)-based NoSQL databases. We identified that, in particular, the background compaction process generates a large number of read system calls, causing significant overhead. To address this problem, we propose RESYSTANCE, which leverages eBPF and io_uring to free compaction from system calls and unlock hidden performance potential. RESYSTANCE improves disk I/O efficiency during read operations via io uring and significantly reduces software stack overhead by handling compaction directly inside the kernel through eBPF. Moreover, RESYSTANCE minimizes user-kernel transitions by offloading key I/O routines into the kernel without modifying the LSM-tree structure or compaction algorithm. RESYSTANCE was extensively evaluated using db_bench, YCSB, and OLTP workloads. Compared to baseline RocksDB, it reduced the average number of system call invocations during compaction by 99% and shortened compaction time by 50%. Consequently, in write-intensive workloads, RESYSTANCE improved throughput by up to 75% and reduced the p99 latency by 40%.
papers.abstract_zh: NVMe SSD等高速存储设备的发展，将主要的I/O瓶颈从硬件转移到了软件。现代数据库系统还依赖于基于内核的 I/O 路径，频繁的系统调用调用和内核-用户空间转换会导致相对较大的开销和性能下降。此问题在基于日志结构合并树 (LSM-tree) 的 NoSQL 数据库中尤其明显。我们发现，特别是后台压缩过程会生成大量读取系统调用，从而导致显著的开销。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 RESYSTANCE，它利用 eBPF 和 io_uring 将压缩从系统调用中解放出来，并释放隐藏的性能潜力。 RESYSTANCE 通过 io ing 提高读取操作期间的磁盘 I/O 效率，并通过 eBPF 直接在内核内部处理压缩，从而显著减少软件堆栈开销。此外，RESYSTANCE 通过将关键 I/O 例程卸载到内核中来最小化用户内核转换，而无需修改 LSM 树结构或压缩算法。使用 db_bench、YCSB 和 OLTP 工作负载对 RESYSTANCE 进行了广泛评估。与基线RocksDB相比，压缩过程中的平均系统调用调用次数减少了99%，压缩时间缩短了50%。因此，在写入密集型工作负载中，RESYSTANCE 将吞吐量提高了 75%，并将 p99 延迟降低了 40%。

papers.title: Subtree Mode and Applications
papers.title_zh: 子树模式及应用
papers.authors: Jialong Zhou, Ben Bals, Matei Tinca, Ai Guan, Panagiots Charalampopoulos, Grigorios Loukides, Solon Pissis
papers.abstract: The mode of a collection of values (i.e., the most frequent value in the collection) is a key summary statistic. Finding the mode in a given range of an array of values is thus of great importance, and constructing a data structure to solve this problem is in fact the well-known Range Mode problem. In this work, we introduce the Subtree Mode (SM) problem, the analogous problem in a leaf-colored tree, where the task is to compute the most frequent color in the leaves of the subtree of a given node. SM is motivated by several applications in domains such as text analytics and biology, where the data are hierarchical and can thus be represented as a (leaf-colored) tree. Our central contribution is a time-optimal algorithm for SM that computes the answer for every node of an input $N$-node tree in $O(N)$ time. We further show how our solution can be adapted for node-colored trees, or for computing the $k$ most frequent colors, for any given $k=O(1)$, in the optimal $O(N)$ time. Moreover, we prove that a similarly fast solution for when the input is a sink-colored directed acyclic graph instead of a leaf-colored tree is highly unlikely. Our experiments on real datasets with trees of up to $7.3$ billion nodes demonstrate that our algorithm is faster than baselines by at least one order of magnitude and much more space efficient. They also show that it is effective in pattern mining, sequence-to-database search, and biology applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 值集合的众数（即集合中最常见的值）是关键的汇总统计量。因此，寻找给定范围的值数组中的模式非常重要，而构建数据结构来解决这个问题实际上就是众所周知的范围模式问题。在这项工作中，我们引入了子树模式（SM）问题，这是叶子颜色树中的类似问题，其中的任务是计算给定节点的子树的叶子中最常见的颜色。 SM 的灵感来自于文本分析和生物学等领域的多种应用，其中数据是分层的，因此可以表示为（叶色）树。我们的核心贡献是 SM 的时间最优算法，它在 $O(N)$ 时间内计算输入 $N$ 节点树的每个节点的答案。我们进一步展示了我们的解决方案如何适用于节点颜色树，或者对于任何给定的 $k=O(1)$，在最佳 $O(N)$ 时间内计算 $k$ 最常见的颜色。此外，我们证明，当输入是水槽颜色的有向无环图而不是叶子颜色的树时，类似的快速解决方案是不太可能的。我们对包含最多 73 亿个节点的树的真实数据集进行的实验表明，我们的算法比基线快至少一个数量级，并且空间效率更高。他们还表明，它在模式挖掘、序列到数据库搜索和生物学应用中是有效的。
