papers.title: MM2SQL: A Benchmark and Method for Visually-Grounded SQL Generation
papers.title_zh: MM2SQL：基于可视化的 SQL 生成的基准和方法
papers.authors: Shengze Shi, Tao Ren, Li Qi, Tingrui Yang, Wei Xiong, Jun Hu
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL methods enable users to query databases using natural language, but they are limited to purely textual inputs and cannot handle queries involving visual evidence. While recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise for multimodal reasoning tasks, these models struggle with queries that require grounding visual content to database schemas. Hence, we introduce MM2SQL, a comprehensive benchmark and method for multimodal-to-SQL generation that bridges visual perception with structured database querying. To address the fundamental challenge of visual-schema alignment, we develop a systematic benchmark construction pipeline that captures varying levels of visual-schema complexity, from direct entity grounding to sophisticated contextual associations, ensuring that genuine multimodal reasoning is required rather than relying on unimodal shortcuts. Our training methodology employs a progressive framework with specially designed reward metrics that prioritize visual-schema alignment capabilities, moving beyond traditional SQL generation metrics to optimize for the unique challenges of visually-grounded database reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in execution accuracy across diverse visual reasoning scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 文本到SQL方法使用户能够使用自然语言查询数据库，但它们仅限于纯文本输入，并且无法处理涉及视觉证据的查询。虽然视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的最新进展在多模态推理任务中展现了前景，但这些模型在需要将视觉内容与数据库模式结合的查询方面遇到了困难。因此，我们引入了 MM2SQL，这是一种用于多模态到 SQL 生成的综合基准和方法，可将视觉感知与结构化数据库查询联系起来。为了解决视觉模式对齐的基本挑战，我们开发了一个系统的基准构建管道，捕获不同级别的视觉模式复杂性，从直接实体基础到复杂的上下文关联，确保需要真正的多模态推理，而不是依赖单模式捷径。我们的训练方法采用渐进式框架，其中包含专门设计的奖励指标，优先考虑视觉模式对齐功能，超越传统的 SQL 生成指标，针对基于视觉的数据库推理的独特挑战进行优化。实验结果表明，在不同的视觉推理场景中，执行准确性显著提高。

papers.title: Doux: Decoupling Values from Keys for Real-Time Analytics
papers.title_zh: Doux：将值与键解耦以进行实时分析
papers.authors: Shiming Yang, Yu Luo, Shuang Liu, Wei Lu, Kuien Liu, Yuxing Chen, Anqun Pan, Lixiong Zheng, Xiaoyong Du
papers.abstract: The Log-Structured Merge-tree (LSM-tree), widely adopted in real-time analytics systems, provides highperformance key-based operations such as point lookups and data ingestion, but suffers from poor efficiency on value-based queries, particularly range queries over secondary attributes. In this work, we propose Doux, a dual-tree storage architecture that combines a Key-Ordered Tree (KO-tree) and a Value-Ordered Tree (VO-tree) to accelerate value-range queries while preserving the high ingestion throughput and efficient key-based lookups of traditional LSM-trees. To further reduce maintenance overheads, Doux introduces two optimizations: a decoupled compaction mechanism that mitigates write amplification on the KO-tree, and DropMap, a compact auxiliary structure that reduces read amplification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Doux significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LSM-tree baselines, achieving 5.04× average speedup on value-range queries, 2.86× faster average real-time ingestion in write-intensive workloads, and 2.51× faster average point lookups in read-intensive workloads.
papers.abstract_zh: 日志结构合并树（LSM-tree）在实时分析系统中广泛采用，提供高性能的基于键的操作，例如点查找和数据摄取，但在基于值的查询（特别是对辅助属性的范围查询）上效率较低。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Doux，一种双树存储架构，它结合了键排序树（KO 树）和值排序树（VO 树）来加速值范围查询，同时保留传统 LSM 树的高摄取吞吐量和高效的基于键的查找。为了进一步减少维护开销，Doux 引入了两项优化：一种可以减轻 KO 树上的写放大的解耦压缩机制，以及一种可以减少读放大的紧凑辅助结构 DropMap。大量实验表明，Doux 的性能显著优于最先进的 LSM 树基线，在值范围查询上实现了 5.04 倍的平均加速，在写入密集型工作负载中平均实时摄取速度提高了 2.86 倍，在读取密集型工作负载中平均点查找速度提高了 2.51 倍。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Analysis of Candidate Keys in Relational Databases
papers.title_zh: 关系数据库中候选键的分析
papers.authors: Zihui Yang, Yuqian Ma, Sebastian Link
papers.abstract: Discovery algorithms in data profiling return an effective representation of all constraints from a given class, such as uniqueness constraints, that hold on the given dataset. Most of the results, however, do not express meaningful business rules but simply hold incidentally. Incomplete and inconsistent data makes the identification of business rules even harder, leading to approximate algorithms with huge computational complexity and few meaningful constraints among many incidental ones. Research is missing a methodology for analyzing the output of discovery algorithms. In response, we propose a framework for identifying and analyzing candidate keys in relational databases with incomplete or inconsistent data. The approach leverages uniqueness and completeness ratios, threshold-based key filtering, and counter-example analysis to identify meaningful keys, and incorporates specialization techniques and pruning strategies to ensure minimality and efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that key analysis improves F1 measures from state-of-the-art key mining between 36-99%, highlighting the necessity of humans-in-the-loop for decision making. Our pruning strategies yield up to 60% reduction in runtime for key analysis, lowering computational overheads while maintaining result quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据分析中的发现算法返回给定类中所有约束的有效表示，例如给定数据集上的唯一性约束。然而，大多数结果并没有表达有意义的业务规则，而只是偶然成立。不完整和不一致的数据使得业务规则的识别变得更加困难，导致近似算法计算复杂度巨大，并且在许多附带规则中很少有有意义的约束。研究缺乏分析发现算法输出的方法。作为回应，我们提出了一个框架，用于识别和分析具有不完整或不一致数据的关系数据库中的候选键。该方法利用唯一性和完整性比、基于阈值的键过滤和反例分析来识别有意义的键，并结合专业化技术和修剪策略来确保最少性和效率。实验表明，密钥分析将最先进的密钥挖掘的 F1 度量提高了 36-99%，凸显了人在循环中进行决策的必要性。我们的修剪策略可将关键分析的运行时间缩短高达 60%，从而降低计算开销，同时保持结果质量。

papers.title: Lequa: A Learning-Based Query-Aware Framework for Selective Query Optimization
papers.title_zh: Lequa：用于选择性查询优化的基于学习的查询感知框架
papers.authors: Guoneng Li, Pengfei Zheng, Ling Xu, Yan Li, Bolong Zheng
papers.abstract: Learning-based query optimizers have shown promise in improving database performance. However, existing learning-based methods often fail to consistently improve end-toend performance across all queries due to inference overhead and variability in both query characteristics and data distributions. To address these challenges, we propose Lequa, a learningbased query-aware framework that selects appropriate optimization strategies for each query based on expected performance gain and query complexity. Lequa addresses different queries through three components. The Unprofitable Query Recognizer component identifies queries unlikely to benefit from learned optimization and routes them directly to the default optimizer, avoiding unnecessary inference. The Struct Planner component uses a lightweight model based on dataset-agnostic features to handle queries whose optimal plans can be inferred from general structural patterns. For more complex queries where general patterns fall short, the Detail Planner component leverages datasetspecific features to produce higher-quality plans. Together, these components enable Lequa to generalize across diverse workloads while selectively applying fine-grained optimization where it matters most. Experiments on real-world workloads show that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to 55% reduction in end-to-end latency compared to PostgreSQL.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于学习的查询优化器在提高数据库性能方面已显示出希望。然而，由于推理开销以及查询特征和数据分布的可变性，现有的基于学习的方法通常无法持续提高所有查询的端到端性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Lequa，一个基于学习的查询感知框架，它根据预期的性能增益和查询复杂性为每个查询选择适当的优化策略。 Lequa 通过三个组件处理不同的查询。 Unprofitable Query Recognizer 组件可识别不太可能从学习优化中受益的查询，并将它们直接路由到默认优化器，从而避免不必要的推理。 Struct Planner 组件使用基于与数据集无关的功能的轻量级模型来处理可以从一般结构模式推断其最佳计划的查询。对于一般模式无法满足的更复杂的查询，详细规划器组件利用数据集特定的功能来生成更高质量的计划。这些组件共同使 Lequa 能够泛化不同的工作负载，同时有选择地在最重要的地方应用细粒度优化。对现实工作负载的实验表明，我们的方法始终优于最先进的基准，与 PostgreSQL 相比，端到端延迟降低了 55%。

papers.title: Robust Spatial-Temporal Similar Trajectory Search via Structure-Enhanced Domain-Invariant Learning
papers.title_zh: 通过结构增强域不变学习进行鲁棒时空相似轨迹搜索
papers.authors: Xiaolin Han, Yonghao Zhou, Chenhao Ma, Lingyun Song, Xinbiao Gan, Xuequn Shang
papers.abstract: Similar trajectory search is a fundamental task in spatial-temporal data analysis, supporting applications such as route planning, traffic forecasting, and mobility behavior understanding. However, existing methods often struggle to generalize across domains. In this paper, we address the problem of robust spatial-temporal similar trajectory search, which aims to generalize across multiple domains or cities, and is applicable to nonuniform trajectory data with irregular time intervals from diverse sources. This task is particularly challenging when deploying such systems across multiple cities or regions, where urban layouts, road networks, and mobility behaviors can differ dramatically. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel Robust similar Trajectory search (RoTraj) framework that introduces structure-enhanced domain-invariant learning to improve cross-domain generalization for non-uniform data. Specifically, RoTraj aligns variablelength trajectories through dynamic spatial-temporal dependency modeling, and employs an adaptive domain discriminator to learn domain-invariant representations for effective knowledge transfer. Moreover, it incorporates a structure-enhanced intradomain dynamics learning module that captures intrinsic structural similarities despite geometric discrepancies, leading to more discriminative and robust trajectory embeddings for similarity computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoTraj significantly outperforms existing approaches with 72.6% improvement on average. Implementation details and code are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RoTraj5022.
papers.abstract_zh: 相似轨迹搜索是时空数据分析中的一项基本任务，支持路线规划、交通预测和移动行为理解等应用。然而，现有的方法通常难以跨领域推广。在本文中，我们解决了鲁棒的时空相似轨迹搜索问题，其目的是跨多个领域或城市进行泛化，并且适用于来自不同来源的具有不规则时间间隔的非均匀轨迹数据。当在多个城市或地区部署此类系统时，这项任务尤其具有挑战性，因为这些城市或地区的城市布局、道路网络和出行行为可能存在巨大差异。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的鲁棒相似轨迹搜索（RoTraj）框架，该框架引入了结构增强的域不变学习来改进非均匀数据的跨域泛化。具体来说，RoTraj 通过动态时空依赖建模来对齐可变长度轨迹，并采用自适应域鉴别器来学习域不变表示，以实现有效的知识迁移。此外，它还采用了结构增强的域内动态学习模块，尽管存在几何差异，但仍能捕获内在的结构相似性，从而为相似性计算提供更具辨别力和鲁棒性的轨迹嵌入。大量实验表明，RoTraj 的性能明显优于现有方法，平均提高了 72.6%。实现细节和代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RoTraj5022 上公开获取。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: LLMSQLMUTATOR: LLM-Powered Test Case Generation for Database Using Bug Reports
papers.title_zh: LLMSQLMUTATOR：使用错误报告为数据库生成 LLM 支持的测试用例
papers.authors: Chenglin Tian, Chaofan Li, Yawen Li, Yingxia Shao
papers.abstract: Relational Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are fundamental to modern software infrastructure, yet their inherent complexity and continuous evolution introduce critical defects that compromise data integrity and system reliability. While existing syntax-based and mutation-based automated testing approaches have demonstrated utility in DBMS validation, they suffer from three significant limitations, that are low quality seed SQLs, lack of bug knowledge, and ignorance of fine-grained constraints. To address these limitations, we propose LLM-SQLMutator, an innovative mutation-based automated DBMS testing tool that leverages large language models (LLMs) and bug reports. LLMSQLMUTATOR extracts the SQL statements from the bug report as mutation seeds, and extracts bug patterns and root causes from the bug reports as mutation guidance. Considering the semantic understanding capability of LLMs, we introduce bug-driven SQL mutation which uses LLMs to perform syntax-aware directed mutations on seed SQLs under the guidance of the bug knowledge. Finally, we propose the LLMbased semantic validation that uses database metadata as the basic validation knowledge and dynamically expand validation rules via LLMs, thereby helping LLMSQLMutator achieve comprehensive semantic validation. Extensive evaluations across six popular relational DBMSs demonstrate the advantages of LLMSQLMutator, and it detects 27 confirmed bugs.
papers.abstract_zh: 关系数据库管理系统 (DBMS) 是现代软件基础设施的基础，但其固有的复杂性和不断的发展带来了严重的缺陷，损害了数据完整性和系统可靠性。虽然现有的基于语法和基于突变的自动化测试方法已在 DBMS 验证中展示了实用性，但它们面临三个重大限制，即低质量的种子 SQL、缺乏 bug 知识以及对细粒度约束的无知。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 LLM-SQLMutator，这是一种基于突变的创新自动化 DBMS 测试工具，它利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 和错误报告。 LLMSQLMUTATOR 从错误报告中提取 SQL 语句作为突变种子，并从错误报告中提取错误模式和根本原因作为突变指导。考虑到LLM的语义理解能力，我们引入了错误驱动的SQL突变，即使用LLM在错误知识的指导下对种子SQL进行语法感知的定向突变。最后，我们提出了基于LLM的语义验证，以数据库元数据作为基本验证知识，并通过LLM动态扩展验证规则，从而帮助LLMSQLMutator实现全面的语义验证。对六种流行的关系 DBMS 的广泛评估证明了 LLMSQLMutator 的优势，它检测到 27 个已确认的错误。

papers.title: Toward scalable Tucker decomposition: skew-aware multi-level partitioning with GPU–storage co-processing
papers.title_zh: 迈向可扩展的 Tucker 分解：具有 GPU 存储协同处理的倾斜感知多级分区
papers.authors: Seung Hyeon Song, Jihye Lee, Chanki Kim, Kang-Wook Chon
papers.abstract: Given billion- scale sparse tensors with highly skewed distributions, how can Tucker decomposition be performed both scalably and robustly?Tucker decomposition is a principled method for capturing latent structures and cross- mode interactions across diverse domains. However, its applicability to billion- scale tensors is fundamentally constrained by two major challenges: (1) the intermediate data explosion, and (2) severe data skew, which lead to memory exhaustion. Existing CPU-, GPU-, and distributed- based approaches alleviate runtime only in limited scenarios but fail to scale under skewed, billion- scale tensors. To overcome these limitations, we present the GSP- Tucker framework, a scalable and robust Tucker decomposition system. GSP- Tucker integrates four key components: (1) skew- aware multi- level partitioning that adaptively splits dense tensor regions into balanced sub- tensors, (2) GPU acceleration for high- throughput factor updates, (3) a multi- level asynchronous I/O pipeline that overlaps storage- to- GPU data transfers with GPU kernels to maximize bandwidth utilization, and (4) a tiling streaming technique that reduces main memory requirements. This unified design of partitioning, data representation, computation, and I/O eliminates intermediate data explosion and mitigates skew- induced failures. Extensive experiments with real datasets, including billion- scale sparse tensors, demonstrate that GSP- Tucker is (1) scalable, efficiently processing tensors with billions of nonzeros; (2) robust, handling highly skewed distributions that prior methods cannot process; and (3) efficient, fully utilizing GPUs and high- bandwidth storage.
papers.abstract_zh: 给定具有高度倾斜分布的十亿级稀疏张量，如何可扩展且鲁棒地执行塔克分解？塔克分解是一种捕获不同领域的潜在结构和跨模式交互的原理方法。然而，它对十亿级张量的适用性从根本上受到两个主要挑战的限制：（1）中间数据爆炸，（2）严重的数据倾斜，导致内存耗尽。现有的基于 CPU、GPU 和分布式的方法仅在有限的场景中减少运行时间，但无法在倾斜的十亿级张量下进行扩展。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 GSP-Tucker 框架，这是一个可扩展且强大的 Tucker 分解系统。 GSP-Tucker 集成了四个关键组件：(1) 倾斜感知多级分区，自适应地将密集张量区域分割为平衡子张量；(2) 用于高吞吐量因子更新的 GPU 加速；(3) 多级异步 I/O 管道，将存储到 GPU 数据传输与 GPU 内核重叠，以最大限度地提高带宽利用率；(4) 减少主内存需求的平铺流技术。这种分区、数据表示、计算和 I/O 的统一设计消除了中间数据爆炸并减轻了倾斜引起的故障。对真实数据集（包括十亿级稀疏张量）的广泛实验表明，GSP-Tucker 具有以下特点：（1）可扩展、高效处理具有数十亿个非零值的张量； (2) 稳健，能够处理现有方法无法处理的高度偏态分布； (3) 高效、充分利用 GPU 和高带宽存储。

papers.title: Mitigating GenAI-powered Evidence Pollution for Out-of-Context Misinformation Detection
papers.title_zh: 减轻 GenAI 支持的断章取义错误信息检测的证据污染
papers.authors: Zehong Yan, Peng Qi, Wynne Hsu, Mong Li Lee
papers.abstract: While generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models have achieved significant success, their misuse for generating deceptive content raises growing concerns about online information security. Out-of-context (OOC) multimodal misinformation detection systems typically rely on Web-retrieved evidence to identify images repurposed in false contexts, but they are increasingly challenged by the presence of GenAI-polluted evidence. Existing work mainly focuses on verifying claims that have undergone stylistic rewriting at the claim level and assume a clean evidence corpus. In this work, we remove this assumption and systematically study the impact of GenAI-driven evidence pollution threat on OOC detection. We show that polluted evidence can degrade the performance of state-of-the-art detectors by more than 9 percentage points. We propose two mitigating strategies, cross-modal evidence reranking and cross-modal claim-evidence reasoning, to address the challenge posed by polluted evidence. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approaches effectively enhance the robustness of existing OOC detectors amidst polluted evidence. The source code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/YanZehong/GenAI-Evidence-Pollution.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然生成人工智能 (GenAI) 模型取得了巨大成功，但其滥用来生成欺骗性内容引发了人们对在线信息安全的日益担忧。脱离上下文 (OOC) 多模态错误信息检测系统通常依赖于网络检索的证据来识别在虚假上下文中重新利用的图像，但它们越来越受到 GenAI 污染证据的挑战。现有的工作主要集中在验证在权利要求级别经过文体重写的权利要求并假设干净的证据语料库。在这项工作中，我们消除了这一假设，并系统地研究了 GenAI 驱动的证据污染威胁对 OOC 检测的影响。我们证明，受污染的证据会使最先进探测器的性能降低 9 个百分点以上。我们提出了两种缓解策略，即跨模式证据重新排序和跨模式主张证据推理，以应对污染证据带来的挑战。对两个基准数据集的广泛实验表明，我们的方法有效地增强了现有 OOC 探测器在污染证据中的鲁棒性。源代码和数据可在 https://github.com/YanZehong/GenAI-Evidence-Pollution 上公开获取。

papers.title: Efficient Query Rewrite Rule Discovery via Standardized Enumeration and Learning-to-Rank
papers.title_zh: 通过标准化枚举和学习排名进行高效查询重写规则发现
papers.authors: Yuan Zhang, Yuxing Chen, Yuekun Yu, Jinbin Huang, Rui Mao, Anqun Pan, Lixiong Zheng, Jianbin Qin
papers.abstract: Query rewriting is essential for database performance optimization, but existing automated rule enumeration methods suffer from exponential search spaces, severe redundancy, and poor scalability, especially when handling complex query plans with five or more nodes, where a node represents an operator in the plan tree. We present SLER, a scalable system that enables efficient and effective rewrite rule discovery by combining standardized template enumeration with a learning to rank approach. SLER uses standardized templates, abstractions of query plans with operator structures preserved but data specific details removed, to eliminate structural redundancies and drastically reduce the search space. A learn to rank model guides enumeration by pre filtering the most promising template pairs, enabling scalable rule generation for large node templates. Evaluated on over 11000 real world SQL queries from both open source and commercial workloads, SLER has automatically constructed a rewrite rule repository exceeding 1 million rules - the largest empirically validated rewrite rule library to date. Notably, at the scale of one million rules, SLER supports query plan templates with complexity up to channel level depth. This unprecedented scale opens the door to discovering highly intricate transformations across diverse query patterns. Critically, SLER's template driven design and learned ranking mechanism are inherently extensible, allowing seamless integration of new and complex operators, paving the way for next generation optimizers powered by comprehensive, adaptive rule spaces.
papers.abstract_zh: 查询重写对于数据库性能优化至关重要，但现有的自动规则枚举方法存在指数搜索空间、严重冗余和可扩展性差的问题，特别是在处理具有五个或更多节点的复杂查询计划时，其中一个节点代表计划树中的一个运算符。我们提出了 SLER，这是一个可扩展的系统，通过将标准化模板枚举与学习排序方法相结合，可以实现高效且有效的重写规则发现。 SLER 使用标准化模板、保留运算符结构但删除数据特定细节的查询计划抽象，以消除结构冗余并大幅减少搜索空间。学习对模型进行排序，通过预先过滤最有希望的模板对来指导枚举，从而为大型节点模板生成可扩展的规则。通过对来自开源和商业工作负载的 11000 多个现实世界 SQL 查询进行评估，SLER 自动构建了超过 100 万条规则的重写规则存储库 - 迄今为止最大的经经验验证的重写规则库。值得注意的是，在一百万条规则的规模上，SLER 支持复杂度高达通道级别深度的查询计划模板。这种前所未有的规模为发现跨不同查询模式的高度复杂的转换打开了大门。至关重要的是，SLER 的模板驱动设计和学习排序机制本质上是可扩展的，允许无缝集成新的复杂运算符，为由全面的自适应规则空间支持的下一代优化器铺平道路。

papers.title: Text2SQL-Flow: A Robust SQL-Aware Data Augmentation Framework for Text-to-SQL
papers.title_zh: Text2SQL-Flow：用于文本到 SQL 的强大 SQL 感知数据增强框架
papers.authors: Qifeng Cai, Hao Liang, Chang Xu, Tao Xie, Wentao Zhang, Bin Cui
papers.abstract: The data-centric paradigm has emerged as a pivotal direction in artificial intelligence (AI), emphasizing the role of high-quality training data. This shift is especially critical in the Text-to-SQL task, where the scarcity, limited diversity, and structural simplicity of existing datasets constrain model performance. To address these challenges, we propose Text2SQL-Flow, a SQL-aware data augmentation framework that systematically generates large-scale, semantically valid, and structurally diverse Text-to-SQL pairs from limited seed data. Our framework spans six augmentation dimensions and integrates an end-to-end pipeline with auxiliary database selection, SQL executability verification, natural language (NL) question generation, NL-SQL correspondence verification, and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning trace generation. Leveraging this framework, we construct SQLFlow, a high-quality dataset comprising 75,386 annotated examples. We demonstrate the utility of SQLFlow in both fine-tuning and prompt-based settings. (1) For open-source large language models (LLMs), fine-tuning with SQLFlow improves problem-solving ability, delivering competitive gains across multiple benchmarks under the same data budget. (2) For closed-source LLMs, we propose a masked alignment retrieval method that uses SQLFlow as both a knowledge base and training data for the retrieval model, enabling structure-aware example matching via fine-grained NL-SQL alignments. Experiments show that our retrieval strategy outperforms existing example retrieval methods, highlighting the combined value of SQLFlow's data quality and our retrieval technique. Overall, our work provides a scalable, data-centric foundation for advancing Text-to-SQL systems and underscores the importance of structured, high-fidelity data in modern AI development. Our code is available at https://github.com/TechNomad-ds/Text2SQL-Flow.
papers.abstract_zh: 以数据为中心的范式已成为人工智能（AI）的关键方向，强调高质量训练数据的作用。这种转变在文本到 SQL 任务中尤其重要，因为现有数据集的稀缺性、多样性有限和结构简单性限制了模型性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Text2SQL-Flow，这是一种 SQL 感知数据增强框架，可以从有限的种子数据中系统地生成大规模、语义有效且结构多样的文本到 SQL 对。我们的框架跨越六个增强维度，并将端到端管道与辅助数据库选择、SQL 可执行性验证、自然语言 (NL) 问题生成、NL-SQL 对应验证和思想链 (CoT) 推理跟踪生成集成在一起。利用这个框架，我们构建了 SQLFlow，这是一个包含 75,386 个带注释示例的高质量数据集。我们演示了 SQLFlow 在微调和基于提示的设置中的实用性。 (1) 对于开源大语言模型 (LLM)，使用 SQLFlow 进行微调可以提高解决问题的能力，在相同的数据预算下在多个基准测试中提供竞争优势。 (2) 对于闭源大语言模型，我们提出了一种掩码对齐检索方法，该方法使用 SQLFlow 作为检索模型的知识库和训练数据，通过细粒度的 NL-SQL 对齐实现结构感知示例匹配。实验表明，我们的检索策略优于现有的示例检索方法，凸显了 SQLFlow 的数据质量和我们的检索技术的综合价值。总的来说，我们的工作为推进文本到 SQL 系统提供了可扩展的、以数据为中心的基础，并强调了结构化、高保真数据在现代人工智能开发中的重要性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/TechNomad-ds/Text2SQL-Flow 获取。

papers.title: Efficient Size Constraint Community Search over Heterogeneous Information Networks
papers.title_zh: 异构信息网络上的高效规模约束社区搜索
papers.authors: Xinjian Zhang, Chengfei Liu, Lu Chen, Rui Zhou, Bo Ning
papers.abstract: The goal of community search in heterogeneous information networks (HINs) is to identify a set of closely related target nodes that includes a query target node. In practice, a size constraint is often imposed due to limited resources, which has been overlooked by most existing HIN community search works. In this paper, we introduce the size-bounded community search problem to HIN data. Specifically, we propose a refined (k, P)-truss model to measure community cohesiveness, aiming to identify the most cohesive community of size s that contains the query node. We prove that this problem is NP-hard. To solve this problem, we develop a novel B\&B framework that efficiently generates target node sets of size s. We then tailor novel bounding, branching, total ordering, and candidate reduction optimisations, which enable the framework to efficiently lead to an optimum result. We also design a heuristic algorithm leveraging structural properties of HINs to efficiently obtain a high-quality initial solution, which serves as a global lower bound to further enhance the above optimisations. Building upon these, we propose two exact algorithms that enumerate combinations of edges and nodes, respectively. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 异构信息网络（HIN）中社区搜索的目标是识别一组密切相关的目标节点，其中包括查询目标节点。在实践中，由于资源有限，常常会施加大小限制，而大多数现有的 HIN 社区搜索工作都忽视了这一点。在本文中，我们引入了 HIN 数据的大小有界社区搜索问题。具体来说，我们提出了一种精炼的 (k, P)-truss 模型来衡量社区凝聚力，旨在识别包含查询节点的大小为 s 的最具凝聚力的社区。我们证明这个问题是NP-hard问题。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种新颖的 B\&B 框架，可以有效地生成大小为 s 的目标节点集。然后，我们定制新颖的边界、分支、全排序和候选减少优化，使框架能够有效地产生最佳结果。我们还设计了一种启发式算法，利用 HIN 的结构特性来有效地获得高质量的初始解决方案，该解决方案作为全局下界以进一步增强上述优化。在此基础上，我们提出了两种精确的算法，分别枚举边和节点的组合。对现实世界数据集的大量实验证明了所提出方法的有效性和效率。

papers.title: SOLAR: Efficient Spatial Queries on Real-time LSM-based Storage
papers.title_zh: SOLAR：基于 LSM 的实时存储的高效空间查询
papers.authors: Jingyi Yang, Jiachen Shi, Jian Chen, Gao Cong
papers.abstract: The burgeoning volumes of spatial data demand spatial databases that support both fast ingestion and efficient queries. Existing LSM-tree-based systems handle high write throughput but remain suboptimal for spatial queries due to their general-purpose storage design. We present SOLAR, an LSMbased spatial data store that embeds spatial awareness as a firstclass design principle. SOLAR adopts a spatial-centric storage model where each level is organized into clustered sorted runs to improve spatial locality. Building on this layout, we design query processing algorithms that effectively prune away irrelevant LSM component files for both spatial range queries and KNN queries. To further enhance write performance, we propose a selective compaction paradigm with a cost model-based selection policy, which reduces write amplification while producing clustered sorted runs that optimize query performance. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the superior performance of SOLAR over existing LSM-based and page-oriented spatial data systems across different dynamic workload scenarios.
papers.abstract_zh: 不断增长的空间数据量需要支持快速摄取和高效查询的空间数据库。现有的基于 LSM 树的系统可以处理高写入吞吐量，但由于其通用存储设计，对于空间查询来说仍然不是最佳的。我们推出 SOLAR，这是一种基于 LSM 的空间数据存储，它将空间意识作为一流的设计原则嵌入其中。 SOLAR 采用以空间为中心的存储模型，其中每个级别都组织为集群排序运行，以提高空间局部性。在此布局的基础上，我们设计了查询处理算法，可以有效地删除空间范围查询和 KNN 查询中不相关的 LSM 组件文件。为了进一步提高写入性能，我们提出了一种具有基于成本模型的选择策略的选择性压缩范例，该范例可以减少写入放大，同时生成优化查询性能的集群排序运行。对真实世界数据集的实验证明，在不同的动态工作负载场景中，SOLAR 优于现有的基于 LSM 和面向页面的空间数据系统。

papers.title: SQLVec: SQL-Based Vector Similarity Search
papers.title_zh: SQLVec：基于 SQL 的向量相似性搜索
papers.authors: Zequn Zhang, Yuanyuan 	Zhu, Hao Zhang, Jeffrey Xu Yu
papers.abstract: Vector data is ubiquitous in many applications, primarily due to the advances in deep learning that enable the representation of diverse data types as vectors. A number of vector databases have been developed to support efficient vector similarity search, and they are generally categorized into two types: specialized and generalized. The latter are gaining increasing interest as they can eliminate data silos and support complex query processing for both vector and non-vector data. However, these systems, built on specific databases, must construct and access vector indices via low-level, database-specific APIs. This requires substantial engineering effort and hinders their migration to alternative databases. In this paper, for the first time, we study whether vector similarity search can be efficiently mapped into SQL, which is independent of the underlying databases and naturally portable across relational databases. We propose a general framework SQLVec, which decomposes the vector search process into a set of atomic operators to support different variants of search tasks flexibly. We map these operators to efficient SQL statements and then further optimize them on search strategies and distance computations to accelerate vector search across various scenarios. We deployed our framework SQLVec on two representative relational databases, and conducted extensive evaluation to compare it with existing vector databases extended from them. Our experimental results demonstrate the portability of SQLVec across relational databases and show that it matches or outperforms existing systems on diverse vector search variants.
papers.abstract_zh: 矢量数据在许多应用中无处不在，这主要是由于深度学习的进步使得多种数据类型能够表示为矢量。已经开发了许多矢量数据库来支持有效的矢量相似性搜索，它们通常分为两类：专用型和通用型。后者越来越受到人们的关注，因为它们可以消除数据孤岛并支持矢量和非矢量数据的复杂查询处理。然而，这些基于特定数据库构建的系统必须通过低级、特定于数据库的 API 构建和访问向量索引。这需要大量的工程工作，并阻碍它们迁移到替代数据库。在本文中，我们首次研究向量相似性搜索是否可以有效地映射到SQL，它独立于底层数据库并且可以自然地跨关系数据库移植。我们提出了一个通用框架SQLVec，它将向量搜索过程分解为一组原子运算符，以灵活支持搜索任务的不同变体。我们将这些运算符映射为高效的 SQL 语句，然后在搜索策略和距离计算上进一步优化它们，以加速跨各种场景的向量搜索。我们在两个代表性关系数据库上部署了我们的框架 SQLVec，并进行了广泛的评估，以将其与从它们扩展的现有向量数据库进行比较。我们的实验结果证明了 SQLVec 跨关系数据库的可移植性，并表明它在各种向量搜索变体上匹配或优于现有系统。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: Data-Segmentation Prompt based Continual Learning Framework for Online Spatio-Temporal Prediction
papers.title_zh: 基于数据分割提示的在线时空预测持续学习框架
papers.authors: Banglie Yang, Liwei Deng, Cheng Dai, Kai Zheng
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of physical sensors continuously generates massive spatio-temporal data streams, supporting critical applications such as transportation management and environmental monitoring. However, in realworld settings, the sensor network often evolves dynamically, where both the data distribution and graph structure change over time. These dynamics pose fundamental challenges to online spatio-temporal prediction, including catastrophic forgetting, high retraining cost, and efficiency degradation. To address these issues, we propose DepCL, a data-segmentation prompt–based continual learning framework from the perspective of spatio-temporal data management. DepCL partitions nodes into clusters according to distribution discrepancies and associates each cluster with lightweight learnable prompts, enabling efficient model adaptation through prompt retrieval and fine-tuning. Furthermore, a Gradient Projection–based Knowledge Balance mechanism theoretically rectifies gradient updates to preserve historical representations while maintaining model plasticity. Additionally, to mitigate representation conflicts caused by node imbalance, we introduce a Density-Aware Sample Alignment strategy that adaptively strengthens learning on newly arrived nodes. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that DepCL achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 物理传感器的快速扩散不断产生大量时空数据流，支持交通管理和环境监测等关键应用。然而，在现实世界中，传感器网络通常会动态发展，数据分布和图形结构都会随着时间的推移而变化。这些动态对在线时空预测提出了根本性挑战，包括灾难性遗忘、高再训练成本和效率下降。为了解决这些问题，我们从时空数据管理的角度提出了DepCL，一种基于数据分割提示的持续学习框架。 DepCL 根据分布差异将节点划分为集群，并将每个集群与轻量级可学习提示相关联，通过提示检索和微调实现高效的模型适应。此外，基于梯度投影的知识平衡机制理论上可以纠正梯度更新，以保留历史表征，同时保持模型的可塑性。此外，为了减轻由节点不平衡引起的表示冲突，我们引入了密度感知样本对齐策略，该策略自适应地加强对新到达节点的学习。对三个真实世界数据集的大量实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，DepCL 实现了卓越的准确性和效率。
topics: 时间序列、流与时序数据

papers.title: Efficient Graph Matching with Pattern Reduction
papers.title_zh: 通过模式缩减进行高效的图匹配
papers.authors: Pingpeng Yuan, Yujiang Wang, Jiangji Peng, Tianyu Ma, Siyuan He, Ling Liu
papers.abstract: The prevalence of similar sub-structures in graphs and the inherent characteristics of graph matching tasks incur a large amount of redundant data accesses and computations. Many existing graph matching approaches to date first identify some sub-structures (e.g., symmetric structure, dense subgraphs) of the pattern graphs, which then serve as the basis to reduce or postpone Cartesian products in graph matching tasks. However, the methods based on the structures may not work efficiently when such structures are fewer or absent in pattern graphs. This paper presents PMiner - an efficient pattern-reduction approach to both undirected and directed graph matching problem with three original contributions. First, we exploit the inclusion relationships between the matching sets of edges and vertices in the pattern graph and convert the redundancy reduction in subgraph matching into a pattern reduction problem. Second, we reduce the original pattern graph to a more compact pattern graph by finding a minimum edge constraint cover over the pattern graph with the goal of reducing redundant data accesses and redundant computations. Finally, PMiner generates an efficient execution plan for the subgraph matching problem, consisting of an exploration plan and a materialization plan. When executing this plan, PMiner employs a bi-directional breadth-first search with mini-frontiers and reuses partial matches, ensuring low memory usage. By transforming a graph matching problem into a pattern reduction problem, PMiner can address both undirected and directed graph matching problems in a uniform manner while it effectively minimizes redundant operations for both data access and graph exploration throughout the graph matching process. Extensive experiments show that PMiner outperforms the representative standalone directed and undirected graph matching methods or systems and can scale to complex graph pattern matching tasks on large graphs.
papers.abstract_zh: 图中相似子结构的普遍存在以及图匹配任务的固有特征会导致大量冗余的数据访问和计算。迄今为止，许多现有的图匹配方法首先识别模式图的一些子结构（例如，对称结构、密集子图），然后作为减少或推迟图匹配任务中笛卡尔积的基础。然而，当模式图中此类结构较少或不存在时，基于结构的方法可能无法有效工作。本文提出了 PMiner - 一种针对无向和有向图匹配问题的有效模式缩减方法，具有三个原始贡献。首先，我们利用模式图中边和顶点的匹配集之间的包含关系，并将子图匹配中的冗余减少转换为模式减少问题。其次，我们通过寻找模式图上的最小边缘约束覆盖，将原始模式图简化为更紧凑的模式图，目的是减少冗余数据访问和冗余计算。最后，PMiner 为子图匹配问题生成一个高效的执行计划，包括探索计划和物化计划。在执行该计划时，PMiner 采用带有迷你边界的双向广度优先搜索并重用部分匹配，从而确保较低的内存使用量。通过将图匹配问题转化为模式约简问题，PMiner 可以以统一的方式解决无向和有向图匹配问题，同时有效地减少整个图匹配过程中数据访问和图探索的冗余操作。大量实验表明，PMiner 的性能优于代表性的独立有向和无向图匹配方法或系统，并且可以扩展到大型图上的复杂图模式匹配任务。

papers.title: EDITOR: Multi-Resolution Cleaning of Multivariate Time Series via Detect-Localize-Repair
papers.title_zh: 编辑器：通过检测-定位-修复对多变量时间序列进行多分辨率清理
papers.authors: Chenyang Li, Chaohong Ma, Xiaohui Yu, Cailong Li, Xiaofeng Meng
papers.abstract: Multivariate time series (MTS) power downstream decisions, yet real-world MTS often contain errors with varying magnitudes and granularities (e.g., points, subsequences, crossvariable), breaking temporal and inter-variable dependencies. Most existing cleaning methods rely on fixed windows, which (i) miss subtle deviations and (ii) over-clean correct values. We introduce EDITOR, a multi-resolution framework that separates error detection, localization, and repair to improve cleaning precision while preserving MTS structure: (i) High-Sensitivity Detection (HSD) identifies erroneous windows (coarse regions likely to contain errors) using a dual-attention UNet, a differenceenhanced UNet, and dynamic thresholding to capture a broad range of anomalies. (ii) Multi-Granularity Localization (MGL) operates within each detected window, casting fine-grained localization as constrained optimization under learned temporal and cross-variable dependencies. It leverages evolutionary search to pinpoint erroneous points, subsequences or cross-variable concurrence while minimizing collateral changes. (iii) ContextAware Repair (CAR) applies a two-stage bidirectional correction: a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) restores temporal coherence, followed by a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) for cross-variable consistency, both in forward and backward directions. EDITOR outperforms strong baselines across five datasets and improves downstream tasks. Ablation studies confirm the necessity of each module.
papers.abstract_zh: 多元时间序列 (MTS) 为下游决策提供支持，但现实世界的 MTS 通常包含不同大小和粒度（例如点、子序列、交叉变量）的错误，从而破坏了时间和变量间的依赖性。大多数现有的清洁方法都依赖于固定窗口，这（i）会错过细微的偏差，（ii）会过度清洁正确的值。我们引入了 EDITOR，一种多分辨率框架，它将错误检测、定位和修复分开，以提高清洁精度，同时保留 MTS 结构：（i）高灵敏度检测（HSD）使用双注意力 UNet、差分增强 UNet 和动态阈值来识别错误窗口（可能包含错误的粗略区域），以捕获广泛的异常。 (ii) 多粒度定位 (MGL) 在每个检测到的窗口内运行，将细粒度定位转换为学习时间和跨变量依赖性下的约束优化。它利用进化搜索来查明错误点、子序列或跨变量并发，同时最大限度地减少附带变化。 (iii) ContextAware Repair (CAR) 应用两阶段双向校正：时间卷积网络 (TCN) 恢复时间一致性，然后是图卷积网络 (GCN) 以实现前向和后向的跨变量一致性。 EDITOR 在五个数据集上的表现优于强大的基线，并改进了下游任务。消融研究证实了每个模块的必要性。

papers.title: GLIDE: GPU-Accelerated ANN Graph Index Construction via Data Locality
papers.title_zh: GLIDE：通过数据局部性进行 GPU 加速的 ANN 图索引构建
papers.authors: Fuhao Ruan, Ziyang Yue, Ling Xu, Dawei Liu, Bolong Zheng
papers.abstract: Graph-based ANN indexes offer state-of-the-art search performance, but suffer from prohibitively long construction times on CPUs. Although recent studies leverage GPU parallelism to accelerate graph construction, they still face key limitations, including redundant computations and poor scalability. To address these issues, we propose GLIDE, a GPUaccelerated graph construction method that leverages data locality. First, GLIDE adopts a locality-aware partitioning strategy to better group vectors, and designs a fine-grained parallel paradigm to efficiently construct high-locality sub-graphs. These sub-graphs allow most nodes to connect with their neighbors, dramatically reducing redundancy. Second, GLIDE presents a lightweight merging technique that treats boundary points as key connectors, which completely eliminates ANN searches during merging. Since all phases of construction operate without all vectors into GPU memory, GLIDE scales effectively to large-scale vector datasets. Third, by leveraging the enhanced data locality, GLIDE further introduces a query-aware search algorithm that restricts the search space to regions likely to contain relevant neighbors, improving search efficiency. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that, compared to state-of-the-art method, GLIDE achieves up to $3.0 \times$ faster construction while delivering competitive search performance. Notably, GLIDE constructs a graph index for SIFT100M in just 13 minutes, and the average query latency is $3 \mu ~\mathrm{s}$ at recall@10 of 95%.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于图的 ANN 索引提供最先进的搜索性能，但在 CPU 上的构建时间过长。尽管最近的研究利用 GPU 并行性来加速图形构建，但它们仍然面临关键限制，包括冗余计算和较差的可扩展性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 GLIDE，一种利用数据局部性的 GPU 加速图构建方法。首先，GLIDE采用局部感知划分策略来更好地对向量进行分组，并设计细粒度并行范式来有效构建高局部性子图。这些子图允许大多数节点与其邻居连接，从而显著减少冗余。其次，GLIDE提出了一种轻量级合并技术，将边界点视为关键连接器，完全消除了合并过程中的ANN搜索。由于构建的所有阶段都无需将所有向量放入 GPU 内存中进行操作，因此 GLIDE 可以有效地扩展到大规模向量数据集。第三，通过利用增强的数据局部性，GLIDE进一步引入了查询感知搜索算法，将搜索空间限制在可能包含相关邻居的区域，从而提高搜索效率。综合实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，GLIDE 的构建速度最高达到该方法的 3.0 倍，同时提供了具有竞争力的搜索性能。值得注意的是，GLIDE 仅用了 13 分钟就构建了 SIFT100M 的图索引，在 recall@10 为 95% 时，平均查询延迟为 $3 \mu ~\mathrm{s}$。

papers.title: Fast k-means via Data-Aware Grouping and Gap-Optimized Lower Bound
papers.title_zh: 通过数据感知分组和间隙优化下界进行快速 k 均值
papers.authors: Xiaogang Huang, Dan Zhuang, Jianbao Chen, Tiefeng Ma, Shuangzhe Liu
papers.abstract: Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering is a fundamental and widely used method for cluster discovery across various domains. However, its application to large-scale data is limited by the need to compute all point-to-centroid distances in each iteration. In this paper, we present a new bound-based implementation of Lloyd's algorithm that significantly improves computational efficiency through data-aware grouping and gap-optimized lower-bound computation. By partitioning the centroids based on the underlying data distribution, the data-aware grouping strategy produces tighter maintained lower bounds, thereby achieving a better balance between the costs of distance and non-distance computations. Furthermore, we introduce a mechanism that prioritizes the most informative dimensions to compute lower bounds, enabling the proposed implementation to skip unnecessary exact distance computations without compromising clustering accuracy. We prove that the proposed lower-bound computation is optimized with respect to data distribution under an orthogonal transformation. Experimental results confirm that the proposed implementation significantly outperforms the existing methods in efficiency.
papers.abstract_zh: Lloyd 的 $k$ 均值聚类算法是跨各个领域的聚类发现的基本且广泛使用的方法。然而，它在大规模数据中的应用受到每次迭代中计算所有点到质心距离的限制。在本文中，我们提出了劳埃德算法的一种新的基于界限的实现，该算法通过数据感知分组和间隙优化下界计算显著提高了计算效率。通过根据底层数据分布划分质心，数据感知分组策略产生更严格的维护下限，从而在距离和非距离计算的成本之间实现更好的平衡。此外，我们引入了一种机制，优先考虑信息最丰富的维度来计算下界，使所提出的实现能够跳过不必要的精确距离计算，而不会影响聚类精度。我们证明所提出的下界计算针对正交变换下的数据分布进行了优化。实验结果证实，所提出的实现在效率上显著优于现有方法。

papers.title: BAMG: A Block-Aware Monotonic Graph Index for Disk-Based Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.title_zh: BAMG：基于磁盘的近似最近邻搜索的块感知单调图索引
papers.authors: Huiling Li, Xin Huang, Byron Choi, Jianliang Xu
papers.abstract: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) over high-dimensional vectors is a foundational problem in databases, where disk I/O often emerges as the dominant performance bottleneck at scale. To accelerate search, graph-based indexes rely on proximity graph, where nodes represent vectors and edges guide the traversal toward the target. However, existing graph indexing solutions for disk-based ANNS typically either optimize the storage layout for a given graph or construct the graph independently of the storage layout, thus overlooking their interaction. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proposing the Block-aware Monotonic Relative Neighborhood Graph (BMRNG), theoretically guaranteeing the existence of I/O monotonic search paths. The core idea is to align the graph topology with the data placement by jointly considering both geometric distance and storage layout for edge selection. To address the scalability challenge of BMRNG construction, we further develop a practical and efficient variant, the Block-Aware Monotonic Graph (BAMG), which can be constructed in linear time from a monotonic graph considering the storage layout. BAMG integrates block-aware edge pruning with a decoupled storage design that separates raw vectors from the graph index, thereby maximizing block utilization and minimizing redundant disk reads. Additionally, we design a multi-layer navigation graph for adaptive and efficient query entry, along with a block-first search algorithm that prioritizes intra-block traversal to fully exploit each disk I/O operation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that BAMG can outperform state-of-the-art methods in search performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 高维向量上的近似最近邻搜索 (ANNS) 是数据库中的一个基本问题，其中磁盘 I/O 经常成为大规模的主要性能瓶颈。为了加速搜索，基于图的索引依赖于邻近图，其中节点表示向量，边引导遍历到目标。然而，基于磁盘的 ANN 的现有图索引解决方案通常要么优化给定图的存储布局，要么独立于存储布局构建图，从而忽略了它们的交互。在本文中，我们通过提出块感知单调相对邻域图（BMRNG）来弥补这一差距，从理论上保证了 I/O 单调搜索路径的存在。其核心思想是通过共同考虑边选择的几何距离和存储布局来使图拓扑与数据放置保持一致。为了解决 BMRNG 构建的可扩展性挑战，我们进一步开发了一种实用且高效的变体，即块感知单调图（BAMG），它可以在考虑存储布局的情况下从单调图在线性时间内构建。 BAMG 将块感知边缘修剪与解耦存储设计相结合，将原始向量与图索引分开，从而最大限度地提高块利用率并最大限度地减少冗余磁盘读取。此外，我们还设计了一个用于自适应和高效查询输入的多层导航图，以及一个块优先搜索算法，该算法优先考虑块内遍历以充分利用每个磁盘 I/O 操作。对现实世界数据集的大量实验表明，BAMG 在搜索性能方面可以超越最先进的方法。

papers.title: Representative Functional Dependencies
papers.title_zh: 代表性的功能依赖
papers.authors: Qiongqiong Lin, Jingyan Sai, Jiazheng Song, Jinfei Liu, Kui Ren, Tianzhen Wang, Yanbei Pang, Feifei Li
papers.abstract: Functional dependencies (FDs) have been extensively employed in many applications, including query optimization, data cleaning, data obfuscation, and schema normalization. However, the number of FDs grows drastically as the dimensionality of datasets expands, making it impractical for large-scale applications operating on the complete set of FDs to utilize every FD. In this paper, we formulate the problem of representative FD discovery as obtaining a subset of FDs that effectively represents the complete set. Representativeness is measured by the pairwise similarity of FDs because similar FDs often convey duplicative information. In contrast to selecting a representative subset from the complete set after FD discovery, we extract it directly during the discovery process for superior efficiency. Specifically, our algorithm integrates the representativeness verification into the lattice traversal strategy (a prominent method in FD discovery) to significantly reduce the costly validation of FD candidates by only validating representative ones. Furthermore, we enhance our algorithm with three sophisticated designs: nearest indexes to prune the search space, dynamic stripped partitions to accelerate the FD validation, and a compressed FD-tree to guarantee the FD minimality, respectively. Experimental results on real-world and synthetic datasets justify the design of representative FDs and verify the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.
papers.abstract_zh: 函数依赖（FD）已广泛应用于许多应用程序中，包括查询优化、数据清理、数据混淆和模式规范化。然而，随着数据集维数的扩展，FD 的数量急剧增加，这使得在整套 FD 上运行的大规模应用程序利用每个 FD 是不切实际的。在本文中，我们将代表性 FD 发现问题表述为获取有效代表完整集合的 FD 子集。代表性是通过 FD 的成对相似性来衡量的，因为相似的 FD 经常传达重复的信息。与 FD 发现后从完整集中选择代表性子集相比，我们在发现过程中直接提取它，以实现更高的效率。具体来说，我们的算法将代表性验证集成到格遍历策略（FD 发现中的一种重要方法）中，通过仅验证代表性候选来显著减少 FD 候选的验证成本。此外，我们还通过三种复杂的设计增强了我们的算法：用于修剪搜索空间的最近索引、用于加速 FD 验证的动态剥离分区以​​及用于保证 FD 最小性的压缩 FD 树。真实世界和合成数据集上的实验结果证明了代表性 FD 设计的合理性，并验证了所提出算法的效率和有效性。

papers.title: Unveiling Semantically Cohesive Structures: Maximal Meta-Path Clique Enumeration in Heterogeneous Graphs
papers.title_zh: 揭示语义内聚结构：异构图中的最大元路径派枚举
papers.authors: Tao Yu, Wen Deng, Weiguo Zheng, Jeffrey Xu Yu
papers.abstract: Existing clique mining tasks primarily focus on homogeneous graphs, often overlooking the exploration of cliques with rich semantic information in heterogeneous graphs. In this paper, we propose a novel task called maximal metapath clique enumeration (MPE) on heterogeneous graphs. By leveraging the fundamental concept of meta path, MPE enables the discovery of dense substructures exhibiting similar semantic relationships among vertices. To tackle this task, we design a two-step framework involving meta-path graph construction and maximal meta-path clique enumeration. Specifically, we present the MPE++ approach, which introduces a label propagationbased paradigm to facilitate the meta-path graph construction and a graph reduction technique based on equivalent sets to accelerate intensive clique enumeration. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic graphs confirm the effectiveness of our proposed algorithms, while comprehensive case studies and applications in recommendation systems demonstrate the usefulness of meta-path cliques.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的派系挖掘任务主要关注同质图，往往忽视了对异构图中具有丰富语义信息的派系的探索。在本文中，我们提出了一种称为异构图上的最大元路径团枚举（MPE）的新任务。通过利用元路径的基本概念，MPE 能够发现顶点之间表现出相似语义关系的密集子结构。为了解决这个任务，我们设计了一个两步框架，涉及元路径图构建和最大元路径派枚举。具体来说，我们提出了 MPE++ 方法，该方法引入了基于标签传播的范例以促进元路径图的构建，以及基于等效集的图缩减技术以加速密集的团枚举。对真实图和合成图的大量实验证实了我们提出的算法的有效性，而推荐系统中的全面案例研究和应用则证明了元路径派系的有用性。

papers.title: Fast Content-Aware Influence Maximization Query Answering by labeling Index
papers.title_zh: 通过标签索引快速回答内容感知影响力最大化查询
papers.authors: Xingliang Lv, Qihao Shi, Can Wang, Mingli Song, Wenliang Du, Wujian Yang, Guanlin Chen
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study the Content-Aware Influence Maximization (CAIM) query-answering problem. Given the abundant research on the IM problem, CAIM is one of its most practical variants. In the CAIM problem, network edge probabilities change according to the content (topic) of the item being spread. The query-answering task, therefore, requires efficiently finding a set of seed nodes that maximizes the item's influence spread. Although SOTA IM methods can achieve nearlinear time complexity, repeatedly executing them for each query is still prohibitively expensive when the number of queries is large. In this paper, we propose a novel labeling-based index approach. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first index framework for dealing with the CAIM query-answering task. By constructing a space-efficient data structure for the index, we pre-store content-aware reachability information. A Reachability Table Estimation (RTE) method is developed, which can compute the lower bound of the reachability probability for any pair of nodes and any topic, with a time complexity dependent only on the number of topics. In addition, we design a scalable pruning mechanism (PRTE) to further speed up the estimation, as well as a lazy-forward-based greedy algorithm for seed node selection. Extensive experiments are conducted on real-world datasets. The results demonstrate that the proposed index-based methods can achieve influence spread performance comparable to SOTA IM methods, while speeding up the query-answering time by several orders of magnitude. We hope this work can open abundant future directions for other query-answering tasks of IM variants, or on uncertain graphs, from an index-based perspective.
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究内容感知影响最大化（CAIM）查询回答问题。鉴于对 IM 问题的大量研究，CAIM 是其最实用的变体之一。在 CAIM 问题中，网络边缘概率根据所传播项目的内容（主题）而变化。因此，查询回答任务需要有效地找到一组种子节点，以最大化项目的影响力传播。尽管 SOTA IM 方法可以实现近线性时间复杂度，但当查询数量很大时，为每个查询重复执行它们的成本仍然过高。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于标签的索引方法。据我们所知，这是第一个处理 CAIM 查询应答任务的索引框架。通过为索引构建节省空间的数据结构，我们预先存储内容感知的可达性信息。开发了可达性表估计（RTE）方法，该方法可以计算任何节点对和任何主题的可达性概率的下界，时间复杂度仅取决于主题的数量。此外，我们设计了可扩展剪枝机制（PRTE）以进一步加快估计速度，以及用于种子节点选择的基于惰性前向的贪婪算法。在现实世界的数据集上进行了大量的实验。结果表明，所提出的基于索引的方法可以实现与 SOTA IM 方法相当的影响传播性能，同时将查询应答时间加快几个数量级。我们希望这项工作能够从基于索引的角度为 IM 变体的其他查询回答任务或不确定图打开丰富的未来方向。

papers.title: Semantic Compression for Sound and Complete Query Answering over Knowledge Graphs
papers.title_zh: 通过知识图进行声音和完整查询应答的语义压缩
papers.authors: Junhua Ma, Jianfeng Du, Hai Wan, Yue Yu, Qunxun Qi, Weilin Luo, Yanan Liu
papers.abstract: To improve storage efficiency, semantic compression approaches filter triples in knowledge graphs (KGs) by mining and applying semantic patterns. However, these approaches typically require full decompression, which limits their practicality. To avoid decompression while keeping the reasoning capacity of KGs, we propose QSC, a queryable semantic compression approach for KGs, enabling sound and complete query answering over compressed KGs without decompression. QSC relies on logical rules and we introduce the notion of first-order rewritable language to express the rules in QSC. Through a first-order rewritable set of rules, a KG can be compressed into another one with fewer triples, while any given query can be rewritten to another query to which the set of answers over the compressed KG is the same as the set of answers to the original query over the original KG. We present a Bayesian optimization-based method for efficiently selecting compression configurations that balance compression and query performance. We also introduce a lightweight redundancy identification mechanism that incrementally filters triples. Compared to the uncompressed baseline, QSC is empirically shown to reduce the number of triples to averagely $\mathbf{7 8} \boldsymbol{\%}, \mathbf{7 6} \boldsymbol{\%}$, and $\mathbf{8 0} \boldsymbol{\%}$ while achieving averagely $\mathbf{0. 8 5} \times$, 0.89×, and 1.08× queries-per-second (QPS) for PostgreSQL, DuckDB and Neo4j, respectively. The code has been open-sourced at https://github.com/ma853529615/QSC.
papers.abstract_zh: 为了提高存储效率，语义压缩方法通过挖掘和应用语义模式来过滤知识图（KG）中的三元组。然而，这些方法通常需要完全减压，这限制了它们的实用性。为了避免解压缩，同时保持知识图谱的推理能力，我们提出了 QSC，一种用于知识图谱的可查询语义压缩方法，无需解压缩即可对压缩知识图谱进行健全且完整的查询回答。 QSC依赖于逻辑规则，我们引入一阶可重写语言的概念来表达QSC中的规则。通过一阶可重写规则集，一个知识图谱可以被压缩为另一个具有更少三元组的知识图谱，而任何给定的查询都可以重写为另一个查询，该查询的压缩知识图谱上的答案集与原始知识图谱上的原始查询的答案集相同。我们提出了一种基于贝叶斯优化的方法，用于有效地选择平衡压缩和查询性能的压缩配置。我们还引入了一种轻量级冗余识别机制，可以增量过滤三元组。与未压缩的基线相比，经验表明 QSC 可以将三元组的数量平均减少到 $\mathbf{7 8} \boldsymbol{\%}、\mathbf{7 6} \boldsymbol{\%}$ 和 $\mathbf{8 0} \boldsymbol{\%}$，PostgreSQL、DuckDB 和 Neo4j 的每秒查询数（QPS）分别平均达到基线的 0.85 倍、0.89 倍和 1.08 倍。该代码已在 https://github.com/ma853529615/QSC 开源。

papers.title: FlashEKGR: Fast Embedding-Based Knowledge Graph Reasoning Models Training
papers.title_zh: FlashEKGR：基于快速嵌入的知识图推理模型训练
papers.authors: Wentai Zhang, Teng Xu, Weiguang Wang, Junxing Li, Jun Zhang, Yifan Zhu, Haihong E
papers.abstract: Embedding-based Knowledge Graph Reasoning (EKGR) models embed entities, relations, and queries into a unified vector space for logical reasoning. However, their training suffers from severe inefficiencies due to redundant computations, I/O bottlenecks, and unoptimized GPU kernels. To address this, we propose FlashEKGR, a multi-level co-optimization framework designed to unleash the full potential of modern hardware for EKGR training. At the logical level, we propose Logical Operator Parallelism (LOP) to eliminate redundant computations and I/O by merging common logic operator prefixes in query structures. At the dataflow level, we design a Staleness-Free Pipeline (SFP) to effectively overlap the latency of data preparation with model computation. At the GPU execution level, we introduce two key techniques: Layout-Aware Kernel Design (LAK), which resolves the memory-access inefficiency caused by the asymmetric data layouts inherent in negative samples, and Dynamic CUDA Graph Caching (DGC), which significantly reduces kernel launch overhead for dynamic query structures. Extensive experiments on public datasets show that FlashEKGR achieves end-to-end speedups ranging from 2.06× to 5.67× over state-of-the-art frameworks, while maintaining reasoning accuracy. Our code is released at https://github.com/BUPT-Reasoning-Lab/FlashEKGR.
papers.abstract_zh: 基于嵌入的知识图推理（EKGR）模型将实体、关系和查询嵌入到统一的向量空间中以进行逻辑推理。然而，由于冗余计算、I/O 瓶颈和未优化的 GPU 内核，他们的训练效率严重低下。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 FlashEKGR，这是一个多级协同优化框架，旨在释放现代 EKGR 训练硬件的全部潜力。在逻辑层面，我们提出逻辑运算符并行（LOP），通过合并查询结构中的通用逻辑运算符前缀来消除冗余计算和 I/O。在数据流层面，我们设计了一个无陈旧管道（SFP），以有效地将数据准备和模型计算的延迟重叠。在GPU执行层面，我们引入了两项关键技术：布局感知内核设计（LAK），它解决了负样本固有的不对称数据布局导致的内存访问效率低下的问题；动态CUDA图形缓存（DGC），它显著减少了动态查询结构的内核启动开销。对公共数据集的大量实验表明，FlashEKGR 比最先进的框架实现了 2.06 倍到 5.67 倍的端到端加速，同时保持了推理准确性。我们的代码发布于 https://github.com/BUPT-Reasoning-Lab/FlashEKGR。

papers.title: OMNIA: Closing the Loop by Leveraging LLMs for Knowledge Graphs Completion
papers.title_zh: OMNIA：利用大语言模型补全知识图谱，形成闭环
papers.authors: Frédéric IENG, Massinissa Hammaz, Soror Sahri, Mourad OUZZANI, Salima Benbernou, Hanieh Khorashadizadeh‡, Sven Groppe, Farah Benamara
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are widely used to represent structured knowledge, yet their automatic construction, especially with Large Language Models (LLMs), often results in incomplete or noisy outputs. Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) aims to infer and add missing triples, but most existing methods either rely on structural embeddings that overlook semantics or language models that ignore the graph's structure and depend on external sources. In this work, we present OMNIA, a two-stage approach that bridges structural and semantic reasoning for KGC. It first generates candidate triples by clustering semantically related entities and relations within the KG, then validates them through lightweight embedding filtering followed by LLM-based semantic validation. OMNIA performs on the internal KG, without external sources, and specifically targets implicit semantics that are most frequent in LLM-generated graphs. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that OMNIA significantly improves F1-score compared to traditional embedding-based models. These results highlight OMNIA's effectiveness and efficiency, as its clustering and filtering stages reduce both search space and validation cost while maintaining high-quality completion.
papers.abstract_zh: 知识图（KG）广泛用于表示结构化知识，但它们的自动构建，尤其是大型语言模型（LLM），通常会导致输出不完整或有噪声。知识图补全（KGC）旨在推断和添加缺失的三元组，但大多数现有方法要么依赖于忽略语义的结构嵌入，要么依赖于忽略图结构并依赖于外部源的语言模型。在这项工作中，我们提出了 OMNIA，这是一种为 KGC 架起结构和语义推理桥梁的两阶段方法。它首先通过对知识图谱中语义相关的实体和关系进行聚类来生成候选三元组，然后通过轻量级嵌入过滤和基于 LLM 的语义验证来验证它们。 OMNIA 在内部 KG 上执行，无需外部源，并且专门针对 LLM 生成的图中最常见的隐式语义。对多个数据集的大量实验表明，与传统的基于嵌入的模型相比，OMNIA 显著提高了 F1 分数。这些结果凸显了 OMNIA 的有效性和效率，因为其聚类和过滤阶段减少了搜索空间和验证成本，同时保持了高质量的完成。

papers.title: MISFEAT: Feature Selection for Subgroups with Mutual Information Estimation
papers.title_zh: MISFEAT：具有互信息估计的子组特征选择
papers.authors: Bar Genossar, Thinh On, Md Mouinul Islam, Ben Eliav, Senjuti Basu Roy, Avigdor Gal
papers.abstract: Mutual information (MI) quantifies the dependence between features and target variables and is widely used in feature selection for downstream tasks. Due to the computational burden of exact MI computation, it is often estimated using statistical or learning-based methods. When data can be partitioned into subgroups, accurate MI estimation becomes even more challenging, as each subgroup may exhibit distinct featuretarget relationships. We introduce a framework that models feature-subgroup-target interactions as a multiplex graph and applies a heterogeneous graph neural network to propagate information between feature combinations both within and across subgroups. Our method efficiently identifies top- $K$ predictive feature subsets per subgroup while addressing key scalability challenges. Extensive empirical evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach, offering, to the best of our knowledge, the first graph-based framework for subgroupaware MI estimation.
papers.abstract_zh: 互信息（MI）量化了特征和目标变量之间的依赖关系，广泛应用于下游任务的特征选择。由于精确 MI 计算的计算负担，通常使用统计或基于学习的方法进行估计。当数据可以划分为子组时，准确的 MI 估计变得更具挑战性，因为每个子组可能表现出不同的特征目标关系。我们引入了一个框架，将特征-子组-目标交互建模为多重图，并应用异构图神经网络在子组内和子组间的特征组合之间传播信息。我们的方法有效地识别每个子组的 top-$K$ 预测特征子集，同时解决关键的可扩展性挑战。广泛的实证评估证明了我们方法的有效性和效率，据我们所知，提供了第一个基于图形的子群体感知 MI 估计框架。

papers.title: Improving Data Imputation through a Tuned Strategy for Dependency Discovery
papers.title_zh: 通过依赖关系发现的调整策略改进数据插补
papers.authors: Bernardo Breve, Loredana Caruccio, Tullio Pizzuti, Giuseppe Polese
papers.abstract: Data Imputation approaches aim at improving the quality of data trying to infer values often missing into data. Among others, dependency-based imputation approaches exploit data relationships among attributes, such as Relaxed Functional Dependencies relaxing on the attribute comparison $\left(\text{RFD}_{c} \mathrm{s}\right)$, to provide semantically coherent and less biased imputations by exploiting similar candidate tuples. However, according to the possibility of considering variable similarity threshold combinations, existing RFD $_{c}$ discovery algorithms can limit imputation quality or become impractical for big datasets. In this paper, we propose triard, a tuned strategy for dependency discovery that iteratively adjusts similarity thresholds based on imputation performance, thus selecting the most effective $\mathbf{R F D}_{c} \mathbf{s}$ for selecting tuple candidates to impute missing values. Experimental results on 20 real-world datasets show the improvement in both imputation performance and execution time with respect to the $\mathbf{R F D}_{c} \mathbf{s}$ discovered by the algorithm domino. Moreover, triard resulted in a higher imputation performance, mainly in terms of precision, when compared with other Data Imputation approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 数据插补方法旨在提高数据质量，试图推断数据中经常缺失的值。其中，基于依赖关系的插补方法利用属性之间的数据关系，例如放宽的函数依赖关系，放松属性比较 $\left(\text{RFD}_{c} \mathrm{s}\right)$，通过利用相似的候选元组来提供语义连贯且偏差较小的插补。然而，根据考虑变量相似性阈值组合的可能性，现有的 RFD $_{c}$ 发现算法可能会限制插补质量或对于大数据集变得不切实际。在本文中，我们提出了 triard，一种用于依赖性发现的调整策略，它根据插补性能迭代调整相似性阈值，从而选择最有效的 $\mathbf{R F D}_{c} \mathbf{s}$ 来选择元组候选来插补缺失值。 20 个真实世界数据集的实验结果表明，相对于多米诺骨牌算法发现的 $\mathbf{R F D}_{c} \mathbf{s}$，插补性能和执行时间都有所改善。此外，与其他数据插补方法相比，三元组带来了更高的插补性能，主要是在精度方面。

papers.title: QPAD: Quantile-Preserving Approximate Dimension Reduction for Nearest Neighbors Preservation in High-Dimensional Vector Search
papers.title_zh: QPAD：高维向量搜索中最近邻保留的分位数保留近似降维
papers.authors: Jiuzhou Fu, Dongfang Zhao
papers.abstract: High-dimensional vector embeddings are widely used in retrieval systems, but they often suffer from noise, the curse of dimensionality, and slow runtime. However, dimensionality reduction (DR) is rarely applied due to its tendency to distort the nearest-neighbor (NN) structure that is critical for search. Existing DR techniques such as PCA and UMAP optimize global or manifold-preserving criteria, rather than retrieval-specific objectives. We present QPAD -- Quantile-Preserving Approximate Dimension Reduction, an unsupervised DR method that explicitly preserves approximate NN relations by maximizing the margin between k-NNs and non-k-NNs under a soft orthogonality constraint. We analyze its complexity and favorable properties. This design enables QPAD to retain ANN-relevant geometry without supervision or changes to the original embedding model, while supporting scalability for large-scale vector search and being indexable for ANN search. Experiments across five domains show that QPAD consistently outperforms eleven standard DR methods in preserving neighborhood structure, enabling more accurate search in reduced dimensions.
papers.abstract_zh: 高维向量嵌入广泛应用于检索系统，但它们经常受到噪声、维数灾难和运行速度慢的影响。然而，降维（DR）很少被应用，因为它会扭曲对搜索至关重要的最近邻（NN）结构。现有的 DR 技术（例如 PCA 和 UMAP）优化全局或流形保留标准，而不是特定于检索的目标。我们提出了 QPAD——分位数保留近似降维，这是一种无监督 DR 方法，它通过在软正交性约束下最大化 k-NN 和非 k-NN 之间的余量来显式保留近似 NN 关系。我们分析其复杂性和有利的特性。这种设计使 QPAD 能够保留与 ANN 相关的几何形状，而无需监督或更改原始嵌入模型，同时支持大规模矢量搜索的可扩展性并可针对 ANN 搜索进行索引。跨五个领域的实验表明，QPAD 在保留邻域结构方面始终优于 11 种标准 DR 方法，从而能够在减小的维度中实现更准确的搜索。
topics: 向量检索与相似性搜索

papers.title: ZTab: Domain-based Zero-shot Annotation for Table Columns
papers.title_zh: ZTab：表列的基于域的零样本注释
papers.authors: Ehsan Hoseinzade, Ke Wang
papers.abstract: This study addresses the challenge of automatically detecting semantic column types in relational tables, a key task in many real-world applications. Zero-shot modeling eliminates the need for user-provided labeled training data, making it ideal for scenarios where data collection is costly or restricted due to privacy concerns. However, existing zero-shot models suffer from poor performance when the number of semantic column types is large, limited understanding of tabular structure, and privacy risks arising from dependence on high-performance closed-source LLMs. We introduce ZTab, a domain-based zero-shot framework that addresses both performance and zero-shot requirements. Given a domain configuration consisting of a set of predefined semantic types and sample table schemas, ZTab generates pseudo-tables for the sample schemas and fine-tunes an annotation LLM on them. ZTab is domain-based zero-shot in that it does not depend on user-specific labeled training data; therefore, no retraining is needed for a test table from a similar domain. We describe three cases of domain-based zero-shot. The domain configuration of ZTab provides a trade-off between the extent of zero-shot and annotation performance: a "universal domain" that contains all semantic types approaches "pure" zero-shot, while a "specialized domain" that contains semantic types for a specific application enables better zero-shot performance within that domain. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/hoseinzadeehsan/ZTab
papers.abstract_zh: 这项研究解决了自动检测关系表中语义列类型的挑战，这是许多实际应用程序中的一项关键任务。零样本建模消除了对用户提供的标记训练数据的需要，使其成为数据收集成本高昂或由于隐私问题而受到限制的场景的理想选择。然而，现有的零样本模型在语义列类型数量较大时性能较差，对表格结构的理解有限，并且由于依赖高性能闭源LLM而产生隐私风险。我们引入了 ZTab，一个基于域的零样本框架，可以满足性能和零样本要求。给定由一组预定义语义类型和示例表模式组成的域配置，ZTab 为示例模式生成伪表并在其上微调注释 LLM。 ZTab 是基于领域的零样本，因为它不依赖于用户特定的标记训练数据；因此，不需要对来自类似域的测试表进行重新训练。我们描述了基于域的零样本的三种情况。 ZTab 的域配置提供了零样本范围和注释性能之间的权衡：包含所有语义类型的“通用域”接近“纯”零样本，而包含特定应用程序的语义类型的“专用域”可在该域内实现更好的零样本性能。源代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/hoseinzadeehsan/ZTab 获取
topics: 多模态、表格与数据生成
